title: Lisa's Pony

title: Lisa's Pony

title: Lisa's Pony

spoken_words: Woo-hoo!

title: Lisa's Pony

spoken_words: Always I dreamed the day would come when one of you would be working for me!

title: Lisa's Pony
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I won't lie to you. On this job you will be shot at.

title: Lisa's Pony
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Each of these bullet wounds is a badge of honor.

title: Lisa's Pony

title: Lisa's Pony

title: Lisa's Pony

spoken_words: Busted!

title: Lisa's Pony
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll work form midnight to eight, come home, sleep for five minutes, eat breakfast, sleep six more minutes, shower, then I have ten minutes to spend as I please. Then I'm off to the power plant, fresh as a daisy.

spoken_words: Mmm... salty.

spoken_words: I'm sorry, baby. While I am here pleasuring you, my store is going down the tubes.

spoken_words: Three dollars and fifty-one... fifty-two... fifty-three cents.

title: Lisa's Pony
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Homer! You are asleep at your post! Now go change the expiration dates on the dairy products.

title: Lisa's Pony

spoken_words: Yes sir.

title: Lisa's Pony

spoken_words: Sorry baby, date's over.

spoken_words: Homie, how long do you plan to do this?

spoken_words: I don't know. How long do horses live?

spoken_words: No.

title: Lisa's Pony

spoken_words: No, Bart. No one's going to make her. This is something Lisa has to decide for herself.

title: Lisa's Pony
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All the years I've lobbied to be treated like an adult has blown up in my face.

title: Lisa's Pony

spoken_words: And fill it to the top this time.

name: Homer Simpson

spoken_words: She likes a little carrot after her oats. And she really likes it when you scratch her behind the ear. And if you're playing the radio, she likes contemporary adult in the morning and easy listening at night. Please take good care of my Princess.

name: Lisa Simpson

spoken_words: What--- wha, da, you call this melted cheese receptacle clean? Eh, the young man you replaced is rolling over in his grave.

spoken_words: Dad, you don't have to do this.

spoken_words: Dad, I understand the sacrifice you've made for me. That's why I gave up the pony.

spoken_words: Hmmm hmmm. There's a big dumb animal I love even more than that horse.

spoken_words: Oh no! What is it, a hippopotamus!

spoken_words: Awww.

spoken_words: Apu. You can take this job and re-staff it!

spoken_words: Giddyup, Dad.

spoken_words: Shh! They'll hear you.

spoken_words: Who's using the power tools?

spoken_words: Anything for my little girl.

name: Homer Simpson

spoken_words: Ooooooh, McBain.

name: Marge Simpson

spoken_words: They want a name, Homer, not a vague description.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. Hank.

spoken_words: Hank?! Hank who?

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hank... Jones.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you made that up. Question two: "Who is your son's hero?"

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Steve McQueen.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's your hero. "Name another dad you talked to about parenting."

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Next.

spoken_words: What are your son's hobbies?

spoken_words: He hasn't done that since he was two.

spoken_words: Then he has no hobbies.

spoken_words: Bart!... BART!!!

spoken_words: What?

spoken_words: You don't have any hobbies, do you boy?

spoken_words: No, not really.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, that's what I... Wait a minute. What are you doing?

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Building a Soap Box Derby racer.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's a hobby!

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, so it is.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my God. I don't know jack about my boy... I'm a bad father!

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm also fat!

title: Saturdays of Thunder

spoken_words: Ho, ho... if he's as smart as he is funny, I'm sold.

spoken_words: Huh?

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, how I envy you!

title: Saturdays of Thunder

spoken_words: I've never been afraid of a little hard work.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What boy?

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he is building a soapbox derby racer.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!... I'm gonna help you build that racer.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, but I'm almost done. Why don't you get back on the couch and watch TV?

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. No, I'm gonna do it.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry dad, but three time Soap Box Derby champion Ronnie Beck never needed his dad's help.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But you can use me. I'm good. I've built a lot of things around the house... The spice rack... The birdfeeder... The gymboree.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What was that? Ah, who cares. Son, please let me help you.

title: Saturdays of Thunder

spoken_words: Come on Dad, it'd be weird.

spoken_words: Oh this isn't working at all. It's hopeless... Wait a second.

title: Saturdays of Thunder

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, I will! Son, I don't think you should let me help you.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Bill Cosby, you saved the Simpsons!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Marge, that Bart of ours is a little miracle. His winning smile, his button nose, his fat little stomach, his face alight with wholesome mischief... He reminds me of me before the weight of the world crushed my spirit.

title: Saturdays of Thunder

spoken_words: I like our chances, son.

spoken_words: Oh, I don't know if I should do that. My dad and I built our car together and if I drove someone else's it'd kill him. On the other hand... I'll do it.

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay Bart, we've got a lot of work to do on that car. So, I'm gonna pull you out of school for the next couple of weeks...

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad... I don't know how to say this, but I don't want to drive your car. It's slow, it's ugly, it handles like a shopping cart...

title: Saturdays of Thunder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, the car had a few bugs in it, I admit that. But we're Team Simpson.

title: Saturdays of Thunder

spoken_words: Dad, I love you, but you taught me to win.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: When did I ever teach you that?

title: Saturdays of Thunder

spoken_words: Well, I picked it up somewhere. And if I drive Martin's car I can win. I'm sorry, but...

title: Saturdays of Thunder

spoken_words: Don't be, no. Go ahead, leave me. Go on, go on and win. No, go on and win without your dad.

spoken_words: I'll just sit here in "Li'l Lightnin'" -- which the Simpsons built -- and remember that for one brief shining moment, I had a son.

title: Bart the Lover
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That sucks. How 'bout, "Crocodiles bit off my face."

title: Bart the Lover
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's disgusting. And besides, when a woman loves a man, it doesn't matter that a crocodile bit off his face.

title: Bart the Lover
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I may hold you to that, Marge.

title: Bart the Lover
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Okay, okay... I cannot see you for the next five years, for I will be farming the ocean floor."

title: Bart the Lover
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "I must finish this letter quickly, for I have only four minutes to live."

title: Bart the Lover
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Three simple words. I am gay.

title: Bart the Lover
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, for the last time, I am not putting that in.

title: Bart the Lover
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "And any time I hear the wind blow, it will whisper the name... Edna!"

title: Bart the Lover
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's very good, Lisa.

title: Bart the Lover
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: P.S. -- I am gay.

title: Bart the Lover
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How shall we end it?

title: Bart the Lover
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How about, "With a love that will echo through the ages?"

title: Bart the Lover
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's sweet.

title: Bart the Lover

spoken_words: Ohhh, Homer, you old honey dripper.

title: Bart the Lover
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little...

title: Bart the Lover
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Wait! Wait!

title: Bart the Lover

spoken_words: Bart, it's such a nice day today. Let's have detention outside.

title: Bart the Lover

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm, do - nuts.
