spoken_words: Hey Homer, slow down. You're gonna choke or somethin'.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't tell me how to eat donuts --

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, Homer's choking again.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hmm. Isn't there a first aid chart around here somewhere?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Somebody scare him.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, look at this.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Softball starts this week.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Softball?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who's next?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's the matter with you guys?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Homer, last year we were two and twenty-eight.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, I know it wasn't our best season.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Actually, it was.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, this year's gonna be different.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Oh yeah. What makes you so damn sure?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I have a secret weapon.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, he's been holding' out on us.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come here boy, I want to show you something.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's that? A home-made bat?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's something very special. A home-made bat. It all started last year, during a terrible thunderstorm, when I locked myself out of the house...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sheltering myself with a large piece of sheet metal, I ran for cover under the tallest tree I could find.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Something told me this was a very special, very magical, piece of wood that I could make a bat out of.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I put my homemade football on hold and set to work making the world's greatest bat.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, come to bed.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, go back to the garage.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And here it is.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! How many home runs you gonna hit with that?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see... we play thirty games... ten at bats a game... three thousand.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hit one here, Charlie.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hey, we know how to play softball.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Turn off that damn radio!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And the next man wants to hit the ball too. And he does. And there he goes off in that direction. And everyone is happy.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Mom, why don't you let me call the game.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's all right dear. I can do it.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hey, stop that!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Okay, Homer, bases loaded and you're up. Where's that secret weapon?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Check it out, boys. My magic bat.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Yeah, I got a magic bat, too.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: And I got an enchanted jock strap.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, just watch.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoooooo!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ha ha. Cops can't win!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Get his license and registration.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, Dad.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, can I get you a beer?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, I want to get him a beer.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, kids, kids. You can each get me a beer. But first let's see it again in super slow motion.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Such a mighty wallop.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, I got my magic bat off a piano.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Good news, sir! The plant's softball team has won again. If we beat Shelbyville next week we capture the pennant.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Did you hear that, Ari? My boys need only to thump your tub and the title is ours.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I disagree.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, if we're going to bet, why don't we make it interesting?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, did you say a million? I'm... I'm sorry, my mind was elsewhere. I thought you would start with a small amount, then we would bait each other and... well, you know how it goes. Yes... certainly, a million will be fine.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Um-hm.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, I've been thinking. Is it wrong to cheat in order to win a million dollar bet?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Yes, sir.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Let me rephrase that. Is it wrong if I cheat in order to win a million dollar bet?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: No, sir! Whom should I kill?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I did! Whoo-hoo! Whoo-hoo! In your face, Strawberry!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No, Smithers. I've decided to bring in a few ringers. Professional baseballers.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We'll give them token jobs at the plant and have them play on our softball team. Honus Wagner, Cap Anson, Mordecai "Three Finger" Brown...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh... sir...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What is it, Smithers?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'm afraid... all those players have retired and... uh... passed on. In fact, your right fielder has been dead for a hundred and thirty years.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Damnation! All right, find me some good players. Living players! Scour the professional ranks. The American League. The National League. The Negro Leagues.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'm on my way, sir.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, and Smithers... You have twenty-four hours.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: That's right, Mr. Canseco.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Ow.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: That's okay, happens all the time. Are you Mike Scioscia?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh, how do you like working for the Dodgers?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: We should talk.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Excuse me, are you Ozzie Smith?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I have a proposition for you...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Hello, are you Don Mattingly?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: How would you like to be a ringer on a small town company softball team?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And now I'd like to introduce the new members of our happy power plant family. Our new security guard... Roger Clemens...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: our new janitor, Wade Boggs...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: our new lunchroom cashier... Ken Griffey, Jr....

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Our new, well uh, we'll make up jobs for these fellows later... Please say hello to Steve Sax, Don Mattingly, Darryl Strawberry, Ozzie Smith, Mike Scioscia, and Jose Canseco.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, by the way, you new fellows, there's a sign up sheet for the company softball team on the bulletin board over there. Eh, just in case you wish to play.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, wait a minute, Mr. Burns. With them on the team, you won't need us!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well... duh. You, Scioscia, sign up...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: One more outburst like that and I'll send you back to the big leagues!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're Darryl Strawberry.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You play right field.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I play right field too.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, are you better than me?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's not fair. Me and the guys worked so hard to get to the championship game and now we'll be sitting on a bench.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You hit so many home runs this year. What makes you think this Darryl Strawberry character is better than you?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, forget it. He's bigger than me, faster than me, stronger than me and he already has more friends around the plant than I do.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You make me sick Homer. You're the one who told me I could do anything if I just put my mind to it.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well now that you're a little bit older, I can tell you that's a crock. No matter how good you are at something, there's always about a million people better than you.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gotcha. Can't win, don't try.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: As your new manager, I want to say this up front. No one is assured a spot in the starting line-up. I don't care if your name is Steve Sax, Darryl Strawberry, or... Smithers, what's one of the bad players' names?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Homer Simpson, sir.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Or Homer Simpson.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Secondly, instead of beer, from now on you will all be drinking this!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's a brain and nerve tonic. Rich in proteids and electromagnetic juices. It promotes robust health. Of course, it has been known to cause gigantism, but only in rare cases. Try some.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent. Now, let's begin our training, shall we? Smithers -- the medicine balls.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: What are you going to do with your million dollars, sir?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, I don't know. Throw it on the pile, I suppose.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I got it! I got it!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I called for that!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Put a lid on it, Simpson. There's no "I" in "team".

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: They sure do, Strawberry.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey Scioscia, I don't get it. You're a ringer but you're here every night, in the core, bustin' your butt haulin' radioactive waste.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Ah, don't worry about it.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aw geez... okay, I'll take Milhouse.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Damn! All right, I'll take Lewis.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Mattingly! Get rid of those sideburns!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You heard me, hippy.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Mattingly! Get rid of those sideburns.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You heard me, hippie.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: These guys aren't so tough. I've got "Wonder Bat."

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Take a knee boys.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Tomorrow is the biggest day of your lives. The Shelbyville game. So lights out at seven-thirty and abstain from coffee, tea, and cola drinks. Make no mistake, they pack a wallop.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes. Now, before I post the starting line-up I want to assure those of you whose names are not on the list, that I'm very disappointed in you. Something was lacking, let's call it heart.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That's right, Darryl.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Aw, nuts!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Please, please, please, I want to make the team. Clemens, did I make the team?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, there's no way I can lose this bet. Unless, of course, my nine all-stars fall victim to nine separate misfortunes and are unable to play tomorrow. But that will never happen. Three misfortunes, that's possible. Seven misfortunes, there's an outside chance. But nine misfortunes... I'd like to see that.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Uh, Mike, try to lift your arm.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Well, I'm afraid you have a case of acute radiation poisoning, Mr. Scioscia.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: No, by tomorrow you'll barely be able to breathe.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Good Lord! Gigantism!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: One thing I'm good at and I can't do it anymore.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homie. You're good at lots of things.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Like what?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Like snuggling...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but none of my friends can watch me.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, that's showin' him, Barney. Pit the Elder.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Nice work, boys. I think we can close the book on just about every unsolved crime in our fair city.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: You watch too many movies, Sax.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where do you think you're going?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: To the game.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, no! I don't want you to see me sitting on my butt.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We've seen it, dad.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Mattingly, for the last time, get rid of those sideburns!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Don't argue with me! Just get rid of them.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, it's almost game time. Where the devil are my ringers?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, Mike Socioscia may not live through the night. Steve Sax is looking at six consecutive life sentences. And Ozzie Smith seems to have vanished off the face of the earth.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What about Conseco?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What about Clemens?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir... he's in no condition to play.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That damn hypnotist!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You, look what you've done! My starting pitcher thinks he's a chicken! Make no mistake, I'm going to report this to the American Hypnotical Association.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh well, I guess it's not your fault... you did a good job.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Mattingly, I thought I told you to trim those sideburns. Go home! You're off the team! For good!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right, you rag-tag bunch of misfits. You hate me, and I hate you even more. But without my beloved ringers, you're all I've got. So I want you to remember some inspiring things that someone else may have told you in the course of your lives, and go out there and win!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Not so fast, Simpson.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The man who plays your position is still here. Hit the pine.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You stink Strawberry. We want Home-run Homer!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dar-ryl, Dar-ryl.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dar-ryl, Dar-ryl.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Children, that's not very nice.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, they're professional athletes. They're used to this sort of thing. It rolls right off their backs.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right, Monty, it's up to you managerial skills. What to do. Smithers, massage my brain.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Yes, sir.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You! Strawberry, hit a home run.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I told him to do that.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Brilliant strategy, sir.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, dear.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Children, tell me when your father stops scratching himself. Kids?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We'll tell ya, mom.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right, tie game. Bottom of the ninth, two outs, bases loaded, Strawberry coming up...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They're gonna win the championship, no thanks to me.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Wait! You! Strawberry! Good effort today. Take a lap and hit the showers. I'm putting in a right-handed batter to hit for you.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: What?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes. You see, you're a left-hander. And so is the pitcher. If I send up a right-handed batter, it's called playing the percentages. It's what smart managers do to win ballgames.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You should be very proud of yourself. Sit down! Simpson! You're batting for Strawberry.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I am? Whoo-hoo!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Atta boy, Homer.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You can do it.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right, Simpson, let's go over the signals.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: If I tug the bill of my cap like so...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: ...it means the signal is a fake.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh uh.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: However, I can take that off by dusting my hands thusly.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Got it.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: If I want you to bunt, I will touch my belt buckle not once, not twice, but thrice...

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Got that Simpson?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sir!

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, dear.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No mom, it counts as a hit. Dad just won the game.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohh, well, I guess he'll be happy when he comes to.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lurleen.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good one, Lenny.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You from outta town?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Have you been to the Museum of Barnyard Oddities yet?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, here, gimme the map. I'll show you.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, you're a manager's dream, Strawberry.

title: Homer at the Bat
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, it's almost game time. Where the devil are my ringers?

title: Homer at the Bat
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, Mike Scioscia may not live through the night. Steve Sax is looking at six consecutive life sentences. And Ozzie Smith seems to have vanished off the face of the earth.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Now, class, I promised you a surprise today...

title: Separate Vocations
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Wow.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I knew it.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: ...And here it is. We're going to take a test.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All right! A test!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Some of you may discover a wonderful vocation you never even imagined. Others may find out life isn't fair. In spite of your Masters from Bryn-mawr, you might end up a glorified baby-sitter to a bunch of dead-eyed fourth graders while your husband runs naked on a beach with your marriage counselor.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: First question: "If I could be any animal, I would be A) A Carpenter Ant; B) A Nurse Shark; or C) A Lawyer Bird."

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Janey, school is never a waste of time.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Military strongman.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Homemaker?!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Police officer? Well, I'll be jiggered.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I don't need you to get me in the back of a police car.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, a drifter.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cool.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A homemaker! I might as well be dead!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, it's not that bad.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So what're you gonna be, boy?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Policeman.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's nice, Bart. You know your father wanted to be a policeman for a little while. But they said he was too heavy.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, the Army said I was too heavy. The police said I was too dumb.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm gonna be a famous jazz musician. I've got it all figured out. I'll be unappreciated in my own country, but my gutsy blues stylings will electrify the French. I'll avoid the horrors of drug abuse, but I do plan to have several torrid love affairs. And I may or may not die young, I haven't decided.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, if that's what you want, we'll do anything we can to help.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute. Isn't anybody gonna follow in my footsteps?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Can you tell me if I have what it takes to be a blues musician?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So you think she has talent?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Do you think she could be a professional some day?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But I'll practice every day!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid fingers.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're wrong, you're wrong! You don't need long fingers to play the blues. The blues come from in here!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: My God, they are stubby.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, I didn't steal that copper wire. I just thought they were throwing it out. Here, take it.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good for you. Maybe this'll straighten the boy out.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! Can I see your club?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, what's it for?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So, you guys like being cops?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Huh-huh.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: How would you like a street named after you?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dear Log... This will be my last entry. For you were a journal of my hopes and dreams, and now I have none.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Do you need straight A's to be a cop?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, fellas, let's go shoot some bad guys.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Ooh, they used nylon rope this time. It feels so smooth against my skin. Almost sensuous.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, baby!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Woww!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, that's nice work, boys.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Looks like you just bought yourself a lottery ticket... to jail.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: They can still hear things!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sir, I know what I wanna be when I grow up. A cop!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, until then, son, I'm gonna make you an honorary police officer... Eddie, give him your badge.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Morning, honey.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's so good about it....

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, I know you're down on homemaking, but it can really let you be creative. See, this morning I turned bacon, eggs and toast into a nice smiley face for Bart and Homer.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's the point? They'll never notice.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh well, you'd be surprised.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now, just relax your hand.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Ma'am. You've been most cooperative.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bad dog! Very bad dog.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, before you blame the dog, I think you should take a look at these surveillance photos.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh... Oh... Unng... Oh, Bart.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I don't know how that got in there.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, why aren't you at band practice?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I quit.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, honey, right now you're discouraged. But deep down, you know you love the saxophone. I think you should stay in the band.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: If you think it's so great, why don't you join the band?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, there are a lot of people in the world who like to tell you what you can't do. But they don't always know what they're talking about.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So you see, my sisters were wrong. Except about the cities on the moon. I was wrong about that. So... well, you can see how anyone can be wrong.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Sweet vigilant puma. Principal of the mountains.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Janey, I'm about ready to chuck the whole stinking alphabet.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A doy.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nothin'.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, but if you really want to honk Skinner off, I suggest you attack the one thing he truly believes in.

title: Bart's Friend Falls in Love
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Really?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I saw some awful things in 'Nam, but you really have to wonder at the mentality that would desecrate a helpless puma. I never thought I'd say this, but the no-goodniks rule this school!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: God, I could really use a half-day.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Get him outta here.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now what is this all about?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's quite simple, really. I observed our friend Groundskeeper Willie burning leaves with a blatant disregard for our clean air laws.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart Simpson on the side of law and order? Has the world gone topsy-turvy?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, man. I got my first taste of authority... And I liked it.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hm.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart, there are a lot of troublemakers in this school... and Lord knows I can't be everywhere at once.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Go on.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Look, let's can the euphemisms, huh? No more bullspit. How would you like to be a hall monitor?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wouldn't that mean squealing on other kids?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: That's the meat of it, yes.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I don't know.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oooh, now, you get to wear a sash...

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You've got yourself a narc.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Jimbo, keepin' your nose clean, dude? Attaboy! Hey, Donna, who loves ya, baby?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Not in my hall, bub.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I think you've had enough, sister. C'mon, let's keep it moving.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Allright, break it up, boys. That belly ain't gonna get any pinker.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Thanks, Bart.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart's grades are up a little this term. But Lisa's are way down.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We always have one good kid and one lousy kid. Why can't both our kids be good?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We have three kids, Homer.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maaarge... The dog doesn't count as a kid.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, Maggie!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Shove it.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I have never seen a good student take such a slide. Lisa, what are you rebelling against?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Whattaya got?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I'll smoke it in class.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart, you're doing a bang-up job. You know, before there were some corridors of this school you'd just never go down. Now I feel safe anywhere.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Every day is a new fight, sir.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Bart. In your pre-Fascist days, you knew the giddy thrill of futile rebellion.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart, the school is a police state. Students are afraid to sneeze. And I have you to thank. Come with me.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Madre de Dios! The legends were true!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yes Bart, whenever a teacher confiscates something it ends up here. Salacious halter-tops, complete collections of Mad, Cracked and the occasional issue of Crazy, and this fake plastic derriere.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now, to show my gratitude, I want you to help yourself to an item of your choice.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All-riight!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Ooo, now, you be careful with that crossbow.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I will.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Seymour, this is an absent slip signed by Nelson's mother. And this is Nelson's English homework. Notice the identical elongated loops on the d's.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Forgery. So he didn't have leprosy.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, Things have changed. There will be no mockery of your name, Mr. Glasscock.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey Lewis, watch this.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Let's go, Milhouse.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Sure, we have order. But at what price!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know. You?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you're earning your eighteen grand a year.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid Hoover... thinks she's so smart.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: She wouldn't be so smart without her Teacher's edition.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Ladies and gentlemen, the unthinkable has happened. Some sick, twisted individual has stolen every teacher's edition in this school.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Declare a snowday!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Please, please, don't panic! They can smell fear.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Children, I know this is highly irregular, but for the rest of the uh, day Martin will be teaching this class.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Just do it, Brainiac.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh now Mr. Glasscock, please reconsider.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart, the police haven't had any luck finding the teachers' editions.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: The dogs have picked up the scent of books.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Send in the battering ram.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: We're going to have to re-order every book.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Seymour, I'll bet you a steak dinner those books are still here. All we have to do is search every locker.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, Bart, I'm not sure random locker searches are permitted by the Supreme Court...

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Pfft, Supreme Court. What have they done for us lately?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Let's move.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hmm...

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bah.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's right. It was I.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lis, why did you do it?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but even I had my limits. You're looking at expulsion for this.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I know. I know.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The books!

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, answers! Answers! Simpson, you've just saved the school one hundred and twenty dollars. Who's behind this monstrous crime?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I am.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I've been so blind. In retrospect, the signs all pointed to a rogue hall monitor.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry if I betrayed your trust, Principal Sucker.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: D'oh. Now Bart, in light of your recent service to the school, I've decided to be lenient. Four hundred days detention.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Four hundred days. I can do that standing on my head.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: All right, five hundred days.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, big man.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Six hundred days.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe I'll just shut my big mouth.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Let's go, Simpson.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, why'd you take the blame?

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: 'Cause I didn't want you to wreck your life. You got the brains and the talent to go as far as you want. And when you do, I'll be right there to borrow money.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Bart.

title: Separate Vocations
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Soundin' good, Lis!

title: Dog of Death
name: Announcer
spoken_words: The State Lottery. Where everybody wins. Actual odds of winning -- one in three hundred eighty million.

title: Dog of Death
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Pfft, the lottery. Exploiter of the poor and ignorant.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: One hundred and thirty million dollars!

title: Dog of Death
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Yes, yes, here's your lottery ticket. Thank you for knocking over my inventory. Please come again.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I need some lucky numbers, fast! How old are you? Uh-huh, and what's your birthday? No kidding. And what's Lisa's birthday?... What? You don't know your sister's birthday? What kind of brother are you?

title: Dog of Death
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Strap on your bullet proof vest, Sanjay. It's time for another bank run.

title: Dog of Death
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I promise nothing.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You'll never guess what happened Marge! Are you ready? I... have... a feeling... that we may win... the lottery!

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But we never ever...

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know you're excited, but calm down and listen to me carefully. Go-get-all-your-money...

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I buy one lottery ticket a week with the girls at the hair salon. We each play our birthday. And that's enough excitement for me.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You don't understand, Marge. The lottery is the one ray of hope in my otherwise unbearable life. Uh, the lottery and you.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, we're on a tight budget here. Promise me you won't get carried away.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Money... I mean Honey. Ooooh! Here comes a news report about the lottery!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, down in front.

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: The whole state is suddenly in the grip of lottery fever. And Springfield is no exception.

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: In fact, every copy of Shirley Jackson's "The Lottery" has been checked out from the Springfield Public Library.

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Of course, the book does not contain any hints on how to win the lottery. It is, rather, a chilling tale of conformity gone mad.

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: But there's already one big winner. Our state's school system, which gets fully half the profits from the lottery.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You can still win some money if you have five out of six.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoo-hoo!

title: Dog of Death
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Just think what we can buy with that money. History books that know how the Korean War came out. Math books that don't have that Base six crap in them.

title: Dog of Death
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: And a state of the art detention hall, where children are held in place with magnets.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've never been so sure of anything in my life. I am going to win this lottery.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, the odds are three hundred and eighty million to one.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Correction. Three hundred and eighty million to fifty. So what are you gonna do with your share of the money, kids?

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Put it in the bank.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Give it to the poor.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do kids know about spending money?

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What are you gonna do, Homer?

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm...

title: Dog of Death
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey Homer, what'd you do? Get a haircut or something?

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look closer, Lenny!

title: Dog of Death
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh I know what it is. You're the biggest man in the world now. And you're covered in gold.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fourteen carat gold!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Take a hike boss, I'm running things now.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All hail king Homer!

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: We now take you to the drawing live -- I hope you've got your tickets. I've got mine.

title: Dog of Death
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: No, you've got the wrong number. This is nine one two.

title: Dog of Death
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: We'll be with you in a minute, kids. This could be our ticket outta here, Mel.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've got so many tickets I can't lose!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Receipts, ugh.

title: Dog of Death
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I knew we wouldn't win.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well why didn't you tell the rest of us? Why did you keep it a secret??? If you were seventeen, we'd be rich! But no! You had to be "10."

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Thirty-eight... forty-nine... Ohmigod! I won! I won!

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Recapping our day's top story -- the winner of today's state lottery is me, Kent Brockman! Can we get a shot of me?

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: There you go.

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: In other news... uh... a tragic mix-up today in Cleveland... many people killed... uh... Goodbye.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh well... we lost the money, but at least we've still got each other.

title: Dog of Death
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, the dog's dead.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa, he's not dead!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you shouldn't say the dog's dead when he's not.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's not fair to toy with people's emotions like that.

title: Dog of Death
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: He is dead! I'll get a shovel.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he's not dead, but he is awfully sick.

title: Dog of Death
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, sure! The old man's off his rocker. If Grampa says he's dead he must be alive.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He is alive. He's wagging his tail.

title: Dog of Death
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: That don't mean nothin'! Dogs wag their tails for hours after they die. I'm tired of this conversation. Let's talk about something else. I'm going home.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you did the best you could.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm, how much will it cost?

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh dear!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... I guess we'll have to talk it over.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Talk what over? What's there to talk about?

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What are we going to talk over?

title: Dog of Death
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Mr. Teeny needs a refill of his nicotine gum.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't help but notice we're leaving the hospital. When's the dog going to get his operation?

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... later. First, I want to tell you about the most wonderful place in the world... Doggie Heaven.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In Doggie Heaven, there's mountains of bones and they can't turn around without sniffing another dog's butt! And all the best dogs are there. Old Yeller... and about eight Lassies and...

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Is there a Doggie Hell?

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... of course. There couldn't be a heaven if there weren't a hell.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who's in there?

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... Hitler's dog... and that dog Nixon had... whassisname... uh... Chester.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Checkers.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. And one of the Lassies is in there too. The mean one. The one that mauled Timmy.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! Wait a minute, does this have anything to do with Santa's Little Helper?

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, honey. Seven-hundred and fifty dollars is a lot of money. We really can't afford this operation.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're gonna just let him die?

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I know you're upset --

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Darn right I'm upset!

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, watch your language. Oh. You did. Sorry.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We are not going to let our dog die! And that's IT! Lousy dog-killing sonsa...

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But it'll be okay... we'll get him a new dog... one with an untwistable stomach...

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, come on! I'm sorry, but we just can't afford it. Marge, make him stop.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Mom.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right. All right. We'll find a way. Lousy manipulative dog.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... Mr. Burns... I need to borrow some money.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Please, do go on...

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know you're a good man... and I have a dog that's very sick...

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, please, continue...

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I thought maybe you...

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. Well, thanks for your time.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What makes a man endanger his job, and yes, even his life, by asking me for money?

title: Dog of Death
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: People like dogs, Mr. Burns.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Nonsense! Dogs are idiots. Think about it, Smithers. If I came into your house and started sniffing at your crotch and slobbering all over your face, what would you say?

title: Dog of Death
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh... if YOU did it, sir?...

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Exactly! You'd be fit to be tied! Dogs!

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You are NOT going to perform that operation yourself.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Marge! It looks so easy! Just like carving a turkey.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe you're right, Marge.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I've found a way we can pay for the operation.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whattaya got, Marge? Insurance scam?

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No. I'm afraid we're just going to have to make a few sacrifices. Homer, you're going to have to give up beer for a while.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, from now on you'll have to get your hair cut for free at Springfield Barber College.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No problemo.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm going to give up buying my weekly lottery ticket, and I found a way to stretch the food budget. Fried chicken night will now be organ meat night. Ham night will be Spam night. And porkchop night...

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: ... will now be chub night.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Chub? I don't even know what that is!

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, I'm afraid we'll have to stop getting you those volumes of Encyclopedia Generica from the grocery store.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But, Mom, next week is volume four: Copernicus through Elephantiasis.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We all have to make sacrifices, dear. Maggie's baby clothes will have to last for a little longer...

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I've figured out an alternative to giving up my beer. Basically, we become a family of traveling acrobats...

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think you've thought this through.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lousy chub night. Hey, how come he gets meat and we don't?

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You wouldn't want what he's eating. It's mostly just snouts and entrails.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm... snouts.

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Yes, I'm back. Kent Brockman is not the kind of a man who would leave a $500,000 a year job just because he won a lottery. Hey, I'm a journalist.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he's got all the money in the world, but there's one thing he can't buy.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's that?

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A dinosaur.

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Of course I'm not the only one who benefited from last week's big payoff. Our state's schools got their share too. Here, lottery officials present Springfield Elementary with a brand new eraser.

title: Dog of Death
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: One eraser? Oh, I'm used to my government betraying me. I was in Nam. I served for three --

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: And speaking of lotteries, here are the winning numbers for this week's forty-thousand dollar "jackpot": 3 - 6 - 17 - 18 - 22 and 29.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no! Those are my numbers! If it wasn't for that dog, I would've won!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: BUFFALO GALS WON'T YOU COME OUT TONIGHT / COME OUT TONIGHT / COME OUT TONIGHT... OH BUFFALO GALS...

title: Dog of Death
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Before his dog got sick, that "old rummy" used to be my best customer.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: AND DANCE BY THE LIGHT OF THE MOONNNNNNNN!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My quarter!!!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know you can't understand me, but you're a lousy dog and I hate you.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not now.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Can't you see I'm reading a third-rate biography of Copernicus I found at the bus station?

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dumb dog.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, did you close the gate?

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you mean tonight.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The dog will get out!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! Close the gate.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa! Close the gate.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Close the gate, Maggie.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here boy!

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Here Santa's Little Helper!

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's all my fault. I called him a dumb dog.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh he's gone and he's never coming back. Wait! There he is. No... that's a horse.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Have you found a picture yet?

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not one that I want the public to see.

title: Dog of Death
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: ... So recycling is our way of giving Mother Earth a great big hug.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, well, it does sound like fun. I can't wait to start pawing through my garbage like some starving raccoon.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Release the hounds. Well, neighbor I see you've got your running shoes on. That's a good thing.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What's wrong with Crippler?

title: Dog of Death
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: He's getting on, sir. He's been here since the late sixties.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah yes, I'll never forget the day he bagged his first hippie. That young man didn't think it was too "groovy."

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'm looking for something in an attack dog. One who likes the sweet gamy tang of human flesh.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Why here's the fellow! Wiry... fast... firm proud buttocks. Reminds me of me.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh...the last one.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now! As an attack dog, you'll be expected to neutralize intruders.

title: Dog of Death
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Wanna buy some cookies? Wanna buy some cookies?

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: If that were a real Girl Scout I'd have been bothered by now.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now here's a film that will turn you into a vicious souless killer. Enjoy.

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Poor Santa's Little Helper. I'm starting to think we'll never see him again.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That was his dish, and that was his leash, and that's where he took a whiz on the rug.

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer get a-hold of yourself. Even if he has passed on, there's no reason to cry. Remember Doggie Heaven.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Marge! There is no such place!

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Or... to put it another way... there is.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not giving up. I don't care if I have to knock on every door in this two-bit town. I'm gonna find my dog.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I'll be right here watching TV.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Poke-A Poke-A Poke-A! Poke-A Poke-A Poke-A!

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent!

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Hello, I'm Kent Brockman.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um, excuse me sir, I lost my dog.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Two tickets for...

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Hmm huh. And I suppose you want me to buy you a new one. You know, ever since I won the lottery, everybody wants a piece of Kent Brockman. Homeless this, and hungry that.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gee, I'm sorry mister.

title: Dog of Death
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Good.

title: Dog of Death
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I, uh. I hate to interrupt your longevity treatment, sir. But there's a sweet little boy at the door.

title: Dog of Death
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Release the hounds.

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Santa's Little Helper! It's you! AAAGGGHHH!!

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's the matter boy? Don't you know me? I'm your buddy!

title: Dog of Death
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I love ya, boy.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let me pet him again!

title: Dog of Death
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You already petted him for ten minutes.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know. I want to pet him again!

title: Dog of Death
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You can pet the cat.

title: Dog of Death
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The cat? What's the point?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look dad, there's a spot.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, there's a spot, dear.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, there's a good one.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That spot says "compact only".

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, that's just a suggested car size.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Easy... easy... How'm I doing on the right?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, we're getting a lot of sparks over here, dad.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh huh... easy... easy... perfect. All right, everybody out the window.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, they all look great.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So, what are we going to see?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "Ernest Cuts The Cheese"!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Honey, I Hit A School Bus"!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Look Who's Oinking"! "Look Who's Oinking"!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, since we'll never agree, why don't you kids pick a movie, your dad and I will pick a movie, then we'll all meet in the lobby later. Hmm?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe we could see something a little more adult.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why Marge, you frisky little devil.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll take two tickets to "The Stockholm Affair."

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh! The paper called it a "taut political thriller".

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Political"!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, this movie's too complicated... Hey, the floor's sticky...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who's that guy?... What did that guy say when I said, "Who's that guy?"

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that submarine's so fake... Look, you can see the strings... Ooh! An octopus!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: If you don't watch the violence, you'll never get desensitized to it.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Just tell me when the scary part's over.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's over.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think that guy's a spy.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well of course he's a spy. You just saw him go through spy school!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh wait, I heard how this ends. It turns out the secret code was the same nursery rhyme he told his daughter.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, it's pretty obvious if you think about it.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, shut up, Homer! No one wants to hear what you think!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, if it makes you feel any better, most of what they threw at you splattered on me. Homer?...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Forget it, mom. Dad's really mad. The tendons are throbbing at the base of his neck...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And stress is collecting in the trouble spots here... here... and here... Making for one unhappy pappy.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, aren't you coming inside?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I have always carried myself with a certain quiet dignity. Tonight you robbed me of it. I'm going now and I don't know when you'll see me again.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I guess that executive stress ball we got him for Christmas isn't working.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ew, a skunk!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, a redneck bar.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Duff please.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Fudd me.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid Marge tell me to shut up.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ... that's true.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, except for the pick-up truck.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no. I went to this bar the other night, and they...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Wha...wha... Wait a minute. You went to another bar?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey... Hey, Lurleen! I've gotta say somethin' to ya.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your song touched me in a way I've never felt before. And which way to the can?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Homer J. Simpson.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's a pretty name.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe. I'm not sure. I forgot it.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bye Lurleen.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Y'ello.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Where were you all night?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I was just up at this bar in Spittle County.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You should have called. I was very worried.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, let's end this feudin' and a fussin' and get down to some lovin'.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I WORK ALL DAY FOR SOME OLD MAN/ I SWEAT AND BREAK MY BACK/

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: YOUR WIFE DON'T UNDERSTAND YOU/ BUT I DO...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Gheee... Homer's singing to his ball again.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, and he's bowling a two-eighty.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh yeah. THERE'S A KIND OF HUSH/ ALL OVER THE WORLD TONIGHT...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Moe, you got any Fudd?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Fudd? I thought they took that off the market after all those hillbillies went blind.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, I was a hundred miles outta town.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, Homer.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lurleen, I can't get your song outta my mind. I haven't felt this way since "Funky Town."

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Do you think I could get a copy of it?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lurleen, we've gotta crack open your head and scoop out those songs!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come with me!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I guess so.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: For the next half hour, beer's on the house.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Nothin'.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I thought I told you to stay away from my sister!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, here's fifty bucks. Take her to the Copa.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: She's wonderful. I could feel her sweet country soul in every digitally-encoded bit.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Country music sucks. All it does is take precious air space away from shock DJ's whose cruelty and profanity amuse us all.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shut up, boy. Marge, what do you think?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's nice. But who is this woman?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, right now she's an out-of-work cocktail waitress. But she's going to be a country music superstar like... uh... that jerk in the cowboy hat... and that dead lady.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't like you hanging around with some cocktail waitress!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you make it sound so seamy. All I did was spend the afternoon in her trailer watching her try on some outfits.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well hi, Lurleen. We were just talking about you. Uh... I think I can come over. Let me ask my wife.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's a date!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't thank me, Lurleen, you should be thanking your brain.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I was going to ask you for a glass of water, but now I feel kinda guilty about it.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks. You did say sugar, right?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? Well, I should warn you... I'm not great with figures...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I make a lot of stupid decisions...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I did bad in school.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My personal hygiene has been described as...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, look at me.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't want to. I'm mad at you.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sick of that waitress and all the time you've been spending with her, and this whole country music thing.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, then maybe you better not look at me.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! Where did you get that suit?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A friend bought it for me.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Was it Lurleen?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No... I think it was Lenny.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't lie to me. Are you having an affair with this woman?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Have you kissed her?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Has she kissed you?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A coupla times.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I want you to stop seeing her.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't. I'm her manager.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Her manager? That's ridiculous. I won't allow you to spend any more time away from your family.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you're standing in the way of my boyhood dream of managing a beautiful country singer.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Your boyhood dream was to eat the world's biggest hoagie. And you did it at the county fair last year. Remember?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, Lurleen's gonna be a big success and whether you like it or not, I'm going to be there.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Fine. See if I care.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sure Lurleen will love it.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, how much did you just give that man?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Calm down, Marge, it's just our life savings. I'm not going to go into hock for this.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mrs. Homer Simpson.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmmm. I thought you said she was overweight!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, it takes two to lie. One to lie and one to listen.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What does that mean?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't have time to answer all these questions. Uh, time is money. Come on, people!

title: Colonel Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Dad, can I do a ham-bone solo?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stop it.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You, off the bench.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Guess what, Lurleen, I got you a gig on TV.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! Oh, you meant that as a compliment. Now on this show, they want you to sing two songs. Maybe we should give them something new.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's hear it.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's hot. There isn't a man alive who wouldn't get turned on by that. Well, g'bye.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Right...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... I gotta think about this.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All our money's tied up in this woman. If she fails, we're broke. If she succeeds, I have no husband. I don't know what to root for.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I gotta go. Homer...

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Later, Marge. Lurleen's on TV tonight. I gotta get ready.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just so you know, while you and Lurleen were out judging that greased pig contest, Maggie cut her first tooth.

title: Colonel Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's great, honey. Say, have you seen my rattlesnake hatband?

title: Colonel Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're not even listening to me!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)

name: Homer Simpson
