title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I just had a bad dream.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, sure... you just lie down and tell me all about it.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I know it's absurd, but I dreamed the Boogeyman was after me and he's hiding...

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boogeyman?! You nail the windows shut! I'll get the gun!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I don't want to alarm you, but there may be a Boogeyman or Boogeymen in the house!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What happened here?

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, nothing, Marge. Just a little incident involving the Boogeyman. Of course, none of this would've happened if you'd been here to keep me from acting stupid.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'm sorry. I have been spending too much time at the casino. I'll be around more from now on.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Does this mean you'll help me with my costume?

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sure, honey. I promise.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Mom.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw. Just like on TV.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm from a casino.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'm afraid Robert Goulet hasn't arrived yet, Sir.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Very well, begin the thawing of Jim Nabors.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Your manager says for you to shut up!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, Mom said she'd be home to help me with my costume, and she's not and the Geography Pageant is tonight.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, your mom still loves you. It's just that she has a career, now. She's a slot jockey.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But Dad, if I don't show up in a rubber suit shaped like the state of Florida, I'll be the laughing stock of the whole school.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's always something isn't it? First, I have to drive your pregnant mother to the hospital so she can give birth to you, and now this.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow...ow...ow...ow.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow, ow, ow, ow, ow!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah, the costume.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Floreeda.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not a state, I'm a monster!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, Lisa. The only monster here is the gambling monster that has enslaved your mother. I call him Gamblor. And it's time to snatch your mother from his neon claws.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! Where are you?! Damn this casino! Damn this casino!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can't talk now.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers! I don't want that unpredictable lunatic working in my casino!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Fine. We'll transfer him to the nuclear plant, sir.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, my beloved plant... How I miss her.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Bah! To hell with this! Get my razor! Draw a bath! And get these Kleenex boxes off my feet!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Certainly, sir. And the jars of urine?

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, we'll hang on to those. Now, to the plant! We'll take the Spruce Moose. Hop in.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: But sir...

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I said, hop in.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! What is it? Slow down.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Think before you say each word.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You broke a promise to your child.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You promised Lisa to help her with her costume. You made her cry, then I cried. Then Maggie laughed. She's such a little trooper.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa's costume. Homer, I didn't realize. I'm so sorry.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I want you to admit you have a gambling problem.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know, you're right, Homer. Maybe I should get some professional help.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No no, that's too expensive. Just don't do it anymore.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: And special awards go to the two students who obviously had no help from their parents, Lisa Simpson and Ralph Wiggum.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yes, of course you are.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can't talk. Robbed. Go hell.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Marge, for the first time in our marriage, I can finally look down my nose at you. You have a gambling problem.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's true. Will you forgive me?

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh sure... Remember when I got caught stealing all those watches from Sears?

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, that's nothing, because you have a gambling problem! And remember when I let that escaped lunatic in the house 'cause he was dressed like Santa Claus?

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you have a gambling problem!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, when you forgive someone, you can't throw it back at them like that.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, what a gyp.

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And remember when I...

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: $pringfield (or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah. I forgot already.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad! We've been robbed!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wake up, Dad! Wake up! There was a burglar and he took my saxophone.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And our portable TV!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And my necklace.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, that's no big loss.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! That necklace was a priceless Bouvier family heirloom.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you've probably got a whole drawer full of 'em.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well... Yes, I do. But they're all heirlooms, too.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The burglar even took my stamp collection.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: YOU had a stamp collection?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Stamp collection. Haw haw!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart's pain is funny, but mine isn't. That saxophone was my one creative outlet. It was the only way I could truly express myself.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shhh, quiet Lisa.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, the burglar left his calling card.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "You have just been robbed by The Springfield Cat Burglar"... Cute.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hidilly ho, neighboreenos.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You folks got robbed too? The burglar took my Shroud of Turin beach towels.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. It's a crime wave.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Good Lord! My Stormin' Norman Commemorative Plates stolen... again.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We are insured, aren't we, Mom?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, tell your child what you bought when I sent you to town to get some insurance.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Curse you, Magic Beans.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, stop blaming the beans.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, police? Are you sitting down? Good. I wish to report a robbery!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: A robbery, right. Thanks for the report.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Another one, Lou. 723 Evergreen Terrace.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, there doesn't seem to be any pattern, yet. But if I take this one and move it here, and move these over here... Hello... It almost looks like an arrow.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Let's get outta here!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: When cat burglaries start, can mass murders be far behind? This reporter isn't saying that the burglar is an inhuman monster like the Wolfman, but he very well could be.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: So, professor, would you say it's time for everyone to panic?

title: Homer the Vigilante

spoken_words: Ladies and gentlemen, ladies and gentlemen please, we have a major break in the case. We recovered the burglar's handkerchief from one of the crime scenes. Now one sniff of this baby and our tracking dog will be hot on his trail. Gosh, look at me, I'm sweating like a pig here...

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Ahhh. Aw man... that's better.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Alright, get the scent, boy. Come on. Get the scent. Now kill! Go on.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Ow, my jugular! Any questions?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let me check my reason list.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yep. It's on here.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Bart Simpson

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Grampa Simpson

title: Homer the Vigilante

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson

spoken_words: What's the point of all these precautions? I've already lost the only thing that matters to me.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What, this jug?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, never, ever stop in the middle of a hoe-down.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know Lisa, music helps daddy think.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I dunno. Can you swing a sack of door knobs?

spoken_words: Welcome, neighbors... since the police can't seem to get off their dufferoonies to do something about this burglarino, I think it's time we start our own neighborhood watch... arooni!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Now, who should lead the group?

name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I don't really have very much experience, but I'll be---

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Someone else!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm someone else!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: He's right!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We don't need a thinker, we need a doer. Someone who'll act without considering the consequences.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'm with you, Homer.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You're the man, Homer.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You're so good.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, Dad. You're too old.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Too old! Why that just means I have experience. Who chased the Irish out of Springfield Village in ought four? Me, that's who!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, Dad, you've done a lot of great things, but you're a very old man now, and old people are useless. Aren't they? Aren't they? Huh? Yes they are. Yes they are...

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop it! It's a form of abuse!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think the guns are a good idea, Homer.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, we're responsible adults and...

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oops.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson

title: Homer the Vigilante

spoken_words: Uh-oh!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Me again.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, we've got the secret vigilante handshake. Now we need code names. I'll be "Cueball." Skinner can be "Eightball", Barney will be "Twelveball," and Moe, you can be "Cueball."

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You're an idiot.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, we're forming a vigilante group.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Put this in your pipe and smoke it.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo Hoo! Woo hoo hoo hoo!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo, hoo! Take that Maynard G. Krebs!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, men, it's time to clean up this town.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Meaning what exactly?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, push people around, make ourselves feel big.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, give me that megaphone of yours.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's not just a megaphone, Dad. It's a RapMaster 2000.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Never mind the commercials. Just give it to me. I've got to whip this neighborhood into shape.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Move along there.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Return to your homes and places of businesses!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey you, where'd you get that saxophone?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get him!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No burning leaves without a permit!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Too late.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You better have a good reason for doing that, boy.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're in. Here's the sack.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: But you gotta supply your own knobs.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So I said to him, "Look buddy, your car was upside down when we got here. And as for your Grandma, she shouldn't have mouthed off like that."

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, don't you see you're abusing your power like all vigilantes? I mean, if you're the police, who will police the police?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I 'unno. Coast Guard?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, wasn't the whole point to catch the cat burglar?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And I still don't have my saxophone.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, the mob is working on getting your saxophone back, but we've also expanded into other important areas.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Literacy programs... preserving our beloved covered bridges... world domination...

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: World domination?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that might be a typo.

title: Homer the Vigilante

spoken_words: Mr. Simpson, how do you respond to the charge that petty vandalism such as graffiti is down 80 percent, while heavy sack beatings are up a shocking 900 percent?

title: Homer the Vigilante

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: I see. Well, what do you say to the accusation that your group has been causing more crimes than it's been preventing?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Kent, I'd be lying if I said my men weren't committing crimes.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Touché.

title: Homer the Vigilante

spoken_words: Well, it looks like we have our first caller. And I mean ever, because this is not a call-in show. Hello, you're on the air.

title: Homer the Vigilante

name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Homer, that's our stage manager!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh sorry. I'm a little nervous.

spoken_words: Listen, Mr. Cat Burglar, I vow to go without sleep and guard the Springfield museum day and night for as long as it takes, from now on unless you want to taunt me more by giving me an approximate time.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll be right back.

title: Homer the Vigilante

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: We're on our break!

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Any sign of the burglar yet?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He'll show.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: How's that?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's his job.

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: How's that?

title: Homer the Vigilante
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He's a burglar.

spoken_words: Woo hoo! We're rich! Bart, get over to the mansion and open up all the windows. We want to get the old people smell out before we move in.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, Mr. Burns hasn't passed away yet.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh? Oh, right. So I guess you're in okay shape, huh? No heart problems or anything...

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, I --

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boo!

title: Burns' Heir
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm okay.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah. So good...

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That explains his mysterious trip to Holland.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now that you've all agreed to reap the windfall of my death, I must return to my large empty mansion to rattle around and await the inevitable... alone.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, let's push him down the steps.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No. You know, Bart, since he is giving you all of his money, maybe it would be nice if you spend some time with him.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well...

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, honey.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All right.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How come Bart gets to do that and I can't spend one night lurking in the bushes outside Chef Boyardee's house?

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Bart, I know you children see me as some sort of "booger man," but I'm really not such a bad "dude." Oh, your milk's gone cold. I'll ring for the maid.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Sorry. Wrong button.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um, uh, I think I'd like to go home.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Aw, if you stay you can have anything you want to eat, even some sort of gelatin dish. It's made from hooves, you know.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Anything, huh? Okay... I want pizza, and I want it delivered by Krusty the Clown.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, it's Krusty the pizza man! -- All right, where's my four hundred bucks?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, wait! How can you be here when your show's on live?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Ah, I just threw on an old rerun. No one will know the difference.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Children, remain calm. The Falkland Islands have just been invaded! I repeat, the Falklands have just been invaded.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: The disputed islands lie here, off the coast of Argentina.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: This is my pride and joy. I've had hidden cameras planted in every home in Springfield. I got the idea from that movie "Sliver." What a delightful romp!

title: Burns' Heir
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Are you talkin' to me? There's no one else here. You must be talkin' to me.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well that was an antique. Crap.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: ...And I had the greatest time. Mr. Burns' house has everything - a hedge maze, a moat, bleached hardwood floors, and a bottomless pit.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It couldn't possibly be bottomless.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, for all intents and purposes.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Mom, Bart's throwing peas.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, don't throw peas at your sister.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns throws peas at Smithers.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! That was a big one.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, say something.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. Lisa quit getting in the way of your wealthy brother's peas.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yuck, meatloaf! My most hated of all loafs.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That was the end piece. That's it! Being abusive to your family is one thing but I will not stand idly by and watch you feed a hungry dog. Go to your room!

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No! This family stinks. Mr. Burns nurtures my destructive side. I'm suffocating here.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you listen.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, go eat some flowers.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My secret shame.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, my plan worked perfectly. Bart Simpson will live here as my son, and I will mold him in my own graven image. Who knows, I may even grow to love him. Bartholomew!

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ugh! Smithers get it off me.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you're coming home.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I want to stay here with Mr. Burns.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I suggest you leave immediately.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Or what? You'll release the dogs? Or the bees? Or the dogs with bees in their mouths, and when they bark, they shoot bees at you? Well go ahead, do your worst.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He locked the door! I'll show him.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm very concerned. Mr. Burns has stolen our son and he won't give him back.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Oh for gosh, can't you people solve these problems yourselves? I mean we can't be uh "Policing" the whole city.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Uh, excuse me, is there an Orange Julius stand on this floor?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well why don't I drink out of a toilet bowl?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know we should really stop hiring him.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Cool train. Where's it go?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Beats me. But it won't be back for three hours and forty minutes. Once it had snow on it.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Wow, Bart! Mr. Burns gives you everything you could ever want. My parents use that old love excuse to screw me out of toys. Well, I'm sure you'd like to be alone with your possessions.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Milhouse, if you stay a little while longer, you can have this blazer. It's a Bob Mackie original.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Wow, a Bob Mackie! ...Sorry, Bart.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Bartholomew, you don't need him. I can be your schoolyard chum!

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Five, twenty-three skidoo! Hut! Hut!

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: For me? But I don't know how to drive.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, pish posh. There's a jaws of life in the trunk.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That was some ride.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure you can get him back for us?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What about Peter Fonda?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You idiot! He was the most talented one!

title: Burns' Heir
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Do you mind? You're killing the romance in here.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, that's Hans Moleman.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can I keep him anyway? Huh, huh?

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That was delightful! Did you see that? That mouse butchered that cat like a hog! Is all TV this wonderful?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um, I'd kind of like to go home now.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Like a hog! Heh? What? What was that?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, I don't want to seem ungrateful. But, I want to go home to my family.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I was hoping I wouldn't have to tell you this, but... I'm afraid your family doesn't want you back.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's probably my imagination but something about them didn't seem quite right.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Really? Excuse me for just a moment.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: People, that was all wrong. Homer Simpson doesn't say "B'oh!" he says... "D'oh!"

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, well, just get it right or you'll all be back doing "Come Blow your Horn" at the Westport Dinner Theater!

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right then, let's see what the old Simpson family is up to now.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's them all right. I can't believe it. I guess you're the only one I can trust...

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: ... Dad.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That rib always breaks.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, what are you doing?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Just trying to fill the void of random, meaningless destruction that Bart's absence has left in our hearts.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's sweet, honey.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's a little tight.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, that's to correct your posture. Soon you'll have a mighty hump.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now, you really are my son. This calls for a celebration. Let's fire some employees.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Okay, let's make this sporting, Leonard. If you can tell me why I shouldn't fire you, without using the letter "E," you can keep your job.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Uh, okay... um... I'm a good... work... guy.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You're fired.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: But I didn't say --

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You will.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Eeeeeeeeeeeee!!

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Let me try one.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, the trail of donuts ended. Bart!

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Huh! What a coincidence. And a perfect opportunity for you to prove your loyalty. Go ahead Bartholomew. You may fire when ready.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hurry! Fire him now or I'll disown you. You'll lose everything. The fabulous toys, a lifetime of wealth and luxury, the gift certificate from Blockbuster Video, the freedom to do whatever you want.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll miss you, son.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, Dad... You're fired!

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What? Fire me? That does it, you can never be my son...

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: A little to the left.

title: Burns' Heir
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Huh? Oh, very well. You can never be my...

title: Burns' Heir
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, try to land on Leonard's carcass!

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, I know you're upset because you thought you saw us on TV saying we didn't want you in our family. But those were just actors playing us.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How do you know?

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Because one of them hung out with me for a week trying to get my character down.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, me too. That midget taught me a lot about his native Estonia.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The point is the real Simpson family missed you a lot and we're really glad you're home.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I love you guys.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Right back atcha, son. Aw.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And now I want you to meet your new brother, Hans Moleman.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Give it a try. It's like kissing a peanut. Heh, heh, heh.

title: Burns' Heir
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I want that thing out of my house.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: They're gonna eat this up at Show and Tell.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not sure if I'm comfortable with the idea of your classmates laughing at our family's private moments. How would you like it if, twenty years from now, people were laughing at things you did?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Not likely. C'mon, have a sense of humor about yourself!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Argh! I gotta find something else quick!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why don't you bring this potato? It's pretty big.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, you're always trying to give me potatoes. What is it with you?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I just think they're neat.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I need something for Show and Tell.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Just take one of my geodes. The rocks on my desk.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, that's a Trilobite... That's petrified wood... Bart, that's a bran

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: muffin.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll be right back.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: The ingredients were "Fresh pureed tomatoes, water, salt, and Sodium Benzoate used to retard spoilage." Once again, if I'm not mistaken, this can contained tomato paste.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Thank you, Nelson. I look forward to seeing it again next week. Bart, you're up.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Boys and girls, Mrs. Krabappel, I come before you today to solve a riddle that has plagued mankind for centuries -- What has four legs and ticks?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: A walking clock?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: A walkin'-clock!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Bart, is it a walking clock?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What? No, it's my dog!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, he is a gem! Here, boy, would you like these cookies Martin made for me?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My dog's name is Santa's Little Helper. One time he crawled under the house, and when he came out he was covered with ants. Then he ran into a church and drank all the holy water.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Thank you, Bart. Great job.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I knew the dog before he came to class.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You're doin' it wrong. You gotta pet him hard so he can feel it.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Ha! It thinks it's people!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Hey, poochie. Poochie-poochie, poochie.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, brother. All right, back to Show and Tell. Bart, why don't you put the doggie away.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I know Weinstein's parents were upset, Superintendent, but, but ah, I was sure it was a phony excuse. I mean, it sounds so made up: "Yom Kip-pur?"

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Sir, ye've goot to coom quick! There's a doog roonin' aroond in the air doocts!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I understand. Children, this is Principal Skinner...

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Remain calm. There is a dog in the vents.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Willie, go into the vent and get him.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: What?! Have ye gone waxy in yer beester?! I canna fit in the wee vent, ye croquet-playin' mint-muncher!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Grease yourself up and go in, you-you... guff-speaking work-slacker.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ooh. Good coomback.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Lunchlady Doris, have ye got any grease?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Then grease me up, woman!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Good lord! It's coming up right behind him!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: What the? No! No!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ouch! Ouch! Stop it!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Children, teachers, back to your rooms! Uh-oh, whenever I get this upset, I get hiccups. Ooh, right on cue.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Aha! There's nary an animal alive that can outrun a greased Scotsman! Now, out we go.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Whoogh! 'Tis more dizzying than the belfry at St. Corgegluynwaagen's!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: That's nice work, boys.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Uh-oh. Someone's getting a visit from Superintendent Chalmers.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I ... can't ... take ... this .

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skinner!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Superintendent Chalmers, you didn't have to come all the way down here. Everything's under control.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Ooh, I have had it. I have had it with this school, Skinner: the low test scores, class after class of ugly, ugly children...

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now, really I hardly think the children's appearance should --

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Seymour, you are in very, very big troub--

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Huh? Why, looking into this lovable mutt's eyes just melts my heart... Seymour, all is forgiven--

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Aah! Make way for Willie!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I said, 'Make way for Willie,' ye bloated gas-bag!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Seymour?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hmm?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: You're fired.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'm sorry, d-did you just call me a liar?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: No, I said you were fired.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh. That's much worse.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I thought I'd be jumping for joy the day Skinner left, but now all I have is this weird hot feeling in the back of my head.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's guilt. You feel guilty because your stunt wound up costing a man his job.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I guess it is guilt.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, let me get this straight. They let everybody out of school early, just because you brought a dog?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, yeah, but --

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm off to work.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The dog has had enough excitement.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Marge, dogs can never have enough excitement.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look! Ree, ree. Ree, ree. Aye, aye. All right, all right, I won't take the dog. C'mere.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Boys and girls, because of Mr. Skinner's sudden departure, I've had to appoint a new principal. Leopold?

title: The Boy Who Knew Too Much
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How many "s"'s in "innocent"?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, tippity-top o' the a.m. to every-good-body here! As chairman of the PTA, I Am dee-diddily-lighted to take over, and I think I can put the "pal" back in principal.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Yeah, and I'll put the "super" back in superintendent.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: That's the same exact joke. What gives, Leo?

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Now I know everybody's eager to get back to class --

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Ha!

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: But I thought it might break the ice if we had a little Q and A.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Yeah, you.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, let me just say I want to put the "stew" back in students.

title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: It's just a damn popularity contest with you kids.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I must admit, you really do make a gal feel needed.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait until my class hears about this. Kidding!

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's great to be indoors with my family.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm really glad you're back, Dad. I knew you could do it. Now don't screw it up.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Dad. I missed you so much, I couldn't concentrate in school and I got an "F".

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, this is dated two weeks ago.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, sorry. Here's a fresh one.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And I have a special present for you, but I'll give it to you later tonight.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Special present?! I don't wanna wait! I want it now! I want the children to see. Oh. Right. Later.

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So Marge, are you really happy, really?

title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Moe!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I hardly think it's fair to be charged full price. I'm up to my knees in the original cast of M*A*S*H.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, my hat goes off to you.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's cool in here, boy. For the rest of the summer, we can live inside the refrigerator.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, the fridge wasn't meant to be used this way. Although I must say, it's certainly refreshing.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I got the idea when I noticed the refrigerator was cold.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Won't this overload the motor?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, can you set the oven to cold?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, face it, Bart. Our salvation isn't just gonna roll by on the Back of some stupid truck.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: POOL MOBILE?!!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Lis, I snatched five bathing suits. All Martin's!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Time's up?!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So long, Lis. I'm gonna stow away underwater, and go where the pool goes. Have a good life.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh well. Same time tomorrow, Otto?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad...

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad...

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad...

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Lisa?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, as you know, we've been swimming. And we've developed a taste for it. We both agree that getting our own pool is the only way to go. Now before you respond, you must understand that your refusal would result in months and months of...

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: CanwehaveapoolDad? CanwehaveapoolDad? CanwehaveapoolDad? CanwehaveapoolDad? CanwehaveapoolDad? Canwe... etc.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I understand. Let us celebrate our new arrangement with the adding of chocolate to milk.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, The Tinkler. I like the sound of that. We'll take it.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is it true we should wait at least an hour after eating before we go in?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, everybody in the pool!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is it a pool yet?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Dad.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Who could that be...?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart...? Are all these children friends of yours?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Friends and well-wishers, yes.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: People, people, it's time we all discussed the pool safety rules.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You got it.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, Bart! Your epidermis is showing!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It is?!!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: See, "epidermis" means your hair...

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: YAAARRRGG!!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: ...so technically it's true. That's what makes it so funny. Pardon me a moment. Haw, haw.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey, Nelson. He's really hurt. I think he broke his leg.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I said, Haw, haw.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: I'm sorry, that leg's gonna have to come off.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Did I say leg? I meant that wet bathing suit. I'm afraid you'll need a cast on that broken bone.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm gonna miss the whole summer.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry boy, when you get a job like me, you'll miss every summer.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, guys! Sign my cast? Sign my cast? Guys...?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh, hi, Bart.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Faithful Milhouse. You'll spend the long, hot days by my side, won't you?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I think I lost my glasses in your pool. I better go in and find them.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But you're wearing your glasses.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: No, I'm not.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, look. Bart's all alone. Maybe I should keep him company, at least for a little while.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Coming!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, great. I get to spend the summer with my brain.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What fun can you have in a pool, anyway, that you can't have in a bathtub with a garbage bag taped around your cast?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Traitors. Go on and have your pool. I'm fine by myself, right here.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You know, this isn't so bad. I'll just spend the summer getting better acquainted with an old friend called Television.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hope you enjoyed that, kids, 'cause Krusty's outta here for the summer. In the meantime, we'll be running "Classic Krusty." Enjoy.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. The universe is so boring.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it looks like it's just you and me, Barty Boy.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah...There's nothing like rising with the sun for a quiet, peaceful dip in your very own pool.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: YAAARR--Ewwwwwww!!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa! The Blob has got me! Don't touch me, or he'll get you too!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad... You have to put chlorine in the water every day, to keep it clean.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Chlorine, eh?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, look. There's Bart. Wave to him.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm, maybe we should spend more time with Bart. He's becoming isolated and weird.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I swear I don't know where the bombs are! Only the Miners know that! Maybe this will loosen your tongue! No! Blah!!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Bart...?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't turn on that light!!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry. I just came to see how you were feeling.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm fine. Just fine.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What are you writing here? A play?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, no.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yuh huh. "Cast of Characters: Viceroy Fizzlebottom, a hearty cherub of a man..."

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gimme that! It's a work in progress. So. How do you like being Miss Popularity?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, well, y'know, it ain't so great. Bart, it's the best thing that ever happened to me in my whole life! Well, anyway, I brought you a present.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, it's the telescope I won at the Optics Festival.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There was an Optics Festival and I wasn't informed? You go now.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But...

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Go!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What have we here... "The Lighter Side of Hippies". They don't care whose toes they step on. .

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This was a lovely idea, Homie. Come here and kiss me.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmmm....

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Do not be alarmed. Continue swimming naked. Aw, come on. Continue. Come on, aw. All right, Lou, open fire.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I know, I'll use this to peer into Springfield's seamy underbelly.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm never ever gonna see anything interesting with this stupid piece of junk.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That came from Flanders' house.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ohmygod! What have I done? I've killed her!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Can't be what it looks like. This is Flanders we're talkin' about.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, I'll just watch some TV.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now, what you've all been waiting for. Another long "raga" by Ravi Shankar.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Shankar. Groovy, man.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, uh, noo. This can't be what it looks like. There's gotta be some other explanation.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I wish there was some other explanation for this. But there isn't. I'm a murderer! I'm a murderer!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Then that's not the real Ned Flanders.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I'm a murdiddly-erdiler.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: If that's not Flanders, he's done his homework!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Mommy had to go away. She's with God, now.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Soon enough.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's gonna kill Rod and Todd, too... That's horrible. In principle.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Look, Lisa. I found this change on the bottom of the pool. You can have it.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Nelson.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Shut up, brain! I got friends now. I don't need you anymore. Duh, yeah, I'd love to go to your house.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hello? Hey, I'm stuck in here. I gotta think of a way to get out.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Listen, Ned Flanders murdered his wife.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But why? She's such a fox. I mean, what's on Fox tonight? Something ribald, no doubt.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wish you'd stop spreading bad rumors about people. Remember how you got Grampa tarred and feathered?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sure. That was twenty minutes ago.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Gonna be in the tub for awhile.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I'm really sorry I've been ignoring you lately. I got carried away with being popular. But now that I'm unpopular again, I want you to know I'm here for you.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You can start makin' it up to me right now. Flanders is leaving the house. I want you to sneak in there and bring me back some evidence... and something sweet for later.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I'm here for you but, I'm not gonna break into somebody's house.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All right. You're right, you're right. Let's-let's just forget about that. Let me read to you from my play. "Kippers for breakfast, Aunt Helga? Is it St. Swivens day already?" "'Tis," replied Aunt Helga.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm goin', I'm goin!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: A human head!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Of course. Oh no. He's back. Flanders is back! Lisa, get outta there!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, Lisa, don't go upstairs. You'll be trapped!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: An axe! He's got an axe. I'll save you, Lisa!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... I'll save you by calling the police.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You see, Marge? You see?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll save you, cast or no cast!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gotta save Lisa, trash can or no trash can!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: MARY HAD A LITTLE LAMB / LITTLE LAMB / LITTLE LAMB...

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: It's time to put you away.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Put you away for good.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nooooo!

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: What the gumdrops is going on, here?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I came to stop you from murdering Lisa like you murdered your wife.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Murdered?

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But I distinctly heard you say that Maude was with God.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But I saw the murder, and then I saw you bury the corpse in the backyard.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: All right. It's true. I am a murderer. I over-watered Maude's favorite ficus plant, I panicked, and then I buried the remains. I was hoping to replace it before you got home.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But I heard a woman scream.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Huh? Well, now that I can't explain.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, well I guess that explains everything.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not everything. There's still the little matter of the whereabouts of your wife.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I see. Then everything is wrapped up in a neat little package. Really, I mean that. Sorry if it sounded sarcastic.

title: Bart of Darkness
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw, haw!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, will you keep it down!? I'm making a crank phone call to Principal Skinner.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Uh, well, as a matter of fact, my refrigerator wasn't running. You spared me quite a bit of spoilage. Thank you, anonymous young man.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's my room and I can do what I want.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah? Well, I can do what I want in my room.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, quit it!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can keep this up all day.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, stop the racket. I'm trying to fix your mother's camera. Now easy... easy.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hm, I'm gonna need a bigger drill.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My, these seas are certainly heaving.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Does that earring mean you're a pirate?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, stop blowing my sex! I mean, stop blowing your sax. Your sax. Stop it.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I'm auditioning for first chair in the school band and I've got to practice!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, but I sacrificed a very expensive camera just to get some quiet time.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Fine. I'll play outside.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hey, why that sounds like Gabriel's trumpet. You know what that means, kids?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, Ralph. That would defeat the purpose of testing as a means of student evaluation.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh! Ooh!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I never made Miss Hoover yow-wee.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Allison? I'm Lisa Simpson. Oh, it's great to finally meet someone who converses above the normal eight-year-old-level.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're younger than me, too?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No. I just like to smell my lunch... Gee, I never met anyone who skipped a grade before.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm sure I could have, but I'd hate to leave behind all my wonderful friends.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh! Hey, Sara! Well, I gotta go. I have to practice for band auditions.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The sax.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm going for first chair this year.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, with so much in common, I'm sure we'll be the best of friends.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Me, too.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hurry up and finish eating!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're steerin' fine, boy... Hard to the right!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hard to the left!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Cat!... Deer!... Old Man!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Jackknifed sugar truck. Sugar?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, buddy. Here's a quarter. Call for help at the nearest phone... I'll keep an eye on things here.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, that was downright decent of you.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We hit the jackpot, here! White gold! Texas tea... sweetener.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, isn't this stealing?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Read your town charter, boy. "If food stuffs should touch the ground, said food stuffs shall be turned over to the village idiot." Since I don't see him around, start shoveling.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What! What?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why am I still rotting away in the second grade instead of being skipped ahead?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know, honey. I guess that's the school's decision to make.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, did you ever talk to anyone at the school? Make a few calls on my behalf? Maybe you could've been "nicer" to Principal Skinner, if you know what I mean.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa! I am nice.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I really appreciate you making dinner, but this food tastes a little strange.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It hurts my teeth.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's because I've loaded it with sugar!!... Marge, our ship has come in! I found five hundred pounds of sugar -- in the forest -- that I'm gonna sell directly to the consumer. And all for a low, low price of one dollar per pound.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But the grocery store sells sugar for thirty-five cents a pound.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And it doesn't have nails and broken glass in it...

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Those are prizes. Ooo, a blasting cap!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I won first chair?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's happening... Oh... it was just a dream.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I won first chair?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh no, not again.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I need help, Mom. There's another girl at school who's smarter, younger, and a better sax player than me. Oh I feel so average.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you'll always be number one to me...

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hell-o. First born within earshot.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... I meant, my number one girl.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, for Chri...

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, if you get too competitive you'll never be happy. No matter how good you are there's always gonna be someone better than you. I always thought I had the tallest hair. But that trip to Graceland really opened my eyes.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But she's better than me at everything that makes me special.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Believe me, honey. She's more scared of you than you are of her.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're thinking of bears, Mom.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sugar Man!!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Door to door sugar? What a marvelous idea! What's that, mother? I'm just talking to the sugar man. Mother, I'm a big boy. I can do as I wish. Excuse me.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Thanks a lot, Simpson! Now I'm grounded!

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't tell you either, Ralph.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, that used to be my face in the mud...

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't stand to see you so miserable, Lis, unless it's from a rubber spider down your dress. Hmmm. That gives me an idea.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Note for later. Put rubber spider down Lisa's dress.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I know... How about if I dig up some dirt on Allison? Remember how I got Milhouse's picture on America's Most Wanted?

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I appreciate the offer, but it goes against every moral fiber in my body.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Suit yourself. But if you change your mind, here's my card.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't need a card. You live in the room next to me.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Note: Next year order fewer cards.

title: Lisa's Rival
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And you didn't think I'd make any money. I found a dollar while I was waiting for the bus.
