spoken_words: Me and Santa's Little Helper used to be a team, but he never wants to play anymore since his bitch moved in!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! Don't ever say that word again!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well that's what she is! I looked it up.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm going to write the dictionary people and have that checked. It feels like a mistake to me.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey look! A really small dog just fell out of Santa's girlfriend.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my God! She's having babies! Oh, I'm sorry, girl. I thought you were just getting fat.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, it's twins!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now it's two sets of twins.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Two sets of twins and a triplet!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, Homer find a place for all these little miracles.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my. I've never seen anything like this.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How many more can there be?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Twenty-two, twenty-three, twenty-four...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Twenty-five.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! Twenty-five puppies!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: An army of dogs! No bully will ever touch me again!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, jerkface! You have the face of a jerk!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Get 'em, boys!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Say, Jimbo ... hope I wasn't out of line with that "jerkface" crack.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homie, aren't they adorable?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, we've waited many years, but the good Lord has finally blessed us with a real family.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look at Branford II! Isn't that cute? He thinks he's one of the Models, Inc.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get that cat out of the way!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Agh, my socks!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, why do I have to wear a flea collar?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's just easier this way.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh... this time... Ah...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yeeesch! This house stinks! You're not just putting the new newspapers over the old ones, are you?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Do you have a better idea?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now I know we love the puppies very much, but I think they're getting to be a problem.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, they ate all my socks! I have to wear Lisa's to school today!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How do you explain the culottes, boy?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I have to coordinate, don't I?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your mother and I have been thinking about giving the puppies away.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nooooooo!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mainly your mother.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Is that what we do in this family? When someone becomes an inconvenience, we just get rid of them?!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Hello? Is anybody there?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right, we'll give the dogs one more chance. As long as the puppies don't do anything else wrong, they stay. On a completely unrelated topic, I'm having a very, very important dinner party tonight.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Splendid. Who's coming?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Rev. Lovejoy, your old Army drill sergeant, and the Regional Director of the IRS.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, just lovely, Marge. The whole town will hear what a perfect evening this was, how nothing at all went wrong.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Don't worry folks, we'll find your wallet.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Dear Lord, it's a demon bird!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: See you in hell! From heaven.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, we sure could use a pooch to guard the flock at the Flanderosa.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: It'd be nice to have some companionship when mother goes out on dates.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: We could use a new pet over at the home seein' how we accidentally killed that smart-mouthed bird.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They don't like being broken up.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We've got to be realistic, kids. Who's gonna have a big enough heart to take care of twenty-five puppies?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: ...and I know the little fellas would love romping around my many acres, chasing my many cars, drinking from my many toilets...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who wouldn't?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, don't give the puppies to him! He'll be mean to them!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: She's right, Homer. There's something about his face I don't trust.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I'm sorry, Mr. Burns, but you can't have these dogs. Am I fired?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hmm? Oh, of course not. They're your pets, you can do as you wish. Good day, everyone.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My, he certainly took that well.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A little too well, if you ask me. I'm sure he's plotting some brilliant scheme to get those puppies.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: There you go. There you go. You too...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Honestly, sir, you just don't put the effort into your schemes that you used to.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Going somewhere?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dogs! Chief, you're getting powdered sugar all over my floor!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: No, I'm not. No, I'm not. I'm, uh, dusting for prints.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We don't have to wait for the cops - who can track the puppies better than their own mom and dad?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Let's go find your babies!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dinner's on, dogs!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I'm sorry, kids. I don't think we're ever gonna find your greyhounds. Maybe Mr. Burns will sell you one of the twenty-five he got last night.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Who knows what horrible things he's doing to those innocent little puppies?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: There. Now, wasn't that heavenly? And don't you feel better, too?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's giving them a bath!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: There you are, there ya go li'l' fella, and you...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, look! He's standing up! I've never seen anything so adorable. You know who it reminds me of...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Benji?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Lassie?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No, no, no. A person, you know who I mean.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Snoop Doggy Dog? Bob Barker? David Brenner?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No, no. The person who's always standing and walking.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Rory Calhoun?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That's it! You stay with me. You're the pick of the litter.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe we were wrong about Burns on this one.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Are you sure you want to go through with this, sir? You do have a very full wardrobe as it is.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: : Yes... But not completely full, for you see... / "SOME MEN HUNT FOR SPORT, /OTHERS HUNT FOR FOOD / THE ONLY THING I'M HUNTING FOR / IS AN OUTFIT THAT LOOKS GOOD..."

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Stee-rike!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: / SEE MY VEST, SEE MY VEST / MADE FROM REAL GORILLA CHEST / FEEL THIS SWEATER, THERE'S NO BETTER / THAN AUTHENTIC IRISH SETTER... / SEE THIS HAT, T'WAS MY CAT / MY EVENING WEAR, A VAMPIRE BAT / THESE WHITE SLIPPERS ARE ALBINO / AFRICAN ENDANGERED RHINO... / GRIZZLY BEAR UNDERWEAR / TURTLES NECKS, I'VE GOT MY SHARE / BERET OF POODLE ON MY NOODLE, / IT SHALL REST... / TRY MY RED ROBIN SUIT / IT COMES ONE BREAST OR TWO... / SEE MY VEST, SEE MY VEST, SEE MY VEST / / LIKE... MY... LOAFERS? / FORMER... GOPHERS... / IT WAS THAT OR / SKIN MY CHAUFFEURS

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: BUT A GREYHOUND FUR TUXEDO / WOULD BE BEST / SO LET'S PREPARE THESE DOGS...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: SEE MY VEST... / SEE MY VEST... / OH, PLEASE, WON'T YOU SEE MY VEESSSST!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I really like the vest.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I gathered, yeah.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's gonna make a tuxedo out of our puppies!!!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry. You've gotta admit it's catchy.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Come on, Smithers. Let's go finish the little flea circuses off. Except for "Little Monty," of course.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We've gotta get the dogs outta there!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ssh.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hush, puppies!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We've gotta get you outta here!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I know, the window!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No Bart! What're you doing?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dogs always land on their feet.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's cats.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, it's dogs. I'll prove it.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Best two out of three.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, Look! A laundry chute!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay guys, let's move!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on! Come on!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've got an idea!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, Monty, but you're too big for this ride.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Quick, let's get...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's impossible! How did you get here first?

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh well, there'll be plenty of time for explanations later. Right now, I'll be taking my puppies back.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But they're ours! You stole them from us!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Here's a phone. Call somebody who cares.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Give me that! Now if you'll excuse us, children, the pups have a date with a fashion knife.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There! Now you don't know which one is Little Monty! I guess if you don't want him to be part of your tuxedo, you'll have to let the other dogs go, too!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Nice try. C'mon, Little Monty, stand up!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Come on, stand up! Do your trick.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, don't! Stay down, Monty! Don't get up! Stay down! Stay down, boy!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now it's simply a matter of bending down and picking up the one and only...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: This can't be happening! They're all standing! I can't tell them apart! All right, you win...

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'll have to kill them all.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nooo!!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: But they're so wretchedly adorable! Twenty-five little Rory Calhouns. I can't do it!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: But I can kill you!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No, I can't kill you either. Look at you standing there on your hind legs like a couple of Rory Calhouns.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Mr. Burns, I hope you've realized the folly of killing innocent animals for fashion.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, I have. I have! I swear I'll never wear any clothing made from an animal that can do an amusing trick!

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! For the love of God, no.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: You don't have the guts to take us all on.

title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you know that batting this lightbulb is the only thing that cheers me up after giving away those million dollar greyhounds.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: This bus has seen better days.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, at least it's safer than the old bus.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh oh, time to move. The hole's gettin' bigger.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Seymour, the children are playing in the hole again. Shouldn't you get that fixed?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Edna, you know they just cut the school's budget. Besides, if I had the money, I'd fix the exhaust leak in the back. Frankly, I think it's causing some of our low test scores.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: All right, the battlefield is just a half mile ahead. Begin braking procedure!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Otto, why don't you get some more gas. Here's the 'credit card.'

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: ...and a mint for afterwards.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Five dollars a child?! Last year it was free.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bu..but we don't have that kind of money. In fact, no school could afford to...

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: He thinks he's so hot ever since he swept the "princi" awards. Those things are rigged.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's hard to see what's going on. I can only make out the fat soldiers.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: All right children, switch.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Run children!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Start the bus Otto!! Start the bus!!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Well Seymour, because of your penny pinching, we're coming back from a field trip with the fewest children yet.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: God bless the man who invented permission slips.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, I think I got your lunch.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah. I didn't think this was for me.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Seymour, the teachers are fed up. You have to start putting money back into the school. You've cut back on everything: salaries, supplies, the food. I don't care what you say, I can taste the newspaper.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Posh. Shredded newspapers add much needed roughage and essential inks. Besides, you didn't notice the old gym mats.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: That's it!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Our demands are very reasonable. By ignoring them, you're selling out these children's futures.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, c'mon, Edna. We both know these children have no future.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Prove me wrong, kids. Prove me wrong.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've never seen them fight like that, Bart. I'm worried that all this posturing and saber-rattling could lead to a teachers strike.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Strike, eh?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oww! My bones are so brittle. But I always drink plenty of... malk?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: How do you expect us to teach with these supplies? Well this pointer's so old, it's worn down to a nub.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: It still points, doesn't it?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Stop that. And look at this. The only books we have are ones that were banned by other schools.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, the kids have to learn about Tek War sooner or later.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Go away, Bart. This is not a good time.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I saw you two fighting. I'm worried there could be a strike and the school would shut down.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: I'm sure you'd really hate that. There's not going to be a strike, Bart.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Skinner said you wouldn't have the wontons to go through with it.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Skinner said that?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I had to clean it up a little.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But basically, Krabappel said you'd give the teachers everything they want.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: She did?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. She said you'd fold faster than Superman on laundry day.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: We'll see about that. Simpson, I always thought you were sneaky and manipulative, but now I see you're really a very sensitive little boy.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, sir.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Aww.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Seymour, you're being totally unfair and the teachers won't stand for it.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Teachers. You don't have the guts to strike.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Attention. This is an emergency broadcast. All is well in the school. My authority as principal is total -- Hey, gimme that.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Attention teachers: we're on strike. Ha!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no. Strike?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! Lisa! What are you two doing home so early?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Great news, Mom!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Horrible news, Mom!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The school's on strike. Maybe forever. Overload. Pleasure overload.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Luckily I've prepared for this, so I'm not too worried.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, leave that crowbar here. You know I don't like you prying and jimmying.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Mom! Dad! Great news! The teachers are on --

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Awesome.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You with the crane, spin around real fast.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now you, dump three tons of sand onto that port-a-potty.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lousy teachers. Trying to palm off our kids on us.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But Dad, by striking they're trying to effect a change in management so that they can be happier and more productive.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, if you don't like your job you don't strike. You just go in every day and do it really half-assed. That's the American way.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've got some textbooks, but without state approved syllabi and standardized testing my education can only go so far.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, maybe you should relax a little?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Relax? I can't relax. Nor can I yield, relent, or... Only two synonyms? Oh my God! I'm losing my perspicacity!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's always in the last place you look.

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So if we were in school this week, what do you think we'd be learning?

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Good news, people!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: I'm happy to announce that another union has joined us in a sympathy strike: the piano tuners local 4-12!

title: The PTA Disbands
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now for operation strike-make-go-longer.

title: The PTA Disbands

spoken_words: I told you I don't have anything.

spoken_words: Get 'im, Ma!

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There's no place left to run, Bart. Hand it over.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Bart. I can't believe you did this.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I wanted to surprise you for Christmas...

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Sweetie. This is the best present a mother could get.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I love you so much, my little Bitty Barty.

title: Marge Be Not Proud
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mo-ommm...

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Since I got my present early, I think you should get yours early too.

spoken_words: You got me...?

spoken_words: Uh, yeahhh! Thanks, Mom.

name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The year was 1968. We were on re-con in a steaming Mekong delta. An overheated private removed his flak jacket, revealing a T-shirt with an iron-on sporting the Mad slogan, "UP WITH MINI-SKIRTS." Well, we all had a good laugh, even though I didn't quite understand it.

title: Team Homer
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: But our momentary lapse of concentration allowed "Charlie" to get the drop on us. I spent the next three years in a POW camp, forced to subsist on a thin stew made of fish, vegetables, prawns, coconut milk and four kinds of rice. I came close to madness trying to find it here in the States, but they just can't get the spices right...
