title: Bart the Fink
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Ladies and gentlemen... Krusty the Clown is dead!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe Krusty is really gone.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, son. I'm sure he's up in Heaven right now, laughing it up with all the other celebrities -- John Dillinger, Ty Cobb, Joseph Stalin... I wish I were dead.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you're seeing Krusty everywhere because you want to tell him you're sorry for causing his death. Would it help if I told you you're not responsible for Krusty's death?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yes. Yes it would.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: And so Herschel Krustofsky is gone. But not forgotten. Today was the unveiling of the new Krusty stamp. Postal patrons were asked to choose between two competing designs: One of Krusty's heartwarming smile... and one of his fiery death.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: By a nearly 2 to 1 vote, the smiling Krusty was chosen.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't let Krusty's death get you down, boy. People die all the time. Just like that. Why, you could wake up dead tomorrow. Well, good night.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom! I just saw Krusty!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, dear. In your mind.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, on the street.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: On the street in your mind.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why won't you believe me?!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sweetheart, maybe you just want Krusty to be alive so badly, you think you see him everywhere. I went through the same thing when Lyndon Johnson died.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: ...and these pills will help with the queasiness.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty?! Doctor Hibbert, who was that man?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Now Bart, telling you would violate the patient/doctor privilege, just as if I were to tell you that Jaspser here has five seconds to live.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Am I going crazy? I'm seeing Krusty everywhere.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ye olde toast.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well I can't. You'll just have to learn to live with your mental problem.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute! All those things I saw -- there's a connection! The truck full of nets and buckets, the queasy guy, the lobsters... they all point to one thing. Follow me.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ahoy! Have you seen this man?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No. We're looking for this man, Krusty the Clown.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's hopeless, Bart. We've searched up and down these docks, from Pier One to that Pier 1 by Pier Seventeen.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa! Look! A signature with stars around it, just like Krusty's!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Rory B. Bellows, Slip Eight!" Let's go!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you Rory B. Bellows?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How about Krusty the Clown?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if you're not Krusty, how come you have the exact same signature as him?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! You've got a pacemaker scar just like Krusty!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And Krusty's superfluous third nipple!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But we saw your plane crash...

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, but I wasn't in it...

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Just before I hit the mountain, I jumped out of the plane into a carefully placed net.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So now that we've blown your cover, I guess you've gotta come back and do your show again!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Or kill us.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I won't be coming back, kids. I've got a sweet life here. The sea air is clearing my lungs, the sun is toasting my pale skin a healthy brown, and most important, I learned that I don't need money to be happy. All that high living just distracted me from my true calling in life: salvaging sunken barges for scrap iron. Sorry, kids, there's nothing left for me on dry land anymore.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But Krusty, what about all the kids who depend on you to brighten up their afternoons? Are you going to turn your back on them?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, Lis, Krusty doesn't want our attention anymore. Let's go worship somebody who has the guts to be a celebrity.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Krusty doesn't want to be a clown. He's happy just being another blue-collar bozo.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Meh.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty's tired of having phonies around, pretending to be his friends. I'm sure he'll find plenty of people who'll like him for who he is.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: It could happen. Who needs friends? The incessant beep of the Global Positioning System is all the companionship I need.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Tell me where you are now, you bastard!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: All right, I admit it. I miss the phonies -- but that's all I miss. That and the Shirley Jones/Marty Engles New Years Eve Party.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What about that great feeling you get from knowing you're better than regular people?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What about: being an illiterate TV clown who's still more respected than all the scientists, doctors and educators in the country put together?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeahhhh, I'm not gonna let those guys hog all the respect while I'm out here on some stinkin' tub.

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: That's just what those eggheads want. Well, forget it, Poindexter, 'cause Krusty's back in town!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yay!

title: Bart the Fink
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So Krusty, what are you gonna do about your tax problem?

title: Bart the Fink
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Don't sweat it. The life of "Rory B. Bellows" is insured for a surprisingly large amount.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: This is going to be great!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I hope they show the time where they traded guns to the Indians for corn, and then the Indians shot them and took the corn.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: "Embiggens." Hmm, I never heard that word before I moved to Springfield.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now as you all know, Springfield's 200th birthday is only a week away. Every class will do its part to make our local bicentennial just as memorable as our National Bicentennial. Of course, you children are too young to remember that -- with the possible exception of Kearney.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, they need volunteers to play old-timey people in the parade. Look, I can be a butter churner, a typhoid carrier... an apprentice! I think I'll be an apprentice, Marge.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What kind of apprentice?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's for my master to decide.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How about town crier? You'd be great at that.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You think so?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Dad! You're a big fat loudmouth. And you can walk when you have to.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah! Well, if you kids believe in me that much, I'll give it my best shot.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, I'm Lisa Simpson. I'm here to research a report on Jebediah.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Congratulations, Ned, you are our new town crier.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: May your shrill, nasal voice ring throughout our streets and brains.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Thankily-dank, Mayor, I shan't disappoint. Har ye, har ye! I declare myself pickled tink about Springfield's Bicen-ciddily-ti-ten-toodily-rin-tin-tennial Day!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You su-diddily-uck, Flanders! Gimme that!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hear ye! Hear ye! Ye olde town crier proclaimed crappy by all! Chooseth Homer Simpson and he shalt rock thy world!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Good God, he is fabulous!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: He's embiggened that role with his cromulent performance!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I was right about Jebediah, and now I can prove it.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Top-notch criering, I admit. But the hat and bell belong to Flanders, so no dice.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Aw, they're just family heirlooms. That shouldn't stand in the way of Homer takin' my job and--

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Less chat, more hat.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Hear ye! Hear ye! The Homer Broadcasting System is on the air! All hollering, all the time! I'm gonna make the...

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: You're to restrict your cryering to the parade, and selected pre-approved publicity events.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "The Secret Confessions of Jebediah Springfield?" "Know ye who read this: there is more to my life than history records."

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "--ha ha ha ha ha." Oh my God! Our town hero is a fraud! "I write this confession so that my infamy will live on long after my body has succumbed to my infectious diphtheria."

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's just the excitement of studying Jebediah.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Just when I was getting over my Chester A. Arthritis.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, no.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hear ye, hear ye! What's for breakfast?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Toast.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't understand thee, Marge.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What would you say if I told you Jebediah Springfield wasn't as great as he's cracked up to be? Look.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Jebediah was really a vicious pirate named Hans Sprüngfeld. His tongue was bitten off by a Turk in a grog house fight!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No tongue, eh? How did he talk and eat and laugh and love?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He had a prosthetic tongue made out of silver.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, that'd do.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He was one of the evillest men of the 1780's. He even tried to kill George Washington!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The dastard!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The next time Hans Sprüngfeld was seen, he had changed his name to Jebediah Springfield.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, honey, when my family first came to this state, they had a choice of living in Springfield or Stenchburg. You know why they chose Springfield? Because everyone knows Jebediah Springfield was a true American hero. End of story.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I believe you, honey.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You do?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Of course I do. You're always right about this type of thing, and for once, I want in on the ground floor.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, thanks, Dad.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But it's all true!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, nice talking to you.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Miss Hoover thought I made the whole thing up. She called me a P.C. thug.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've been called a greasy thug too, and it never stops hurting. So here's what we're gonna do: grease ourselves up real good, and trash that place with a baseball bat.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That won't help, Dad. No one's ever going to believe me.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But you have proof! We could go get that confession out of Jebediah's fife.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We could?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, we can use the baseball bat to smash open the case.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No baseball bat.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Mr. Hurlbut.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Town Crier. I'd like to ask you a few questions. One: where's the fife, and two: give me the fife.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah? Well, put this in your fife and smoke it!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's Jebediah's secret confession. It proves he was a fraud.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But it explains why there's no record of Jebediah before 1795! He was Hans Sprüngfeld until then!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not going to give up. I refuse to believe that everyone refuses to believe the truth.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'd like 25 copies on goldenrod, 25 on canary, 25 on saffron, and 25 on paella.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You don't have to help me with this, Dad.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Go! Go!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, sure I do. I always believe in helping the little guy, and you're the littlest guy I know.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Question: is your name Ridley Scott or James Cameron?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, it's Homer.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Well, then I will thank you to stop peering at my screenplay, "Homer." And if I see a movie where computers threaten our personal liberties, I will know that you stole my idea.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm just waitin' for my kid.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Apu. Can I put this poster in your window?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, of course you can, you little pixie! Woo! You are just as sweet as the stix which bear your name.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: No, no, no, no, no, no, no! Take that down! As a semi-legal immigrant, your poster could land me in a predicament as red-hot as the candies which bear that name.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He wouldn't let me put it up.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, well, that's not gonna stop us. I know a much better way to get attention...

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hear ye, hear ye, my daughter has something to tell you about Jebediah Springfield.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, the little cutie wants to do something cute... Shut up, ya bums, shut up! Go ahead, angel.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Jebediah Springfield was nothing more than an evil, blood-thirsty pirate who hated this town!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Good God. Homer, y'know I support most any prejudice you can name, but your hero-phobia sickens me. You and your daughter ain't welcome here no more. Barney, show 'em the exit.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: "Evil blood-thirsty pirate"... Hello, Town Jubilation Committee? I got something that's going to make you a lot less jubilant.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Can't you understand, little girl? Jebediah was no criminal.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: That's right. The reason they say he had a silver tongue is because he was such a fine speaker.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's a myth that got mixed up with the truth.

title: Bart on the Road
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: You are tampering with forces you can't understand. We have major corporations sponsoring this event.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hope you know you're sponsoring a celebration for a murderous pirate!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, I see no way of settling this. I say we imprison them for the duration of our Bicentennial.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: There is one way: get the silver tongue. If Jebediah's who I say he is, then it should still be in his grave.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Well, yes, but human decency prevents--

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: DIG HIM UP! Dig up that corpse!! If you really love Jebediah Springfield, you'll haul his bones out of the ground to prove my daughter wrong!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dig up his grave! Pull out his tongue!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Can't we have one meeting that doesn't end with us digging up a corpse?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Now, Lisa, when you see there's no silver tongue in there, will you stop trying to ruin Jebediah's reputation?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do we win if the tongue is there?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Credibility.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What a jip.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Jebediah Springfield has been replaced with a skeleton!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Gotcha, gotcha. Okay, ah, well, let's start looking for that silver tongue.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't forget to look in his shoes. When I lose something, sometimes it turns up in my shoes.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Actually, if it's anywhere, it would be lodged in the sinus.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Alright, here goes... Forgive us, Jebediah, we mean no disrespect.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, that settles that. There is no silver tongue. Is there, Bonesy?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: That's the spirit, Bonesy. Why don't you sing a song for the nice people?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I was so sure...

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hear ye, hear ye, everybody makes mistakes. Let's go home.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Not so fast, Simpson. This foul business was all your fault.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: By the power vested in me, I hereby strip you of your ceremonial bell--

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No! Nooooooo!!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: -- and tri-corner hat.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: You will have the hat cleaned, and then return it.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Dad, I'm really sorry. I know how much you wanted to be in the parade.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's not your fault, honey. I'm supposed to be the responsible one. I shouldn't have let you let me get carried away.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: General Washington?!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But I've caused so much trouble already, General Washington. I can't go on.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! Not Janey! She'll pack the Supreme Court with boys!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, let me help you, George Washington, I still want to help you.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "I want to help you, George Washington?" Even your dreams are square.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The missing piece of the puzzle... I've got it!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Slow down!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's because you stole it!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But when you found the truth, you couldn't take it! You couldn't stand that you'd devoted your life to a fraud! So you covered it up! Didn't you? Didn't you?!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop it! Where's the silver tongue?!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You did. Until I realized that Jebediah's confession was saying more than he meant it to.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How else could he have gotten this?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Exactly.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What's going on here?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: This is highly unorthodox!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: People of Springfield, I, uh, I don't know quite how to say this...

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I did a lot of research on Jebediah Springfield and...

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Wait, let's see what she has to say.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: But what would you do without me, Sir?

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Jebediah Springfield was... Jebediah was... great. I, um, just wanted to say that I've done some research and, uh, he was great.

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Because the myth of Jebediah has value, too. It's brought out the best in everyone in this town. Regardless of who said it, "a noble spirit embiggens the smallest man."

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, hey, it's Homer! Good to see ya, neighb--

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get lost!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hear ye, HEAR YE, HEAR YE!!

title: Lisa the Iconoclast
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, I'd like to, ma'am, but he's too damn good. Let him march, boys. Let the man march.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Testing... Testing for Mr. Burns. Here you go, Sir. I've warmed up the crowd for you.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: "Welcome employees!" "Come in!" "The whole night's entertainment is on me" -- "Monty Burns!"

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Welcome to an evening of exciting quarter mile action !

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Our first race is a benefit for daredevil Lance Murdock , who's hospitalized with cirrhosis of the liver !

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right! Liver!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, it sure would be fun to carpool in one of those, huh, kids? I'd be a real hot-rod mama, wouldn't I? Huh? Huh?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You missed the race, mama.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wish I'd pay more attention.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, this beer isn't working. I don't feel any younger or "funkier."

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'll switch to the tablespoon, Sir.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Coming up next, our feature race: The Nuclear Power Plant Championship .

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, at last! Smithers, fetch the bi-oculars.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Damnation! Tell them to go slower!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Yes sir.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Hi, guys. Could we keep it in first gear for a couple of laps?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, this novelty foam hand is ludicrously oversized. Go swap it for a smaller one.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It is a bit ostentatious, Sir. I'll be right back.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, Burnsie! Ha! -- This was some swell shindig. Thank you very much.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers! What's happening?!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I had a great time and... and I just want to shake your hand...

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You're the greatest!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers! Help!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It doesn't seem as funny to me, but what do I know?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh my God!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You should've seen the murderous glint in his eye, Smithers. And his breath reeked of beer and pretzeld bread.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'm so sorry, Mr. Burns. This was all my fault.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, don't concern yourself. If things had turned ugly I always had my mace.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Don't let me off the hook that easily, Sir. I failed you and I'll never forgive myself. Never! Never! Never!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Never! Never! Never!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Good morning, Sir. To make up for my failure last night, I've alphabetized your breakfast. You can start with the waffles, and work your way up to the zwieback. And to prevent newsprint from rubbing off on your hands, I've laminated today's newspaper.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I appreciate the thought, but my pen won't write on this. How am I supposed to do the "Junior Jumble?"

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh, I can't even grovel properly! I'm a buffoon! I don't deserve to live on your planet anymore!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Pull yourself together, man! I dare say you're in need of a long vacation.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: No! Don't make me take a vacation! Without you, I'll wither and die.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That's a risk I'm willing to take.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Tchah! I'm not a baby who needs a nursemaid to burp me. You see? Now I insist you take a vacation just as soon as a temporary substitute can be found.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I've got to find a replacement who won't outshine me. Perhaps if I search the employee evaluations for the word "incompetent..."

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: 714 names! Huh. Better be more specific. "Lazy", "Clumsy", "Dimwitted", "Monstrously Ugly".

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Aw, nuts to this. I'll just go get Homer Simpson.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think Smithers picked me because of my motivational skills. Everyone always says they have to work a lot harder when I'm around.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Dad, assisting Mr. Burns could give your career a real shot in the arm.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Homer, assisting Mr. Burns could give your career a real shot in the arm.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mo-omm! I just said that!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sor-ry. Next time get your own darned corn.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Um, is this the chair I'll be sitting on?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Yah. Now I realize caring for Mr. Burns seems like a big job, but actually it's just 2800 small jobs.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh. But this is the chair, right?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Your new duties will include answering Mr. Burns' phone, preparing his tax return, moistening his eyeballs, assisting with his chewing and swallowing, lying to Congress, and some light typing.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Montgomery Burns' office... Oh, hello Mrs. Burns... I'll see if your son is available.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns has a mother!? She must be a hundred million years old!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: She has limited capacities. All she can do is dial and yell.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'm sorry, Monty can't come to the phone right now. He's in a very important meeting and can't be disturbed.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Dough-nuts?! I told you I don't like ethnic food!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Here. Tell me how my stocks did yesterday.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh-huh... Okay, I'll give him the message. Mr. Burns can't stand talking to his mother. He never forgave her for having that affair with President Taft.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heh, heh. Taft, you old dog...

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Really, Smithers, I'll be fine! I'm sure your replacement will be able to handle everything. Who is he, anyway?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh, Homer Simpson, Sir. One of your organ banks from sector 7-G. All the recent events of your life have revolved around him in some way.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Simpson, eh?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Mr. Smithers? I don't understand 2700 of my new duties.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Well, the van's leaving. Which one duty is giving you the most trouble?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Um, what do I do in case of fire?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sorry, can't hear you. Bye-bye!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just my luck.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Good lord, Smithers! You look atrocious. I thought I told you to take a vacation.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Smithers already left, Sir. I'm his replacement, Homer Simpson.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, yes, Simpson. I'll have my lunch now. A single pillow of shredded wheat, some steamed toast, and a dodo egg.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I think the dodo went extinct...

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Get going! And answer those phones, install a computer system, and rotate my office so the window faces the hills.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh, uh-huh, okay. Um, can you repeat the part of the stuff where you said all about the things? The things?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lousy two-legged pants.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, it's 4:30 in the morning. "Little Rascals" isn't on 'til 6.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know. I'm taping it. I want to get to Mr. Burns' house bright and early to make his breakfast.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, poor Homie. Poor, poor...

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmmm. One of these must be a breakfast maker.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's my job to cook him breakfast, and I'm gonna cook the best damned breakfast he ever ate!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... they all won.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Eh? What about my options?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you can either get up or go back to sleep.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I believe I'll get up.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Scrub harder. Got to get that layer of dead skin off.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I think the fangs today.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Simpson? Simpson?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Did you get that report on the accounting department?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Sir, I did.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The accounting department is located on the third floor. Its hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. The head of this department is a Mr. Johnson or Johnstone.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here are your messages: "You have 30 minutes to move your car," "You have 10 minutes," "Your car has been impounded," "Your car has been crushed into a cube," "You have 30 minutes to move your cube."

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello. Mr. Burns' office.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Is it about my cube?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's Mr. Smithers. He's calling for you.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: How is everything going there, sir?... Well, I have a lot of free time on my hands. If you Fed Ex'd me your mail, I'd be happy to open it and return it to you.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Everything's fine, Smithers. But this Simpson fellow seems to be getting dumber by the minute. I've never seen anything quite like it... Anyhoo, you just enjoy your vacation.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look alive, Simpson! I'm not paying you to goldbrick!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes! Yes, sir!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now get cracking on my long division. And don't forget to show your work, Simpson.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll have it on your desk in the morning, sir.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, leave Simpson alone.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Simpson! I need a ride to the library.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, stop exploiting your father. Homie, why don't you lie down and relax.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No time, Marge. I think Mr. Burns wants me to do some long division.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Simpson! Lie down!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, but you need a good night's rest.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Simpson!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The telephone has been ringing for some time. Answer it.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yello?... It's for you.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, 48 rings! Are you all right? What did Simpson do to you?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Nothing other than drive me to distraction with his incompetent boobery. Terrible at everything. A complete moron. But I'm not really free to talk right now.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Look, stop calling me and start enjoying your vacation. Remember, I want to see lots of pictures when you get back.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Ah... actually, Sir, picture taking is not allowed at this particular resort. Whoops, I've got to go now -- there's a line forming behind me.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: 60 watts! What do you think this is -- a tanning salon?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I asked for light starch on my nightcap!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You call this Postum?!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You call this a tax return?!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You call this a super computer?!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You're a travesty of a truke of an assistant.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is there something wrong, Homie?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Except...

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Except... I killed Mr. Burns.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What happened, Dad?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I punched Mr. Burns right in his 104 year-old face.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure he's dead? Maybe you just really really hurt him.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. Maybe everything's all right. Maybe if you go apologize, he won't even fire you. If he's alive.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm really sorry I hit you, Mr. Burns. Here, let me put some salt on that eye.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No, please! I can't bear another thrashing. Just leave me be.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sir.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Must call Smithers. He'll protect me from this beast.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I've seen people activate this machine a thousand times. Doesn't seem to be any trick to it... Let's see... Smithers... "S-M-I-T-H-E-R-S". Success! It's ringing!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Moe's Tavern.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'm looking for a Mr. Smithers. First name, Waylon.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, so you're looking for a Mr. Smithers, eh? First name, Waylon, is it? Listen to me, you... when I catch you, I'm going to pull out your eyes and shove 'em up your pants so you can watch me kick the crap out of you. Okay? Then I'm going to use your tongue to paint my boat.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, Smithers, if only you could hear me.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Something tells me Mr. Burns needs me.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Praise God, I think the thug has finally gone home for the day.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now I can make my escape...

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Mr. Burns. Do you want your coffee now?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Uh... no! I'm... uh... making it myself!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hear that? The percolations are imminent! No need to come in! Cease your ingress!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Stay back, Homer! Approach no further. Coffee's already made. I stomped the beans myself.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, can I at least drive you home, Mr. Burns? It's five o'clock.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No... I thought... I thought, uh, I'd chauffeur myself this evening! Yes, that's what I thought. How difficult can it be? I'm sure the manual will indicate which lever is the velocitator and which the deceleratrix.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I can't believe it! All my life I've avoided doing things for myself, but I'm actually enjoying this. Plus I'm making incredible time.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Beep beep! Out of my way, I'm a motorist!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Ahh, that's some nice reckless driving, Mr. B!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Would you like me to shred those environmental reports for you, sir?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Already taken care of.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Cappuccino, Simpson?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ahoy-hoy? No, you have the wrong number. This is 5-2-4-6. I suspect you need more practice working your telephone machine. Not at all. Ahoy.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, is there anything at all I can do for you?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No, Homer. You've already done more for me than any man. Your brutal attack forced me to fend for myself. I realize now that being waited on hand and foot is okay for your average Joe, but it's not for me. I want to thank you.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Thank you, thank you, thank you!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh my God! I knew I shouldn't have left!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, welcome back, Smithers. Say, do you know Homer Simpson? He pitched in around the office while you were away. Bang up job, Simpson, but I guess it's back to your trusty post in sector 7-G.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You heard the man, Simpson.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, and my dear, dear Smithers... you're no longer needed at all. You're fired. Ta!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You shouldn't've gone away on vacation.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Cheer up, Homie.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I just feel terrible about getting Mr. Smithers fired. That job was all he had. Imagine how you'd feel, Marge, if you got fired from the... those things... that you do.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Quick, Mom! Whip up a cake before Dad fires you!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, Dad. Mr. Smithers is a resilient man. I'm sure he can get a great job at any corporation he wants.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Meet your new piano mover.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: We'll going to have to put a steel rod where your spine was.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh, will I ever move a piano again?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Oh, my goodness gracious, no.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Get ready for exciting quarter mile action at the Springfield Dragstrip. It'll be motorized mayhem !... Do we need all these "mayhems?" We do. All right, fair enough. I suppose you know your business. Get ready for fun ... The people are already here. We don't need to keep hustling them like this, do we? Hey, let go of me! Where are you throwing me?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh, hello. You had a "help wanted" sign in the window?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, yeah, I need someone to help me with the midnight beer delivery. Your job is to distract Barney until it's safely off the truck.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'll just wait out back until then.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Smithers, wait!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You can't let yourself end up in a place like this. You've got two choices: You can give up on yourself and take the Barney-guarding job, like so many of us have contemplated in our darkest moments. Or you can admit to yourself there's only one person that can make you happy and do whatever it takes to get them back.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You're right! But I'm going to need your help.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I gotcha covered.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Mr. Burns may have mastered 2,799 of my 2,800 duties. But I'll wager dollars to donuts he still can't handle a call from his mother.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're on.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Hello, Mrs. Burns? This is Waylon Smithers. I have your son Montgomery on the line.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Perfect. When I give the signal, you transfer the call to Mr. Burns. After she tears into him, I'll rush in and save the day.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Got it.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm transferring a call into you, Mr. Burns.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No problemo.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ahoy-hoy? Hoy?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Mr. Burns? This is your mother.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Gah! Oh, hello, Mater. Uh... Sorry about pulling the plug on you and all. Who could've known you'd pull through and... live for another five decades? Oh, is my face red...

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Mrs. Burns is 122 years old, so try to sound more desiccated. And she doesn't call her son Mr. Burns!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, this is Mrs. Burns! I just called to say I don't love you. You are a bad son, Montel!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: So!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Impersonate my mother, will you? And you, Smithers! You must have put him up to it! I'm glad I fired you.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You really blew it this time, Smithers.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Stop that! Stop that at once! You're fighting!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Stop fighting like a girl, Simpson.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Stop it! Stop it, I say!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'll teach you how to use a phone, you boob!

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It's for you.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll show you.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh my.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Here comes the endangered condor into the power lines.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I've got Bobo, hot from the dryer! Careful not to burn yourself on his eye.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I don't need you to do any of this. I'm totally self-sufficient now. What I would like, though, is a Spanish peanut.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Skin.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's a remarkable thing. In the short time you were gone, I learned to be completely self reli--

title: Homer the Smithers
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: -- ant. Oh, and as for that brutish fellow who knocked me out the window... see that he gets what's coming to him.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I already have, sir.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What did you get that for?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: For knocking Mr. Burns out a third story window.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Makes sense to me.

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Did he die?

title: Homer the Smithers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What am I -- a doctor?

title: The Day the Violence Died
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, if I ever stop loving violence, I want you to shoot me.

title: The Day the Violence Died
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Will do.

title: The Day the Violence Died
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Tonight: a stow-away bear is terrorizing Space Shuttle astronauts! But first: a sneak peek at tomorrow's Itchy and Scratchy parade!

title: The Day the Violence Died
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Hello, everybody. I'm here live on Main Street, where dedicated fans are already staking out the best seats for the big Anniversary parade.

title: The Day the Violence Died
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bye, Mom. Bye, Dad.

title: 22 Short Films About Springfield
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy

title: 22 Short Films About Springfield
name: Ned Flanders

title: 22 Short Films About Springfield
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy

spoken_words: Does the whole town have to hear about this?
