title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: 'Bout time, Knothead.

title: 22 Short Films About Springfield
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Yep, everybody in town's got their story to tell.

title: 22 Short Films About Springfield
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There's just not enough time to hear 'em all...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa! I don't mind when you spit at home, but I have to work with these people.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, jabberjack! Schoolhouse don't put out spittoons, I ain't responsible.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: All right, seniors, we'd all love to share in your wisdom, experience, yadda yadda yadda. Let's start with Milhouse's grandfather.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You're living in a fool's paradise, Van Houten. If you fell down in the shower, that thing'd be your tomb!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa, hush.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here, why don't you spit some more.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Wow, 47. I love you, Grampa.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, well, I may not have a fancy black bathrobe and a hammer like Snooty, but I do have slippers and an oatmeal spoon. Look!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Bart, perhaps your grandfather would like to come up front now and give someone else a chance to interrupt.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, please, no.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Now... hey, listen! Now, my story begins in 19-dickety-two. We had to say "dickety" 'cause the Kaiser had stolen our word "twenty." I chased that rascal to get it back, but gave up after dickety-six miles.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: What're you cackling at, Fatty? Too much pie, that's your problem!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Now, I'd like to digress from my prepared remarks to discuss how I invented the terlet.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Terlet. Ha!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop yer snickering! I spent three years on that terlet!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: ...And then he claimed he was the one who turned cats and dogs against each other. Why is he always making up those crazy stories?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe it's time we put Grampa in a home.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You already put him in a home.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe it's time to put him in one where he can't get out.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! Old people deserve our respect! Look at Jacques Cousteau and Goldie Hawn. You wouldn't shut them away like second-class citizens.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Second class? What about Social Security, bus discounts, Medic-Alert jewelry, Gold Bond powder, pants all the way up to your armpits, and all those other senior perks? Oh, if you ask me, old folks have it pretty sweet.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Ehh, this junk was hardly worth getting up for. Maybe if I go back to sleep for a few days, some good mail will build up.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's this?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Asa Phelps has-- The seventh Hellfish is dead! That means the fortune's almost mine!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Asa Phelps spent his entire life in Springfield. Except for four years' service in World War II and one high school day-trip. He worked at the United Strut and Bracing Works as a molder's boy, until he was replaced by a Molder-Matic and died.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Would you do the honors...?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I got this in the second World War Two!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, Simpson, seven gone. As soon as you're in your pressboard coffin, I'll be the sole survivor, and the treasure will be mine!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Over my dead body it will!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That's exactly the poi-- Oh, Simpson, can't you go five seconds without humiliating yourself?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: How long was that?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Your clownish behavior notwithstanding, we have made a gentleman's agreement and sworn on our lives to honor it.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, I want that man killed.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Let's see... "Mesmerists," "Dowsers," "Luddites," "Alienists," "Zoroastrians," "Alphabetizers,"... Aha! "Assassins!"

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I was wondering, Sir, do we really need to, uh... "settle" Abe Simpson? I mean, I'm familiar with his physical state, and perhaps if we wait, nature will assassinate him for us.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, I can't risk it. I won't allow that Simpson boy to take the Hellfish Bonanza, and I can't get it without his key!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, just the man I need. Fernando Vidal, the world's most devious assassin.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Fernando, it's "M.B."

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: This is Montgomery Burns.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'm sending you a photo over the Faxtrola. I need you to fly to Springfield and assassinate this man post-haste.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm up! I'm up!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Hot diggity! My family's come to visit me!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Waaait a minute! My family never comes to vis--

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'll be in the car, dudes.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Nurse! Someone's trying to kill me!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Lemme in! Someone's trying to kill me! Sweet Merciful McGillicuddy, ya gotta open the door!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who is it?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's Grampa. And it sounds like he's gotten into the horseradish again.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: ...and then a knife flew at my head! And you were there... And you were there...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Grampa, maybe I should moisten your washcloth...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: It's plenty moist! Listen, Monty Burns is tryin' to kill me and it's all because of um... I can't tell you why.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm sure you'll make up something. Maybe you just need more of my classmates around.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I gotta hole up here for awhile. They might still be after me.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, he's even more agitated than usual. Maybe we should let him stay.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But where are we going to put him?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart's room.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart's room.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart's room.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dumpster.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry to crowd ya, boy, but I'll let you in on a secret. Burns is after me 'cause he wants the Hellfish Bonanza.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, if you're going to stay in my room, could you at least stop making up gibberish?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Gibberish, eh? Then what's this?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wrinkly gibberish?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Back then, I was known as Sgt. Simpson, and I commanded the Flying Hellfish -- the fightingest squad in the fightingest company in the third fightingest battalion in the army. And we were all from Springfield. There was Police Chief Wiggum's father, Iggy Wiggum...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: ...our radio-man, Sheldon Skinner...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: ...and watchin' our backs was Private Fifth-Class Arnie Gumble.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Then there was also Griff, Asa, Ox and Etch.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: But every unit has a troublemaker. Ours was a cocky little private named Montgomery Burns.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Haven't you won the war yet?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: "Dead -- tired," but I'm quite refreshed now, thank you.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm-hmm. You bossed around the richest, most powerful guy in town. How come you were a sergeant and he was only a private?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he got busted down for obstructing a probe from J. Edgar Hoover. And we got stuck with him...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Heh, heh, heh. Now they'll never save your brain, Hitler...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Little help?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Boom! Boom, it went! Boom! Just like that! They took a photo of my keister for Stars & Stripes. At least they told me it was for Stars & Stripes.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if you saved Burns' life, why does he want to kill you?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: It was the closing days of the war. We had just flushed some Germans out of an abandoned castle...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You want me to report ya to Commander Flanders? Just leave 'em, Burnsie.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Leave them for whom? The Germans? The folks who shoot at us all day? Let's just take them. We'll all be rich! Rich as Nazis!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I don't feel right about it... but I could use a nest egg for retirement. I'd hate to wind up in one of them old folks homes.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Then it's agreed. Of course, we can't sell the paintings now. We'd be caught. How many of you are familiar with the concept of a "tontine?"

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right, Ox. Why don't you take us through it?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well put, Oxford. Now remember, you can't all sign with an X...

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: So we sealed up the paintings, knowing only one of us would ever look upon them again.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Ox was the first to go -- he got a hernia carrying the crate out of the castle. Five more men died in the Veterans' Day float disaster of '79. Now with Asa gone, it's down to me and Burns.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Great story, Grampa. Coulda used a vampire, though. 'Night.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: My own grandson thinks I'm a liar.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Aghhh! Don't kill me!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I've tried to meet you halfway on this, Simpson, but you had to be Little Johnny Live-a-lot. Now give me your key to the Hellfish Bonanza.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh wow! There really is a treasure! Whatever you do, don't give him the key, Grampa!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Here's the key.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Figures... Hey, Mr. Burns!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Can I go with you to get the treasure? I won't eat much and I don't know the difference between right and wrong.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, you're a good boy. But the child labor people have been watching me like a hawk.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, I'm off to get the paintings. As they say, time is Monets. As you were, Sergeant.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, terribly sorry. Back to sleep,

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: little girl.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I guess Burns is finally gonna be rich.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Not without the keys, he isn't.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you got the keys!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now we can get the treasure!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, what's the use? Burns would still find some way to take it from me.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe you, Grampa. The sergeant in that story you told would never be scared of a dork like Burns! You gotta get that treasure! You gotta do it for Ox and Asa and Griff and Burnsie... Well, not so much Burnsie.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You really think I can do it?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, yes. But we gotta act fast!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where are you two going at this hour?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: On a treasure hunt.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, can I come?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Only if you're ready to stare danger in the face, put your manhood to the ultimate test, and take--

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pass.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Grampa, do you think your dead buddies get up and walk around at night?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: If they're anything like me, they have to get up twice. Okay, hold up here.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Fellas, it's me, Sarge. At ease. I know I'm bendin' the rules tonight, but I also know none of you wants that skunk Burns to take our treasure. And I want you to know that when I die, you're all welcome to visit me in rich man's heaven.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Now it's gonna show us exactly where to dig!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, you borrow us some diving equipment while I borrow this boat.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, howdilly-doodily, stranger! Couldn't help but notice you stealing my boat.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll bring it back.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You ever operated a power boat?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Know anything about water safety?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: What do you need it for?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: It's a secret.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ooh, sounds spine-tingly-dingling. Just promise you'll have a good time.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Maude? Boys? Come on up! We're gonna have a little camp-out in the dinghy.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Now remember the plan, boy. If you run out of air, tug on the rope--

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: --sixty-four times. No more, no less. Got it.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: No, no. Sixty-three times if you're out of air. Sixty-four is if you found the treasure.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gotcha. Hey, Grampa, do you think I could've been a Flying Hellfish?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You're a gutsy daredevil with a give-'em-hell attitude and a fourth-grade education. You coulda made sergeant.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wo-o-o-ow!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: 61... 62... 63... Oh, no, 63?! He's out of air! I've sent my only grandson to a watery gra... !

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: 64?! He found the treasure! I'm rich!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You're one heckuva grandson, boy! Now, let's break 'er open and have a look-see.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Huh. The light must've burned out.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'll thank you to stop pinching my Botticelli.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Looks like I didn't need the keys after all. I'll take the masterpieces, thank you.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Consarn it!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You coward! You're an embarrassment to the name "Hellfish!"

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, am I?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: No! Look, take the art if you want. Just don't hurt the boy.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hmm. I'd rather do both.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: So long, Sarge. See you at the reunion in November.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry I cost you your fortune, Grampa.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, the fortune doesn't matter, boy. The important thing is you're safe. Now let's get that fortune!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: They're gaining on us, sir. We'll have to jettison something.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It's been an honor to serve you, sir.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Consarn it, he's getting away!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: In a pig's eye he is!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Act your age, Simpson! You look foolish!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Agh! Don't kill me!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I ain't gonna kill ya. That'd be cowardly. Monty Burns cowardly. I just wanna watch you squirm.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, sir! Is this to your liking?

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Now, Burnsie, there's one thing we don't stand for in the Hellfish, and that's trying to kill your commanding officer. So consider this your dishonorable discharge. You're outta my unit. You're outta the tontine. And that means the paintings are mine. Private, you are dismissed.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're rich, Grampa! You did it! And Burns can never take that away from you!

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I guess he deserves it more than I do... Well, at least I got to show you I wasn't always a pathetic old kook.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You never were, Grampa.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, I'd hug ya, but I know you'd just get embarrassed.

title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "The Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I won't get embarrassed. I don't care who knows I love my Grampa.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Open the door, Maude! I don't have time for the secret knock!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman with a special report from the Channel 6 newscopter. A large bear-like animal, most likely a bear, has wandered down from the hills, in search of food or perhaps employment. Please, remain calm. Stay in your homes.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Looks like bad news for the... ..."Impson" family.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's all calm down. Everyone's going to be just fine, as long as I've got enough beer.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, that does it. If I'm gonna be trapped inside the house I gotta go out and buy some beer.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now to drop gracefully through the windshield.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I've got ya, dad!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Sweet dreams, Smokey.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Book 'em, Lou. One count of being a bear. And one count of being an accessory to being a bear.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, things were bad everywhere.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sick of these constant bear attacks! It's like the freakin' country bear jamboroo around here.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, now realistically, Homer, I've lived here some 30-odd years. This is the first and only bear I've ever seen.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey -- if you want wild bears eating your children and scaring away your salmon, that's your business. But I'm not gonna take it! Who's with me?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: WE'RE HERE! WE'RE QUEER! WE DON'T WANT ANY MORE BEARS!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, Homer, that's a pretty catchy chant. Where'd you learn it?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I heard it at the Mustache Parade they have every year.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Does it have an appointment?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I phoned ahead.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Mayor, I hate to break it to you, but your city is infested with bears.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And these ones are smarter than the average bear. They swiped my pic-a-nic basket!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Very well. I promise swift and decisive action against these hibernating hucksters.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ahh, not a bear in sight. The bear patrol must be working like a charm.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's specious reasoning, Dad.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Honey.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: By your logic, I could claim that this rock keeps tigers away.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, how does it work?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It doesn't work.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's just a stupid rock.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But I don't see any tigers around here, do you?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, I want to buy your rock.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo! A perfect day -- zero bears, and one big fat hairy paycheck!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey... how come my pay is so low?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Bear Patrol Tax: $5?!" What?! This is an outrage! It's the biggest tax increase in history!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Actually, Dad, it's the smallest tax increase in history.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let the bears pay the bear tax. I pay the Homer Tax.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's the Home-Owner Tax.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, anyway, I'm still outraged.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Are these morons getting dumber or just louder?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Ducking this issue calls for real leadership.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: People, your taxes are high because of illegal immigrants! That's right, illegal immigrants. We need to get rid of them!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Immiggants?! I knew it was them! Even when it was the bears, I knew it was them!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: In one week, the town will vote on a special referendum -- whether or not to deport all illegal immigrants from Springfield. It shall be known as Proposition 24!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey German boy, go back to Germania!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Young man, the only thing we exchanged for you is our national dignity.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: You want to pick on immigrants?! Then pick on Willie!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Willie, please. The children want to pick on someone their own size.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ach.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't see how you can support Proposition 24, Dad.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Open your eyes, Lisa. Our schools are so jam-packed with immigrants, kids like Bart have lost the will to learn.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There's no denying it, Sis.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But immigration is what America's all about. Even the Simpson family immigrated to America. Right, Grampa?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, you twisted my arm. The Simpson story begins back in the old country... I forget which one exactly...

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: My father would drone on and on about America. He thought it was the greatest thing since sliced bread -- sliced bread having been invented the previous winter.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Later that day, we set sail for America.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: We had to move out once we'd filled the head with garbage. The end.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, when those immigrants get deported, there'll be more elbow room for regular Joes like you and me, Apu.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Ah... Mr. Simpson? It may astonish you to learn that I am an immigrant.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You? Pfft. I don't believe it.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: No. In truth, an illegal immigrant, Sir. If Proposition 24 passes, I shall be forced to leave this country.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, I wish... Oh, I wish I could have stayed just one more year or two. There was so much I wanted to see and to do and to have done to me.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God. I got so swept up in the scapegoating and fun of Proposition 24, I never stopped to think it might affect someone I cared about.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know what, Apu... I am really, really gonna miss you.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ya know what really aggravazes me, is them immiggants. They want all the benefits of livin' in Springfield, but they ain't even bothered to learn themselves the language.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. Those are exactly my sentimonies.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Eh, you said it, Barn.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Make the protesters go away and I'll give you the entire bottle.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, thank goodness. My first customers in a week.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's hard to believe someone so close to our family could be an illegal alien.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Alas, it is true. I came here shortly after my graduation from Cal Tech -- Calcutta Technical Institute...

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: As the top student in my graduating class of 7 million, I was accepted for graduate study in the United States.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I enrolled at Springfield Heights Institute of Technology under the tutelage of the brilliant Professor John Frink.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Nine glorious years later, I completed my Ph.D. thesis.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: 200,000 precisely-ordered punch cards comprising the world's very first tic-tac-toe program. Only the top human players could beat it.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's this one for?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So Apu, why didn't you go back to India when your student visa expired?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I did not feel right leaving without paying off my student loans.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: So I took a job at the Kwik-E-Mart. When my debts were wiped clean, I was all set to go, but by then I had made so many friends here.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What you're saying is so understandable... and really, your only crime was violating U.S. law.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, you are one of the good ones.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know what? I'm going to vote "no" on 24.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, you're the greatest. Can I have this licorice?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Hey, Kearney, this fake I.D., it is truly excellent.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Say, if you tell me where you obtained it, I'll overlook the ice cream sandwiches concealed in your armpits. Eh?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Most humble and grateful thanks to you.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Hey there, Homer, how's it hangin'?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Low and lazy, so -- Hey! Say something again.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, you're just noticing the way I'm talking to you now. You see, it turns out I am an American citizen after all.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Apparently, I just plumb forgot about it. Say, let's take a relaxed attitude toward work and watch the baseball match. The NY Mets are my favorite squadron.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you got rid of that goofy sacred elephant statue.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh yeah, what was I thinking with that? Who needs the infinite compassion of Ganesha when I've got Tom Cruise and Nicole Kidman staring at me from "Entertainment Weekly" with their dead eyes?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Look at me. I've betrayed my Indian heritage, Sir. What would my parents think of me now?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, forgive me, Mother, Father, I failed you!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Who am I kidding. I am no citizen. This passport is a cheap forgery. A cheap two thousand dollar forgery.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I have brought shame to my parents, to my homeland, and to myself.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't forget Ganesha.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: There was an amnesty declared for people who've been here as long as you! That means you can take the citizenship test!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I cannot deny my roots and I can not keep up this charade. I only did it because I love this land, where I have the freedom to say and to think and to charge whatever I want. I want to stay, but as the real me -- not as some yahoo from Green Bay.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. You must love this country more than I love a cold beer on a hot Christmas morning. Darn it, Apu, I'm not gonna let them kick you out!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I never should have bought this button. Can I have my three dollars back?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Store credit only.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Marge, look what I brought home.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homer. Are you rounding up immigrants?

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, Marge. Apu convinced me that Proposition 24 is a big mistake.

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All right! Now you've got all the Simpsons behind you, Apu!

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing

spoken_words: And I'm not registered!

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I do appreciate your concern, really, but it is hopeless. The latest poll shows a whooping 85% support for Proposition 24.

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon

title: Much Apu About Nothing

spoken_words: Hey, the government don't control the sky. What if you lived in a balloon?

title: Much Apu About Nothing

spoken_words: That's it!

title: Much Apu About Nothing

name: Lisa Simpson

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But Apu, the vote on Proposition 24 is Tuesday. You'll have to pass the test before then.

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Correct. Now we all know the thirteen stripes are for good luck. But why does the American flag have precisely 47 stars?

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, they may ask you to locate your town on a map of the U.S, so let's do that. Uh, Springfield, Springfield... Ah, right here.

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing

spoken_words: Hey, whatcha doin -- studyin'?

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing

title: Much Apu About Nothing

spoken_words: Actually, there were numerous causes. Aside from the obvious schism between abolitionists and anti-abolitionists, economic factors both domestic and international played a significant--

title: Much Apu About Nothing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now that you're all relaxed... Most of us here were born in America. We take this country for granted. But not immigrants like Apu. While the rest of us are drinking ourselves stupid, they're driving the cabs that get us home safely...

name: Homer Simpson

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer, I'm in a rhubarb of a pickle of a jam here. I was all set to go off on vacation, when I get called up for jury duty. Oh, it's a corker of a case -- seems a man drove up onto a traffic island and hit a decorative rowboat full of geraniums.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Now they're trying it as a maritime offense. So anyhoo, how'd you like to use my beach house? Free of charge.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I only get two weeks of vacation a year -- and you want me to spend it in your lousy beach house?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, if it'll seal the deal, I'll take a look at your septic tank. See if I can get her hummin' again.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Deal. See, Flanders, you give a little, you get a little.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hello, "Mr. Brown Ground", whatcha got for me?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: ... And you're sure the Flanderses won't be there? Well, it sounds great!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you can invite Milhouse. Lisa, you can bring a friend, too.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Heyyy, great, a friend... or a companion... ... stuffed animal...

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, did you call one of your friends?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Friends? Hah! These are my only friends...

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grown-up nerds like Gore Vidal. And even he's kissed more boys than I ever will.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Girls, Lisa. Boys kiss girls.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, why don't I have any friends?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We have each other! When I was a lonely little girl, I always dreamed that someday my daughter would be my best friend.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We are best friends, Mom. But I'm a kid. I need friends my own age, too.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, you'll make plenty of friends. All you have to do is be yourself.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Be myself? I've been myself for eight years and it hasn't worked. Look at all these dorky clothes... A bathing cap... nose plugs...

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A microscope at the beach -- ugh, what was I thinking?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I'm gonna tighten Milhouse's straps. He's fidgeting again.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, let's go!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey. Hmm, somebody's travelin' light.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe you're getting stronger.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I have been eating more...

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wave bye-bye to our house, Maggie. Bye-bye, tree.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bye-bye, job.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Bye-bye toothbrush.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bye-bye Lisa Simpson.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: When the hell are we gonna get to... where the hell are we going?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's called Little Pwagmattasquarmsettport. It's known as "America's scrod-basket."

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I thought Springfield was America's scrod-basket.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, Springfield is "America's crud-bucket." At least according to Newsweek.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Wel-diddly-elcome Simpsons." Oh, geez. He actually wrote "diddly."

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That was thoughtful.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I left a few helpful notes around the house...

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Put food in me.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll take that.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, duh! With what, Ned?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nice try, Todd.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Isn't this fun, honey?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It must be exciting to make a different set of beds.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I know you're joking -- but it is! Say, why don't you put on your swimsuit and head for the beach?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's kind of funny... with all the craziness and confusion and mishegoss of packing... Ha... I forgot to pack.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, that's not at all like you.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Exactly.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I forgot my swimsuit, too. But I improvised.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Mom, I'm kinda trying to go for a different look this year.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, okay.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhhh, how about this adorable sun-suit. It has a starfish on the fanny and it comes with its own pail!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, come here. Bring money.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So where do you want to show off your new hip togs? The Sherbet Shoppe? The Candle District? Big Sue's Tap Water Taffy?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Um, if it's okay with you, Mom, I'd rather go find some kids.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh... okay.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You'll be my friend. I'm never gonna let you get away.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Last one in is a yearbook editor!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Full speed ahead. Prepare to dive! Dive!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's low tide, boys.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I wonder where all the kids are.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, a library! No, I can't. That's the old nerdy Lisa.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't see any kids at all. It's like they ditched me in advance.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Only kids are that incoherent!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Like, you know, whatever. Like, you know, whatever.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's hap--

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay, okay... not your fault, it's a bird thing. You don't control the birds -- you will someday, but not now.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A compliment!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks. Umm... You guys skate?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I think I know a place you can skate that's virtually deserted.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Like, you know, whatever.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Didn't. It's Lisa.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Me? Unlikely. My goony brother's always going to libraries. I usually hang out in front.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it beats doing stuff.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay... thanks. That's very, uh... "rad" of you.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey, Bart, Lisa's skateboarding with some cool kids! And she looks like Blossom!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa? With people? If they're impressed by her, I'm gonna Bart their world. Okay, Milhouse, you know the drill.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Right. You go over and wow them, I hide in the shrubs.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hot stuff comin' through!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My friendship. You know you want it.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's my dorky little brother, Bart --tholomew.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: How'd it go? Are we down with them?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No. They must have seen you.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, why do we have to play this lousy old game?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Because it was the only one in the house. Come on, Homer, open the door for your Mystery Date!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, Captain of the Football Team! He's a dreamboat! Don't wait up, Marge.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Bart, your turn, your turn.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You got "The Dud!"

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, he looks just like you, Poindexter!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How come Lisa doesn't have to play? Why does she get to hang out with her friends?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You've got friends. You got "The Dud" right here. Stand up for yourself, Poindexter!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: BEACH IN FRONT OF THE HOUSE
spoken_words: That's a hermit crab. When she outgrows her old shell, she finds a new one that's a better fit.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: BEACH IN FRONT OF THE HOUSE
spoken_words: Don't be afraid, little friend. You'll be the most popular crab on the beach.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: BEACH IN FRONT OF THE HOUSE
spoken_words: Aww, a gift from my favorite crustacean.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: BEACH IN FRONT OF THE HOUSE
spoken_words: No. No, I heard it on "Baywatch."

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: BEACH IN FRONT OF THE HOUSE
spoken_words: Hmm. I bet this place sells illegal fireworks. Just go in and act casual, like you buy 'em all the time.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Um... let me have one of those porno magazines... a large box of condoms... a bottle of Old Harper... a couple of those panty shields... and some illegal fireworks... and one of those disposable enemas. No, make it two.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we could do something fun. Um, how 'bout a beach party?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Gee, I don't know what you've got planned for tonight, Homer, but count me out. Didn't you buy any meat?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Check this out: "Miss Perfect Attendance".

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This baby's sure to kill something. Okay, now everybody -- stand back while I celebrate freedom. Bart, give me your matches.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Fresh out.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No lighter?... Nothin'?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, I got it.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The beer!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, this is the worst Fourth of July ever. I hate America! Come on, Milhouse, let's go down there.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think you should. Let Lisa be alone with her new friends.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: They're my friends, rightfully. She only got them by copying me!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't have a cow, man!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: See?! That's my expression!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you haven't said that in four years. Let Lisa have it.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's the principle. She's gotta learn!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No! Now park your keister, meester!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aye carumba!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: For me? Wow, my first real friend... ...ship bracelet. I don't have anything for you... ...except this necklace I made.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I just know we're gonna be friends forever.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So Lisa has a friend. We'll see about that.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Bart! I need my glasses!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh, nice doggie.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's he doing here?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: My yearbook! No!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you guys! You wanna see how cool Lisa Simpson really is?

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "Grammar Rodeo -- Head Buccaroo".

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "The French Table" -- ooh la la.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Lis.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I guess my little yearbook stunt was pretty rough, but it did teach you a lesson: It's important to be yourself.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I know exactly who I am. I am the sister of a rotten, jealous, mean little sneak.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You cost me my only friends! You ruined my life!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, kids, there's a carnival tonight!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh boy, a carnival!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids! Stop that! Don't make me get the carney!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Lisa, make friends with this!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hellllp! Hellllp!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Remember, kids, there's no need to bump! Just enjoy the ride!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, wait!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Being myself didn't work... Being someone else didn't work... Maybe I just wasn't meant to have friends.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, you found out I'm an over-achieving bookworm. So whatever mean prank you're pulling, just finish it up and send me a Polaroid. I'm going to sleep.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Does this mean you still want to be friends? Even though I tried to cover up my nerdish... leanings?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ohmigod, Bart, look!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2

spoken_words: This is the most thoughtful thing anybody ever --

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sweet merciful crap! My car!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The polite thing to do would've been to clean the shells first. Shoo, shoo!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I guess I should give this back to you.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2

spoken_words: I showed it to your friends again before we left.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2

spoken_words: Look inside.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2

spoken_words: Oh. Thanks, Bart.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2

spoken_words: I signed it too!

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh huh.

title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, get a last look at the beautiful ocean scenery, kids.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Did you hear that, Bart?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe it was just the cat.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII

spoken_words: No. She's sleeping with

title: Treehouse of Horror VII

spoken_words: me.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Did you guys hear something moving around in the attic last night?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Attic? Oh, that's silly. Seriously, though, don't ever go up there.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, isn't it about time for the... ...you know.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah. I'll go feed it.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fish heads, fish heads, do de do de doo...

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's up there? / Is it a monster? / We have to know! / What's the secret?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No more questions. I work my butt off to feed you four kids and all you do I -- what?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Three! We have three kids, Homer!

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, three nosy kids. And you know what happens to nosy kids who ask too many questions?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hurry up! Mom and Dad'll be home soon!

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The unsold copies of Dad's autobiography.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, do you think it's safe?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I don't care. I can't breathe in here.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See, Marge? Who needs a car wash when you can just drive around in the rain.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: MomDadWeSawSomethingInTheAtticAnd --

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You went into the attic? I'm very disappointed and terrified.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, Marge, it's escaped!

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Doctor, it's what we've always feared: it's loose. Hugo is loose. See you soon.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who or what is Hugo?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm afraid we haven't been entirely honest with you, Bart. You see... you have a brother.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So I have two brothers?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, please. Yes, Bart, you have a twin brother. You see, when you were born, there was... an irregularity.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: A monstrous irregularity.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Yes, I remember Bart's birth well. You don't forget a thing like... Siamese twins.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I believe they prefer to be called "conjoined twins."

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: And hillbillies prefer to be called "sons of the soil," but it ain't gonna happen. Now normally, the birth of Siamese twins is a joyous occasion... But unfortunately, one of them was pure evil.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I think I'll bottle-feed that one.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: A routine soul smear confirmed the presence of pure evil. It was then I knew the only option was to separate you two immediately.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: You'll both need to sign these.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: But what to do with poor Hugo? Too crazy for Boys Town, too much of a boy for Crazy Town, the child was an outcast. So we did the only humane thing.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We chained Hugo up in the attic like an animal and fed him a bucket of fish heads once a week.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It saved our marriage!

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You expect me to believe all this? If any of it was true, wouldn't I have a big, hideous scar...

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: We've got to find Hugo.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll search out every place a sick, twisted, solitary misfit might run to.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll start with Radio Shack.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Right. Bart, you stay home and tape the hockey game.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're here, aren't you?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: W-w-what do you want from me?

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're crazy!

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But you'll kill both of us!

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Hugo, stop!

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: There, there, Hugo. I understand. All those years caged up in here... why, you've probably never even seen your own face in the mirror, have you? Here...

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We think we saw Hugo at the airport! He was boarding a plane to Switzerland and... Oh.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: You know, isn't it interesting how the left, or sinister, twin is invariably the evil one? I had this theor... Wait a minute, Hugo's scar is on the wrong side! He couldn't have been the evil left twin! That means the evil twin is, and always has been... Bart.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, don't look so shocked.

title: Treehouse of Horror VII
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Well, chalk this one up to carelessness on my part. But I think there's a way to set everything right.
