spoken_words: Can't you read? Call the police!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what happened to your belt?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Some bullies beat me up and took it.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, there's only one thing punks like that understand: squealing. You've got to squeal to every teacher and every grown-up you can find. Coming to me was a good start.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But then they'll just beat me up even worse.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yesss, they are a clever bunch. I know, I'll squeal for you. To their parents.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The thing is -- oof! -- Bart really loves that belt and -- ugh!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Fun's over, fellas. If you're gonna beat up my friend in my bar, there's a two-drink minimum.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Jeez, Homer, I never seen a guy stand up to that kinda punishment -- I mean, you took a three-man poundin' and didn't ever fall down.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Big deal. I didn't even get my kid's belt back. The only thing a loser like me is good for is taking beatings.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: There ya go! That's the spirit! Homer, I seen prizefighters couldn't take a punch half as good as you! Y'know, boxing might be right up your alley!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, please, it's the good life, Homer. Some of these boxers, they eat steak and lobster and salad bar all in a single meal!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dressing?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Their choice.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You really think I could do it?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, I dunno, are you man enough to test every one of your limits?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And are you man enough to throw a punch, should the opportunity arise?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And are you man enough to give me a sixty percent cut?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: YES!!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'll take it!!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Now, Homer, if I'm gonna manage your boxing career, I wantcha to have complete faith in me. C'mere, lemme show ya somethin'...

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! I've never been in here before!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, well, when I realized we hadn't had no ladies in here since 1979, I turned it into an office.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You used to be a boxer just like me?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yep. They called me "Kid Gorgeous." Later on, it was "Kid Presentable." Then "Kid Gruesome." And finally, "Kid Moe."

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's this?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, that -- that's my old spit bucket. Yeah, I been meanin' to empty that out.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know Lucius Sweet? He's one of the biggest names in boxing! He's exactly as rich and as famous as Don King, and he looks just like him, too.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, he was my manager. Back when I was gorgeous, everybody wanted a piece of me. But somehow I just never made it to the big time.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why not?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: 'Cause I got knocked out forty times in a row. That, plus politics. You know, it's all politics...

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lousy Democrats.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, of all the crazy ideas you've had, this one ranks somewhere in the middle. You're thirty-eight years old, you don't know how to box and you haven't gotten any exercise since grade school. Before you even consider this, I insist you consult a doctor.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No problemo.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A competent doctor!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Well, sir, you more than meet every one of this state's requirements to box, wrestle, or be shot out of a cannon.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's what we get for living in a state founded by circus freaks.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: You have an absolutely unique genetic condition known as "Homer Simpson's Syndrome."

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, why me?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Don't worry, it's quite beneficial. Your brain is cushioned by a layer of fluid one eighth of an inch thicker than normal. It's almost as if you're wearing a football helmet inside your own head.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Why, I could wallop you all day with this surgical two-by-four without ever knocking you down. But I have other appointments.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, Homer, let's see the left.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oooo-kay... Let's see the right.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just a second.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: When you're ready...

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right... Ready... Wait a minute... All right... Wait a minute... Just a sec...

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, punching isn't your thing. But that's okay... you're not that kind of fighter. What you're gonna do is stand there while your opponent gets exhausted from overpunching.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then I can just push him over.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That's right. And if the ref's not looking, you can kick him a coupla times.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Who's gonna knock you down?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No one.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: When are you gonna fight back?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Never.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What are you gonna do?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That's my boy.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay. You're fighting a guy named Boxcar Bob.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Brawled his way up from the boxcars, did he?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, no. Not yet. He still lives at the train yard. But he's a hungry young fighter. In fact, he's actually fighting for a sandwich.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Homer, I want you to have my lucky mitts. I hope you do better with 'em than I did.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gee, thanks, Moe... What's this?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, that's the barbed wire. Heh. We, uh, we called that "The Stinger." They... they don't let you use that no more.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Now, no matter how much he hits you, you don't do nothin', okay? You don't wanna get drawn into a boxing match here.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Way to go, Dad! Take those punches!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Man, that tramp's got the energy of a hobo!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, he never stops punching... 'cept to check on his bindle.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, Homer, he's tired! He's tired! Now's your chance! Nudge him! Nudge him!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Lucius! Hey, what's a glitterati like you doin' in my dump? I--I thought you were managing the Champ.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, what?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, oh, man. Yeah, well, who's donatin' his body for that one? Huh?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Homer? You want Homer to fight Tatum?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah. But Homer's no boxer, he-- he's just a freak. Tatum'll fustigate him!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I gotta be honest with ya, Homer. I didn't bring you up here to show you my new tar-paper.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You... didn't?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: No. Homer, how would you like to be Heavyweight Champion of the World?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, sure.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Great. All you gotta do is fight Drederick Tatum. It's this Saturday. Here's your parking pass.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, "General!" Who's Drederick Tatum, anyway? Is he another hobo?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, you know what? I'm gonna have to check on that...

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I trust you, Moe. If you say I can beat this guy, then he doesn't stand a chance.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, why are they saying you're going to fight Drederick Tatum?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, well... I was gonna surprise you, but, um... happy anniversary, baby!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Have you lost your mind?!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, c'mon, I'll make a fortune for one night's work! We could have all the things we always dreamed of: a snooty butler, carpeted car ports, those blue cupcakes they sell sometimes --

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But you'll get killed!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, will you let me finish? ...Plug-in room deodorizers, front and rear spoilers for the car --

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom's right, Dad. The odds against you winning are a thousand to one.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I don't think it's that unlikely.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Those are the odds they're giving in Vegas.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, I think we've heard just about enough from Mr. Newspaper today.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Society put Drederick Tatum away for his brutal crime. But he's paid his debt, and now he's going to get revenge... on Homer Simpson.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: That's your dad-dy!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You'll be okay, Dad. Just make sure he hits you an even number of times so you don't end up with amnesia.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, I'm so glad I found you. Please promise me you won't let Homer get hurt.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, hey, hey! I'm not the villain here, okay? If Homer gets killed in the ring tonight, it'll be because of your negative attitude! There, I said it.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Listen to me. The instant that Homer's in any kind of danger, I want you to throw in this towel and stop the fight.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, all right, all right! I promise! Okay?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Celebrities at ringside tonight: star of the "McBain" action films and featured player in the Hollywood prostitution scandal, Rainier Wolfcastle; TV anchorman and Springfield institution, Mr. Kent Brockman.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This just in: go to hell!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Aw, cripes. Now I gotta comb this side over.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, Homer, I'm not going to lie to you: there's a good chance you can beat Tatum. But you gotta visualize how you're going to win, okay?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gotcha.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, don't worry. You'll get your three rounds!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okey-doke, future down the crapper. Gotcha.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Homer, nothing to be worried about... just--

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! I've never seen Dad hit somebody like that before!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What are you talking about?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Isn't Dad the one in the black trunks?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What? What?! What am I missing? What?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, jeez, only six seconds in... Attaboy, Homer! Keep dancin'!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! Homer, he's not going to get tired! You've got to hit him back! Hit him back!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hang in there, Homer! Only 440 more seconds! He's getting his second wind.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: No, he's getting killed! He's gonna die on his feet!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I can't watch this. I gotta get out of here!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Somebody stop the fight! Where's the doctor?!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are you an angel?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yes, Homer, I'm an angel. All us angels wear Farah slacks.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But you stopped the fight. Won't everyone be mad at you?

title: A Milhouse Divided
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aaar, matey.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, let 'em be mad. The only thing that matters to me is, you're safe.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I don't need your stinkin' money!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homie, are you okay?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't remember where we parked.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's all right. We'll just wait until everyone else leaves.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I got your tooth, Dad!

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, not mine.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Moe. I know you gave up your dreams for Homer.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, what do dreams matter, Marge? I was able to stick up for a pal.

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, so long, Springfield...

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where are you going?

title: The Homer They Fall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, nowheres in particular. I just need some time to think.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What a perfect outing for a beautiful autumn day!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I feel sorry for everyone who's cooped up inside watching the seventh game of the World Series!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, they won't learn anything about apples today.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, if God didn't make little green apples -- it's Homer Simpson! How long have you been here?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Twenty of the suckiest minutes of my life.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, suckin' down the cider, eh? Hey, word to the wise... season pass!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Pays for itself after the 16th visit. You know, most people don't know the difference between apple cider and apple juice. But I do. Now here's a little trick to help you remember...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: If it's clear and yellow, you've got juice there, fellow! If it's tangy and brown, you're in Cider Town! Now there's two exceptions, and it gets kinda tricky here...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: ...Adirondack cider can be yellow if they're using late-season apples. And, of course, in Canada the whole thing's flip-flopped...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, my. I better get you some cider.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Next to spring and winter, fall is my absolute favorite season. Just look at all this beautiful foilage.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's not foilage, Mom. It's foliage. Fo-li-age.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's what I said, foilage . It doesn't take a nucular scientist to pronounce foilage.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Honestly, Smithers, I don't know why Harvard even bothers to show up. Heh. They barely even won.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Their cheating was even more rampant than last year, sir.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, I say let Harvard have its football and academics. Yale will always be first in gentlemanly club-life. Why, every friend I have I made right here.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Steady... steady...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh-ho, nicely played, sir.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: This may take a while, Smithers. Why don't you get drunk and stumble around comically for my amusement?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'll be a one-man conga line.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Da, da, da ... Whoa-- Ow-- Where'd that lamp come from?... Whoa...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can honestly say that was the most fun I've ever had. The mill, the history, all that gorgeous foliage.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't excape Lisa, our little walking libary!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can't they get a pole for that sign?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's a hitchhiker, Homer.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, let's pick him up!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No! What if he's crazy?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And what if he's not? Then we'd look like idiots.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We're not picking him up!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yes we are!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There's not enough room!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yes, there is!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I just don't think it's a good idea.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I think it's the best idea I've ever had! We're picking up the weirdo, and that's final.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Careful of the apple pie on the seat.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-ohhh.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa, are you sitting on the pie?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I sure hope so.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, sure, we know him. That's Mr. Burns.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He tried to kill our puppies.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He sexually harassed me.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: He stole my fiancée.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He made fun of my weight.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Yes?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Well, I hate to break it to you, "Larry," but if Mr. Burns ever wants to see a stranger, he will observe him through a powerful telescope. Now if you'll --

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, what's going on? How dare you interrupt my lime rickey? State your business.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You're what? Selling light bulbs? Worried about the whales? Keen on Jesus? Out with it!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's true. He is my son.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Good God!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, Larry, my lad, I've gone over this story in my mind a million times. It was 1941 -- the -- no, '39 -- my 25th Yale reunion...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Who should appear but the unrequited love of my college years, Mimsy Bancroft...Of course, by then Mimsy had her share of wrinkles and a gray hair or two, but my adoring eyes saw past those minor imperfections to her 21-year-old daughter, Lily.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I took Lily to the local cinematorium...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yay, Mom! All right, Mom!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: ...where our passions were inflamed by Clark Gable's reckless use of the word "damn."

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We sneaked into the nearby Peabody Museum. There under the smiling eyes of four stuffed Eskimos, we expressed our love physically, as was the style at the time.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, there was a terrible scandal. Lily's family forced her to give you up and bundled her off to a convent in the South Seas. I never heard from her again. But I prattle on -- tell me everything about your life.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well. You must be tired. Let me show you your room.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes... All right... Uh-huh... It's good to see you, too... Now then, in case you get bored, here's the playroom.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: This show was supposed to close last week! Close this show! Close it, I say!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you're that hitchhiker! What are you doing here?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, that's really lazy.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So lazy.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I see. Well, I... Oh, you know, I just remembered it's time for my annual donation. I wonder how much I should give...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...and Larry and I have so much in common, Marge, way more than you and me. If I could be stranded on an island with anyone, it would definitely be Larry!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I think we heard enough about Larry Burns for one evening.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why? It's not like anything interesting happened to anyone else today.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Nonsense, Larry, your blood is bluer than any of theirs! Just give them a snootful of the old Burns charm!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ooh, Admiral Carstairs, I'd like you to meet my son, Larry.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Larry, please, he's very sensitive about his age.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, there's something a bit odd about young Larry. I can't quite put my finger on it.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Well, he is a bit rough around the edges, sir. One might blame his truly heroic intake of cocktails.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: A total lack of refinement. Smithers, send for the boys at Yale Admissions, huh?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, did you meet Larry?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: How were his test scores?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Are you mad? I'm not made of airports! Get out!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Summon my son at once!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh, it appears he's "gone drinkin'," sir.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, but the last guy who charged a drink to Burns turned up in a landfill.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Quiet, you! Nobody likes a comedian!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, "yakkety-yak-yak"... You, Foodbag -- do you have a son?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sir. I do.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And is he a constant disappointment? Does he bring home nitwits and make you talk to them?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, all the time! Have you ever heard of this kid Milhouse? He's a little wiener who...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Fascinating. Goodnight.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'll tell you what's with me -- the humiliation of having a coarse, boorish, ignoramus for a son!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, I should go.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's so unfair. You're everything a dad could hope for.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Larry, there's only one sure way to make him realize how much he loves you. And that... is a phony kidnapping.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pho-ny kid-napping...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Your son has been kidnapped...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I can't believe someone would kidnap my Larry. I won't rest until he's returned to me!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Not to be impertinent, sir, but didn't you want Larry out of your life as recently as two hours ago?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's the principle, Smithers! Nobody steals from Montgomery Burns, whether it be my Sunday newspaper or my loutish oaf of a son.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right, Mr. B, when the kidnappers call with the ransom demand, you tell them you'll leave the money under the big net in the park.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Heyyyy, I like it! I like it a lot!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What are you doing in the basement? It's like you're hiding out down here.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hiding out? Marge, you've been reading too many hideout books.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And what's that hitchhiker doing here? Is every drifter we meet going to move in with us?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Of course not. We'll decide that on a drifter-by-drifter basis.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's not a drifter, Mom. That's Mr. Burns's son, Larry.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's great at pointing out everyone's foibles!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's kidding, Mom. But seriously, I'd love to have hair like yours -- I just can't get the zoning permits.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, that reminds me, Mom -- Buckingham Palace called. They want their hat back.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: More food.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. Yeah. Thank you.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ahoy-hoy?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Mr. Burns, this is the kidnapper. Do you miss your son?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes! I'm missing one son! Return it immediately!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If you really love Larry, prove it and you can have him back today.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, how much proof do you need? Five thousand? Six thousand? I swear, that's all I've got.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you care about your son? This is more important than money!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: More important than money? Who is this?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just a second.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Beautiful. Eddie, did you trace the phone number?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: "5-5-5..." Aw, geez, that's gotta be phony!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I think I got a Pai Gow!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I hate Pai Gow. Can't we just play Quang Jong?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Can't we just go upstairs?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman in ChopperCopter 6 with a special report. Montgomery Burns's son has been kidnapped.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kidnapped?!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, it's not a real kidnapping. It's a simple hoax to win a father's love.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know how I feel about hoaxes!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Still?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I want you to take Larry back to Mr. Burns right now, before you get in a lot of trouble.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What... But... Marge, it's broad daylight and there's cops everywhere!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No excuses! Just do it!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Of course we'll bring you updates as soon as they... Oh, wait a minute! There they are! Larry Burns and his kidnapper!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Appearing in broad daylight, with police everywhere... Ladies and gentlemen, there's only one word for that: idiocy!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The abandoned warehouse!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid economic recovery!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We've gotta find someplace no one will ever go. Hel-lo!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heh-heh, they'll never look for us here.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You don't like it, call the cops!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman, live from the Aztec Theater, where police have learned that kidnapper Homer Simpson and hostage Larry Burns are inside, talking loudly...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh! Give yourself up, Homie!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, Dad! Shoot your way out!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: A bloody end for Homer Simpson...is just one of several possible outcomes, according to our computer simulation. Now, here's how it would look if the police killed him with a barrage of baseballs...

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We've got to go down there and help Dad!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hmm, still warm. They can't be far.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Don't be a fool, Simpson! Let the kid go!

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The negotiations have failed! Shoot him!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It'll be okay, honey. There's lots more oil where that came from.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I should've known. You're the only one stupid enough to kidnap you. Now get down here so I can spank you in front of this gawking rabble. Smithers, take off my belt.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: With pleasure, sir.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hold on, Mr. Burns. Maybe we did fake a kidnapping, but is that really such a crime? All your son wanted was a little attention, a little love.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm a father myself, sir. And sure, sometimes my kids can be obnoxious... or boring... or stinky --

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: -- but they can always count on one thing: their father's unconditional love.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: There, there, sonny-boy. I suppose I have been a bit... Oh, no, I can't do it. It's just not me.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'm sorry, Larry, I can't be the family that you need.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, son, delighted to have met you. It's good to know that there's another kidney out there for me.

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Who's playing that music?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And where is all that liquor coming from?

title: Burns, Baby Burns
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's a party, Marge. It doesn't have to make sense.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Da-ad! V-chip, V-chip!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, sorry. My fault.

spoken_words: We interrupt this cartoon for a Special Report.

spoken_words: Someone found my keys!

spoken_words: Kent Brockman at the Action News desk. A massive tanker has run aground on the central coastline, spilling millions of gallons of oil on Baby Seal Beach.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Preliminary reports indicated the ship's captain was drunk at the helm. Those reports were later confirmed.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: A clean-up effort is already underway. And as always, the first to pitch in are those unsung heroes, Hollywood movie stars.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ...And we'd be doing our part for the environment! Plus, we'd get to clean up all those cute animals.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, we don't need to drive 400 miles to clean animals. You can stay right here and give the dog a bath. Or trim the cat's nails.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Mom, please! You can make this my birthday and Christmas presents!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You've already used up your birthday and Christmas presents on that peach tree we got you. And you hardly ever play with that anymore.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes I do! Sure I do! Look!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, all right, we'll go.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now, the cat needs his medication every morning --

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No problem... Can do.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And the furnace has been giving off a lot of carbon monoxide, so keep the window o--

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Right... Uh huh... Gotcha... Cat in the furnace.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, you know, I think I'll take Maggie with us.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And if anything happens, just use your best judgm... Just do what I would do.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A whole week of just father and son! See you at dinner.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What time?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, I don't know.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Shall we say ten?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right. Just wake me up.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, do I have to brush my teeth?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, but at least rinse your mouth out with soda.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm gonna rescue a baby seal! And then I'm gonna save an otter!

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You mean there's nothing left to clean?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I've got rocks that need washing at home.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Geez, look at this place. We gotta do something.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Huh -- garbage angels?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I think I need some fresh air. Can I go to the park?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Do I have to sit up?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Knock yourself out.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse, this is boring. Make it crash or something!

title: Bart After Dark

spoken_words: Perfectly level flying is the supreme challenge of the scale-model pilot.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Gimme that!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey!!

title: Bart After Dark
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I don't like being outdoors, Smithers.

title: Bart After Dark
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: For one thing, there are too many fat children.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Thanks a lot! Now it's stuck on that haunted house!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I heard a witch lives there.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: You guys are way off. It's a secret lab where they take the brains out of zombies and put them in the heads of other zombies to create a race of Super-Zombies!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: That's the house?!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Stand aside, wussies.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Enough talk.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: S-U-C-C-E-E-S / That's the way you spell succes--

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, no!... He... help!... I'm gonna die!...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh, no! The witch has Bart!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just a minute!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I have misplaced my pants.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Preciate the suggestion, lady, but he hates that. And I gotta live with him.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're the man, Homer.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No! Wait! Wait! Madam, I run a house of discipline. The boy will be disciplined, and disciplined severely. Good day.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I don't know how to punish you! What does Marge usually do?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She makes me taste beer.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, boy. Give your old man a little credit.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, well, I still get to punish you.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, you're gonna do chores for that lady until you work off the damage you did. It's called responsibility.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I can't believe I gotta spend all my free time dustin' doilies in a smelly, run-down dump for a creepy old witch...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lady, I gotta tell ya -- I have been grossly misinformed about witches.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, man! What is this place?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you having a party or something?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's tough but fair. I'll start sorting these bras.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Just glad to be on the team!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, the ol' greet 'n' toss. No problemo.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Is your name Bart?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: What the ?! Does your father know you're working here?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It was his idea.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: In that case, I'll have a whiskey sour.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, there's something unsatisfying about scrubbing these rocks. And I think I know what it is...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Lisa, I know it's frustrating. But we made a commitment and we have to see it through, no matter how unpleasant.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Faster, Mom, faster!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So who's gonna warm up the crowd tonight?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Eep.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Heh. Nudist colonies are everywhere these days. I'd love to go, but I... I can't get the wrinkles out of my birthday suit!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But I gotta tell ya, Adam and Eve must have been the first bookkeepers. They invented the loose leaf system.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: If there's a bad bookkeeping joke, I haven't heard it.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I told you last night, no! Where is Bart, anyway? His dinner's getting all cold and eaten.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, where are you?! Come on! I have to be up at six a.m. to swipe Flanders' newspaper!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the... "President Eisenhower celebrates 40th wedding anniversary... Not pictured: Mrs. Eisenhower."

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't care if he was filling in for Mel Zetz! He's my son and I don't want him --

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: working... so... late... that...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, everyone loves rules...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah, drugs. Ya gotta have drugs.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, he didn't pay the cover!

spoken_words: Oh, I hope I didn't miss the floor show...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nope.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Is Roxanne back?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yup.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Did she, uh, get my flowers?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She did.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I... Hello, Bart.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Principal Skinner.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: This is the National Air and Space Museum, isn't it?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, this isn't gonna be about Jesus, is it?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: All things are about Jesus, Homer... except this. Your son has been working in a burlesque house.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: That's true, but I was only in there to get directions on how to get away from there.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Helen, as a responsible parent, I was already well aware of that.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer, I'm as permissive as the next parent. I mean, just yesterday, I let Todd buy some Red Hots with a cartoon devil on the box. But you can't possibly think it's appropriate for your ten-year-old son to work in a burlesque house!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no?! Well, if Homer Simpson wants his ten-year-old son working in a burlesque house, then Homer Simpson's ten-year-old son is going to work in a burlesque house! That's...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hi! Now, Marge, you're going to hear a lot of crazy talk about Bart working in a burlesque house...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "Maison Derriere"?! I can't believe there's a place like that in our wholesome little town. Homer, did you know it was a burlesque house when you sent Bart to work there?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No! I only learned that four days ago.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What were you thinking, sending Bart to such an awful place?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I was trying to punish him exactly like you would. So, in a way, you really dropped the ball on this one. This is your mess and I'll be damned if I'm gonna clean it up!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I have a favor to ask: please shut this place down and move away from Springfield.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Springfield doesn't want places like this!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh? I've lived in this town for 37 years.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm third generation.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Get out of my town!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Mother!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is that so? Well, sleazy entertainment and raunchy jokes will never be as popular as sobriety and self-denial!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're about to learn the two most dangerous words in the English language are Marge Simpson!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's the light pink '87 wagon.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: ...and after visiting the area for the past two months, I have determined it is not feasible to construct a Supertrain between Springfield and Aruba.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Next on the agenda is, uh... the Citizens' Committee On Moral Hygiene.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm here to share my moral outrage, but this time it's not about that giant, inflatable Dos Equis bottle. It's about a certain house in our town...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, well, what's wrong with this house? Is it the plumbing?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No. It's a House of Ill Fame... a House of Loose Ethics...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Is there a building code violation? A drainage issue? A surveying error?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The house is perfectly fine!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, then quit badmouthing the house!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, geez -- It's what's inside the house that's disgraceful -- drinking, gambling, and debauchery! It's right under our noses -- a secret house of burlesque!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: People, this is an issue that we, as a town, are strong enough to ignore. Let us give no more scrutiny to this bawdy house and its small clientele of loyal perverts.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, I'm afraid this problem goes far beyond Eugene and Rusty.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Marge, if you please...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skinner!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, uh, Barney...

title: Bart After Dark
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hey, come on! You did me twice!

title: Bart After Dark
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers?!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: My... my parents insisted I give it a try, sir.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Uh, well, uh, that could be any mayor.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I rest my case.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Er, uh, well, in light of these new facts, of which I now realize I was largely aware, I must take action. All in favor of demolishing our beloved burlesque house, raise your hands.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: No, the burlesque house. So just keep your mouth shut.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Ah, there's no justice like angry mob justice.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I'm gonna burn all the historic memorabilias!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'm going to take me home a toilet!

name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: There'd a-better be two!

name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Uh, it's an angry mob, ma'am. Could you step outside for a twinkle while we knock down your house?

title: Bart After Dark
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, we can't let this happen to Belle! Do something!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you worry, son.

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My friends! Stop!

title: Bart After Dark
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure, we could tear this house down...

spoken_words: No, I can't. This is my cause. I'm like the man who single-handedly built the rocket and went to the moon. What was his name? Apollo Creed?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Please, let's just go to sleep.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, I refuse to share a bed with someone who thinks I'm crazy. Unless you're feeling... amorous?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, I'm not.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well then, good night!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Dad. What's the word from Planet Crackpot?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I suppose you're going to mock me, too.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, actually, Dad... I believe you.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You do?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, I do. You seem so damn sure.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, son. And do you think you could stop the casual swearing?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hell, yes.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's my boy. Well, if you believe in me, then I'm not going to give up. I'll prove I'm right. This Friday we're going back to the woods, and we're going to find that alien!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What if we don't?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll fake it and sell it to the Fox network.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: They'll buy anything!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now son, they do a lot of quality programming, too.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I kill me.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yo, Dad, can I have a sip of your beer?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, son, you don't want to drink beer. That's for Daddies, and kids with fake IDs... besides, it's such a beautiful night. How about a ghost story?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And that is how much college will cost for Maggie!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No! No! No-o-o-o-o!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Dad, it doesn't matter that we didn't see the alien. I've really had a great time out here.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, me too.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's him!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: As a representative of planet earth, let me be the first to say...

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bwah! Bwah! Bwaaaaah!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's gone. And we still don't have any proof.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yes we do! I got it all on tape.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good work, son! We did it! We did it!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Tonight on Eyewitness News: a man who's been in a coma for twenty-three years wakes up!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: No, uh, she won an Oscar and he's a congressman.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: But first, E.T. phone Homer -- Simpson that is!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! Kids! They're about to show my videotape!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Local man Homer Simpson -- shown here with his tongue stuck to a lamppost --

title: The Springfield Files
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: -- has given us this videotape. It's a Close Encounter of the Blurred Kind .

title: The Springfield Files
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Very unprofessional, Phil.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Lis, what do you think about the alien now?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I think there must be a more logical explanation. And I think the people of this town aren't gonna be won over by three seconds of videotape.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I'm happy to answer any questions you have about the alien. Any questions at all. Doctor Hibbert?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Yes, is the alien carbon-based or silicon-based?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... the second one. Zilliphone. Next question.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, yes.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Uh, were you on my roof last night, stealing my weathervane?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This interview is over!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: I remember another gentle visitor from the Heavens. He came in peace, but then died, only to come back to life. And his name was... E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial. I loved that little guy.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Leonard Nimoy! What are you doin' here?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Take a look at this, Lisa. You don't see any "Homer is a Dope" T-shirts, do you?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! How could you?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: These shirts are a hundred per cent cotton! And look at the fine stitching on "Dope!"

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll take two!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look! There it is!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Homie! Homie, I'm so sorry I doubted you!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Now, is that the love between a man and a woman or the love of a man for a fine Cuban cigar?

title: The Springfield Files
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: It's bringing love! Don't let it get away!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Break its legs!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wait!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You want an alien? This is your alien!

title: The Springfield Files
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hello children! I bring you love!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Aw. It's Mr. Burns! Kill it! Kill it!

title: The Springfield Files
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: No, no, let me explain... Every Friday evening after work, Mr. Burns undergoes a series of medical treatments designed to cheat death for another week...

title: The Springfield Files
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: First, Mr. Burns' chiropractors perform a slight spinal adjustment...

title: The Springfield Files
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Then a team of doctors administers eye drops, painkillers, and a vocal cord scraping...

title: The Springfield Files
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: La la la la la...

title: The Springfield Files
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But what's with the glowing?

title: The Springfield Files
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Uh, I'll field that question. A lifetime of working in a nuclear power plant has given me a healthy green glow and left me as impotent as a Nevada boxing commissioner. And now that I'm back to normal, I don't bring you peace and love. I bring you fear, famine, pestilence, and...

title: The Springfield Files
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: GOOD MORNING STAR SHINE / THE EARTH SAYS HELLO.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you said you'd bring them peace and love and it looks like you did it. I'm proud of you, Homie.

title: The Springfield Files
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Marge.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, oh! How about OklaSoft? It's Oklahoma's fastest-growing software company.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not wild about these high-risk ventures. They sound a little risky.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: If we'd listened to you, we wouldn't have sponsored that Mexican wrestler!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I guess I'm just not comfortable with the whole idea of "investing"...

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right, Helen, if I'm not wanted, I'll leave.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: ...and then they gave me back my 500 dollar investment and kicked me out of the club.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait -- back up a bit now. When are the pancakes coming in the mail?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, maybe it's all for the best...

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do you need to make money for anyway? As long as I have my earning power, this family's got nothing to worry about.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! Oh! Call work and tell 'em I won't be in tomorrow.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, this is no time to be conservative. Let's roll the dice here.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It would be nice to beat those women at their own game. Maybe I should look into a franchise.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we're trying to, but you're blocking our way.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll handle this.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No deal, McCutcheon. That moon money is mine!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now you're the one who's being naive.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I don't want to own my own business. I don't know why I came here in the first place.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Helen.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Edna.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Marge.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... oh...

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, Agnes.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, your fish are dead.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: And "fa-la-fel?"

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look at them. They've jumped on the one franchise I might possibly have considered thinking about becoming interested in. I'm not cut out for the world of business.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm... hmm... That's not bad.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I had that dream again!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wooo! We're number one! We're number one!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's going on?! Wait, wait! Hey, let go of me!...

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Your franchise, how much?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll take it!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: When can I start? What's my territory?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't forget fat people. They can't stop eating!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, pretzels!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Welcome back, Space Girl!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's all that commotion outside? Why, it's one of those Pretzel Wagons the movie stars are always talking about.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Here? Our plant?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, Lenny. Let's all give in to deliciousness, the Pretzel Wagon way.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, Mom, look at all those customers!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hairnets, everyone.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Welcome to Pretzel Wagon. May I take your order?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Uh, let's see... I'll have one... Uh...

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, hurry up. I wanna get my pretzel.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: One pretzel.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Let's see... Um, I will have one of your... Uh...

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Come on, come on, while we're young.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Wow, check out that van. It looks like it doesn't even need our business.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, let's go!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me. I had this spot first.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, sorry, dear. Just business. Ha!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess Macy's and Gimbel's learned to live side by side.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Very well. There must be dozens of great locations in this town. Don't you worry about me.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You see? A little persistence and patience paid off. That'll be 300 dollars.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I should've said "limit -- one per customer."

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "Hang in there, baby." You said it, kitty. Copyright 1968? Hmm. Determined or not, that cat must be long dead. That's kind of a downer.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They're good pretzels, Mom. But you've got to think big. Find a major public event and set up shop there.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here you go -- free Pretzel Wagon pretzels for everyone! One bite and you'll be hooked!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That means thank you, Marge.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no! No! Don't do that! You're supposed to be tasting them!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, cheer up, Mom. You can't buy publicity like that. Thousands and thousands of people saw your pretzels injuring Whitey Ford.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You could call 'em Whitey Whackers.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I was wrong to have a dream. Wrong as usual. I mean, if you're nothing special, why kid yourself?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Mom, no!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Listen to your mother, kids: aim low. Aim so low, no one will even care if you succeed.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dinner's in the oven. If you want some butter, it's under my face.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge needs help, and God knows, I'm not the man to provide it. But I know who can...

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, looks like Mr. Pretzel Man is doing pretty well for himself.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm here to see Mr. Ormand.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I guess I should speak to the executor of his estate.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're my last hope. I've never reached out to you before, but my wife is in her hour of need. Your help could make all the difference in the world.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello? Uh, no, Pretzel Wagon's no longer -- Three hundred pretzels?! Wait, wait, let me get this down. Mmm... Mmm... Meatpackers Union Hall... Batavia, New York... I'll send them right out! Homer, Homie, wake up! Wake up, I'm back in business!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I had a feeling things would work out for you, honey.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure the children will get enough nutrition from these pretzels?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yes, I am sure. Sure as sure can be.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, what happened to your fingers?!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I believe it was a boking accident.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I have to go now.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Yeah, we uh, found a couple o' barnacles on the hull. That, and uh, the deck was uh, wet.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Look, lady, if I was you, I would just leap into the air as I am preparing to do.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Here you go, Homer.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Moe.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, Homer. You know your money's no good here.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, wait a minute -- this is real money!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, my wife is raking it in.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Fat Tony! You still with the Mafia?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You mean the mob only did me a favor to get something in return? Oh, Fat Tony... I will say good day to you, sir.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, here I am -- 11905 Dead Weasel Road, but I don't see any apartment building, I just --

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's going on?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, oh, you have to push in as you turn.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, that's it.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Who are you?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What are you talking about?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, did you tell the Mafia they could eliminate my competitors with savage beatings and attempted murder?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In those words? Yes.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it just sickens me. How could you do this to someone you love?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How could I not? I saw you pouring your heart and soul into this business and getting nowhere. I saw you desperately trying to cram one more salty treat into America's already bloated snack-hole. So I did what I could. I did what any loving husband would do: I reached out to some violent mobsters.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homer, I know you were trying to shield me from failure, but this is my business, and the Mafia's not getting one cent of my money!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So what are we gonna do?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We're going to do what we do every day. We're going to make pretzels.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There, that's the last one.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, thank God. It's only Grampa.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now what?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The answer is no.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You heard her. She said "no."

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Well, well, if it isn't Marge Simpson and her gangland cronies.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, maybe we should go inside.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Marge, that little guy hasn't done anything yet.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at him. He's gonna do something. And you know it's gonna be good!

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You must hate me, Marge. Every time I try to help, I just fail miserably.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I don't hate you for failing. I love you for trying.

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's going on outside?

title: The Twisted World of Marge Simpson
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's just a mob war. Go back to sleep, Honey.

spoken_words: Good morning, Sir. Care for some coffee?

spoken_words: No, the promise of a new day is more than enough exhilaration for me.

spoken_words: I don't know, sir. The... this stopwatch only goes up to fifteen minutes.

spoken_words: Damnation! What kind of slowcoaches do I have working for me? Ah, here comes one of our fellows now.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think I won, Mr. Burns.

title: Mountain of Madness

spoken_words: Yes, you won all right. You won more than you bargained for.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What a disgraceful display. I've seen more orderly behavior in a Ritz Brothers film. You all need a serious lesson in teamwork.

title: Mountain of Madness

spoken_words: Maybe he does, but I don't.

title: Mountain of Madness

spoken_words: Hey, you take that back!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: No, you take that back!

title: Mountain of Madness

spoken_words: Hit 'em, Carl! You too, Lenny!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So Burns is going to make us all go on a stupid corporate retreat up in the mountains to learn about teamwork. Which means we'll have to cancel our plans to hang around here.

title: Mountain of Madness

spoken_words: Teamwork is overrated.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

spoken_words: Think about it. I mean, what "team" was Babe Ruth on? Who knows?

title: Mountain of Madness

spoken_words: Yankees.

title: Mountain of Madness

spoken_words: Thank you. Now pair off as I draw your names. Lenny and... Carl.

title: Mountain of Madness
