spoken_words: Sharing is a bunch of bull too. And helping others. And what's all this crap I've been hearing about tolerance?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmmm. Your ideas are intriguing to me, and I wish to subscribe to your newsletter, but I think we have to go on the retreat anyway.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, here we are.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right. Let me start off by telling you this will not be a walk in the park. This will be the most arduous and backbreaking weekend of your life. I cannot overemphasize the dangers which... did you bring your family, Simpson?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... yes sir. I thought I was supposed to.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Imbecile. Simpson, your family will have to remain here.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, kids. This is a national park. We can have lots of fun.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Each two-man team will work its way through the wilderness to a cabin hidden somewhere on this mountain. The routes are treacherous, so use your maps.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I lost my map.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You haven't been issued a map yet. When you arrive at the cabin, there will be a congratulatory party with sandwiches and moderately priced champagne.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now as an added incentive, the second to last team to arrive at the cabin will receive an hilarious "World's Worst Employee" trophy.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, this sounds like fun.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And the last team to arrive will be fired.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And to show that I'm not playing favorites, both Smithers and I will be participating. Who knows? I might be the unlucky one who gets fired. Not bloody likely.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I've placed all your names in this hat--

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Woooo-hoooo! / Huzzah!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Aw, nuts-- I mean, uh... Aw, nuts.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Fong and... Zutroy... Kimball and... Dawson... Haney and... Drucker...

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Simpson and... Burns?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, this can't be right. You assured me this drawing was rigged so we'd be teammates.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, well, frankly, you've been a bit of a pill lately.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Why do we always fight on vacation? Now there's only one name left. Whoever it is will be paired with me. And that person is... ...Waylon Smithers. Perfect. That's just perfect.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Prepare for the adventure of a lifetime as you fight for survival against the merciless forces of nature! Toe your marks, get set, go!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ready, Mr. Burns?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: One moment.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, can Lisa and I play outside, away from the bear?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, but when you start getting apple-cheeked, it's time to come in.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: How could you do this to me, Mr. Burns? After all I've done for you. Why, if you were here, I'd kick you right in your bony old behind!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Why, thank you, Simpson. I have been watching my figure.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lis, Lis, come here! I found two snowflakes that are exactly alike!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Really? Let me see!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oops. Sorry.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Mr. Smithers!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh great, it's the Bobbsey twins. Well, take your prying eyes elsewhere.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh, I'm sorry. It hasn't been a good day. If I don't get to the top of the mountain real soon, I could get fired.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We'll help you.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I have a watch with a minute hand.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: All right. You can come. What time is it?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: 12:80. No, wait. Wait. Wh-- what comes after twelve?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: One.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, after twelve.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Tell me, Simpson, if an opportunity arose for taking a small shortcut, you wouldn't be averse to taking it would you?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, not as such.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Neither would I. I've always felt that there's far too much hysteria these days about so-called "cheating".

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, lotta hysteria...

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Mmm-hmm. If you can take advantage of a situation in some way, it's your duty as an American to do it. Why should the race always be to the swift or the Jumble to the quick-witted? Should they be allowed to win merely because of the gifts God gave them? Well, I say, cheating is the gift Man gives himself.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, I insist that we cheat!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And to do so, I propose we travel by...

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Horseless sleigh.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. You sure know how to cheat, Mr. Burns.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, well, I'm older than you. You know, Simpson, you're not as objectionable as you seemed when we first met.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No sir. I am not.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart? Lisa?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me, sir. I can't find my children.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We made it, old friend!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Mom!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There they are! Let me down here.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right, kids. We'll meet you at the top. Just be careful!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That worked sooo well.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We have several hours before the others arrive. What say we get comfy?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now we have electricity. This propane tank will supply us with heat, and this doorknob, properly turned, will allow us access to the cabin.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No going through the window for us!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Is there maple syrup in this one?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: There isn't any food in any of these trees. Please Bart, we've got to hurry. I can't be the last one to reach the cabin.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I'm not gonna get fired. Is there any gold in this mountain?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It doesn't matter.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll check.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Smithers! Mr. Smithers! I found another hurt shrew! I think this one has a twisted ankle!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Twisted a... Aren't there any healthy animals in this forest?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, I don't suppose the others will mind us starting the party early, Homie old boy. More champagne?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Mr. Burns, you're the richest guy I know. Way richer than Lenny.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, yes, but I'd trade it all for a little more.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, these sure are comfortable chairs.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, yes, sitting. The great leveler. From the mightiest Pharaoh to the lowliest peasant, who doesn't enjoy a good sit?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, man, you are so right. Did you ever sit like this?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, yes! That's it! Oh, I could go for one of those right now!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The only hard part is getting up.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why get up? Here's a little move I've been tinkering with. Say I want that bowl of dip.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Why, you'd have to get up.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Sir, I am in your debt.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Use it wisely, my friend.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, did you hear something?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: No.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hmm. Did I?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: I don't know.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hope that wasn't an avalanche. Be a chum and have a look-see.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You got it, buddy.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Isn't there any way out of here?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Um, I don't see one. Unless...

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No. There's no way out.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: There must be some way to contact the outside world. Ah, the telegraph.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: S-O-S. Avalanche... Send... Help...

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: According to the map, the cabin should be right here.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, maybe there is no cabin. Maybe it's one of them um, metaphorical things.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah, yeah. Like maybe the "cabin" is the place inside each of us created by our goodwill and teamwork.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ohhhh. Nah, they said there'd be sandwiches.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Simpson, I have a confession. I'm not quite the tunnel digger I made myself out to be.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You can supervise me.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right, good. Let's dig... That's right, dig some more... Oh, we make quite a duo: Burns and associate. No, no, what am I thinking? Burns and... teammate.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We sure did!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What happened?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think when we yelled we caused another avalanche.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We... should... be... careful... not... to... speak... unless... it's... absolutely... positively... necessary.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shhh! You're causing more avalanches. .

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think they've stopped. .

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Let's go.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Those last three avalanches were your fault, Simpson.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So what?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Sew buttons.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Oh, there's not another place for miles. This must be the cabin Burns was talking about.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Well, we made it here first, all thanks to teamwork.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, my teamwork.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We must be covered by a thousand feet of snow.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It could be days before they find us.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hmmm... no books, no radio, no board games. Ah! A Bazooka Joe comic.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ech! I heard that one 75 years ago.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We could build snowmen.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No, I have a better idea! We could build real men. Out of snow.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh... Okay.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Smithers! Mr. Smithers! That moose is on fire!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Fine. Good. I don't care anymore. I'm the last one here. You kids cost me my job.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You ain't last, Mr. Smithers.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh, thank goodness.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah. Burnsie and Homer never made it.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Mr. Burns is still out there?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What about our dad?!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stay back! I have powers! Uh, political powers!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah. 206 bones... fifty miles of small intestine... full, pouting lips. Why, this fellow is less a snowman than a god.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, we've managed to stave off cabin fever for a few hours.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I... I think we should dress the snowmen.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Agreed.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Look at them. Smug and secure in their finery. Mocking us.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, they're just snowmen, Mr. Burns.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, snowmen have peepers. Peepers to watch. To watch for our moment of weakness and then baff! comes the knock on the head and we're down.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do we do?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, wouldn't you like to know.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Wait a minute. If this is a ranger station, we must be in the wrong place.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, Dad and Mr. Burns could be trapped in there!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'll kill you, you bloated museum of treachery.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You and what army?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Burnsie!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Did you hear that, Lis? Dad's gonna be just fine.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look! What's that?!!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We'll be dashed to pieces.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Lord, protect this rocket house and all who dwell within the rocket house.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It's them all right.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We're over here, Homie!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh, something's wrong with its brakes! Gangway!

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, kids.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Have you people forgotten our little competition? Last one in the cabin is fired.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You're fired, Lenny.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Aw, nuts.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: So how did we do?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It's a new record, sir.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Outstanding. Well, perhaps all of this has been worthwhile. Did you all learn about teamwork?

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent. In that case, no one will be fired after all.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: That old goat can't fire me. I'm going to give him a piece of my...

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Aw, nuts.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, Simpson, I must say, once you've been through something like that with a person, you never want to see that person again.

title: Mountain of Madness
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You said it, ya weirdo.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Announcer
spoken_words: It's the Krusty Komedy Klassic!

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey Hey! It's great to be back at the Apollo Theater and... KKK?! That's not good.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now I'd like to introduce a new feature never before seen on TV... "Dumb Pet Tricks." Oh boy. Here's a dog that's been trained to catch this red rubber ball.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Auggh! Oww! Somebody shoot it! Somebody shoot it!

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: These specials get worse every year.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll see what else is on. Hey, where's the remote?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Hello? Hello? Stupid cordless phone. I'll try the old-fashioned model.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, that's better. How ya doin', Gertie?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: And now, our parody of "Mad About You" entitled "Mad About Shoe."

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Gimme a kiss, baby. No tongue.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: You're not gonna like our "NYPD Shoe" sketch. It's pretty much the same thing.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ma, could you get me some milk?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Can't you get it yourself?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's okay. I'll just go without liquid.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, all right, all right, I'll get your milk!

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Does anyone else want anything while I'm up?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, get me a beer.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, mom?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What?!

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Um, there's a hair in my soup. But I'll just eat around it.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What kind of hair?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's blue... six feet long...

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ewwwwww!

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's my hair. Excuse me.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your mother seems really upset about something. I better go have a talk with her... during the commercial.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now let's hear it for a great American... former president Gerald Ford.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Well, all the good Presidents turned us down.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Uh, um... How's your wife Nancy?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Who cares?

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Marge I just had a couple of beers.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eww.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I was just watching Women's Volleyball on ESPN...

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on. There's no need for that baba-ma-bushka.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right... but don't be shocked.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, There's no way I could --

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, I'm losing my hair.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now sweetie, don't worry about a thing. I'll teach you to comb it over so no one can tell. Just like my hair!

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Mrs. Simpson, there's no physical reason why your hair should be falling out. This thing has me buffaloed.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ma, I need a glass of milk.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Me too.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: I think the problem may be stress.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I was just with Dr. Hibbert. He said I was under a lot of stress and should get some help.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, whatever it takes to make you well, we'll do it.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well... I was thinking we could hire a nanny to help me out.

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: A nanny?!

title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious

spoken_words: Oh, my God, what's happening now?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...and the entire steel mill was gay!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Where ya been, Homer? Entire steel industry's gay.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, aerospace, too. And the railroads. And ya know what else? Broadway!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, it ain't no mystery -- whole modern world got a swishifyin' effect on kids today. And their MTV's and their diet sodas ain't gonna set 'em straight neither. You gotta do it yourself, Homer. And you gotta do it fast.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But what would turn Bart into a man fast? You have to think for me!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, lessee now... uh, time was, you'd send a boy off to war. Shootin' a man'd fix him right up. But there's not even any wars no more thank you very much Warren Christopher!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, he's right, Homer. After the boy bags a deer, all the diet sodas in the world won't turn him back. Then you just sit back and watch the grandkids roll in!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hunting, eh?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stand aside, Marge. I'm taking the boy deer hunting. He's going to grow up straight for once.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What? You never went hunting before, and you're perfectly straight!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah?! How long since you've had a baby?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But, Dad, it's barbaric! How does killing a deer make you more of a man?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It just does! Name me one gay Indian!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Butt out, butt-insky! What would you know about hunting?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hang onto it, Toy-Boy! You might need it when it starts raining naked ladies!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You guys gonna teach me to drive?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Yes. I'm a good, good man.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, yeah, let a twinkle-toes drive Betsy. Right.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, boy. You can't drive, you're only 10. You're going hunting!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Y'ever been huntin' before there, Barty?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nope. Something about a bunch of guys alone together in the woods... seems kinda gay.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That is a very immature attitude, young man.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Remember, guys, the truck only holds six carcasses, so don't shoot nothin' but trophy bucks, huh?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, those ain't your rats, Barn. Well, Homer, you ready to call it quits?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... but... Wait a minute. Bart's not fixed yet! He hasn't even --

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Homer...

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: C'mon, don't take it so hard, Homer. You still got that other kid... uh, Lisa. Let's take her out huntin' tomorrow, make her into a man.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, she'd never go. She's a vegetarian.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: ...Aw, geez, Homer! Geez! You and Marge ain't cousins, are ya?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No... This whole thing is my fault. I've been a lousy dad.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Cheer up, Homer. Christmas is comin' early this year!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No. They were just going to find a deer and make Bart shoot it.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But if there're no deer out there, then what are they hunting?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, boy, wake up! Your old man found some deer!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Huh? You did? Wait, man, those are reindeer.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yep, and it's your shot, son.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where are the dice?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What? I'm not gonna shoot a reindeer in a pen.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, Bart. Be a sport and kill Blitzen, okay?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Da-ad --

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, criminy! Here come the waterworks.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I'm gonna turn my back -- and when I turn around, I wanna see a whole pile of dead reindeer.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Attaway, son! You made your old man proud!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't do anything.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, it must be matin' season!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I'm scared.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Me too, son.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, don't! You have to protect yourself!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, there comes a time in every father's life when he must -- GAAHHH!!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: UNNGHH!!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, are you hurt?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just... my bones... and organs...

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the -- ?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, look! It's Santa Claus!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, it's Santa, all right! And he is kickin' ass!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's a miracle!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homie, I'm so glad you're safe! Hmmm, you feel softer than before.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've been tenderized.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How'd you know that thing would work?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'll do anything you say! Anything!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, we'll never live it down. Oh, boy, it looks like it's suicide again for me.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Stop, you idiots!

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, we owe this guy. And I don't want you calling him a sissy. This guy's a fruit! And a -- No, wait, wait, wait -- "queer!" Queer, queer. That's what you like to be called, right?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This is about as tolerant as Dad gets, so you should be flattered.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Amen to that.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Y'know, Bart, maybe it's just the concussion talking, but any way you choose to live your life is okay with me.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He thinks you're gay.

title: Homer's Phobia
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He thinks I'm gay?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I SLUGGED SOME JERK IN TAHOE / THEY GAVE ME ONE TO THREE / MY HIGH-PRICED LAWYER SPRUNG ME ON A TECH-NI-CAL-I-TY / I'M JUST VISITING SPRINGFIELD PRISON / I GET TO SLEEP AT HOME TONIGHT --

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, hey, I kid! I kid 'cause I love. I tell ya, the best folk in the world are prison folk.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Man, those cons love Krusty. Inside every hardened criminal beats the heart of a ten-year-old boy.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And vice versa.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just remember, Bart, convicts aren't "cool." They're bad people.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, maybe so. But they get the job done.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, now I know where my tax dollars are goin', huh?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey hey, it's my old TV sidekick, Sideshow Bob! Why, I haven't seen you in years. Whattya been doing with yourself, Bob?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Can't you find it in your hearts just to let me live and work in peace?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Well, Krusty, as you may remember, after I tried to frame you for armed robbery, I tried to murder Selma Bouvier... Let's see, I rigged the mayoral elections, I tried to blow up Springfield with a nuclear device, and I tried to kill you...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: And, whenever I could find a spare moment, I've tried to murder Bart Simpson...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He said "tried"!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Someone should really go up there and talk to him.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ho-mer.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, all those stairs...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you have nothing to worry about, honey.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your mother's right, Bart. Sure, you're the one who ruined all of Sideshow Bob's criminal schemes --

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We're very proud of you, by the way.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And sure, he's probably so insane with rage that he'd butcher you horribly if he could --

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But he's safely locked away!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In a medium-security prison.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: For life!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Unless he gets out somehow.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Which is impossible!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Or so you'd think, except he's done it so many times before.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks for trying, guys, but Sideshow Bob wants me dead, and Sideshow Bob is an unstoppable killing machine.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: I once was lost but now am found...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: ...Was blind but now I see!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Well, that was lovely, Robert. You other cons could benefit from his shining example.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Really, Reverend, your praise is going to get me beaten up.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, I'm sorry, Bob. But your transformation is truly inspiring.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: You know, it's hard to believe this model prisoner could be the same monstrous fiend who once ran for Mayor. It's a pleasure to have recommended you for the work release program.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Me? I'm touched, I really am. But you'll never find anyone willing to hire a five-time loser like me.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: I already have.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Cecil?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Is it really you?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: But it's been ten years! We haven't spoken since the... unpleasantness.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: No, no, no. I mean our falling out.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: But this is wonderful!... You do know I used to have a... problem with trying to kill people?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Touché, Cecil.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: You don't have to worry about me, brother. I'm all murdered out.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Praise the Lord.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How can you even think of releasing Sideshow Bob?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's just faking it to get out of jail! He's a maniac!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Bob is no maniac. He explained his reasons for trying to kill us all, and I assure you they were perfectly sane.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: My friends, please! I make no secret of my past, but isn't our system of justice based on the idea that a man can change?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Uh, have the boys check into that.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: I know I don't deserve another chance. But this is America, and as an American, aren't I entitled to one?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you see what you've done? Sideshow Bob hasn't reformed! He's pure evil! Oh, if only you knew what he was thinking...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: I've been in prison, Cecil. I'll be happy just as long as it doesn't taste like orange drink fermented under a radiator.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And God bless Mom and Dad and Lisa and Maggie, and please, God, kill Sideshow Bob --

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, no!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's him or me, O Lord!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You can't ask God to kill someone!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah! You do your own dirty work!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Well, I suppose I should ask you what you do if I'm to be working with you.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Hydrological and hydrodynamical? Talk about running the gamut.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Thank you. I believe I shall.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Aha! I knew it! You're still angry that Krusty picked me instead of you!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Oh, come now! You wanted to be Krusty's sidekick since you were five! What about the buffoon lessons? The four years at Clown Kollege?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: The point is, you obviously still blame me for what happened at your audition.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Who is that? Why, it's Bart Simpson. Hellllooo, Bart!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Cecil, no civilization in history has ever considered "Chief Hydrological Engineer" a calling.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Yes, yes, the Cappadocians, fine.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Just the thought of all that raw surging power makes me wonder why the hell I should care.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Oh great. Whenever a woman passes by, I suppose it will be my job to lead the hooting. "Oh, yeah. Shake it, madam. Capital knockers."

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's planning something evil, I know it. It must have something to do with the town's water supply.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Maybe he's gonna pee in the river.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um... Nah, that's not his style.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: He's just a little shy because I've tried to kill him so many times.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: I really must thank you for this moment of tranquillity, Edna. You know, I haven't been on a date in six years.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, the pleasure's mine, Bob. It's so exciting to be dating a killer.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: To be fair, I never successfully killed anyone.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh? I see...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: I did once try to kill the world's greatest lover, but then I realized there are laws against suicide.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, you!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mrs. Krabappel, nooo! That's Sideshow Bob!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Well, that's the last time I announce my dinner plans in class.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: That was Edna Krabappel. You only get one chance with Edna Krabappel. I hope you're happy.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I won't be happy until I find out what you're up to. Wherever you go and whatever you do, I'll be there watching and waiting.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: He says that, but I bet he gives up pretty quickly.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: It most certainly is not. The workmen you've given me don't know their asses from the hole in the ground they accidentally blew yesterday.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Oh, Cousin Merl, really!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Well, obviously.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: I'm telling you, Cecil, I can't take much more of this! Rustic workmen who've turned the SaniJohn into a smokehouse...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Coveralls that don't quite cover all...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: And a psychotic little boy who will not stop hounding me. This little boy right here!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Sometimes I wish this dam would burst and bury this cursed town.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you said we were going to Dairy Queen.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I lied. Now help me rummage through Bob's trash for clues. Then I promise we'll go to the water slide.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: You again! Well, that's it. I'm going to do what I should have done a long time ago.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Madam, your children are no more!... than a pair of ill-bred troublemakers.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa too?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Especially Lisa. But especially Bart. If he crosses me one more time, just once more... well, I can't be held responsible for my actions.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I hope Bob fed you, 'cause I ate your dinners.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I know it's hard to accept, Bart, but face it: Sideshow Bob has changed.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, he hasn't. He's more the same than ever. And I know where the evidence is. There's only one place it could possibly be.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bob's trailer at the construction site?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's even better. Let's go there.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What were you thinking?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The Haunted Mine.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Blueprints... concrete invoices... construction schedule...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: If I didn't know better, I'd swear Bob was building a dam.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah? Then explain this!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, there must be millions of dollars there!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What is Sideshow Bob doing with --

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Who left the lights on?!! Who's in here? Cletus? Cousin Merl? Big Hungry Joe?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I hink he nay have spotted us.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Run!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: You two!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Be careful! There's hydroelectricity in there!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Will you children stop tormenting me? I've done nothing wrong.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Give it up, Bob. We found the money.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Where did that come from? I've never seen that money before in my life.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Then you must have had your eyes closed when you embezzled it.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: I told you, I'm not a criminal anymore. You want to know what I've been up to? Here's a clue for you, Jack: One hundred thousand tons of reinforced concrete.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: My God, it's completely hollow! What happened to all the concrete?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You cut back on building materials and kept all the money for yourself! That's what happened.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Get 'im, Lis!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: But I wasn't in charge of the money. Cecil was. Now let's stop bickering and get out of here. This dam could collapse at any minute.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But everyone will know you did this!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Now I know Cousin Merl has had his troubles with the Revenuers, but he's hardly a master crim -- oh, you're referring to me.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Wait a minute. This is all because I got to be Krusty's sidekick instead of you, isn't it?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's hopeless. Utterly, utterly hopeless.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Oh, I see. When it's one of my schemes, you can't foil it fast enough. But when Cecil tries to kill you, it's "Hopeless, utterly utterly hopeless." Well, if you kids aren't going to foil him, I'll have to do it myself.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Come on, quickly now!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Bart, for once I'm not trying to kill you. I know it's an awkward situation, and I don't like it any more than you do. But you've got to trust me.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, what the hell.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Let's go again! Let's go again!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Come on, children! Let's go thwart my brother!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Um, do you know what you're doing?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Lisa, you don't spend ten years as a homicidal maniac without learning a few things about dynamite.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nooo!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Guess who!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bob, look!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: By throwing me off a dam? Isn't that a little crude for a genius like you?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Cecil!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I guess this is it. Thanks anyway.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: You know, I could snip the wires. We'd fall to our deaths, but we'd save the entire town. Bart, how would you like to do something incredibly noble?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Do we have to?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: You -- you saved my life, Bart.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah... I guess this means you can't ever try to kill me again, huh?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Oh, I don't know about that. Joking! Joking!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: You've brought shame to this family, Cecil. Oh, I don't relish having to write the Christmas letter this year.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Cecil? I think not. This looks like the work of crazy old Sideshow Bob.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, Chief, Bob's innocent! It's the truth!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: The truth, huh? That sounds like the testimony of crazy old Lisa Simpson.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: That's some good work, Lou. You'll make sergeant for this.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Perhaps you are. But I say Bob goes back to jail.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: But surely -- I mean, I caught Cecil...

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Maybe so. But Lou here says you were resisting arrest.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Quiet, Lou. Or I will bust you down to sergeant so fast it'll make your head spin.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Heh, funny, isn't it, Lis? Those people down there have no idea how close they came to complete destruction.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I'm going to look for the kids!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: But you can't do this! I saved the children's lives! I'm a hero!

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: You'll live to regret this! Oh, thanks a lot. Now I look crazy.

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: There they go. Two criminal geniuses, locked away together.... Who knows what diabolical scheme they might concoct?

title: Brother from Another Series
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: But I'm older! I get the top bunk!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Tonight on Eye On Springfield: Opening day at the world's first two-story outhouse...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: ...a comedy nurse who's laughing all the way to the blood bank!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: But first, move over Baltimore, Springfield has stolen your idea!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: I'm walking on the waterfront -- once the center of a thriving squid-gutting industry, now abandoned by all but a few longshoremen and allied trades-people.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: But the decades of rot will end with the opening of the South Street Squidport, an upscale shopping promenade with authentic maritime theming!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: And to kick it all off in style, area merchants will host a black-tie gala Saturday night.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that sounds fabulous, Homer. Stores throw the best parties.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You like parties, huh? Well, I just remembered they're having a big one down at the waterfront this weekend.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You didn't remember that. You just saw it on TV.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The important thing is I didn't imagine it.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I love everything about the world of babysitting: the responsibility, the obligation, the pressure...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's a trust, Janey. A sacred trust.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: That concludes our service. All right. I have two announcements. Friday you will have the chance to "party down" in the church basement to the Jesus-rock stylings of "Testament". That's Friday, six p.m. sharp.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All the best bands are affiliated with Satan.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Also, anyone in need of a reliable and affordable babysitter should call Lisa Simpson.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Mention the topic of today's sermon to get a dollar off.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: The topic was love.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why hasn't anyone called?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe people don't want an eight-year-old babysitter, honey. Parents need to be sure their sitter can handle anything that might happen. That's why they hire teenagers.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But... but I'm very mature for my age. People often mistake me for nine.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer, I've got a fozzie of a bear of a problem. Y'know, Maude and her mother were visiting Tyre and Sidon, the twin cities of the Holy Land. They must've kneeled in the wrong place and prayed to the wrong God, because, well, they're being held prisoner by militants of some sort.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Militants, huh? Well, if I were you, I'd kick their asses.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, any hoodily-doodle, the embassy says it's just a routine hostage-taking -- but I have to drive to Capital City, fill out some forms to get 'em out. Could you possibly watch the kids tonight?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, gee, I'd really love to want to help you, Flanders, but uh, Marge was taken prisoner in the... Holy Land and uh...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll do it! I'll babysit!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, I don't know, Lisa. You're awfully young, and the boys can be a handful. Todd's been pinching everyone lately.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But I'm smart and responsible, and my parents will be right next door!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, what do you say, Homer? Can Lisa babysit for my kids?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Please, please, please!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll have to ask her.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry. A moth is no more harmful than a ladybug.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, they're going to get eaten alive in middle school.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Once there was a robot named Todd...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, he had a brother robot named Rod, who was two space-years older than him.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, imagine that -- sleeping quietly after a bug attack! Oh, and Todd's as dry as a bone! Lisa, you're a wonder! I'm going to recommend you to everybody!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: So long, Lisa. If anything goes wrong, just dial 9-1-1. Unless it's an emergency.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Chief. Enjoy Bob Saget!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Heh. It's Bob Seger!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Aw, crap...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Now put your left leg into the left side of the pants -- and you're done.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Dad, how come you're wearing a tuxedo?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Going to that fancy waterfront party tomorrow.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why you wearing it now?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's like a rent-a-car, son. You get all the mileage you can. Then ball it up and cram it through the mail slot.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks for the ride!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Well, you did a first-rate job of babysitting. I've never seen such a responsible young lady.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Dr. Hibbert. Your trust means so much to me.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: I only wish my Volvo mechanic were as reliable.

title: Homer vs. the Eighteenth Amendment
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Wahoo!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Good night, Lisa...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You made all that money for sitting around and watching TV and eating food?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: There's a lot more to it than that, Bart. I don't just babysit; I sell peace of mind for a dollar an hour -- two dollars after nine o'clock.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Man, if I was making that kind of money, I'd be out of here so fast...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You look so glamorous, Mom! Oh, and you smell like vanilla flowers!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And Dad, you look totally classy. You could be Abe Lincoln's father's boss!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can you see the pie stains?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It'll be dark.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So when's Grampa getting here to babysit?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Grampa's not coming...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Not Patty and Selma!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Actually, Bart, Lisa is going to be in charge tonight.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What?!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I know she's young, but Lisa has proven herself mature and dependable.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, help me out!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Take it like a man, boy. And do everything your little sister says.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This is an outrage! I am two years and thirty-eight days older than she is! This is the greatest injustice in the history of the world!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we have to run. I'm sure you kids will work things out. Good night!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Make sure he brushes his teeth, Lisa.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I know you're not wild about having me for a babysitter, but I'm not some ogre. I think you will find me fair and fun.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're dead.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You should wash up for dinner. To make it fun, you can use the Mr. Bubble -- it'll be like giving your fingers a bubble bath!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You are so dead.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, I love this pedestrian mall! There's practically no traffic!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I don't think we should be driving here. The mayor's yelling at us.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, all right, geez. Okay, honey, remember where we're parked.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: May I have some more lima beans?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Certainly.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: More than that.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Certainly.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: More.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: More.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: More.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, maybe you should eat the ones you have.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't say I was gonna eat them. I just wanted to look at them, because they're so gross. What's for dessert?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, if you don't want to have a babysitter, maybe you should stop being such a baby.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'm a baby, huh? Well, then I'll act like a baby.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ga-ga-goo-goo.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Even babies know how to open and close their mouths. You need a bib.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, baby hate bib. Waah! Waah!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, look, Bart, now you got Maggie all upset!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Relax. I'll give her some ice cream.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, that's coffee ice cream! It has caffeine in it!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess that'll make things more interesting for you now, won't it?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's so beautiful! This is what I imagine Paris must be like!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You've never been?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so honored that Springfield has been chosen to host all these upscale chain stores. I guess this makes us "yuppies," huh, Homie?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nah, I'm really more of a slacker.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, Malaria Zone! That's where all the explorers shop.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Marge! A restaurant owned by celebrities! I always wanted to be a celebrity!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Isn't that clever? It looks like a Cadillac drove right into the building.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, even Moe's moved to fancy new digs.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You're a long way from home, Yuppie boy. I'll start a tab.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mag-gie, if you come down, I'll give you some more cof-fee.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Lots more coffee. Are you getting ready for bed, Bart?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I am!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, I want the 25-foot Italian party sub. And don't skimp on the vinegar. It's time Lisa learned what babysitting Bart Simpson is all about...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um, yes, I'd like to host an A.A. meeting. Tonight, if possible.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Maggie... Good Maggie... The talcum powder's not to play with...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Bart, now it's really time for you to go to bed!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why do you have to make this so hard?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm using non-violent resistance.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uch! The idea that you would compare yourself to Mahatma Gandhi...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll answer it. You go to bed!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What? I didn't order any giant sub!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey hey! Are you ready to get rowdy?!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Somebody hired me for an emergency bachelor party.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, there's been a mistake.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Well, I'm not leaving 'til I get paid! I get five hundred just for "Hey hey!"

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't see any U.F.O.!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he's not here! Nobody's here! And none of you should be here! You've all been tricked!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you are going to be in so much trouble when Mom and Dad get home. Now go to bed!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're the boss.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I thought I told you to go to bed!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, right, "bread." You said go to "bread"...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I said go to "bed."

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, "go to bread."

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: B-E-D -- BED!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhhhh, bed! Oh. Well, anything you say, sis.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You didn't say which bed!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: GO TO YOUR BED!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Make me!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll make you!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: If you want me, you gotta catch me!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Almost!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh -- Oh -- so close!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ba-art!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Okay, we'll call it even if I can just have some of that big sandwich-- Uh, I'll come back.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, are you okay?!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, yeah, I think so... It's just a bump on my head...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ew, your arm! It's got extra corners!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yah! Oh, cool, it must be dislocated or something...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We have to get you to the emergency room!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And get this fixed? What's the rush? Don't you want everyone to see what a responsible babysitter you were?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop it! Stand still! Maybe I can pop it back in.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no! I'm going to preserve the evidence until Mom and Dad get home...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And you'll never baby-sit again!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, honey, when I think of all the good times we've had together-- AAAGH!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Did you see that, Marge?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, you walked into the fountain! Get out of the fountain!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just stand still and I'll get someone!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't laugh at me! I was once like you!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! You need first aid! Let me in!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm afraid you'll hurt me again!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, if you come out, I'll let you eat raw cookie dough. I'll let you... ride the lawn mower through the house. Come on, open the door!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What are you doing now?!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm banging my head! I'm going to make the lump even bigger!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! As your babysitter, I order you to stop hitting your head on the wall!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart? Did you stop because I said to? If so, thank you.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, this is Lisa Simpson, and...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wait! Dr. Hibbert!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Dislocated shoulder, bump on the noggin... My diagnosis: bad babysitting.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Uh, near as we can tell, the boy was studying quietly when the girl, drunk on her own sense of power, beat him silly with a block of frozen lima beans.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's true!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Young lady, you will never babysit again! I am so disappointed -ointed... - ointed... -ointed...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess I don't have a choice...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Complete confidentiality?" Oh. And I'm sure he's as good as Dr. Hibbert. It says so right in his ad.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's the matter, Marge? I thought you loved Jello shooters.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I do. I'm just a little concerned about the kids. Maybe I should call.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, come on Marge, relax! Lisa's in charge. She's the responsible one.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hold on, Bart. Everything's going to be just fine. I'm going to get you to a doctor. He will fix you up, and by this time tomorrow we'll all be a happy family. Happy, happy, happy family.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mag-gie!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Please, Maggie, please go to sleep!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Um, excuse me, Mr. Smithers, Bart may be seriously hurt. Could we possibly go ahead of you?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Um... no. I really would rather get this taken care of.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Loneliness and cheeseburgers are a dangerous mix.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hold it right there.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, if it isn't Springfield's finest little babysitter, Lisa Simpson.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi. How are you?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Um, I'm fine. Now Lisa, when you're walking down the side of the road you always wanna be sure to go with traffic, okay? Well, is that with traffic or against traffic? No, it's with traffic, with traffic. Anyway, good night.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Uh, hold on a minute. Let me have a look at that wheelbarrow, please.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Just as I thought!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: It's a Yard King. That is a quality barrow. Well, gotta run.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh God! Where's Bart?!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Bart, I'm so sorry. This is all like a bad dream...

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Citizens of Springfield, I officially declare this -- What the hell is that?!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Why, it's Lisa Simpson! And look what she's doing!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: And she's tryin' to dump the body in the harbor!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, what's happening? Where am I?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Give me the drugs, Lisa.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I'm not on drugs. I was just trying--

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: His arm! Oh, my special little guy, are you okay?!

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Hmm. Dislocated shoulder, bump on the noggin... My diagnosis: a rather nasty fall caused by bad babysitting.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Bart. How's your arm?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's all right. I was hoping they'd give me one of those steel claws, but what're ya gonna do?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm... I'm sorry I was such a jerk last night. Guess I sort of ruined your babysitting business.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, well, that's okay. I can always sell seeds. Do you want some seeds?

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No thanks.

title: My Sister, My Sitter
name: Lisa Simpson
