title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Ted.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, this is Patches, and what was your name?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh, I don't like where this is goin'.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Please, I don't deserve this.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, listen up, everybody! The Simpsons are the best friends I ever had. So I'm givin' them the tip jar from the bar!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: My goodness, there is over $15,000 here.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Fifteen thousand missoulians?! Holy schlamola! What are you gonna do with all that kablingie?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if you mean the money, I suppose we'll just replace the items the burglar took from--

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Bo-ring! Spend it on something fun! Go wild! Ha! Right, Seymour?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yes. Something wild.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, enjoy.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Hey, speak for yourself.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, kids, let's go buy some happiness!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is this car $15,000?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What a deal! I'd be a sucker not to get it.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know about this, Dad. Shouldn't we give the money to charity or some...? Ow!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! You're still doing it.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Here comes Santa Claus / Here comes Santa Claus / Right down Santa Claus Lane... Vixen and Blitzen all the reindeer pulling at the reins... / Oh what fun it is to ride in a one horse open sleigh...

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Will this Christmas never end?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Outta my way, snow-poke!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Slow down, Homer.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, honey. I know exactly what I'm --

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oopsie.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Tap the brakes! Tap the brakes!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Turn into the skid!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, away from the skid!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hit the brakes! / Floor it! / Stop! / To the left! / Head back!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shut up! One at a time! Lisa?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bail out!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That was close.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I knew this would happen.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, at least the burglar's having a merry Christmas.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! You're up early.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I couldn't sleep.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's wrong?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There was no burglar.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No burglar? / What? / what's he mean?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I accidentally burned up the tree and the presents. I'm really sorry.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little...

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, no! Your hands are too weak!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop that!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm gonna kill you! / No, I'm killing him first! / Why you little... Bart, the next time you ever have... / You went too far...

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Kent Brockman here for a follow-up with Springfield's favorite hard luck family, the Simpsons!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Folks, any words for the Christmas thief, if he's watching?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Kent. "Hello, jerk. We may never find you, and we should probably all stop looking. But one thing's for sure: you do exist."

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Strong words. Strong, bewildering words.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Also, we want to thank the whole town for their generosity.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Little Lisa's sweater? Little Homer's sausage?! What in the name of holy hell is going on here?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's true! We weren't robbed! That part we made up! But the rest is true!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait! He's just covering for me! I destroyed the presents, then I buried the evidence. And I acted alone.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: So the family never knew about any of this.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, the boy told us. But that was after we filed a phony police report.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And after we spent all the townspeople's money.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So you can see why my husband had to lie to you a moment ago.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So this was all a scam. And on Christmas.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: In my long career, I've seen some pretty shabby things. But this putrid fraud out-stinks them all.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: I just want to thank you folks so much. This has turned out to be a great, great story for me.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I think they're running out of tomatoes.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but they've still got plenty of pumpkins.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homer. I'm so ashamed.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Relax, Marge. This'll all blow over.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no. Look at the line!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, there they are.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: It's the Simpsons.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, them stinkin' liars.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: There goes Christmas dinner.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Ha.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Head of the line! A family could get used to being shunned. Huh? Huh?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Um, Miss Hoover! Miss Hoover!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Run for your lives, everyone! This is not a drill!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh, right, yeah. Then while we're gone, you take our snacks, just like you took our money.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: You tell him, Lenny.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "...You'll all get yours in hell, you lying, thieving, blanking blankers. Sincerely, Moe."

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh great, now we have to send him a card.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I know you're used to getting hate mail, but I'm not.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There's only one way out. We've gotta give this greedy town its money back.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But we don't have $15,000.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Unless...

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But Mr. Trebek --

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Run, Mom!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I guess we better get used to being pariahs.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There's no shame in being a pariah.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no, there's that angry mob again.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Hey, look who's here, everybody.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They've forgiven us. It's a miracle! You know, deep down, people are pretty g-- Hey, wait a minute! They're taking our stuff!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Good Lord!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hot! Hot! Hot! Hot! Hot!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: If you're headin' for the medicine cabinet, I already been there.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the hell's goin' on?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, we hated being mad at ya, Homer, so we decided to make things right.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Consider your debt repaid, neighbor.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: And then some.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look, I know this has been a stressful holiday. But, in a way, having nothing reminds us how lucky we really are.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We still have each other. And isn't that the best gift of all?

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But we would have had each other anyway.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. Plus lots of other stuff.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe so. But there's one thing they forgot to take away from us. This washcloth.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, that's my washcloth.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The hell it is!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gimme that! / Uh, gimme that! / No! / Let go! / Gimme that my washcloth! / I want it!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop this madness. It's just a washcloth.

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Besides, it's mine. Yoink!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, she's getting away with the washcloth!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Head her off at the stairs!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm over here!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She's going around the other side. Now get her!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Go!

title: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I got it! Oh, it's just a thread! It was... She's got... she's got the washcloth!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We got the popcorn! Did you get "Waiting To Exhale?"

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, they put us on the "Waiting to Exhale Waiting List." But they said don't hold your breath.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Did you get "Emma?" Did you get "Emma?" Did ya? Did ya? Did ya? Huh?

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa. Whoa. Calm down, little lady--Take it easy--Take it easy. No.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What did you get?

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Something very close, exactly along those lines--A Clint Eastwood - Lee Marvin shoot 'em up western!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So prepare yourself, for the bloody mayhem and unholy carnage of Joshua Logan's, "Paint Your Wagon!"

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: With blood, I bet!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They're singing! They're singing, Marge! Why aren't they killing each other?

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, their guns are right there!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, wait, wait. Here comes Lee Marvin. Thank God. He's always drunk and violent.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mm! Who knew that Lee Marvin could do such marvelous splits?

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's dreamy.

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, why did they have to screw up a perfectly serviceable wagon story with all that fruity singing?

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I thought it was toe-tappin' fun.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Singing is the lowest form of communication.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you sing all the time!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No I don't, I hate to rhyme.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You like musicals, don't you Dad?

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: NO I DON'T, I THINK THEY'RE BAD / THEY'RE FAKE AND PHONEY AND TOTALLY WRONG.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: WAKE UP DAD / YOU'RE SINGING A SONG!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I WOULDN'T / I COULDN'T / I HATE THAT STUFF!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: NOW HOMER, LISTEN, I'VE HAD ENOUGH! / IN OUR FAMILY VIDEOS, WE HAVE PLAINLY SEEN / YOU'RE A SINGING, DANCING, ENTERTAINMENT MACHINE!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: MOM WAS RIGHT, YOUR SINGING'S A SIN / YOU'RE AS LES MISERABLES / AS LEE MAR-VIN!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: SURE YOUR DAD'S SINGING / COULD MAKE YOUR HAIR CURL / BUT YOU TOO BART / HAVE SUNG AND DANCED LIKE A GIRL.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Eep.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: THAT WAS PRETTY BAD, BART / BUT IT COULD'VE BEEN WORSE / YOU COULD HAVE BEEN CARRYING A SEQUINED PURSE!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I HATE TO DANCE AND PRANCE AND SING / THAT'S REALLY MORE OF A MILLHOUSE THING!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I THINK YOU MOVE LIKE A YOUNG BARYSHNIKOV!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: OOOOOO.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: IT'S A DESPERATE CRIMINAL / ON THE RUN FROM THE LAW / PLEASE SPARE MY CHILDREN!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: AND THEIR DAMP-TROUSERED PA.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: SEE? ALL THIS SINGING SCARED HIM AWAY / IF WE JUST TALKED LIKE NORMAL, HE'D PROBABLY STAY.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: MANY PEOPLE IN THIS TOWN / SING LIKE WE DO / THERE'S MISTER BURNS, THERE'S KRUSTY, AND EVEN APU.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: BECAUSE HE WAS SINGING, WE OVERHEARD HIS PLAN / AND COULD SAVE THOSE DOGS FROM THAT MEAN OLD MAN.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: IT STILL WASN'T WORTH BURNS' SONG AND DANCE.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I knew I should've shut that window.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: EVEN THE CRIMINALS ARE BEGINNING TO CROON.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: HOMIE, THIS WHOLE TOWN RUNS ON A TUNE! / OUR CHURCHES, OUR CLUBS OUR GOVERNMENT TOO.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: SPRINGFIELD SWINGS LIKE A PENDULUM DO!

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: WE CAN'T EVEN GET ANY LOCAL LAWS PASSED / WITHOUT EVERYONE SINGING LIKE A BIG BROADWAY CAST.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ALL RIGHT MARGE, YOU'VE CONVINCED ME, THERE ARE MORE TERRIBLE THINGS / THAN MUSICAL COMEDIES WHERE EVERYONE SINGS.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: THERE IS SOMETHING WORSE...

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: AND IT REALLY DOES BLOW...

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: ACTUALLY, WE'RE DONE.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Done, done.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And not a moment too soon.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, who wants dinner?

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, let's get eatin'.

title: All Singing, All Dancing
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right! All right! Sorry!

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Come onnn. You have to go outside to do your... business.

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The experts say that if you want an animal to do something, you should do it yourself first to show him how.

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not going to the bathroom in the backyard.

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sor-reee, your majesty.

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmf. Why don't you want to go out there?

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The kids were supposed to be keeping this yard clean.

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Ned! I'm so sorry!

title: Bart Carny
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh-ho-ho. No problem, Marge. Oh.

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Turn on the TV, Lis.

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You turn it on. I turned it on yesterday.

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Allowance Day. Ding ding ding ding ding.

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You don't deserve an allowance.

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sure we do. Ding ding ding ding ding.

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ding ding ding ding ding...

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ice-cream-man-Ice cream-man!

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That backyard is a disgrace. Now get busy.

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's a good suggestion, Mom.

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We'll take it under advisement.

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But I can't go out dressed like this! What if someone sees me?

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're just going into our backyard. No one will see you.

title: Bart Carny
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw...

title: Bart Carny
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw!

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, man. Look at all this stuff: "Pull weeds, mow lawn, scoop and bag 'dog business...'"

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There's gotta be a way out of this. Lisa, chop off my hands!

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! Then who'd chop off my hands?

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All right, you chop my hands half way off and then I'll still have enough strength to chop...

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Get to work!

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, I made some lemonade for you.

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sounds great.

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bring it in here.

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What the? What are you doing inside?

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Work was hard, so we quit.

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What?!

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hard work made us quit.

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I see. Well then, no chores, no allowance.

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. We get our room and board free anyway.

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And Santy Claus provides the rest.

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The Carnival!

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We need money fast!

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, well, well...

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Looks like somebody's gonna have to do some yard --

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's carnival time!

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here's money, kids! Take what you need!

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh boy! / All right, free money! / Wow!

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ding! Ding! Ding! Ding!

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oo! Oo! I want to see Lobster Boy and Shrimp Girl!

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I want some Fried Sugar!

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I wanna go on the Yard-work Simulator!

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But when we ask you to do yardwork...

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, the Tooth Chipper!

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oo! Oo! Me first!

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You can't go on that. You have a heart condition.

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heart condition? Get outta here.

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You had a quadruple bypass. You nearly died. Don't you remember?

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Obviously, I don't. Now if you'll get out of my way...

title: Bart Carny
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But it doesn't look safe. And the guy running it looks a little seedy. No offense.

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He's not just some "guy," Marge. He's a carny, and part of a noble tradition. Carnies built this country. The carnival part of it, anyway. And though they may be rat-like in appearance, they are truly kings among men.

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sir!

title: Bart Carny
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow, my heart!

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Out of my way! I'm Hitler!

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Two tickets? Whoa, what a break!

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This isn't very scary.

title: Bart Carny
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um, I think that one's broken.

title: Bart Carny
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That was just confusing.

title: Bart Carny
name: Krusty the Clown

name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: With its own symbol. We'll use this "Special K!"

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I believe that's already a breakfast cereal, sir.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And people worship it?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: In a way.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All right, then. Uh, how about this?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh, why don't you leave the symbol to me, sir.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Ladies and gentlemen, behold your new God...Mr. Burns!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ahoy hoy, lowly mortals! In addition to working for me, you may now praise me as your Almighty!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Amen, sir.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Ahh, we'll try this again tomorrow.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ah, he's all right, but he's no bowl of Special K.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This is ridiculous, we're already married!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Marge, we're not mass married.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I could've done a lot worse, Mother.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: So, do you enjoy comic books?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: And who can tell me where thunder and lightning come from? Yes, Bart?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The Leader, Ma'am.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Very good, Bart. And who invented Morse code?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I should know this one. Th--The Leader?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Ah, correct again.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's wrong! You're wrong! The whole damn system is wrong!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: What's the matter, Lisa? You used to be such a good student. Don't you want to please your teachers and get good grades?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grades?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: These lima beans are even better than the ones we had for breakfast and lunch. Oh! A lima bean that looks just like the Leader! I'll put it with the others.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you know I always try to put the best face on everything. But there's no face on that damn bean! We hate it here and the family wants to leave.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We love the Leader!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No-o-o-o-o-o-o!!! All righty, time for bed.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm leaving this place, and you'd better step aside!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, I never thought I'd have to do this again.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Reverend Lovejoy! You've got to help me! My entire family has been taken in by the evil Movementarians.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, I feel for you my child, and I'd like to help you.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now, how are we going to get my Homie back?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I'll kidnap him for fifty. De-program him for a hundred. And I'll kill him for five hundred.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, no. Just the first two.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: All right. I'll throw in the killin' for free.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yaaay! Here comes the Leader!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What an honor! We've been called into the presence of --

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge? You're the Leader? You don't look anything like the beans.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Knock 'im out, Reverend!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, the Devil has given him superhuman strength!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Give me that, you noodle-armed choir boy!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Well, that didn't do it, Mr. Kilt.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look, let's the three of us try it together.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Oh, you're gonna break like matchsticks. I promise you that.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hey, I made some Rice Krispy squares for our hungry deprogramerinos!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ah, man! You ruined the atmosphere, you daft pansy!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, this is my rumpus room.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ach! Don't call it that!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Attention all citizens! Even though the Leader himself is completely non-violent, he urges you to be as violent as you like in capturing the Simpsons.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: What are you doing? They're not here, you idiots!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: All right, I'll get out my checkbook.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So, you kids really love the Leader, huh? Even more than your parents?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah! / Absolutely! / At least twice as much!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right, already! But do you love the Leader more than having your very own, brand new -- Hoverbikes?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What do you have to say about the Leader now? Hunh? Hunh?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The hell with him! / What Leader? / He can take a flying leap as far as I'm concerned! / Lea-who?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And who do you love now?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hoverbikes!!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Close enough.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yayyy!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry kids, there's no such thing as Hoverbikes. They're just a couple of Huffys on a fishing line!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But we heard them hovering!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh ho, I'm afraid I played a dirty part in this little charade.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, can we at least keep the bikes?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no, no, no, no, no, no! They're due back at the store by six. Get off 'em! Get off, off! Get off!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: All right, Now, what's so all-fired great about your fancy-pants Leader?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The Leader knows all and sees all.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Eww, well, that is impressive.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And he's going to take us to a wonderful new planet.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Does anyone here like food?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Oh! This Leader, he sounds like a grand fella.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Willie, I'm not sure we're making any headway here.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Would you shut up, woman! He's talkin' about my Leader!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Uh, maybe we should take a little break-a-rooney, huh? Anyone like a draft beer?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Beer?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm... Would you like a tall frosty one, Homer?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Go on, Homer. Our commandments clearly state that beer is all right. Try some.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you don't have to go with them!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I want to go.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You know, I pride myself on being a good host, so I'm obliged to offer you a beer. But I'm so darn mad it's gonna be mostly head.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, come back!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's my husband!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm glad I'm back! Because the moment that sweet, sweet beer hit my tongue, I was born again!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Hallelujah!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now I can show all of you what I've come to realize. The reason we're not allowed in the Forbidden Barn is because there is no inter-galactic spaceship! He's taken our money just so he can...build one hell of a spaceship!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoops.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Nice going there, Homer.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Omigosh! Maybe he was telling the truth about everything.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, mercy! He's the real deal!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Come back! Come back! Willy still loves you, oh Great One!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Dammit, it fell apart like everything else I've ever believed in. Oh, I guess it's back to good old fashioned voodoo.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Come with me.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Uh, is that your collar, Reverend?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Ah yes, how did that get down there?

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Come back to papa, baby.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: To think I turned to a cult for mindless happiness when I had beer all along.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And you Marge, the bringer of beer!

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's wonderful to think for ourselves again.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You said it, sister.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Announcer
spoken_words: You are watching Fox.

title: The Joy of Sect
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We are watching Fox.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, cool! God is so in-your-face.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. He's my favorite fictional character.

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, it's so late. You kids have to go to bed.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But the flood's only knee-high! At least let us watch 'til the midgets drown.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Mom, c'mon. You let us stay up to watch Troy McClure in such other bible epics as "David vs. Super Goliath" and "Suddenly, Last Supper."

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Go, Lis! Way to cite precedent! Ah ha!

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, all right. You can stay up late tonight. But tomorrow everyone's going to bed at five o'clock.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, those poor badgers are soaked.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Quiet. God looks like he has something important to say.

title: Das Bus
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: You've seen the movie, now meet a real-life Noah. O-only this Noah has been accused of killing two of every animal... Coming up next, on A.M. Springfield!

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my goodness! That was a long movie! It's time for school! Let's go! Let's go!

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't make it in today, Mr. Smithers. I have Smallpox... Well, it wasn't wiped out in my house.

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Okay, delegates. You leave tomorrow for the statewide model U.N., so this is our last chance to bone up. And bone we will.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lighten up, Lis.

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Finland, let's see that native dance.

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Smile more... Work that pelvis... No, too much smile... Sit down.

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Poland, tell us about your nation's achievements.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well, uh, I heard they sent a rocket to the sun once, at night. And there was that submarine with the screen doors--

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: No, no, no, no, no. Young man, you need to do some serious boning.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, grow up, Lis.

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: O-okay, Libya. Exports.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sir, you American pig.

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Nice touch.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, uh-hum. Let's see. Ah. The exports of Libya are numerous in amount. One thing they export is corn...

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Or as the Indians call it, maize. Another famous Indian was Crazy Horse. In conclusion, Libya is a land of contrasts. Thank you.

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Uh, I'd like to, but I'm afraid he has diplomatic immunity.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Point of order. If we want to learn anything, we must respect...

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Point of odor. Lisa stinks.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You leave her alone!

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Order, order! Do you kids want to be like the real U.N., or do you just want to squabble and waste time?

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Have a great weekend, kids! Be nice to the underprivileged countries.

title: Das Bus
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Good luck, Ralphie! If your nose starts bleeding, it means you're picking it too much. Or not enough.

title: Das Bus
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Okay, kids. Otto's in charge. Remember, Otto, we're trusting you with our greatest natural resource, the school bus.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Water bill, third notice... jury duty, third notice... mortgage bill, ooh, second notice...

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flancrest Enterprises?

title: Das Bus
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oops! That's for me. Flancrest Enterprises is my home business.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You liar. You don't have a home business. Why would you make up a lie like that?

title: Das Bus
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: No-ho-ho, it's true! Maude and I sell religious hook rugs over the Internet.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Internet, eh?

title: Das Bus
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Yes indeedy. Makin' some good scratch, too.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Scratch, eh?

title: Das Bus
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Yep.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maude, eh?

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, what are you doing?

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No time to answer that, Marge. I'm setting up a home office for my new business enterprise.

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What business enterprise?

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ever heard of a little thing called the Internet?

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Internet, eh?

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah, everybody's making money off the Internet except us. We've fallen behind. Way behind.

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is that my good butter?

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can't discuss that now, Marge. I have to write another delicious memo.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm... memo.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, Simpson -- race ya!

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: First one to the front of the bus gets Martin's lunch money.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Go apple!

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Go orange!

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Make way for grapefruit! Gooo grapefruit!

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I guess this is the end, Wendell.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whatever. Just tell Wendell I said bye.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Somebody help me! I think I'm getting swimmer's ear!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Martin seconded the motion. It's entirely his fault.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: People, people. Let's not blame each other. We all know this is Milhouse's fault.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's everyone's problem? I'm glad we're stranded. It'll be just like the Swiss Family Robinson, only with more cursing. We're gonna live like kings. Damn hell ass kings!

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: ... And every night the monkey butlers will regale us with jungle stories.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: How many monkey butlers will there be?

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: One at first. But he'll train others.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Good, let's get to work. Me and Nelson will build the treehouse. Martin, draw up plans for a coconut radio and, if possible, a coconut Nintendo system.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What about the rest of us?

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You guys gather food for the big feast tonight. And maybe a little wine for the older kids.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Delicious wine?

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Exactly.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What am I gonna call my Internet company? All the good names are taken. Oh, wait, I've got it! Flancrest Enterprises.

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What exactly is it your company does again?

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, this industry moves so fast, it's really hard to tell. That's why I need a name that's cutting edge, like Cutco... or Edgecom... Interslice... Come on, Marge -- you're good at these. Help me out.

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How about CompuGlobal HyperMegaNet?

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fine. It's not important. What really matters is my title. I think I'll make myself Vice President. No, wait... Junior Vice President.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: CompuGlobal HyperMegaNet. Junior Vice President Homer Simpson speaking. How may I direct your call?

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's Patty.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Food patrol, we're all starved. Let's see what you've got.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's it? What happened to all the lobsters, mangoes and chewy chewy cocoa beans?

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All we found were these oozing berries. And they look pretty poisonous.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How are they, Ralph? Good?

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, food patrol blew it.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Yeah? Well, your tree house looks kinda crummy, too. Kinda really crummy.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, when monsoon season comes, you'll be glad it's there.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. No food, no shelter, no monkey butlers... This island is a death-hole. We should've just swum for it like Otto.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Run for your lives!

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Monster! Monster!

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: There's no monster, you big Scaredy. Scaredy got scare-ared.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well, you'd be scared too if you saw a monster.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Nuh-uh.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh-huh.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Unlikely.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Likely.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Knock it off. We gotta find a way to light a fire.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: No problem. We can use Scaredy's glasses.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey! What's he doin'? What's that sound?

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: There you go. Good as new.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: What's good as new? Who's talking?

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: She really is hungry.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: She's really hungry.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: It's the monster!

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No it's not, it's my tummy. I mean stomach. Gut. Crap factory.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute... We had a cooler full of snacks on the bus.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, yeah! And I think I know how I can get it.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey, I need that to live!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We may have to live on this food for a long time, so no more till tomorrow.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: But I'm hungry now.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Yeah! Who put the Duchess of Dork in charge?

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No one, but if we're gonna survive, we need rules and order. Let's not forget what we learned in the U.N. Club.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Not now, Martin.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Who wants rations?

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I'm so hungry, I could puke.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Mornin'. Is it time to eat?

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Looks like you already did.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: What are you talkin' about?

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: But I swear I didn't do it.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Nacho cheese. Get him!

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: You wouldn't dare hurt me! You forget that I have... THE GLASSES!

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Yoink!

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Now that you've got everything you need, I'll just, you know, get out of your hair.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Not so fast, two eyes. C'mon, let's slice him open and get our food back.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wait! We're not savages! We live in a society of law. Milhouse has the right to a fair trial!

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Society blows.

title: Das Bus
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Ooo, Captain Janeway... Mmmf. Lace, the final brassiere.

title: Das Bus
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Oh, hurry up, I'm a busy man! Ugh, this high-speed modem is intolerably slow.

title: Das Bus
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Hey, what the-- Huh, the Internet King. I wonder if he can provide faster nudity.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Welcome to the Internet, my friend. How can I help you?

title: Das Bus
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: I'm interested in upgrading my 28.8 kilobaud Internet connection to a 1.5-megabit fiber-optic T1 line.

title: Das Bus
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Will you be able to provide an IP router that's compatible with my token-ring ethernet LAN configuration?

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can I have some money now?

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uhm, is this cage really necessary?

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No talking in the cage. Court is now in session. All rise.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ah-ha! Made you rise.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Your honor, the defense calls its first and only witness: Milhouse Van Houten.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse, did you steal the food?

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Nuh-uh. No way.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Could anyone else have taken it?

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well... I guess you could of.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse! I am defending you!

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh, sorry. I'm just saying, it was either you or the monster.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Monster? Oh, please.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I remind you, we are not here to debate the existence of monsters.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The defense has just one more question.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Did any one of you actually see Milhouse eat the food?

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I rest my case.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Prosecutor, your witness.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You liar! You did it, ya lyin' jerk! Take that! You did it! You did it! Ma--

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Object-Objection! He's not asking any questions!

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm. I'm gonna allow this.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Prosecution rests.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: After careful deliberation, it's my opinion that Milhouse probably did eat the food. But since there's no proof, I must find him not guilty.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: All right!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The law has spoken.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Ah, sucks to the law!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop! Leave Milhouse alone! Help me out here, Bart.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know, Lis... to be honest, that verdict made me pretty angry.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Bart's with us, law girl! Step aside!

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, man! Leave my sister alone!

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Oh, so you're one of them. So be it. KILL-THE-DORKS!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: RUN-A-WAY!

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: The hunt is on...

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, they have the Internet on computers now...

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, Bill Gates is here.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bill Gates? Billionaire computer nerd Bill Gates? Oh my God, oh my God! Get out of sight, Marge! I don't want this to look like a two-bit operation!

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You don't look so rich.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get a load of the bowl job, Marge.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is it, Marge. I poured my heart and soul into this business, and now it's finally paying off! We're rich! Richer than astronauts!

title: Das Bus
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, quiet. You'll queer the deal.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, right. I reluctantly accept your proposal.

title: Das Bus
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what the hell's going on?!

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I can't go on. You two go ahead. And carry me with you.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, crud. / Aw, come on, man.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hurry! They're catching up!

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here, Milhouse, you go first.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. Gee thanks, mister.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, now throw the vine back!

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: There's no time!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look! We can hide in that cave!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We should be safe in here.

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: They're trapped in the cave! Move in for the kill!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, figs.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop! You are in violation of the Model U.N. Charter!

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, that's right. The U.N. doesn't look too kindly on...

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: The monster!

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, look at his tusk!

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: So the boar ate our food! Oh, sorry about that whole tryin' to kill ya thing.

title: Das Bus
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Yeah, well, you should be. I only stole two sandwiches and a bag of Doritos.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey... If a boar can survive here, there must be a source of food.

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, he's licking the slime off that rock! That's what he's been eating -- slime! And there's enough slime for all of us! We're saved!

title: Das Bus
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: All that slime made this boar extra tender.

title: Das Bus
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm. Mm. How's your dinner, Lis?

title: Das Bus
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, shut up. Savages.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, look! This is a perfect chance to get you kids some nice church shoes.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What do we need church shoes for? Jesus wore sandals.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, maybe if he had better arch support, they wouldn't have caught him.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Homer. There's that bird you like to argue with.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, well, well... If it isn't Professor Know-it-all. 'Scuse me, Marge.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. Excuse me, I'm looking for someone named, Jay Leno.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They need a good, stiff, all-purpose dress shoe. Something for church, but also for doctors appointments dental check-ups, piano recitals, building dedications, visiting elderly relatives, haircuts and shoe shopping.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Did you hear that kids? Brown!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh rats! Talk about bad luck! I forgot to wear socks today. Guess I can't try those on.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ewww!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, if you didn't wanna tie shoes, you shouldn't a become a shoe salesman.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's where you're wrong, pal!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's not enough to want a cracker. You have to earn it!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, these are at least two sizes too big.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Perfect. You'll grow into them.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: When?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, you're both way overdue for a spurt.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yes! As long as it's tasteful... And never at someone, or with... And not...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why, yes. Yes I do.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A rest home for pirates?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, Dad, it's to fight soil erosion.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now that's a fight I wanna be a part of.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, somebody screwed up bad! You've got all these big comics lined up for your show, but there's no Krusty.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty the Clown!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Funniest man alive? Prince of Pies? The Sultan of Seltzer?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Well, only if something tickles me just right. .

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if you're running the show, how could you leave out, Krusty the Clown?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, he's alive. And he is so funny you could plotz. At least according to his press release.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Charity, eh? What's my cut?... Nothin'?! I make more than that taking a shvitz.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey hey, happy birthday. Ah, ha. Now get 'em outta here.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Tell him it'll count towards his community service.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. All right, I'll do it. Boy, you swipe one pair of Haggar slacks and you're payin' for it the rest of your life.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't get it.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, the zebra didn't do it. It's just a word at the end of the dictionary.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I still don't get it.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's just a joke.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh I get it. I get jokes.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, hey! Ha. Ha. It's you. Right? Yeah, ha, ha. And this guy, uh -- with all the jokes he does...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Y-Yeah, right, uh, thanks.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh good Lord.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes! Yes! Oh, God yes!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Ah, isn't that illegal?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Yeah! Krust-ee!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, hey. So... how 'bout those TV dinners, huh? I try one the other day. Lightning strikes -- the peach cobbler goes out.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Cobbler.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: The other thing about TV dinners -- you don't have leftovers, you have reruns.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Didn't like that one, huh? Well...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Me sooo solly! Ahh, so.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Uh-oh, I'm losin' 'em. Time for the "A" material. Hey hey!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Ah so. Ah so. Me lika da flied lice... Me flappa dickey long time...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Krusty, great set.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Are you kidding? I stunk up the joint.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No! No, I was talkin' to Lisa back there, we both agreed you killed.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Really? Lisa, huh?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh sure, there were a lotta laughs. Y-You probably couldn't hear 'em, the acoustics were so bad.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, the acoustics, that's what it was. Oh, I mean, "Me so solly"...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, I was great.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, I ain't going back out there.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Where is that stinkin' monkey?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: 'Bout time. Gimme those reviews.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Take that, Marge!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: "Last night's comedy benefit delivered wall-to-wall laughs without exception." "The only exception was the embarrassingly dated humor of Springfield's green-haired, red-nosed hack... Yeah, yeah, yeah. Krusty the Clown."

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: You, sir, are an idiot.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Aw, that's your answer to everything. Look at my life. I'm talkin' to a monkey and a -- I don't know what the hell you are.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Well, I'll fix that. I'm goin' on the bender to end all benders!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What'd he say, Lisa? What'd he say?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He said there's no shame in their forbidden love.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, Diego's not gonna like that.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Take me here, under the disco ball."

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Clear the couch. It's Krusty time!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Announcer
spoken_words: And now, heeeere's Krusty!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Hey, hey. I'm Kent Brockman the Clown, filling in for Krusty the Clown, who didn't come in today. He is presumed dead or on vacation. Today's top joke... It seems a local moron threw his clock out the window. We'll tell you why, right after this...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, this sucks. I am outta here.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! Get away from him, you little freaks!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Ooh, it hurts to talk. We'll have to work out a system of blinks.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Not you, you imbecile.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, pew! What were ya drinkin'? Gasoline?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yes, I was drinking gasoline, Mother.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Krusty...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hang on kid, I got a tack in my head.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's one of your posters. I got all the Krusty stuff.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Man, look at all the crap with my face on it. "Krusty's Personal Swabs?" What was I thinkin'? All these years I shoulda been workin' on my act, but I was too busy sellin' out. Now I'm just a tired old hack.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Ah! Ah! That burns! What the hell's on those things?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here, here, quick! Use my Krusty eyewash!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: No! Not on your life!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks for comin' over, Jay. Krusty really needs help.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: No question, I gotta freshen up my act. Jay, you're a professional comedian, right? Right? Answer me.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: They are just impossible.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, they are! Anyway, don't you have some advice for Krusty?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh yeah, you mean like when your lazy butler washes your sock garters and they're still covered with shmutz?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, whoa, whoa. Let's not tamper with a classic.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Shut up, kid. Come on, Leno. Tamper. Teach. Impart.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woop, sorry son. I didn't know you, Jay Leno, and a monkey were bathing a clown.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Well, they are. So make with the loofah or get out.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: ... And then, of course, there's Mom, who sounds something like this.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Eat your vegetables. Take a sweater. I don't think that's a good idea.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you. Thank you. And now, the all new comedy stylings of... Krrrusty the Clown...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh! Oh! Krusty!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Wait, where's my water? Oh, here it is. All right. Hello. I'm a real person and as a real person I've made some humorous observations about real life. For example, have you ever noticed how there are two phone books? A white one and a yellow one? What's the deal with that?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: One's residential, the other is business.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh. Well, that makes sense. What'll they think of next? Blue pages?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They have those. They're government listings.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I see.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Uhh... what about 2 cent stamps?... pizza pie's very hot these days, uh... can't open pickle jars, no mail on Sunday... out of paper towels... Oh! Oh! Oh! What's the deal with cardboard?...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Booo!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: All right, let's just move on to notebook two...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I've really gotta get dinner started...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Me too...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I also have to go. Booo!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty, the acoustics in here are...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I appreciate the effort kid, but there's only one thing left for me to do.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Thank you for coming. "Smart lads who slip betimes away / From fields where glory will not stay... Runners whom the race outran / And the name died before the man --"

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yes, I'm quitting show business. I was just tryin' to go out with a little class, you jackass.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: 'Cause comedy ain't funny anymore. Instead of time-tested jokes about women drivers and doctor bills, you got some big-chinned schlub readin' typos from the Palookaville Post. Well here's a headline for ya... "Nobody Cares!"

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, hey!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: These comics today... Oh, look at me. I can't set my VCR, I can't open a bag of airline peanuts... I'm a freakin' moron!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty's gone nuts...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Then you got these "lady" comics talkin' about stuff that would embarrass Redd Foxx, God rest his smutty soul. Who they slept with, what time they sit on the can... This is supposed to get you a husband?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What the hell are you laughing at? I'm just tellin' the truth!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: It is? In that case, I'm proud to announce my triumphant return to comedy!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Four drink minimum?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll cover ya, honey.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hi. How you folks doin'? I'm Moe. Or as the ladies like to call me, "Hey you, behind the bushes." Uh, is this thing on?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And now, without further Apu...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Woo! I have been zinged and I love it.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: ...the last angry clown, the man who spews truth from every orifice, ladies and gentlemen... Krusty!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: So, I'm watchin' TV today...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo! TV! Yeah!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: All I keep seein' is dead celebrities hawkin' products! They got poor Vincent Price floatin' around on a toilet cake tellin' me about the "horrors" of an unfresh bowl...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: And I'll tell ya somethin' else, I do not believe Winston Churchill would eat at Der Wienerschnitzel!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: There's nothing those Madison Avenue grave robbers won't do to get us to buy their crap!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Impeach Churchill!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Well, here's one dollar those crooks aren't gonna get their hands on.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I don't care if it is illegal. I'm makin' a stand here. Who's with me?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I am! I work like a dog for this!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: It's my allowance, Mother, and I'll burn it the way I want.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Take that, you greedy fat cats. Marge, gimme your purse.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here's $42 -- it's everything I have. Run home and bury it in the yard.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I love you, Mom!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: From now on, I'm gonna be just like Krusty and tell it like it is. Marge, you're gettin' a little fat around the old thighs.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You too, Bart.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, knock it off, Homer. You're the fattest one in the car...

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You didn't have to tell it like it is, Marge.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Get to the point, Armani.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I guess you Wall Street weasels didn't get the word. Krusty's not for sale.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: It's a quality form. But those days are behind me. I don't shill for nobody no more.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: No!

spoken_words: Take your corporate bloodwagon and get the hell out!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Stop saying that!

name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I brought a bag of money in case he wants us to burn it again.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I hope he tells us to burn our pants. These things are drivin' me nuts!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: So this afternoon, two suits come up to me and ask me to endorse some new sports utility vehicle.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you hate pants?

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I threw those two creeps out on their ass.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Then, they followed me home, begging me to take a test drive. And let me tell you, talk about roomy! The Canyonero combines the smooth handling of a European sports car with the rugged driveability of a sturdy 4X4.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, Krusty, what are you talking about? I, I thought you said those guys were creeps!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, but that was before I got to know 'em. And I'm tellin' ya', the Canyonero is the Cadillac of automobiles. That's Canyonero.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Wait! Where you goin'? I still got plenty of beefs! Fat-free yogurt!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Th-Th-Th-The quality of computer porn!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I don't get it, Krusty. You said you would never be a shill again.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I learned something about myself tonight, kid. It ain't comedy that's in my blood. It's selling out.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: C'mon, I'll give you a ride home.

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, this is roomy!

title: The Last Temptation of Krust
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Federal highway commission has ruled the Canyonero unsafe for highway or city driving.

spoken_words: Whoa-ho-ho! Texas snowball fight!

spoken_words: Ow! Bart, that has nuts in it!

spoken_words: Yeah, Mom says a lot of things.

spoken_words: Hmmm.

name: Homer Simpson

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: To Marge. And all the blissful years I've spent hiding from her in this bar.
