name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah. Big deal. You got a wife. I got a rash. Who cares? Ech, I'm sorry, Homer. It's just, it's been four years since my last date with a whatchacallit, uh, woman.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whatever happened to your mail order bride?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, she got homesick for her old life, diving for tourist pennies in a Micronesian swamp.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So her career got in the way.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I don't blame her. No girl wants to end up with a Joe Puke-pail like me.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, now, I won't hear of it, Moe. You're a fabulous catch.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He thought he was gonna steal--

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, well, uh, how come I ain't fendin' off movie starlets with a pointy stick?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's probably due to your ugliness. But that doesn't mean we can't find you a woman. Come on, we're goin' to the darkest bar in town.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, I don't know, Homer. Women can smell panic. And, uh, right now, I gotta be reekin' of it.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Relax. All I smell is garlic and fish.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, you look pretty clean. You, uh, mind if I had this dance?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I won't lie to you. A lot of people saw that. But you gotta keep tryin'.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So, hi there... Uh, don't scream.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, that'd be great!

name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Sure, whatever.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, do you work for Bacardi?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, don't give up, Moe. The girl of your dreams has gotta be in some bar.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Awww, there's nobody for Moe. I'm just gonna die lonely, and ugly, and dead.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, come on, what's the catch? A gorgeous woman don't just hand ya a free daffydil.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, well, the part that's showin'. I guess you could have a lot of weird scars, or a fake ass, or somethin'.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well... no... no... well... no... not a... lot... I... Gee, I'm sorry. I used to box you know, my brain's... Well, it's in and out.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, there's extensive cauliflowering.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, well, thanks. Yeah, it kinda draws the eye away from the old mug.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's get out of here, Moe. This is goin' nowhere.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I... look, I don't suppose... you'd never want to... uh... I dunno... get together sometime?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, what was I thinkin'? A beautiful girl like you and a gargoyle like me. I... I-I'm sorry.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Really? Hot damn! All right. Don't eat nothin' for the next three days, 'cause I'm takin' you out for a steak the size of a toilet seat!

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Who cares? You're goin' out with me. She's going out with me, cat!

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stop kissing that cat and get in the car!

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey! Hey! Sabu! Ah, I need another magnum of your best champagne, here, uh? And bring us the finest food you got, stuffed with the second finest.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So, Renee, it looks like you've taken quite a shine to Moe. Do you mind if I ask why?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maa-rrge...

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't mean any disrespect. I just can't figure it out.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah. It's like out of a story book, ain't it?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah, I got that.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeahhh, well, I just get so tired of idiots shootin' their mouths off, laughin' and clappin'. Makes you wanna start pokin' eyes out and slashin' guts and kickin' throats...

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'm sorry. I... I-It's just I'm so happy I met ya.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, yeah, park the dessert cart under this beautiful lady's nose. And charge it all to my Players Club card.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I wanna send her two dozen roses. And I wanna put something nice on the card, like, um, "Renee, my treasure..."

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Shut up, or I'll ram a stool down your throat! Ah, nah, nah, no, I don't want that on the card... Well, lemme hear how it sounds... Nah, nah, take it out. Take it out. And charge it to my Players Club card... Maxed out?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Look, I really need these flowers, okay? I got a real tenuous hold on my girlfriend here... Hello? Hello?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, that's it. It's all over. Renee ain't gonna wanna hang around with no Joe Pinchpenny.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, come on, Moe. Think of all you have to offer besides money.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hmmm... I need cash, and lots of it. Um, all right, everybody, I'm calling in your bar tabs.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ya bunch of ungrateful ingrates! Ya--

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, Homer, what am I gonna do? Renee's my last chance for true love.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If you really need money, you could sell a kidney, or maybe even your car.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Nah, my car ain't worth nothin'. But it is insured... For five grand... Homer, I need your help. You gotta steal this car and wreck it for me.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Steal? Oh no, you got the wrong guy.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You dropped somethin'.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: C'mon, Homer! I'm one of your dearest friends! When everybody said you were too drunk to drive that time, who gave you your keys?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you did. But -- I still don't know... I can just imagine what Marge would say.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I insist you steal that car.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll do it!

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, here's the plan. This model car represents my car, huh? And this olive is you. Now...

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmmm... me.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey! Hey! Aw, that's great. Now the car's gonna have to represent you, and, uh, this little toy man will represent the car.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, forget it!

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Listen up, here. Tomorrow night at eight, you go down to the waterfront and you "steal" my car.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What about the cops?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That's the beauty part. Every cop in town's gonna be on the Police Department's Moonlight Charity Cruise. And I'm gonna be right there with 'em.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, as soon as you get back, we steal the car, right?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Righ-- No, no. Wrong. Listen. While I'm on the boat with the perfect alibi, you steal my car, and park it on the railroad tracks. Then when the 10:15 train comes along...

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: WHAM! The insurance company pays off five thousand clams. I keep showing Renee the sweet life.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're a genius, Moe. All your troubles will soon be over for a couple months.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why all the black?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why all the pearls? Why all the hair? Why anything?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You look a little nervous, Dad.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, you look a little nervous, Lisa.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're up to something, aren't you?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No. I'm just going out to commit certain deeds.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Suckers.

spoken_words: Thank you. Welcome, folks. Have fun. Drink responsibly, till we're a mile out.

spoken_words: Uh, yeah? What about it?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Ah, I was just thinking what a good parking job I did with it.

spoken_words: I'm gonna be the best car thief ever.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! Oh, no you don't!

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Aw...

spoken_words: Hey, Moe. Isn't that your car up there, with the rubber hippie daisy? The one that was parked in 7A?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Hey! Hey, what's it doin' there? It was supposed to be on the railroad tracks -- no, I mean... the parking lot.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Homer, you moron...

spoken_words: Ger-onimo!

spoken_words: Huh?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Huh. Well, that car thief can't hold his breath forever.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Then God help us all.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: O-Oh! Oh! Homer! How -- could you?

title: Dumbbell Indemnity
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: You're under arrest, Simpson -- for grand theft auto! Now put up your hands!

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Y'know, fingerprints are just like snowflakes. They're both very pretty.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Homer, did you really steal a car?

name: Homer Simpson

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh! Great! Listen, I know it looks bad. But all I can tell you is I destroyed that car for all the right reasons.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: I'd like to believe you...

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Hurry, Moe. At three o'clock they're going to put us in the exercise yard. The exercise yard!

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, I'm okay. There's just somethin' I gotta do.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Naw, naw, naw, we're goin' for the real thing. First class all the way. Come on, we can leave tonight.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: Hurry up, Moe, for the love of God! Hurry up!

spoken_words: Oh my God, he's right. Oh, how could I treat a friend that way?

spoken_words: Uh, yeah. Here ya go.

title: Dumbbell Indemnity

spoken_words: ...Then we light a match...And FWOOOF! We start a new life in Hawaii.

name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Where you goin', baby? You goin' to find the corpses?

name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, well, you want me to come with? Renee? Dearest? She ain't comin' back.

name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ow.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Happy Love Day, everyone!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Mom, the stores just invented this holiday to make money.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, don't you ruin another Love Day.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: For you, Homie.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They didn't have Lord Huggington?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's the same basic bear, Homey.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I guess.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What the hell is this?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's a "Kisses-Make-Me-Boogie-O-Lantern."

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kiss it and make it boogie!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kiss it.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, maybe later.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh-ho yeahhh...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we'd better start our Love Day clean-up. You kids take care of the wrapping paper. I'm going to dismantle Love Land.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, what a terrible waste!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, but the memories will last a lifetime.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Crap -- py -- stuff.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's full, Dad. That means you have to take out the trash.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yep, that's the rule. He who tops it off, drops it off.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nuh-uh. It isn't filled until it's spilled.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I heard that! You know the rule.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, but I can rebuild!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow-ow, stupid-trash, rotten-stinky, hate-world, revenge-soon, take out on everyone... Garbage water! Oh-ho-ho!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're pushin' me, baby.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey wait! Stop! I have garbage!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And the school nurse says Bart has the plague.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You guys are the lousiest garbage men ever! Yeah, I'm talkin' to you! You trash-eatin' stink bags!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh oh.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know. A lot of people were yelling stuff.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That was yesterday, moron!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good news, everyone. I got in a fight with the garbage men and they're cutting off our service.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh lord! Now what are we going to do? Just let the trash pile up?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I'd rather live in a dump than in a world run by snooty garbage men.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, is this another one of those situations that could be solved by a simple apology?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I never apologize, Lisa. I'm sorry, but that's just the way I am.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Siddown, honey. The men will clear the table!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So long, chicken bone.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: See you in hell, brussel sprouts.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No room for you, Jell-O.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Goodbye, fine China.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Easy, Ned, don't breathe in.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oooooh!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry Ned. I didn't see you down there. Got him.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Uh, listen Homer, ah, hate to be a fussy Freddy and all, but Maude's folks are here and, ah, they're a tad touchy about odors...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then you might wanna close your windows before the sun hits Diaper Hill.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Rod, get off of there!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Three, two, one...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Go! Go! Go!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So-ho, the rats seem happy.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, that crazy lady who lives in our trash pile attacked me again.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's not the way she tells it.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, it's like the measles. Good to get it out of the way.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, this has gone far enough. Will you please just apologize to the garbage men?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah Dad, you're always telling me and Bart to apologize.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but I'm always secretly disappointed when you do. Anyway, I think those garbage men are starting to crack.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I think you're startin' to crack.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Apologize for that remark.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No way.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Attaboy!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good morning, Trash Pile. How's about...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! Woo-hoo! I won!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is a very, very proud day for us, especially me. Your father, me, beat City Hall. It's just like David and Goliath, only this time David won.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And to think you wanted me to crawl, Marge! Well, this man doesn't crawl. He stands tall. That rhymes, Marge, and you know it rhymes. Admit it!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Homer, you didn't beat City Hall! They picked up our trash because I wrote a letter of apology to the Sanitation Commissioner and signed your name. Period.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You signed my name? I feel so violated.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You've signed my name lots of times.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But this isn't like a loan application or a will -- you signed away my dignity. And I'm going to get it back. Lisa, do I have my pants on?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Perfect.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't come off all high and mighty with me, Patterson. You can't scare me, with your office and your desk and your lamp.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, oh, oh, I get it. Put on a big show for the cameras.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I came to fight City Hall. I wanna shake things up, Patterson. Stir up some controversy. Rattle a few cages.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You'll never silence me! I'm the last angry man, Patterson! A crusader for the little guy!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Never!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You want to know what I think?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we'll see about that.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I want to register to run for Sanitation Commissioner. And tell the fatcats upstairs -- things are gonna change in this town!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, jeez. There's always a line.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, everybody, vote for my Dad, Homer Simpson. If you don't he'll beat us.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little... No one's gonna beat ya, son. You're gonna get such a beating.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, vote Simpson... Hi... Nice to see ya... Heh, thanks for comin' out... Keep puttin' on weight, huh? Lenny, my man.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: So, Homer, if we vote for you, whaddaya gonna do different?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What am I, the answer man? Just vote for me.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hmf, I don't know Ray Patterson, but he's no Ray Patterson.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, Homer's a great Nuclear Safety Inspector, but I don't know if I'd trust him with my garbage.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Yea, I know. It's a peace of mind issue you know?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: These old geezers just don't get it. It's time to rock the vote.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Potato man.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Take a hike, Kojak.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hellooo Springfield! It's me, Homer!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Quiet, you! I know you youngsters wanna see these rockin' rockers. But I also know you care about the race for Sanitation Commissioner. So, let me give ya the 911...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's a good question, Bono. 'Cause I'd be the most wack, tripped-out Sanitation Commissioner ever! Can ya dig it?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! Oh, Bono! Help me!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My campaign is a disaster, Moe.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I hate the public so much. If only they'd elect me... I'd make 'em pay. Oh Moe, how do I make 'em like me?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, gee, you're kinda all over the place there, Homer. You need to focus here. You gotta think hard and come up with a slogan that appeals to all the lazy slobs out there.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can't someone else do it?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: "Can't someone else do it?" That's perfect!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It is?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah. Now get out there and spread that message to the people!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, hey, you didn't pay for the beer.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can't someone else do it?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: / Very good.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Seriously, gimme the money.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fellow citizens! How would you rate the trash service in this town?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, okay, it's excellent. But aren't you tired of waking up early and dragging the garbage to the curb?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aren't you tired of having to peel that last snotty Kleenex from the bottom of your wastebasket?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well then...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well then, can't someone else do it?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, yeah!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And can't someone else scoop out that nasty kitty litter?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Ray Patterson thinks you should do it! Animals are crapping in our houses, and we're picking it up. Did we lose a war? That's not America. That's not even Mexico.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you deserve better than the best?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who should handle all your dirty jobs?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry my opponent didn't think enough of you to show up for this debate. I'm sure he had more important things to do.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, then you shoulda been early.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Ha. He - he gotcha there, Ray.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not if we hire more men. And my men will do all your messy jobs. They'll wash your car, scrub your shower, air out your stinkables...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, then you'd better turn up your hearing aid, Pops.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Do we want old man Patterson here with his finger on the button?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What-what-what. What button? Where am I? Who took my false teeth?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aren't you gonna buy it, Dad?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fifty cents? Not likely.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Ray. Cleanin' out the old office, eh?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa Ray. Are we gonna let politics get in the way of our friendship?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, that was just a lie.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See? We're still friends. C'mon, give us a cuddle.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Jean-Paul, how are the new uniforms? Do they match the suede boots? Beautiful. Did you get the new trucks? Are they amphibious? Well, there's only one way to find out. We can always buy more.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, Dad, you're really working hard.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, I gotta work hard, honey. Daddy made a lot of crazy promises.

title: King of the Hill
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Him?!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm really proud of you, Homie, but can the garbage man really do all the things you said?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, the garbage man can, Marge. The garbage man can.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: WHO CAN TAKE YOUR TRASH OUT? / STOMP IT DOWN FOR YOU? / SHAKE THE PLASTIC BAG AND DO THE TWISTY-THINGY TOO? / THE GARBAGE MAN...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: WHO CAN TAKE THIS DIAPER?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: WHO CAN CLEAN ME UP / BEFORE THE BIG POLICEMAN'S BALL? / THE GARBAGE MAN?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: WHO CAN?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: WHO CAN?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: 'CAUSE HE'S HOMER SIMPSON, MAN

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Simpson, you idiot, you spent your entire year's budget in a month. Your department's broke.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no! Wait, I think I've got the perfect solution.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: You better, because those garbage men won't work for free.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Patterson was right. I'm crashing and burning... crashing and burning...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How could you spend four point six million dollars in a month?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They let me sign checks with a stamp, Marge. A stamp!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You know Dad, there's a lesson in all this. Many cities have problems with garbage disposal, and it's time we realized you can't just...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, shutup... I just thought of something!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Mornin', boys.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Will cash be okay?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Did I hear a briefcase opening?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, before I show ya, who wants to guess how I got the money?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dealing drugs?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Drugs.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll have to say drugs, too.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Close, but you're way off.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at that beautiful garbage! Other cities don't want it, so they pay me to dump it in this old abandoned mine.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's awful! I almost wish it were drugs.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Some of it is.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Good God, Homer! You're turning our wonderful little town into America's trash-hole.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge... ix-nay on the ash-hole-tray.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But Dad, you can't cram garbage under Springfield forever.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure I can, Honey-kitten.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: I don't know how you did it, Homer, but you certainly solved that budget crisis.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: What the hell is that?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, nothin'.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, uh, you were saying how great I was...?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: What's this? Melon rinds? Panty hose? A term paper from Texas Tech? Simpson, do you know anything about...

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Dear Lord, please take Mr. Bunny up to heaven.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: And all those opposed to horse-whipping Homer Simpson?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nay!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: And now, all in favor of reinstating Ray Patterson!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: He's right. He ain't much on speeches.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Now, people, we are far from screwed.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: The time for panic has come. We must move forward, and turn to the town's all-purpose contingency plan.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You mean plan B?!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Yes, B.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe it's come to this.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come to what?

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moving the whole town five miles down the road! It's crazy!

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, it's somethin', all right.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So we transplant the town. We're just gonna trash the new Springfield, too.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but whaddaya gonna do? If you need me, I'll be at Moe's.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hi Moe.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey-ya, Homer.

title: Trash of the Titans
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Wankers...

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wowwww! McBain has really buffed up. You could grate cheese on those abs.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but can he do this?

title: King of the Hill
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's what I call break-neck speed.

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, a man just died.

title: King of the Hill
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Anyway, it's time for the church picnic.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What? They had a picnic last week.

title: King of the Hill
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No they didn't. You just brought a bucket of chicken to church.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If God didn't want us to eat in church, he would have made gluttony a sin.

title: King of the Hill
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Ah, the joke's on you. We borrowed that jar from your table. So you just shot your own mustard!

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, still plenty of parking.

title: King of the Hill
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Nice to see you, Homer.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, out of the way, whoever you are. You're blocking the food.

title: King of the Hill
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, there's nothing like a good old-fashioned picnic. How's my kite doing, Smithers?

title: King of the Hill
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh-ho, it's, uh, soaring majestically, sir.

title: King of the Hill
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We'll see about that. After him, Smithers!

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gentlemen, the game is capture the flag. Rod, ladies pick first.

title: King of the Hill
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh! Oh! Oh! Bart! Bart! Over here! O-over here!

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um... I'll take... Nelson.

title: King of the Hill
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Saving the best for last, huh, Bart?

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, that must be it.

title: King of the Hill
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Heh. Sports on a Sunday? Hm. I'd better check with Reverend--

title: King of the Hill
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, play the damn game, Ned.

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, well, if you get a grown-up, then so do we. I pick my Dad.

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you'd be surprised. He gets pretty competitive when he's drinking. C'mon, Dad. We're playing Capture the Flag!

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, son, Daddy's down for the day. Why don't you go capture me some more potato salad?

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But Rod picked his Dad. It's a matter of family honor.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders is playing? Why didn't you say so?

title: King of the Hill
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Oh, it appears I will have to find a new Fortress of Solitude.

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Dad, they've got our flag guarded pretty good...

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I agree. Let's surrender.

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, wait. I have a plan. But I'll need your underpants.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm... All right, but don't lose them. They're my only pair.

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I got it! I got the flag!

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid kids...

title: King of the Hill
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: This isn't the flag! It looks more like... Ewww!

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Suckers! Go Dad!

title: King of the Hill
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Dad! Just a few more feet! Show 'em what you got!

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Time out... t... time out...

title: King of the Hill
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Oh, I don't think he can get up. Let's egg him!

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, stop it!

title: King of the Hill
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey, h-he's trying to turn over.

spoken_words: If you're trying to scare me, it won't work. I'm one hundred percent focused on my goal. Hey, my hat has ear flaps!

name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson

title: King of the Hill

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Air's getting thin, but I'm gonna make it. Woo! Getting lightheaded... Good -- no heavy head to carry. Wait! I'll just take that escalator!

spoken_words: La la la la la la la la...

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It just keeps going! I give up. You beat me, mountain!

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: At least I won't freeze to death.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Last entry. I have mountaineered to the utmost, but the peak is unclimbable. Worse still, that treacherous skunk Abe Simpson stole my oxygen, and tried to eat my left arm."

title: King of the Hill

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My Dad's a disgrace, just like Bart's Dad. Me.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This may not be the top, but it's as close as a Simpson's ever gonna get.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is for you, son.

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey. Wait a minute. I'm on the top. I actually did it. I climbed the unclimbable mountain! Bow down before me, everyone! For I am your KING!

title: King of the Hill
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hi.

spoken_words: Oh, Homie! You're alive!

title: King of the Hill

spoken_words: Aw, dammit!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ohh, why are people always trying to kill me?

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We have to get out of here!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: It was people. People soiled our green!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Boy, I tell you, they only come out at night. Or, in this case, uh, the daytime.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Think of the children! Won't somebody please think of the children?!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right, all right.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Here you go, boy. Get the scent.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: 'At's a shame. He had one day left till retirement.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, can we trade? I don't trust these guys.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We've gotta get home before someone sees us.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Y'know, all this danger is kind of a turn--

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gil! Thank God it's you. You gotta help us.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, my shoulders are separating.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right, men, those nudies are here somewhere. Fan out.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, we're surrounded, Marge. Maybe we should give ourselves up.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But think of the scandal.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, the British tabloids will have a field day. There's only one thing left to do.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Grab onto the handles, Marge.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Got 'em.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I think I've figured this thing out. It can go up and down, but not side to side, or back in time.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Clothes! We're saved!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: These have pleats...

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just grab 'em!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm okay, honey. Now listen very carefully. I want you to pull on the thing that's near the other thing.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You mean this thing?

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, that was not the thing.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hang on, Homie. I'm gonna try to set her down.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you...

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, a lot of people have pools.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay. Here we go.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, uh, can we not land here?... Honey?... Baby doll...?

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why don't you take a picture? It lasts longer.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it would have to be Camera Day.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wowww.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't want you reading those awful scandal sheets.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I was just trying to find Dave Barry's column.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's great! He pokes fun at life's little foibles.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, I want to explain about the stadium. Y'see, sometimes Moms and Dads get a little... well, accustomed to each other.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dads especially!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So they need to explore new ways to express their love.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Scary ways. But we never intended it to end like that. With thousands of people staring at our naked bodies.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All those eyes, just leering and leering at us.

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who's in the mood for miniature golf?

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I am!

title: Natural Born Kissers
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: They're gonna to feel so silly when they realize they forgot us.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Dad, they've got every kind of paper! Looseleaf, graph, unlined, college-ruled!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can't you just write on your arm like I do?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All you're getting is rubber bands and paper clips? Don't you need a notebook or something?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nah. These days everything's done on computers.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And staplers. Computers and staplers.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty's Speak and Say?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: "S" is for "shiksa". S... H... I... I think there's a "T" in there somewhere. Ah, look it up.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Lisa! Stay cool, Milly...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh, hi, Lisa. Did you have a nice summer? Don't you hate that we have to go back to stupid school tomorrow?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I like school.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Me, too. We have so much in common.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You have a pen glued to your cowlick.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: If you don't like it, it's gone.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh, you want this?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yo, Apu, gimme the usual.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Yes, sir! One Kwik-E-Dog, one bubble gum cigar, and the latest issue of "Success" magazine.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, this hot dog tastes different.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Yes, I just cleaned out the machine, sir, so the snack you are enjoying has not been soaking in putrid grease.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, yeah, but without the grease all you can taste is the hog anus.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I'm so sorry, but I sold it all to the rendering plant.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: People buy grease?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh yes. They use it to make products such as soap, cosmetics, baby food...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Used grease is worth money? Then my arteries are clogged with yellow gold. I'm rich, Apu! Rich, I--!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Money in the bank.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, this bacon's done.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And now for the profit taking.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Dad, I don't think the dog can handle any more bacon.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Looks like he's about ready for another squeezin'.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, that side of bacon was for my bridge game tonight.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, if you don't mind, I'm a little busy right now achieving financial independence.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: With cans of grease?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, through savings and wise investments. Of course with grease!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Bart. The bus is here.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where do you think you're goin'?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's the first day of school.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not for you it isn't. You're in the grease business now.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey blindie, have a nice trip.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw haw.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Attention, please. I need a volunteer for a thankless chore.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Shall I assume the only hand in the air is Lisa Simpson's? Thank you, Lisa.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: We have a new student, Lisa. And I want you to show her the works. The lunchroom, the tree...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: But when you get to the trophy case, give her some cock 'n bull story. They're out for cleaning, or whatever.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, I'll help her out. I remember how hard it was to be an outsider. Always trying to fit in... never quite feeling like...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lisa, I'd like you to meet Alex Whitney.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Did she just tell me to shut up?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Take it outside.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You'll want a locker in this hallway -- it's library-adjacent.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Is that perfume?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you'll definitely want to get yourself a good doll. The new Malibu Stacy has an achievable chest.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, jacks. Jacks are big. They went out for a while, but then they came roaring back.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, don't worry, you'll pick it up fast. Once you get to foursies, you're in the zone.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, they were... all wiped out in the big trophy fire.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Ah, I see the trophies are still out for cleaning. Eh, Lisa?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, boy, this is where all the hard work, sacrifice, and painful scaldings pay off.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, all that bacon cost twenty-seven dollars.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but your Mom paid for that.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But doesn't she get her money from you?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I get my money from grease. What's the problem?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, look at that load of grease. Boy, if we're ever gonna earn paper money, we have to expand our operation.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um, I don't know how much more school I can miss.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you'll miss plenty. I have a feeling this business is going to consume our whole lives.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Alex! Over here! Okay if the new girl sits with us?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: She's a little weird, but let's give her a chance.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Guys, this is Alex.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I'll go get our lunches.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's it, don't be shy...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Now maybe a little joke, to break the ice.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Or a big joke.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Careful, now. Nobody likes a showoff.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where are they going?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, wait up!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They left without me.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh, Lisa...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I've got an extra seat, and you've got an extra lunch... Catch my drift?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Milhouse, lower those eyebrows! And the other one.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So, there I am being nice to Alex, and she takes all of my friends and ditches me.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sure they didn't "ditch" you, honey. Maybe they went off to plan a surprise party for you.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah. Good one, Mom.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They only like her 'cause she acts so grown up, with her perfume and her cell phone and... Oh, and get this, Mom, she drinks iced tea.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Li-sa, I can't imagine anyone being more likable than you. But apparently this new girl is. So my advice would be to start copying her in every way.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But, Dad...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-uh, think. Is that what Alex would say?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hm, don't give it a second thought. I didn't.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, earrings! Wow, thank you so much, Alex. But these are for pierced ears.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But I don't think I'm ready for pierced ears.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, Lisa, I was hoping I could count on you again to spearhead our annual school-wide apple-pick.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Absolutely.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, it's great. We have pony rides, sing-alongs, apple-bobbing, apple-picking, apple everything.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Uh, you forgot apple-bobbing.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, I didn't.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, uh, we've never had a dance before. Lisa, you'd be doing all the work. What do you think?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Um, I don't know. The ponies might be startled by the loud music.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, there wouldn't be ponies.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, then, at the risk of being unpopular, I think I'm gonna have to say...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: School dance?! I didn't approve any school dance!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, you did! Yesterday. Right by my locker.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, yes, yes. Uh, carry on.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: When you want grease, go to the source: good old Krusty Burger.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh I'll say. Look at that redheaded kid. There must be twenty dollars' worth of grease on his forehead alone.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I was thinking more of the deep fryer.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right. We'll try it your way.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My God, you're greasy.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom's gonna kill you.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If she didn't want her car ruined, she should've done a better job hiding her keys.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what the...?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, hey, you're taking our grease!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, that's my shovel.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, girls, we're gonna need balloons, crepe paper, party hats...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I am not wearing this.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aren't we a little young for makeup and... What do you mean, five pounds?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Date?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You guys have dates?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop saying hello!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's "D.M.Y."?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Eww!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't want a date! And I don't want to wear perfume and cocktail dresses! Am I the only one who just wants to play hopscotch, and bake cookies, and watch "The McLaughlin Group?"

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hel-lo?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hello?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I can't believe those goons muscled me out of my grease business. I've been muscled out of everything I've ever done, including my muscle-for-hire business.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My poor Homie. Couldn't you try some other far-out money-making scheme?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, what's the point?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You could raise some emus...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're taking me! You got that?! And it's gonna be a magical evening!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Emus? Really? Oh, that's pretty crazy... Nah... I'd only fail just like I fail at everything.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Dad, I've been thinking. What if instead of giving up on grease, we go for one last big score?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute. The boy's right! I can't quit now. Aww, you always know just what to say to cheer me up. Emu farm... You're priceless, Marge.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: The thing about huckleberries is, once you've had fresh, you'll never go back to canned.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Uh, uh, so anyway, I kicked the guy's ass.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Now, if the berries are too tart, I just dust them with confectioner's sugar.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, guys.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Are you all right?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No doubt! Can't a girl fabulize herself before the big dance?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Your earlobe's bleeding.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. So, I guess major muffins like yourselves all have dates, huh?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Really? All of you?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Unbelievable!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ahhhh!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh-huh.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh, hurry.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse! I've been lookin' all over for you! Listen, you've always had a crush on me, right? Well, this is your lucky day, 'cause you're gonna take me to the dance. Pretty great, huh? See ya.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: But I can't. I already asked somebody.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So un-ask her.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: But that wouldn't be...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah. What am I doing? This isn't me. I'm sorry, Milhouse.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I'm free next weekend! There's plenty of Milhouse to go around.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, son, we're about to embark on our most difficult mission. Let's bow our heads in prayer.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dear Lord, I know you're busy, seeing as how you can watch women changing clothes and all that. But if you help us steal this grease tonight, I promise we'll donate half the profits to charity.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, he's not stupid.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, screw it. Let's roll.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm... I knew I should have attached those somehow.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Lucky parameciums.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You don't have to worry about finding dates or dancing.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I made you some homemade Pepsi for the dance. It's a little thick, but the price is right.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Mom. But I told you, I'm not going.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohh, so you don't have a date. You can still go and have a wonderful time.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You don't understand. I don't belong there. The other girls are already into fashion and make-up and dating. They make me feel like a little baby.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, honey. A baby couldn't have organized a big school dance. Unless it was especially skilled. Or one of those super-babies from Brazil.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Forget it, Mom. I'm not going.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But they're counting on you to take tickets. And if you sit there with a brave little smile and a festive bow, why, you could be the belle of the ball.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, you can't possibly believe that.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I have to, honey. Or... you can stay here and we'll have our own dance. "Every Simpson dance now! Bomp bomp bomp bomp bomp bomp!"

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll go.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This better work, boy. I don't wanna wind up workin' on your mother's emu farm.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry. This is the score we've been dreamin' about. The grease traps in this kitchen have never been emptied.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, turn on the suction.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's not working.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What is it?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, nothing.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Enjoy the dance.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Wow, Lisa. I really admire your guts. You came here all by yourself, at the risk of being labeled a dateless wonder.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Ow!

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It slipped.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, it's gonna be a long night.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Where's the hose?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bringin' up the rear.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you as excited as I am?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, here goes...

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And now we wait. So... is this your school?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it used to be.

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Eek! -- I mean, ach! -- I mean, what are you doing here?

title: Lard of the Dance
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uhhhh... we're, uh, new foreign exchange students from, uh... um... Scotland.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's boring. You're boring everybody. Quit boring everyone!

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ... And then he worked on a machine to communicate with the dead. Some kind of scary telephone I guess. Or maybe he planned to just stick his head under the ground and yell.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace

spoken_words: Shutup.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: As long as you're here annoying me, let's have a brainstorming session. Now, here's how it works: Lisa, you say one thing, then Bart, you say another. Just toss out things and I'll use my inventive mind to combine them into a brilliant original idea.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But it does break easily. Now this next one's for the ladies. How many times have you gals been late for a high-powered business meeting, only to realize you're not wearing makeup?

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Women will like what I tell them to like. Now here's something for everyone.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace

spoken_words: In the olden times, if you were watching TV and nature called, you'd have to get up and walk to the bathroom. It was the hardest thing in the world to do. But now, with the Lazy Man Reclining Toilet Chair, you can just lean back and let 'er rip.

spoken_words: Sure! Believe me, every man in America will want to have one.

spoken_words: Gangway! Gotta poop.

spoken_words: They're not very...

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace

spoken_words: Yes? Yes? Yes?

spoken_words: They're terrible.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace

spoken_words: What?

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not saying you're a bad inventor. I'm just saying these particular inventions are awful, and no one in their right mind would buy them. Or accept them as gifts.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
