title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: ...Authorities say the phony Pope can be recognized by his high-top sneakers and incredibly foul mouth. In other news, Thomas Edison, the greatest inventor of all time...is apparently still inventing, despite the notable handicap of being dead.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's my Tommy.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Two new Edison creations have just been discovered in his museum: A six-legged chair that won't tip over...

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: And even more astounding, an electric hammer!

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That was your idea!

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This brilliant innovation is expected to generate millions for Edison's already wealthy heirs.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, those should be your millions.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I gotta admit, Homer. You're taking this pretty well.

title: The Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's just say I'm sitting in the right chair.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mail call! Gather 'round, everyone!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right. One for "resident"...

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's me!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, that's it.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: One stinkin' letter? Why'd you make us gather 'round like that?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I needed my power fix.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, listen to this!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Congratulations. Your child or children have been selected to appear in Who's Who Among American Elementary School Students.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Please submit their names along with ninety-five dollars for each handsome volume you wish to order.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I've never been so proud. You both deserve a big, big reward!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, they put every kid in America in that book, just so gullible parents will buy it. It's all a big scam.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Shut up.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure? I can usually smell a scam from two towns over.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Lis. She is a smart, sophisticated woman. Now let's hear more about that big, big reward.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, quit stalling, Marge. We want our reward.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: One reward coming up. Ta-da!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, it feels good to get out of that car. Ooo, go-carts! C'mon everybody, let's go.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at me, Bart! I'm driving!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We're all proud of you, Dad.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Move it, poky.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Slow and steady wins the race.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Easy, easy. Stick with the plan.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Oh, are you all right, man?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh... I think so.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: How 'bout now?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw haw.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That was no accident! Shame on you, Nelson.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Cram it, ma'am.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stand back and watch the pro.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, shouldn't you put on a batting helmet?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nah. They mess up my hair.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh. Ball one.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ball two. This Bozo's gonna walk me.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're going down, you--

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh! Oh! Why you-- Hey you-- You better-- I'm gonna-- If you k--

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hang in there, Dad! Just half a basket left!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, you sure get a lot of balls for a quarter.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes! A Maggie-oop!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, that's cheating.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, what can I get for twelve, count 'em, twelve prize tickets?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: What can I get for eight thousand tickets?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hmm, hot food is tempting... but I just can't say no to a weapon.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, can I try that some time?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Yeah, sure. Never hurts to have a second set of prints on a gun.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, thanks, Nelson! I'll come by your house later --

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no you won't.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You stay away from Nelson Muntz.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But, Mom --

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Nelson's a troubled, lonely, sad little boy. He needs to be isolated from everyone.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But, Mom --

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's all I got.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So what prize did you end up getting?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mustache comb. What'd you get?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Fake mustache.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wanna comb it?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This sucks. It's time to punch outta this yawn factory. I'm going to Nelson's.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But Mom said not to!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She doesn't scare me. I do what I want, when I want. Oh God, inchworms!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Won't you get in trouble if your Mom sees you doing that?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Nah, my Mom's got bigger problems. She doesn't give a crap what I do.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, you are so lucky.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: C'mon, let's lock and load.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You're not going out without a scarf, are ya?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, I don't need one.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hmm, it's your health.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Think I can hit that bottle?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, probably.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Shows what you know. Hey, check this out.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: That's my Dad's shootin' car. Just three more payments, and it's ours.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, cool. Can I get a shot now?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hang on. First, how 'bout I try and peg you in the stomach?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm. No, thanks.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Or what about you put on these nerd glasses and I shoot 'em off?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No way. C'mon, quit hoggin' the gun.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Bet you can't hit that bird from here.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you crazy? I don't wanna shoot a stupid bird.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: That's 'cuz you know you can't. You're not a superstud like me.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Am too.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Are not. You're an octo-wussy. Ohh, look at me. I'm Bart Simpson. I'm scared to use a gun. I want to marry Milhouse. I walk around like this. La la la la la la la...

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, quit it!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God...

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Whoa-oa, major shot! You even compensated for the crooked sight!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Crooked sight?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You are one cold-blooded killer, dude!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But, but I wasn't... I didn't...

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Right through the neck! Doesn't get any sweeter than that, Simpson. Savor the moment.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I rolled up all the socks.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's next?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: While I deal with this, why don't you start on that basket?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I hate folding sheets.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's your underwear.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, whatever it is, it's a two-man job. Where's Bart?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He's up in his room. Bart?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's okay, Marge. I'll get him. BA-ART!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What the heck's going on?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We need Bart to help fold your father's underpants. Where is he, anyway?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart? Uhh, he went to play with a friend.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He didn't go to Nelson's, did he?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, no. I'm pretty sure he's with Milhouse.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: MILHOUSE!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: What?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: TELL BART TO COME HOME!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I think he's at Nelson's!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: WHO'S NELSON?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Nelson?! I explicitly forbade Bart from playing with that little monster. Ooo, Bart is in deep, deep trouble.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yes. And punish Lisa for lying to us.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, young lady. I want you to march yourself directly to the Kwik-E-Mart and get me some chips and a beer.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And get a little something for yourself, sweetheart.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Should we bury it, or chuck it into a car full of girls?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, leave it alone.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Okay, okay. Don't kill me, killer.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't call me that!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Relax, Simpson. It was either him or you. No court would convict you.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sir. Because I killed an innocent bird.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No! Not the face!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! What are you doing?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I got bored, so I started slapping you.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Young man, you're coming home with me this minute.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: All right! Finally, a real home.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not you. Bart.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Oh. See ya later, killer.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Killer? Why did he call you killer?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, you were right. Nelson is bad news. Can we go home?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What are you hiding there?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What are those cats doing behind you?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, cats like me.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Get off, get off!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! Did you kill that poor bird?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't mean to, Mom. The gun pulled to the left --

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You disobeyed me, snuck over here, and murdered a helpless animal?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I know, I really screwed up. I deserve to be punished.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's the point, Bart? I punish and I punish and I punish, but it never sinks in. So you know what? Do what you want. You want to play with little hoodlums? Fine. Have fun killing things.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, wait...

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my God.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, little eggs. I'm not sure how to tell you this, but... Y-Your mom was involved in an incident. Mistakes were made. By me. But don't worry, I'll take care of you.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Perhaps on a librarian's salary.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, fellas, good news. I found an extra 75-watt bulb lyin' around.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Check it out, guys. I've been working on this regurgitation thing.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah. Hope you like PopTarts.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I think I'll call you Chirpy Boy, and you Bart Junior. And you can call me Mother. No, wait, that sounds kinda fruity. Just call me Mom.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm. What do you think he's doing up there?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'unno. Drug lab?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Drug lab?!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Or reading comic books. What am I, Kreskin? You tell me what he's doing.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know, and I don't want to know. And I'm going to find out!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my good, gray extension cord.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I've gotta keep these warm.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, stop whatever you're doing and come down here.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Can't right now. Come back later.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'll come back later.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How's this for later?!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, listen--

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why are you sitting like that? What are you hiding this time?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Eggs?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That bird I killed was their mother. I don't want her babies to die, too.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh, oh, honey. Oh, come here.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my goodness! Look!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, man. This is the most exciting thing I've seen since Haley's Comet collided with the moon!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That never happened, Dad.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure it didn't.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Is the nest still warm enough, Mom?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm... it's starting to cool down. I'll bake another pie.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, how 'bout cherry this time? And would it kill you to make some coffee?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why is this taking so long? Bart was born in about five minutes.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Actually, it took fifty-three hours.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? Well, the time just flew by, didn't it?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Everybody come quick! They're hatching!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I see a foot!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I see an eye!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I see a neck!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I see a horn!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A horn?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Man, those are some funky-lookin' birds.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aww... Ohh, you look like a little tiny dinosaur.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That is one vicious baby bird.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, they aren't birds.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sure they are. They came from eggs in a bird's nest. Therefore, they're birds. Ixo fatso.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: One, they don't have beaks, two, they don't have feathers, and three, they're lizards.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're a lizard.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Enough bickering. I know how to settle this.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No kickboxing!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If anyone wants me, I'll be eating alone in the basement.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now, uh, people, there's been some confusion about our bird-sighting rules. You cannot count birds that you've seen at the zoo, on stamps, or in dreams.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, I'm back to square one.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me. Can you tell us what kind of birds these are? They hatched from eggs I found in a nest.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Good heavens! I'm very glad you brought those in, Bart.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'll just get those killed and you can be on your way.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait! What the heck are you doing?!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: My civic duty, that's what.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bolivian Tree Lizard?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Mm-hm. It's a vicious ovoraptor. It feasts on bird eggs, and lays its own eggs in the nest. The unsuspecting mother bird cares for them until the babies hatch and devour her, too.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What a chump.

title: Treehouse of Horror IX
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Help! Dad's trying to kill me!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: It's already wiped out the Dodo, the Cuckoo, and the NeNe. And it has nasty plans for the booby, the titmouse, the woodcock, and the titpecker.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How vile.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, the one thing that mystifies me is how a Bolivian lizard made it to Springfield.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: That is a puzzlement.

title: Bart the Mother
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Look, Skinner, we haven't got all day. Kill the horrid beasts, then do away with their lizards.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No! Don't hurt them! I'll just keep them as pets.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: No, they might escape and breed. The law is very clear on this: they must be exterminated as quickly and as gruesomely as possible.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nooo! They're mine.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sure we can work this out. He's just a child. Let me talk to him.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: All right. I'll give you a moment. That will give us time to prepare for the splatter.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I'm sorry, but there's nothing we can do. Your lizards are banned by federal law.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Everyone thinks they're monsters, but I raised them and I love them. I know that's hard to understand.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not as hard as you think.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Run for it.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Really?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Okay, that's exactly one moment. It-- Oh my God, he's getting away!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Stop him!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Outta the way, Midge!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, am I in the way?

title: Bart the Mother
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, yes, you're in the way! Are you daft, woman?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry. I didn't realize I was in the way.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You're still in the way. You don't seem to be moving at all.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, for cryin' out loud. Just knock her ass down!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Way to shove, Edna.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Let us roll.

title: I'm with Cupid
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid cards.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Guys, is it really true? Are you cold-blooded egg-murderers?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't use that look on me. I invented that look.

title: Bart the Mother
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: There he is, off in the distance!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Okay, Bart. This is where it ends. Relinquish the lizards.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I said relinquish!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no! You killed 'em.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Good riddance to bad lizards.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, look at 'em.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Go, Chirpy Boy! Go, Bart Junior!

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, nuts.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. Did you know they had those web flaps for gliding?

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yes, but I was hoping they didn't know that.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, I hope you're happy, Bart. You have no idea what kind of plague you've unleashed upon this town.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Our top story: the population of parasitic tree lizards has exploded -- and local citizens couldn't be happier! It seems the rapacious reptiles have developed a taste for the common pigeon, also known as the feathered rat, or gutter bird.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: For the first time, citizens need not fear harassment by flocks of chattering disease-bags.

title: Bart the Mother
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: For decimating our pigeon population, and making Springfield a less oppressive place to while away our worthless lives, I present you with this scented candle.

name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I love you, son.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I love you, Dad.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Now, don't you fellas worry. This'll all be over soon. And...

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: What the...?!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: We gotta get rid of that window.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Where'd he go?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't imagine Dad running away like this. Leaving his father to die.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Even I wouldn't do that. And I'm America's Bad Boy.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: It's a heartbreaking situation.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Am I dead yet?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: How 'bout now?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Now?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll tell you when you're dead, Grampa.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not worthy to live among civilized people.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Even those guys look too civilized for me.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I could live at sea! The sea forgives all. Not like those mean old mountains. I hate them so much.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmmm... the sea won't stand for this.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, excuse me, I'm fleeing in shame and I'd like to look my best.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Um, can I be a mate on your ship? Preferably First Mate.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I like taffy, but I don't deserve taffy.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, hey!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Krusty here to cheer you up as part of the hospital's "Last Laugh Program."

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Last laugh?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: So, how 'bout that hospital food? Uh?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I wouldn't know. I'm not allowed to eat.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Okayyyy... well, let's have a look at the old chart. Uh-- Ho ho, boy. Looks like we're both short on time so I'll go to the big finish. "You are so beautiful to... meee!"

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Feel better!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Come back, doctor.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A tramp steamer! That's perfect!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'd like to apply for a job. Any job. If you don't have a captain, I could be that.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've been on that one. The taffy shop.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The name on the back says "Honeybunch."

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, actually, you did...

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Say, who are you guys?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: H-Heyy, let me off this thing.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whew.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Forget what?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, back on land, my name was Homer Simpson. And I guess it is here, too. I promised my Dad one of my kidneys, but I chickened out at the last minute and left him on his deathbed.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, yeah, I know...

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's the last time I trust the strangest people on earth.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Even the sea won't forgive me.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I wish I had that kind of relationship with my father... or my kids. Well, I guess it's up to me to take the first step.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, this is it. No more living in shame. I'm going to show my family the kind of man I really am.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, I'm gonna...

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Aren't you going to give him the last rites?

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: That's Catholic, Marge. You might as well ask me to do a voodoo dance.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Doctor Hibbert, I thought you'd located another kidney for Grampa.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Larry Hagman took it. He's got five of them now. And three hearts. We didn't want to give them to him, but he overpowered us.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry about old Grampa. I'm goin' to a better place. Shelbyville Hospital!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, who'm I kiddin'? I'm a goner.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No you're not, Dad.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Son!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, Dad. The way I behaved was shameful. I guess fear made me run away. But love made me come back.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Bless you, son. I knew you'd come through for me.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Now, Homer, this may sting just a tiny bit, b--

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, son of a--!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, that...

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's waking up!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homie. I'm so glad you're all right.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Try not to move, Dad. You swallowed a lot of motor oil.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry I ran off again. Oh, I guess Dad must be dead by now. When I get better, and after I've built those shelves for the kitchen, we'll visit his grave...

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Grave nothin'!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I never felt more alive!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh! Boy, I shouldn'ta done that.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's a miracle! You recovered!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What? What? Hey!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: While we were setting your broken bones and putting your blood back in, we helped ourselves to a kidney and gave it to your father.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You butchers! Give it back! Gimme that! Gim--

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you dance out that door you... I'll get my kidney back, old man! You have to sleep sometime!

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I know you're a little peeved at Grampa, Dad, but you've done a wonderful thing.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes. You've shortened your life significantly, so someone else can have a slight extension of theirs.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I guess you're right. Gimme a hug.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't need two kidneys. I have everything I need right here...

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmmm...

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you're tickling me.

title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yesss, tickling.

spoken_words: Look out! Behind you!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'd rather get a message than see another lousy commercial.

spoken_words: Hey, Lisa.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi.

spoken_words: Ha! Nobody cares!

spoken_words: Hey, wait. I saw that Lost in Space movie. You are not Doctor Smith.

spoken_words: "A", that is not water, it is diet Mr. Pibb, and "B" I--

name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Tell me, how do you feel about forty-five-year-old virgins who still live with their parents?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Don't try to change me, baby.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Welcome futurists, cyberphiles, and the rest of you dateless wonders!

title: Mayored to the Mob

spoken_words: And now to push this convention into hyperspace, the man who put the star in "Star Wars," a real burr under Darth Vader's saddle, Luke Skywalker himself, Mark Hamill!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nooooooooooo!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You stupid nerds! He's trying to save you money on long distance!

name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Kenobi?!

name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Mark! Mark! Mark! Mark! Pick me! My whole life has been leading to this moment!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Aw, like hell it has! If anyone's gonna play Obi, it's me!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: That's not how you vwing!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Oh God, can't this town go one day without a riot?

name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Gadzooks! Where are my bodyguards?

spoken_words: Oh, poor Mark Hamill.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That swarm of nerds is gonna kill him!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Neeerrrds!

spoken_words: Get out of there!

spoken_words: Mr. Hamill, Mr. Mayor, come on!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Never!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Follow me.

spoken_words: I've got Maggie.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's all-- Hey, I thought you twisted your ankle.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: You call yourselves bodyguards? You're fired!

name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: I'll tell you who. Him!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I don't think you were listening to what he just--

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I said, "woo hoo."

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Even during Ramadan?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wha?

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nooo!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Clear!

spoken_words: Oh, for Pete's sake.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The pig is in the poke.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know, I really don't care for that code name.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look out, Marge! Cat!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Nah!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I know you're excited about starting your new job, but could you just relax for now?

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hold it! What's your clearance?

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We just want to get a snack.

spoken_words: Access denied.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But, Da--

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! I don't want you using your new sleeper hold on the children.

spoken_words: It's a real honor to be guarding your body, sir.

title: Mayored to the Mob

spoken_words: Heh. Here's a couple of Düffenbraus, on the house, of course.

spoken_words: Semi-imported. Keep 'em comin'.

spoken_words: Your generosity is greatly appreciated, especially during this health inspection season.

title: Mayored to the Mob

spoken_words: Oh yeah, yeah, right. Health inspection. That reminds me.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Your change, sir.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: We're workin' on that roach situation, I swear to God.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Eh, you should see the hospital.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ... And after Moe's, we went to Krustyburger and the mayor got some more change, and I ordered a double double, but they gave me the double double double double. And then Apu gave the Mayor lots of change for...

spoken_words: Dad, don't you see what's going on?

title: Mayored to the Mob

spoken_words: Oh, honey, don't be so naive. That's how the world works. Sure, the mayor takes a few bribes, but he also makes the trains run on time.

title: Mayored to the Mob

spoken_words: No he doesn't. Trains are regulated by the Federal Department of Transportation. And recent studies have shown that...

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Well, the good children of Springfield need their milk, and I need my...

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Thank you, Fat Tony. However, in the future, I would prefer a nondescript briefcase to the sack with a dollar sign on it.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, how'd you get the nickname "Legs"?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, mini-cannoli!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! I called that! I saw it first! Come back here!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Milking room? I hope you cows are decent.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh! Crap on a crutch!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They're milking rats! Milk-ing rats!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Rats? I'm outraged. You promised me dog or higher.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, no!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, my milk! I traded my math book for that!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad! What a nice surprise.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, get that away from me!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, I don't want you drinking any more milk. Ever.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Can I still drink it?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Go nuts.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: All right!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You... monster! How could you do that to the children?!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Those wacky gangsters. What are you gonna do?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And to think, I respected you! And defended you! You wouldn't even be alive if it wasn't for me!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, we'll call it even.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, I killed the mayor. All right, stay calm. I'll just use the body to stage an elaborate farce, à la "Weekend at Bernie's," and...

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Help! Help!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: His corpse is climbing the building!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: I'm alive, you idiot! Pull me in!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A-- Wait a second. I'm not saving you unless you promise to get that rats' milk out of the schools.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: But the gangsters will kill me.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're forgetting, you've got the best bodyguard in the business. Now promise, or I'll let you fall to your death.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: All right! All right, I promise.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shake on it?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Relax, you're in good hands. Now come on, I'll pull you up.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Not so fast. I can see into the interns' restroom from here.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Did you know that this is how FDR met Eleanor?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: All right. Pull me up.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Freeze, goombahs! We're shuttin' ya down, ya filthy Italians.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Oh right, right. Filthy Italian-Americans.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Not this time, Fat Tony. The mayor's office is not for sale.

title: Mayored to the Mob

spoken_words: Can you, uh, edit out the laughs?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, the Mafia guy's all mad. Oh, what are you gonna do? Call your Godfather? Huh? Ooh, Godfather. Break it down!

title: Mayored to the Mob

spoken_words: It's pure. Pull the plug, boys.

title: Mayored to the Mob

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: ... And so, as the rats' milk is returned to the sewers, the circle of life is complete.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Ah, Fat Tony. Do you have any comment?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Huh. Any words for the mayor?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aren't you scared, Dad? I mean, if I were Fat Tony, and God willing someday I will be, I'd just be stewing in my jail cell, gettin' madder and madder.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, don't worry about that, boy. He's already out on bail. Well, I'm off to work.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're guarding the mayor tonight? After Fat Tony swore revenge?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's my duty, Marge. Besides, those mobsters don't scare me. Bart, would you go start Daddy's car?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What? There's nothing to worry about.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, fine. I'll take a cab.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Homer, I'm, uh, not sure it's wise to go out right now. I was thinking of a quiet evening at home with the, uh... wife.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I get it. You're worried about those mobsters, aren't ya?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: No, no, I truly do want to stay home with the... wife.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You've gotta snap out of this funk, Mayor. I'm gonna take you someplace where you can relax and forget all about gangsters.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, excuse me...

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Do you have a table for the mayor?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why do you talk that way?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Dear Lord, please make tonight's production better than "Othello" with Peter Marshall.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Mr. Burns, Fat Tony, what's-his-name... Fat Tony?!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, Fat Tony. If it's trouble with Quimby you're after--

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mayor, Fat Tony asked me to give you this--

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: You moron! That's the Kiss of Death!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no. Wait... maybe I didn't do it right.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Never mind that, just go patrol the perimeter.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Ah, au gratin potatoes, that's a quality side.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nooooooooo!!!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Potatoes are clean. The poison must be in the steak.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yesss! Nobody messes with the mayor when Homer Simpson's on -- Aw, crap.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That guy with the knife sure can dance, huh?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: He looks awfully familiar.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think I saw him in "Rent," or "Stomp," or "Clomp," or some piece of crap.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look out!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gimme that knife!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The force?!

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Fat Tony.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ohh, I'd say you were luminous, magnetic, incandescent.

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? Would you say I was magnetic?

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aww...

title: Mayored to the Mob
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get out of the way you--

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman live at the Monty Burns Casino. Moments from now, the house that social security checks built will be demolished to make way for a casino-themed family hotel.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: This must be heartbreaking for you, sir.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'm just thinking of my employees -- all the card sharps, bottom dealers, and shills. Where will they go?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: They're managing your chain of nursing homes, sir.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Gone are such headliners as "Little Timmy and the Shebangs," "The Shebangs," and "The New Shebangs featuring Big Timmy."

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Remember how excited we were when this place opened? Then a week later, we just forgot about it.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm surprised they bothered to move it when they moved the town.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I can explain that. You see...

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All right! Here comes the implosion!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don Rickles zinged you, Marge.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dust!!!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eat my dust, dust!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, we hit Don Rickles!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We'd better stop and get the car washed.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aaah, what's the rush? Might rain next week.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, Homer. Car's kinda dirty.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? You think I should get it washed?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Yeah, maybe.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You listen to your friends, but you never listen to me.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, that's great.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: I insist you take special care with my collection of valuable and humorous bumper stickers, particularly this one... which was given to me by a Harrison Ford look-alike.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, you can't find this stuff anywhere! Seals and Crofts, Pablo Cruise, Air Supply, Ohhhh, Loggins and Oates! And it's free!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've never heard of these bands, Mom. What kind of music do they play?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Crap rock?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No...

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wuss rock?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's it.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ten dollars?! What is this, a car wash for millionaires?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Throw hot wax on him, Dad!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Howdy, Homer.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! How did Churchy La Femme get half price?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Senior citizen? Flanders?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we'll see about that.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mesquite it is!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: ... And once again, tithing is ten per cent off the top. That's gross income, not net. Please people, don't force us to audit.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Now we're going to pass this around a second time. Brother Ned, if you'll do the honors.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wouldn't do that, Reverend. You see, "Saint Flanders" is as crooked as you or me!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, it's my sad duty to rat out this man for defrauding a car wash. How, you ask? With a phony senior discount card!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, that's not quite true--

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Did you or did you not use a senior citizen discount card at said car wash?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, I did, but--

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now I'm not a fancy big-city lawyer...

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But it seems to me that a senior citizen has to be over 55. Isn't that so?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, yes.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And you are how old?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I suppose, if you must know... I'm... well, I'm... I'm sixty.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: What's your secret, Flanders? Goat placenta? Monkey sweat?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Some kind of electric hat?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Holy water? It's holy water, right?!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aaah, it burns!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: L-Listen, folks, there's no magic formula. I just follow the three C's: clean living, chewing thoroughly, and a daily dose of Vitamin Church.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: And, of course, I resist all the major urges.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You mean, you've never splurged and, say, eaten an entire birthday cake, then blamed it on the dog?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: You've never licked maple syrup off your lover's stomach?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You mean that one with the red paint?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You've never snuck out of church to break into cars?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: No, no, and double-no! I haven't done any of those things, folks. You name it, I haven't done it!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Geez, Flanders. You're 60 years old, and you haven't lived a day in your life.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, even the boy in the bubble had a deck of cards.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, can you believe it? It almost seemed like those folks were, were, were making fun of old steady Neddy.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Mmm-hmm. And some people steer clear of that whole hornet's nest. I'll stick with just plain white bread, thank you very much. Maybe with a--

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Gosh darn it! Am I that pre-diddley-dictable? I've wasted my whole dang diddley life.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey there!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Look at that! Everyone's living it up except Ned.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Help! We're being carjacked!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: In the bathroom. Not trimmin' my mustache. Whaddaya think? Do I remind you of troubled troubadour David Crosby?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Would a silly billy sit like this?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, Bart!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fire in the hole!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, no more gasoline.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Full power!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Never a dull moment, huh, Homer?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You got that right. Throw on the mesquite, Bart!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Here, this may sound just a teensy bit insane in the ol' membrane, Homer. But I, I was wondering if you could show me how to have some fun.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, well, well. So flawless Flanders needs help from stinky-pants Simpson.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Yeah, I, I guess I do.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Welly, welly, welly... Mr. Clean wants to hang with Dirty Dingus Magee.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: How 'bout it, Homer? Will you teach me the secret of your intoxicating lust for life?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wellity, wellity, wellity...

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Stop that! Will you help me or not?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's do it.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: So what about all this meat?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, the Missus will clean that up.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now it's Marge's time to shine!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: First of all, I get five dollars a day plus expenses.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Seems fair.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I'll need your signature... here, here, aaannnnd... initial here.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Heh, you're not really giving my father power of attorney, are you?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Of course I... Oh, my stars! I can't do that.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well that's unfortunate. It really is.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: All right.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Congratulations! Welcome to the Homer Simpson Program.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: So, what happens next?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: One day soon I will come for you, and then the game will begin. Could be in the middle of the night. It could be when you least expect it. Or whatever's good for you. I don't care.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Okay, Homer. I'm ready to learn. What's the first lesson? Just give me the topic sentence.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gimme that!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's your problem. You're living up here.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You gotta live down here.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In the impulse zone. If you want to be like me, you gotta make snap decisions. Like this.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We're going to break the bank at the Monty Burns Casino!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You mean Lisa?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer, they blew that up yesterday.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah, right.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then we're goin' to Las Vegas! Which is actually back in that direction.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Nobody's goin' to take my Ned / I'll teach him to have fu-un / Ooh, he's a Flanders machine..."

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ooh, it's goin' on eight-thirty. I'd better call Maude and tell her where I am.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Relax, I called her from the gas station.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Thanks, buddy.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sucker.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, gee, Homer, this all looks so garish.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, the lights, the noise, the letter X -- i-it's all designed to inflame the senses. I'm overstimulated! I gotta get out of this town!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think so.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think you'll find escape is quite impossible.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: No, I got it.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! Lance Murdock!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: If he's not careful, his scooter could roll right down that ramp.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He's a daredevil, Ned. He laughs at death.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, when I wanna laugh, I'll take Bob Saget, thank you very much.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Announcer
spoken_words: And now, the indestructible Lance Murdock will jump his SuiCycle over an audience member. And he'll do it while attempting to open a locked safe on his head. Any volunteers?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, ooh, ooh, pick him! Pick him!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: No, Homer, no! I wanna do something exciting, but I can't just go from zero to thirty like that! I-I could be killed.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fine, I'll do it. Where do you want me?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, yeah, I'll figure it out. This isn't rocket science.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bo-ring.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Okay, he's cleared the ring of fire! Past the ring of ice! Over the dog doo stick! He's cracked the safe!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Flanders, Don't spill my beer!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Announcer
spoken_words: He's all right, folks!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okey-doke, let's hit the tables.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: God Homer, watching you risk your life turned my beat box all the way up to .. Rumba! Yea, I was praying you'd be safe but to be honest, part of me wanted to see ya get splattered.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I think someone just had his first taste of blood loss.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see... what's Marge's birthday? Barney is July fifteenth, same as Lassie's, so Marge's must be... fifty... oh, forget it. Flanders, what's your birthday?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Aw, leave me out of this, Homer. Games of chance are strictly forbidden by Deuteronomy seven--

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Seven, eh?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Way to go, Flanders. The Bible's finally pulling its weight. Got any more holy numbers?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, I got a bunch, Homer, but I just don't feel right ab... Oh, Lord, what should I do?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: J-- What?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, righty-o. One betting disk please.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "One betting disk please." Watch and learn.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, there you go. Now how 'bout a drink?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: How do you do it, Homer? How do you silence that little voice that says, "Think"?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh no. I-I mean common sense.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that. That can be treated with our good friend alcohol. You might want to write that down. Where the hell's your notebook?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You threw it out the...

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, never mind. Just pay attention.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Slave girl? Oh, slave girl?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whuh?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah. Two more of these, please.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And for you, Ned?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I'll have a Shirley... no, a virgin... no, make it a children's... Oh, what the heck, you only live once. Give me a...

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: White wine spritzer!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh my goodness, Homer. Wake up!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Look at this place! We must have really painted the town last night. I have a pounding headache, my mouth tastes like vomit, and I don't remember a thing!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Welcome to my world.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, I did it! I conquered my fears and I made up for a lot of lost livin'. And I owe it all to the Homer Simpson program.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The what now?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, of course a-- Who are you?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, smooth move, Flanders!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Here comes that vomit again.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eeech.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay... okay... okay... okay... okay... okay... okay. Okay, you're saying that Ned and me married you two?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Mm-hm, I'm workin' on that.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ned, no! Think of your wives!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute. This could be some kind of scam -- or possibly, scam-ola. We would remember if we got married.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ahh, precious memories.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I okeley dokely shmokely do!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What did you call me?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure. Sock it to me, baby.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We are so dead.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ladies, we want to do the honorable thing. So breakfast is on us, with full waffle-bar privileges. But first, I'm afraid we have some bad news. The waffle bar is closed. I'm sorry. I'm so very--

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer! The bad news, ladies, is we already have wives.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Ginger, honey, I am not the catch I appear to be.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ginger's my wife.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure? Oh, rats. No offense, Sweetie.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer, why don't we go make the girls some custom omelettes?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Geez, I've never seen anyone so whipped so fast.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: What are we gonna do, Homer? My kids are gonna be traumatized! And then there's Maude. And then there's Maude!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know, Flanders, having two wives could have its advantages.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Chop, chop, dig, dig. Chop, chop, dig, dig. Chop, chop, dig, dig...

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Homie, there's so much more two wives could do for you.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I hear digging, but I don't hear chopping.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, a friendly bee.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow, that sting hurt so much. We gotta get outta this, Ned.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, do something! This is all your fault. You and your stupid program.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Blame me if you must, but don't ever speak ill of the program. The program is rock solid. The program is sound.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, those awful women want their omelettes.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ginger throws Ned a kiss.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: How are we going to get outta this mess in an honorable and decent--

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ooh, nuts.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh no!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A lion!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Drederick Tatum!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The Moody Blues!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What if we switched wives? Would that help?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: For the last time, no!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hel-lo. Our ticket to freedom.

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So long, su--

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Amber, I can change!

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Will you shut up?

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, let's get our stories straight for Marge and Maude. We were out buying them fabulous gifts...

title: Viva Ned Flanders
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: What's the occasion?
