spoken_words: You mean this hunka junk? This isn't art. Just a barbecue that pushed me over the edge. Didn't you? Didn't you?! You stupid so...

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I got that, lady.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is everything okay? I got worried when I didn't hear any shots.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This lady says I'm an artist.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You, an artist?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In high school I was voted "Most Likely to be a Mental Patient, Hillbilly, or Chimpanzee!"

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So you'd better catch the fever. Catch it...

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, chew with your mouth closed. You're losing your mystique.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, all great artists love free food. Check out Jasper Johns.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm, I don't know. I studied art for years, but I just don't get this.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sounds like somebody's jealous.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No I'm not. I just can't believe some people are paying hundreds of dollars for something a hillbilly pulled out of the trash.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, I think I'm in love!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: With this sculpture!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, that's by Homer Simpson. I don't think you want to buy it.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, years ago, I blew the chance to buy Picasso's "Guernica" for a song. Luckily, that song was "White Christmas," and by hanging onto it, I made billions.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Anyway, I love this hideous thing. Young lady, I'll take it!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Look, Marge, my first sale! In your face, Jasper Johns!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where are you going with that junk, Dad?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm gonna be an outsider artist! That way, I can turn all these old baseball cards, Disney memorabilia, and antiques into something valuable.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, I'm really happy you sold your sculpture -- but don't you think it may have been a fluke?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I've always had an interest in art, dating back to my schoolgirl days when I painted portrait after portrait of Ringo Starr.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's my life you're describing.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think I remember my own life, Marge.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Astrid said the key to my art is anger. But you know me, I'm Mister Mellow.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So I'm giving you kids permission to get me mad. C'mon, gimme what you got.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if it'll help - Um, Mom found out her engagement ring is made of rock candy.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good work, honey. Keep it comin'.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm flunkin' math, and the other day I was a little attracted to Milhouse.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, this is Astrid, my "dealer." And these are my fans, Gunter, Kyoto, and Cecil Hampstead-on-Cecil-Cecil.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So, uh, you guys are Eurotrash, huh? How's that, uh, workin' out for ya?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh-huh. So, ah, where might this sea be located?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do we owe you, Moe?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Nothin', nothin'. Just gimme a priceless sketch with a certificate of authenticity.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, nice try there, Twelve-Step.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Uh, Homer, you're, uh, makin' us a little bit uncomfortable.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Relax, big guy. He's just doin' this for his art, right Homer?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here he is. This is where the... "magic" happens.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is it about pies?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. It's like Marge's dream come true... for me! Isn't that great, Marge?! For me!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look Marge, they're advertising my show in "Art in America." It's the first time I've been mentioned there, that I know of.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm happy for you. Now g'night.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good night.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're upset about something. Is this about that trip Barney and I took to Machu Picchu?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, Homer, being an artist was my dream. But now, without even trying, you've accomplished more in a week than I have in my whole life.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, honey, I've always liked your art. Your paintings look like the things they look like.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's sweet, but, well, how would you like it if I, I don't know, entered a belching contest?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Frankly, I'd be a little turned on.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You don't understand.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I've screwed up everything I've ever done. I mean, look at Bart. But I finally found something where people worship me for screwing up. And that feels pretty good.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess nothing else matters as long as you're happy.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now you're making sense. Good night.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I give you "Botched Hibachi." The tricycle is on loan from the Maggie Simpson collection.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This piece I call "Failed Shelving Unit with Stupid Stuck Chainsaw and Applesauce."

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And finally, my thing de resistance, "Attempted Birdhouse I."

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shall we start the bidding at, say, ten thousand dollars?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, how about a million?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'll give you two bucks for the bird, if it's still alive.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's going on here? You weirdos love this stuff.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait! Come back! I'm a God to you! Worship me -- or fear my wrath! Please fear my wrath, please... Call me.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't get it. Why don't people like my art anymore?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I know you worked hard, but all of your... things were kind of the same.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Ray J. Johnson never changed his act and he's more popular now than he's ever been.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Who?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You can call him Ray / Or you can call him J. / Or you can call him Ray J. / But you doesn't have to call him...

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sick of him already.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The point is, great artists are always trying new things, like Michelangelo or Shaquille O'Neal. You just need some inspiration.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's so exciting to do something cultural together.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Matt Groening? What's he doing in a museum? He can barely draw.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! Oh no, I'm being erased!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A Claes Oldenburg. He's a European who defied convention and embraced American popular culture.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He must be a hundred feet tall.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now this is a Joseph Turner. In an era when everyone else painted portraits, he broke away by painting the Venetian Canals.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's glorious! The streets are paved with water. You could ride a walrus to work!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hit the road, "Welcome Home."

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And Picasso started out painting realistically, then moved on to cubism. By the end of his life, he was just painting crank letters to the editor. They call it his "angry jerk" period.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmmm, split-pea.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: With ham!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Any ideas yet?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, these guys are geniuses. I could never think of something like soup or a pencil.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm just gonna rest for a minute.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the?! Who the?! Hey!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! Ah! No! Ow! Ow! Hey! Ow! Ow! You're mean.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eww...

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! Hey! No! No! Ow! N-No! Ow!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, Andy, no!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer... Homer...

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! Why does Art hate me? I never did anything to Art.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, let's get out of here.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Dad, if the museum didn't inspire you, maybe you should do something really radical, like Christo.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is he that jerk that revealed the magicians' secrets?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, Christo is a conceptual artist who does huge outdoor projects. He once wrapped the Reichstag in plastic.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not the Reichstag!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yes, and he also set up hundreds of yellow umbrellas along the California highway...

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why'd he do that?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: To make the world a more magical place, I guess. Although they did blow over and kill some people.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Killer umbrellas? Of course. Exquisite.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, Dad, no. My point is you have to do something big and daring.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Big? Daring? Lisa, that's it! I've got an idea for a wonderful art project that'll make everyone love me again. Step one: steal all the doormats in town.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Adios, "Casa de Flanders."

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: See you in hell, "God Bless This House."

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So long, The Simpsons!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Step two: snorkel the animals.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It wasn't easy, but I got all the grizzlies.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Great. I'll do the pony while you do the lions.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Make sure you strap 'em on real tight.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, step three...

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure this is art, not vandalism?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's for the courts to decide, son.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wake up! Wake up, Springfield!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've got a surprise for youuu!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Lord. What now?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that can't be good.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: People of Springfield, behold my latest work!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, what have you done?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's conceptual art -- the Grand Canals of Springfield. Just like Venice without the black plague. What do you think?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I think some people are going to be upset.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, they're in the business. Real people might not be so understanding.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: What the flood?!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Maude, it's a miracle! The Lord has drowned the wicked and spared the righteous!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Looks like Heaven's easier to get into than Arizona State.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Ohhh, I hate these flood pants.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey, they're working! My feet are soaked, but my cuffs are bone dry! Everything's comin' up Milhouse!

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Edna, I'm gonna pop you a question and... I hope the answer is yes.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Do you think Mother would like this hat pin?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh. Yes.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, you've made me the happiest man on earth.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Homer, I have to admit, you created something people really love. You truly are an artist.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, I'm just a nut who couldn't build a barbecue. You'll always be the artist in the family.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohh...

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is that our house?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yep.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And is that us on the roof?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's us.

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are we kissing?

title: Mom and Pop Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, I don't know. Could be. I need some inspiration.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hit the road, Lefty. You too, Rizzo.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you! Thank you!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Springfield was shocked today to learn it will host the next Olympics. Economists predict our city will experience the same boom that Sarajevo enjoyed after the 1984 games.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And it's all because of your letter, Lisa.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, actually, I just wrote it for a school assignment. Everyone else wrote to the Back Street Boys.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: To honor the arrival of our foreign friends and enemies, Channel Six is sponsoring a contest to find a Springfield Olympic Mascot. The winner will join such other memorable mascots as the Atlanta "Whazzit"... and the Montreal "Vampire."

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A mascot contest?! I'm sure to win that. Unless one of you jinxes me.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No one's gonna jinx you, Homer. In fact, we're rooting for you.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, go for the gold, Dad!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shut up, shut up, shut up!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you said I couldn't do it, but here it is! Meet Abby the Olympic Tabby.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How'd you get the eyes to move?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You papier mache'd my cat?!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just for the prototype, honey.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Knowing you always hate my first idea, I prepared a backup. How about a big Olympic hello for Springy, the Springfield Spring!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Those aren't the dog's eyes, are they?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, that's cute.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Good work, Dad.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's fun for the whole family. And the ends are razor sharp to protect our nation and its interests.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ow!!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: God bless America!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Aw, Cinnamon. Don't make this harder than it already is.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, love that sun, man!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: And we will do anything, including but not limited to anything, to make your stay here tolerable.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Yes, you'll be completely above the law. Uh, women, guns, cash, uh, whatever you need -- it's yours.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: And that's not all. We've just chosen our official Olympic mascot.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They picked Springy! In your face, Patty and Selma!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: And now, because the children are our future, here are the children of Springfield Elementary with a song they call "The Children are our Future." Children?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Are you ready for the...

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The future is a...

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've never wanted a beer worse in my life.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I love you, honey.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Are you talking to me or the beer?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: To you, my bubbly, long-necked, beechwood-aged lover.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Wait! Wait! We have one more act! The patriotic comedy stylings of Bart Simpson!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So, uh, you're from Russia, huh?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You drunk yet?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Poland, eh? Ha. Too easy. How you doin', Germany? Here's my impression of an East German woman, "Kiss me or I'll crush you."

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He says what we're all thinking.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not thinking that!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Swiss Miss. There's no missin' you, babe. Heh, heh. Lay off the cocoa.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now I'd like to say one last thing to our Olympic representatives: if there was a medal for horrible audiences, you'd get the gold. Peace out.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skin-ner!! How could you put this boy on with that horrible material?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, it really did seem funny in rehearsal.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: And he didn't even get to his Ubangi routine.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Ha, ha, ha. Laugh it up, ya punks. 'Cause you and Jan Murray here just cost our town the Olympics!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Chalmers, where are you from?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: I-- Oh. Well, I was born in Queens, went to Ball State, then made the move to Intercourse, Pennsylvania. Eh, why do you ask?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Uh, don't worry, sir, I'll teach these children some respect for their town. I'm assigning each of you twenty hours of community service.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: What if we refuse?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You won't pass to the next grade.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I fail to see the threat.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skin-ner! Good idea. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm off to my vacation at Lake Titticaca. Let's see you make a joke out of that, Mr. Smart Guy!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: All right, Martin. For your community service, you'll be setting up a midnight basketball program for inner-city street gangs.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Milhouse, do you like the beach?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Who doesn't?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Good, I want you to pick up all this medical waste that's washed up on the shore here.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Ow! I pricked myself.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, just keep working. You'll prick yourself with the antidote sooner or later.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What are you gonna do to me?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart, not all community service is gang warfare and dangerous infection. And to illustrate that point, here's where you'll be working.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The Fireworks, Candy and Puppy Dog Store?!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: No, no, no. Next to it.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Settle a bet. Boil or mole?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ewwww.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. Just breathe through your mouth and don't ask how they're feeling.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, man...

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yahhh!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Phew, saved by the bell.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no, Lis! They got you, too?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Got me?" What are you talking about? I've been volunteering here for a year.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I got a bingo! What do I win?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A banana!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: A whole one?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yep!

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sweeet.

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's the prize?! A banana?

title: The Old Man and the "C" Student
name: Lisa Simpson

name: Announcer
spoken_words: Tonight's episode: "Enter the Collector."

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Behold! I am the Collector... and I'm here to add you to my collection!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Care for a Rollo, sweet Xena?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Oh, please. I'm not insane. I simply wish to take you back to my lair and make you my bride.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Clobber Girl?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's Xena! She's been kidnapped! Come on!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Remember, you're vulnerable to Kryptonite!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Geez, Marge, tell the neighborhood.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Fear not, my syndicated sweetie. You'll be preserved in this Mylar pouch. Forever remaining in near-mint condition between Dr. Who and, of course, Yasmine Bleeth.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: I don't think so!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: I don't think so, either.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Your collecting days are over, Collector...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Stop right there! I have here the only working phaser ever built. It was fired only once -- to keep William Shatner from making another album.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Stretch Dude! Help!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Just a sec.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Whoa! Hey, phaser, phaser, phaser -- zing!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Goodnight, Retch Dude and Slobber Girl. Sweet screams.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: I'm unbelievably rude.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Soon, those bratty buttinskis will be encased in Lucite for all eternity. While we're waiting, here are some names you may call me on our wedding night: Obi-Wan, Iron Man, Mr. Mxyzptlk, and, of course, Big Papa Smurf.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: You would think so, but no.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: You tricked me with a ruse so hackneyed it would make Stan Lee blush.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Ooh! Ow! Oh, that hurts!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Bart, just let me drop and save yourself!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: What d'you think I've been tryin' to do?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Aha! Not even Xena is a match for the limited-edition, double-edged light saber from "Star Wars -- Episode 1... The Phantom Menace".

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Nooo! It's no longer a collectible!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Lucite hardening...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Must end life in classic Lorne Greene pose from "Battlestar Galactica"...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Best... death... ever.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Wow, thanks for saving us.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Wait a minute, Xena can't fly.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Oh.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Man alive, what a stinko thousand years! Blimp wrecks, teen-agers... then again, we had two TV shows with Andy Griffith.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And eleven with Robert Urich.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, Homer. Weren't you the plant's Y2K Compliance Officer?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Absolutely.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: It musta been hard debugging all those computers, huh Homer?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Doin' what now?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You did fix them, right Dad? Because even a single faulty unit could corrupt every other computer in the world.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That can't be true, honey. If it were, I'd be terrified.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Ha...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Who's going to clean up all those jets?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There goes the clothesline.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, those ivory tower eggheads have screwed us again. Let's just have some milk and go to bed...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, this milk's broken.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's got a computer chip in it. Everything does.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stop! Ow!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: ... Judgment Day is upon us. I warned you the Lord wouldn't stand for your mini-dresses, and Beatle boots...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I resisted these for thirty-five years! Why did I wear them today?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: But it's not too late to repent your sins and be embraced by the Almighty --

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hey, everybody!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: They're looting the mall. Hurry! I got nine shoe buffers!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm caught on something!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't want you looting!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I was gonna loot you a present!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, all right.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, thank you, Homie. A Lady Remington.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, look at the wonders of the computer age now.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wonders, Lisa? Or blunders?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I think that was implied by what I said.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Implied, Lisa? Or implode?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, make him stop.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no! Krusty!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: My pacemaker... it's stuck on hummingbird!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Nectar! Nectar! I need to drink my weight in nectar!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Krus-tyyyyyy! Hey, a note.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You have been selected for Operation Exodus...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They're evacuating the Earth! We're saved!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, sweet clown.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In death you saved us all.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I'm not dead!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can still hear his voice on the wind.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There it is!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just like the dead clown promised.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, there's Bill Gates, Stephen Hawking, Paul McCartney, Michael Jordan, Michelle Kwan...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They must be starting a new civilization on Mars with our best and brightest.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's us!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Certainly. I am... the, ah, piano genius from the movie "Shine."

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... Shiny McShine?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're pouring hot butter on my leg!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Actually, he's Homer Simpson. That's Bart. I'm Lisa...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Love ya lots!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good-bye Lisa, remember me as I am... filled with murderous rage.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, son. I guess this is the end. But we've both had long, full lives. Oh, right.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, look, another spaceship!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And there's nobody guarding it. Let's go!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe I destroyed the Earth.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you still talking about the Earth?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're right. I gotta let it go. All that counts is we're alive and rubbing elbows with the greats.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, there's Ross Perot, Dr. Laura, Spike Lee...

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute. They're not so great.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, but there's... Dan Quayle and Courtney Love... Tanya Harding... Al Sharpton...?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Tom Arnold?! What the hell's going on?!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait. Only that ship is going to Mars. Our's is headed for the sun.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So we're all gonna die?

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The sun? That's the hottest place on Earth!

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no, Rosie O'Donnell.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, you don't want to get Zorro mad.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, Dad. We'll be dead in five minutes.

title: Treehouse of Horror X
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not fast enough!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my, war is terrible.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Buzz Cola, the taste you'll kill for.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Do they really think cheapening the memory of our veterans will sell soda?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I have to go to ze lobby!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're not supposed to go to the bathroom without washing your hands, either.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: To the top please.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Swim, my pretties.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's a history lesson come to life.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No it isn't. It's totally inaccurate--

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Quiet, here come the Ninjas.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She's lying! Slice her head off!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sh-sh-shh!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo! You go, Zorro!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why that little... He insulted your honor!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sir, I demand satisfaction.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I challenge you to a duel.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Will you duel, or are you a coward?!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My hero!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, uh. "H" is for Homer.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Homer.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Mother, please! You're embarrassing me.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, thanks. It's just past the end of the bar, next to the heavyset guy.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heavyset? What's that supposed to mean?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, take it easy. Take it easy. I'm just saying you ain't no, uh, Tommy Tune.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No Tommy Tune, eh? Oh, that's it. You insulted my honor.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I-- Your what now?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I demand satisfaction! I challenge you to a duel.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, a duel? I, ah-- Isn't that a little extreme? Here, here, have a free beer.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? But you've never given anyone a free beer.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I ain't never been slapped with no duelin' glove before, either.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, a free beer! And I owe it all to a little glove slap. GLOVE SLAP...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: BABY, GLOVE SLAP...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Coming through... challenge... duel... Hi Lenny... how dare you... demand satisfaction...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You'll need a will and headstone, aisle six.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aisle six?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Duelling at dawn? How did it ever come to this?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The National Weather Service says dawn is still scheduled for six-twenty tomorrow, and to please stop calling.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homer, I bet that southern colonel doesn't even show up.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, he's probably just a big blowhard like you.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sir, that is an insult! I challenge you... What?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, honey, I had the worst nightmare. This glove kept slapping people and I was getting blamed.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He's out there, isn't he?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm afraid so. And his wife's with him.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I'm not dead yet.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Save me, Marge. I saved you!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why don't you have the colonel's wife save you?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Marge, that's in the past. Just let it go.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, my husband will be right with you. We're just taking this old Christmas tree to the dump.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, no, no, you'll get sap on your duelling blouse.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's worth a try don't you--

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We're fine, Colonel. Good day.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Looks like you were saved by a Christmas tree.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And somebody wanted to get rid of it in April.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders, you gotta help me. Is there a southern couple parked in front of my house?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oooh, yes indeedy, Homer. Looks like they're settling in for a long stay.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I was afraid of that. Well, goodbye, my gentle neighbor. You know, I've always wanted to tell you how mu...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, screw it.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We can't go back home?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where are we gonna live?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh! How 'bout that house?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That has people living in it. You can see them through the windows.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lousy show-offs.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look! It's Jimmy Carter!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Could you build us a house, President Carter? We can't go back to ours.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Carter, build us a house, you lazy bum.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, move it!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where are we going, Dad?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How should I know?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Then why are you driving so fast?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Cause I'm trying to think! What would Zorro do?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Zo-rrooo!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Rural route 9?" That's it! We can hide out at the farm where I grew up!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You mean Grampa's old farm?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, it'll be fun. Fresh country air, apples for the pickin'... sing-along hayrides...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What a dump!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Race ya to the swimmin' hole!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Com'on, Maw. Bring the young 'uns! There's no leeches! Lots of snakes, though.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Holy moly, we can't stay here. It's full of raccoons.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just think of 'em as cats with rabies.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, kitty.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You little scamp.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Are we really gonna live here and grow crops?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Absolutely. This is our big chance. The Simpsons will be reborn as a bunch of gap-toothed bumpkins.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll dig an outhouse.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll weed the floor.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll repress the rage I'm feeling.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's my girl. Let the agriculture begin!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, let's see what the old girl can do.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It doesn't sound very tractor-y.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hang on.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And... there.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now we're talkin'!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Go get Lassie.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lassie?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you poor little sheep! No one's sheared you for years!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All right. Almost done, my little friend. Soon you'll be a nice, cool... RAT?!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This car was made in Guatemala.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I bought these shoes from a hobo.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, I believe in good grooming.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, what do you know?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's just superstition.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You watch me. I'll grow something out there.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, Dad, this is the juiciest watermelon I ever tasted.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I hope I can grow some like that.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What are you planting?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, a little bit of everything.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Something will thrive in this harsh, merciless soil.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And for those who face nature unafraid, it is they who reap the... ah... I'm down.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Paw!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Move the handbrake...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh, that's heaven.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's been a month. Why won't anything grow?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe it needs more fertilizer.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm only one man, Marge.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's probably just a bad growing season.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, who am I kidding? I'm no farmer.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Leave me alone, you big bully.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: More tumbleweed, Lisa?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No thanks. I'm still finishing my thistles.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, if we leave for town right now, we can catch the dinner special at Krusty-Burger.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, boy. Going back to Springfield would be a coward's way out.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wasn't skipping town in the first place a coward's way out?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you're right. I'm a coward. I've made such a mess of things. If only there was some magic potion that would make those crops grow...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Plutonium?! Gee, Homer, isn't that kinda risky?... Yeah, I guess you're right. It's not.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey Lenny, you sendin' some outgoing mail?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You know it.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: I'll probably send some tomorrow.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I hear that.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Easy... careful... steady...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Time to give Mother Nature a little goose.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Marge, have you ever seen a field glow like that?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's eerily beautiful, but are you sure this is safe?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Of course not. But you know something? Sometimes you have to break the rules to free your heart.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You got that from a movie poster!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, when there's nothing left to believe in, believe in hope.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Where'd you get that?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: From the producers of "Waiting to Exhale."

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is that plutonium on your gums?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shut up and kiss me.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's time to harvest our radioactive supercrop!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But it's only been one night.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's all it takes. If we learned one thing from "The Amazing Colossal Man," and "Grasshopperus," it's that radiation makes stuff grow real big, real fast.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but didn't Grasshopperus kill Chad Everett?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Only 'cause he tried to reason with him.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Brace yourselves, everybody. You're about to see the hugest, juiciest, possibly super-intelligent vegetables man has ever known. You might want to crane your necks upward now to save time.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ta-da!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, now don't panic. It's possible the giant vegetables are invisible.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah-ha!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh... Where are you?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, honey, give it up.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you're right. This farm's hopeless. Why didn't I listen to those inbred hicks? I guess I'll just go hang myself in the barn.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, no!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Let 'im go, Mom.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, Dad, you don't have to kill yourself.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This better be good.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Something's growing.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A sprout!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And there's some more!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What is it? Carrots? Peas? Maybe it's okra.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who cares what it is? It's growing! I've saved the farm!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at my babies. This tomato will be Heinz ketchup. And this to-mah-to will be Hunt's catsup.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bup, no fighting, boys.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Bleh! Tastes like cigarette butts.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's odd. The outside looks like a tomato, but the inside is brown.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe the tomato seeds crossbred with the tobacco seeds.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, great. I got a field full of mutants.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gimme! I want more!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I thought you said it tasted terrible.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It does. But it's smooth and mild. And refreshingly addictive.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Addictive, eh?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "ToMacco?" That's pretty clever, Dad. I mean, for a product that's evil and deadly.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, thanks honey.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm not crazy about the plutonium or nicotine, but it is very nice to see Bart eating his vegetables.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Excuse me, Mr. Farmer man. I promised my son he could tip over his first cow, and I... "ToMacco?"

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, it's the latest craze. Try some, won't you?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Go ahead, Ralphie. The stranger is offering you a treat.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Holy Moses, it does taste like Grandma.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Yeah, me too. We'll take a bushel or a peck or just, just give it to me.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Can I interest you in a mincemeat pie? There very...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Does it have tomacco in it?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, but I use only the fre...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Pass.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't push. There's plenty of tomacco for everyone.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Have your cash or food stamps ready!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't forget your mincemeat pie!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're scaring the customers, honey.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Those dirty rotten...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wish I could make a difference, Lisa, but I'm just one man.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How much?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: One hundred and... May I speak to my family for a moment?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Did you see the way Emile's lookin' at Mindy? Hoo-hoo, I think something's going on there.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Shouldn't we be talking about the hundred and fifty million dollar offer?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah. Let's take it.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, it's a tobacco company. They make billions off the suffering and deaths of others.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She's right, Dad. They can afford a lot more.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, I...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm with Lisa. Let's take 'em to the cleaners.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We all agree that a hundred and fifty million is an insult. The least we can accept is a hundred and fifty billion.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: Road in Front of Simpson Farm
spoken_words: They'll be back. We control the world's supply of tomacco and no one can take that away from...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: Road in Front of Simpson Farm
spoken_words: Stop eating our future!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: Road in Front of Simpson Farm
spoken_words: Get the... get outta... bad animals! Go home!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: Road in Front of Simpson Farm
spoken_words: Thank God, there's one left!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: Road in Front of Simpson Farm
spoken_words: Look, a flying saucer!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There, there. We had quite a scare today. But you're gonna make us millions. Yes you are.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're about to launch a terrible evil on the world. You've gotta destroy this plant.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know, honey. But what can I do, as an individual? I wouldn't know where to begin.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Just burn that plant right now and end this madness.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I agree, but how?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They're after the tomacco!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Now you can't tell me nicotine's not addictive.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, there's absolutely no evidence this is...

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Give them the plant, Homer!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, I'd rather die!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Take it!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, Mindy? How did you want to pay me the hundred and fifty million?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Cash'll be okay! Or stock? Does your company have stock?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mindy?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mindy and I are just hammering out a payment plan. We'll talk Monday!

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I've never been so glad to be home.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know why we ever left in the first place.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It certainly is. Why don't you put down your gun and have a slice?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, are we duellin' or what?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You okay, Dad?

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think so. The bone stopped the bullet.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, this might be one of those things you should go to the hospital for.

title: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: After pie.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Snooze... need more snooze.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Num num, Maggie. Num num.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Did somebody say num num?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't get Maggie to eat. Maybe if you try...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'm twenty-six hours late for work. No time for Maggie.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, where's Waldo?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nope. Nope. This would be a lot easier without all these people. Nope. Nope. It's there-- Uh, nope.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Waldo, where are you?!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh sure. Single me out.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right, smart guy. Where's the fire?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Over there.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Okay, you just bought yourself a 3-17: pointing out police stupidity. Or is that a 3-14? Nah, nah, a 3-14 is a dog, ah in... no, or is that a 3-15? You're in trouble, pal.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heh, heh. I'd hate to see the look on ol' Burnsie's face if he knew I was just gettin' in. Hee hee.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm, who is that? Big ugly nose... bald... liver spot... liver spot... Mmmm.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Turn around, Simpson.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No! I can't get in trouble if I can't see you.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'm afraid he's got us, sir.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Safe in the core. And now...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Don't forget the leg protectors, sir.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, yes.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I knew I had those installed for a reason.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is the worst day ever.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey Homer, what gives?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns is making me eat all these drums of toxic waste.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Geez, that's rough. There must be two, three hundred gallons in here.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Yeah, and even a teaspoon could cause a fatal tumor.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, you wanna come bowling with us tonight?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello? Homer? Where are you? You promised you were going to have a tea party with Maggie.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Marge, I'm sorry. I can't make it.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The cooling tank just blew and they're taking Lenny to the hospital.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no, not Lenny. Not Lenny!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, so I'm going to have to work late, instead of seeing you and the kids, which is what I really want.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, sure.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, turn off the TV. I have some bad news about Lenny.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Not Lenny!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, Carl. Check out the overhead scoreboard.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Poo. Uh, Homer, what wacky name do you want?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are poo and ass taken?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Damn! Could my life get any worse?!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, guys. Is it normal to see Burns' face on a bowling ball?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Uhh, actually, I'd say you're having a severe psychotic episode.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What a rotten day!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Wow, a strike. Hey, if that's psychotic, then why am I taking these?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: You're polishing bone!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, Homer. That's four strikes in a row. You got a perfect game going!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Careful what you say, Lenny. You'll jinx it.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh, right. Sorry.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Miss! Miss!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Sorry, I was calling the waitress.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ah, this split you sold me is making me choke.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lenny...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: What? I paid seven-ten for this split.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Will you at least call it a banana split, you dumbwad?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, spare me your gutter mouth.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ow!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Practice ball! Practice ball!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Real real real real real!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Kids, today we have to talk about Krusty Brand Chew-Goo gum-like substance.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: We knew it contained spider eggs, but the Hantavirus, well, that really came out of left field.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: So if any of you have experienced numbness, or comas, send proof of purchase and five dollars to...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: "ANTIDOTE, P.O. BOX 14..."

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman live from Barney's Bowlarama, where local "pin-head" Homer Simpson is on the verge of a perfect game.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, there was no accident at the plant. Dad just wanted to go bowling!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He shouldn't have deceived me, but I'm just so relieved Lenny's okay.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This could be the greatest individual achievement in the history of Springfield, which proves just how pitiful this town is.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Morons.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! I'm ten pins away from perfection.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now listen, your father really needs to concentrate. So we'll just stay here and not disturb him.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why won't they come over? I'm so lonely.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is it, folks. The ball that will determine whether Homer Simpson rolls a perfect game or a pathetic two-ninety-something.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Yay! Yay!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: What's wrong, Abe?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: This is as fast as I move now.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get down, get down, get down!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! This is the greatest day of my life!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You did it, Homie!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In your face, to-do list!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you! Thank you! But there was someone else with me on that alley. I'm talkin' about the big man, Carl.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Aw, can the corn, bonehead.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Children, today's Local Hero is Homer Simpson.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Mr. Simpson bowled a perfect game without the aid of steroids, crack, angel dust, or the other narcotics that are synonymous with pro bowling.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Bart's teacher. You know, kids, my teachers said I would never amount to anything. And until last week, they were dead right. But now I've achieved perfection.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Any questions?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Bart's weird friend.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Will you be my Dad?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You've got a father. He's just a dud.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Next question.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, the girl Bart has a crush on.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Um, how 'bout one not touching your ass?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, this was supposed to be about me. Now, any other questions? Pumpkin face? Headgear? Chicken pox? Smelly? Lazy eye? Spikey head? Okay, class dismissed. Rock on!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Wanna split the birthday cupcakes?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Live from Shelbyville, it's the Springfield Squares! Featuring our new center square, Homer "Perfect Game" Simpson!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Okay, we'll start with our returning champion, Disco Stu.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Uh, Stu, we like to downplay the resemblance to "Tic Tac Toe."

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Uhhh, Homer...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Kent?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: According to Redbook Magazine, what is the speed of light?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... that would... uh, wait... uh... do I read from the sheet labeled "Jokes" or "Answers?"

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Oh, for the l... stop tape!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dream on, Drunky!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Ohh, we've got to stop putting these flavors of the month on.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flavor of the month? Me?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I 'unno... Because you weren't cute anymore?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Circle gets the square. Goodnight, everyone.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eww, thanks for sharing!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, everybody!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Did somebody say a perfect game?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm doing a walk-on. It's a show business thing. So how y'all doin'? Let's see... What's in the news today?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I thought you never talked.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Remember Springfield, keep on swinging!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, everybody! I'm gonna be on TV again.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right. You've got a special daddy.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! First stop, Maude Flanders.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But she said I...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, what she's saying is you've had your moment in the sun and now it's time for you to gracefully step aside.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, I know what's going on here. They did it to Jesus and now they're doing it to me.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Are you comparing yourself to our Lord?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, in bowling ability.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sweet bowling alley balloon. You're my only friend.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What was that about?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, has my life peaked?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh, Homey, is that what's bothering you?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mm-hmmm.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well the one sure cure for the blues is to talk it over with your life partner.
