title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're right!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe it, Moe. The greatest feat of my life is already forgotten.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Geez, Homer. I never seen you so depressed. As your life partner, I'm very worried.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Save your tears, Moe. Save 'em in a shot glass for someone who still has a shred of hope.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: A shreda what? Uh, sorry, I was countin' the cocktail radishes.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Now where was I? Uh, two... three... Three radishes. Three big radishes.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: THIS IS THE END / MY ONLY FRIEND, THE END / WEIRD SCENES INSIDE THE GOLD MINE...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, world, this is it. You know, I always thought you'd die before me. But now as I prepare my soul for an eternity of fire and poking...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wanna live!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's a glandular problemmmm!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, Morlocks... CHUDS... Mole People!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Lord... you saved me. I guess you had some higher purpose in mind.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not anymore, Ron. Now, I'm looking for something to dedicate my life to. Something noble, but easy.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's great. Even big stars take their kids to the zoo.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's it! Kids are the answer! I'll dedicate my life to my children.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No. I don't want your pity or your money.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I do what now?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Listen, boy... I was wondering if you could use a little more fatherly attention.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No need, Dad. Over the years I've learned to find father figures wherever I can... construction workers, the internet... and Nelson, here.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: If you tie a string around your finger real tight, you can make it turn purple.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can see I'm not needed here.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, honey, do you need any help with your homework?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sure! You can help me find three words where "y" is the vowel.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've been so blind. I'll lavish my attention on Maggie, the forgotten Simpson.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mag-gie. It's me, Dad-dy!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Daddy's gonna spend a lot more time with you. Yes he is. Yes he is.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where's Mag-gie? Where's Mag-gie? Hey, where is she?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There you are.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hi Maggie! I'm Homie-Womie, the Teletubby. And I'm all man, in case you've heard otherwise. Let's see what's on Tummy-vision!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! Ow, that hurts! Owww! Ohhh!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whee! Whee! Don't be scared, Maggie. Daddy won't drop you. Whee!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're a tough cookie, Maggie, but I'm gonna win you over. Just like I did with Lisa.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, honey!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, Maggie. You can trust me.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come to Daddy! Come to Daddy!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, Maggie. I never realized things between us had gotten this bad.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What are you pointing at? The ocean?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's a great idea. We'll swim in the ocean.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See, Maggie. The ocean is just like a bathtub. Except instead of rubber ducks, it has barracudas and moray eels.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing to worry about. Just a little wave.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And this riptide is certainly nothing Daddy can't struggle against. Help! Help! Somebody, help!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, current... too strong... I know! If I sink to the bottom I can run to the shore.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maggie! Call Aquaman!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maggie, you're swimming! You swam out to save me.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you do love me!

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Mr. Simpson, you're going to be fine. Although you do seem to have swallowed a number of shark eggs.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Actually, that was before I went in the ocean.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Well, I don't want to pry into your personal life...

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then don't.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Doctor, how could a little baby save a full-grown man from drowning?

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: It's quite simple -- When a parent's life is in danger, a child can summon superhuman strength.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, all I care about is that my little girl loves me. And we're gonna spend a lot more time together from now on.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good girl, Maggie. You knocked down all the pins. But you stepped over the line just a little bit, so I'll have to give you a five.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And that gives you a final score of... two ninety-five.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Looks like Daddy won, but two ninety-five is awfully good for a baby.

title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes it is. It's very good and you're a good little baby. Yes you are.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: These Swedish furniture designers sure have some far-out ideas. I mean, a green table! I wouldn't have thought of that in my wildest dreams.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And these bean bag chairs look so comfortable.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, there's someone else in here.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He's named after what he is.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cool costume!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me, where are your hamper lids?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, look at all these clever pencil holders.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, I want to get the "Kr_nk"!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You don't want something that overshadows the pencils.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How about this "Pöpli"?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, no! Everyone at school picks on the "Pöpli" kids. Even I do. I just hate them so much.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh! Manjula has begun to ovulate.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, I will have the... Pl_penlügen. And don't skimp on the D__dlemünch.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How ingenious. The forks are made out of Lego.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Hello, Simpsons!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Apu, Manjula. You guys are still married?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, yes sir. Quite happily.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pay up, Marge.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Say, whatcha got there?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I don't know exactly. It's from the room of lamps that do not look like lamps.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maggie loves baby talk.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. Sorry. So have you two thought about kids?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, sure we have, but the decision to have a child is not to be made lightly.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Mm. On the other hand, monkey see, monkey do!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids are the best, Apu. You can teach them to hate the things you hate. And they practically raise themselves, what with the Internet and all.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, perhaps it is time. I've noticed this country is dangerously underpopulated.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You know... I do. I mean, there comes a time in a man's life when he asks himself, "Who will float my corpse down the Ganges?"

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, Calcutta!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Apu. Sittin' in the ice cream cooler, eh?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: By chilling my loins, I increase the chances of impregnating my wife.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, too much information! Thanks for the mental picture. Why don't you tell us what you really think?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Just stop spouting those hackneyed quips.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Could you be any more...? Hel-lo! Look, just give me some ice cream.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: More than I wanted to knoooow!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Here goes nothing...

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, that is a pretty grim assessment.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You know, Homer, you might want to open those cans before they explode.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But the cans seal in the flavor.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: O-kay.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, how's the tribe comin' along? Any papooses?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: No, still no luck. Tell me, Homer, did you have to take any special steps when you decided to have children?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Decided? That's classic. Decided. Babies just happen.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, not to us they don't. Oh Homer, we have tried everything! Oysters, gravity boots, Sanjay's bed, every possible position...

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? On top and underneath?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Eh, yes.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, don't worry, I can help ya. I'm all about ideas.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, come and get it!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, this situation is guaranteed to end in pregnancy.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I'm willing to play the high school jock, but did you have to cut the roof off my car?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Up-bup-bup-bup! That's an Apu question. You're "Greg."

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: "Uh, gee, Betsy. It's such a nice night. Why don't we go all the way?"

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: "Loosen up, baby. Tomorrow I'm shipping off to Vietnam." I... I thought I was going to Ivy League State.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My mistake. Stay in the moment.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And that's my cue to exit.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I just wanted to invite you to the wrap party. And that's my cue to exit.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: No, no, wait a minute. Pirates are wild!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, get lost.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, the last nine months sure were crazy.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll say. I learned the true meaning of Columbus Day.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I enjoyed a brief but memorable stint as "Sideshow Marge."

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I became the most popular girl in school, but blew it by being conceited.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And then I learned the true meaning of winter.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Of course I do, sweetheart. You're beautiful and silky and manageable.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: That's true. But you still have a...

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, we must drive to the hospital!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Cleanup in aisle three.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Apu, come quick! You're missing the miracle!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, you shall be the jewel of our lives.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Aww, now say hello to your other seven children.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: My... Whaa...?!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: We had quite a discussion about the funniest way to reveal them to you.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You have octuplets. It rolls off your tongue and into your heart: octuplets.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Apu, you shoulda seen your face when they showed you those babies.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. It looked just like that.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: How did we get eight?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I too, I am afraid, am guilty of monkeying with nature. I slipped fertility drugs into your breakfast Squishee.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Mm-hmm. Well, that would only account for quintuplets. Did anyone else slip this woman fertility drugs?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mine tasted like strawberry.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm... Ovulicious.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Absolutely. Yes.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: We have a "love-eight" relationship.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Yes, Kent Brockman, Channel 6. How would you respond to people who say this kind of multiple birth is more suited to, say, a possum, than a human being?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Well... Pundits... Wags... I'm not the one on trial here.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: No one is on trial. This is a joyous occasion for all. And the outpouring of support has been so lucrative.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Free baby cola? Apu hits the jackpot, and I'm stuck with these useless one-tuplets.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gee, sorry for being born.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've been waiting so long to hear that.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: How do you feel about this avalanche of free merchandise?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: But the good folks at Sony... ! Their giant TV will really help us love our babies.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, they even have a better sound bite than us.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Don't worry, my little Curry-Face. We don't need corporate handouts. Our children will live on love.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I just had the most beautiful dream where I died.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Listen, I'll die when I want to.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Thank you, steal again.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: We-ell, morning, Apu. How are the little blessings?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Ooh, they're a ravenous swarm of locusts, just eating and screaming and grabbing and poking and pulling and drooling and two have cradle rash! How do you get cradle rash when you sleep in a suitcase?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: They can be a handful... of joy.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Shut up!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: ... They'll fill your lives with...

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Just shut up!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: ... can't put a price on a miracle...

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I can't believe you don't shut up.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, look at that. Ooh, gingerbread house. Hansel and Gretel are set for life.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know, I saw Apu today. He's really frazzled.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, that Hansel sure can eat.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My corneas! You were saying?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Apu told me all eight babies have colic. Although he thinks one or two might just be going along with the crowd.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eight kids. Hm, I'm sterile, right baby doll?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, dear. From the nuclear plant.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Beautiful.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Knock, knock!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Apu? Manjula? Marge, I've got a bad feeling about this.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Welcome to my nightmare.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I knew you had your hands full with the babies, so I baked you some banana bread.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh hallelujah, our problems are solved. We have banana bread.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you don't have to be sarcastic.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge... They've turned into jerks.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I'm very sorry, we've been rude. Can I offer you something to drink?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... no thanks.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Okay, break it up.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe you two should get a nanny.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Yes, and what would I pay her with, banana bread? Sorry. Sorry. It's just we haven't slept in days and we're running out of money and... Banana bread! What the hell were you thinking? Banana bread. I apologize, apologize again. As a token of forgiveness, please take this baby.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, Marge. No!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Who cares? There's only one of him!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I would say that there must be some sort of horrible catch.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: The zoo?!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Look, I'm not going to put my babies in a zoo.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: The habitat?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, my goodness!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: But is it right to put such young children on display?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Butch Patrick?!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, obviously. Hey, one question, Eddie.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Eh, right, right. If your mother was a vampire and your father was a Frankenstein, how come you are a werewolf?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: We wouldn't be giving the babies away. We'd be moving in with them. They'll have a traditional zooish upbringing.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Hey, what the...

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, everything is perfect.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Showtime?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe we're gonna see the octuplets.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You already saw them.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but now their umbilical cords have fallen off!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How can he rebel? He doesn't even know where he is.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhhhh.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: She's no Liza, but it works.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: He's thinkin' what we're all sayin'.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Boo, Baron!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Our babies are not circus freaks! We're taking them home now!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Not any more!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Laminated! You monster!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I'm afraid there's nothing I can do.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: The zookeeper paid you off, didn't he?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Paid me off? What are you, crazy?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, they might give Dazzle back. Ah, the buzz is she's got one more show to turn it around.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, if the police won't help us, we'll simply have to take the law into our own hands.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, a lot of people are doing that these days.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: These animals certainly act different at night.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, my little treasures. We'll get you out of this terrible place.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: She's waking up!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry. I brought some chloroform.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There... and... there...

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You idiot, those are Colorforms.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Nabendu... Pria... and Sashi... Now let's go!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, this is gettin' weird.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, let's get that awful thing off!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Okay, whatever.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Please, Mr. Kidkill, look into your heart. I know these babies have a lifetime contract. But what if I put together an even better act for you? Something sensational!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not any more!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Are those real cobras?

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Some are real, some are just robots filled with venom.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Now, that is a true friend.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: We'll do our best, Chutney-Butt.

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay... don't panic. Release the mongoose!

title: Eight Misbehavin'
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid mongoose! get the snake! The snake! Do I look like a snake? Ow! Ow! He bit me Show's over! Show's over! Next show is eight o'clock and ten!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Tonight on "Guinness Book of World Records..."

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Announcer
spoken_words: ...a man who holds the current record for Least Amount Of Faces, with none!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Announcer
spoken_words: You'll also see... The World's Smelliest Tumor!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ew! These records used to be real accomplishments. Now they're just gross.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Plus, you'll meet a dog who can't predict anything!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Then, three other things!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Announcer
spoken_words: When we come back, we'll show you the contents of a supermodel's stomach!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What an age we live in.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, look at all that Sweet N' Low.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I remember television!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A fifties-style restaurant.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What a neat idea!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why don't we eat there tonight?!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nah. We'll go next month.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dennis the Menace?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I have to go.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: California, here we come!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's not a real car, Grampa.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Allen Ginsburgers, Un-American Cheese Sandwich, Polio Dogs..."

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's clever how the names remind you of the fifties and at the same time tell you what there is to eat.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, look at this old-timey gizmo! I feel like I've gone back in a time machine.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, they have those everywhere.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What an age we live in.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dancing!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no. You're not gettin' me on that dance floor. Don't try and make me. If I have to get a divorce I will.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, never!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh! I need a dance partner! What about you?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Daddy-o.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wooo!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, a fifties nostalgia cafe!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's mine. Finally, I've won the respect of my fellow... Get away from it!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Man, you're bending the hell out of that kick-stand, Dad. Why don't you just take it for a ride?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Promise you won't laugh?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I promise.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know how.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're kidding?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You don't know how.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Will you teach me?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Of course.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A gang! That's the answer.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Answer to what?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: All right, class. Today we'll be sitting quietly in the dark, because teacher has a hangover.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, it's like a chainsaw in my head...

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Later, Homer.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Sweet hog, Mr. Simpson.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Remember to rebel against authority, kids.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Don't listen to him, children.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: But we already did. Now I can't get it out of my head.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Thank you, Nelson.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: The sermon today is on... John 4:13. I think it was Jesus who said that... blessed are those who... Oh, the heck with it. Church dismissed!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Will you turn that engine off?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Quiet, Marge. The motorcycle and I are trying to sleep.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know, I know. Just tune her out.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, that's the life for me, Marge. Cruisin' and hasslin' shopkeepers.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, don't make me hassle you, Lisa.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, if you want to be in the gang, eventually you're gonna have to get motorcycles.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Yeah, we know.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hey, Homer! Can I join?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This gang's for rebels, Flanders, not conformos.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, that's right!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Buzz off!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, if I were a member, we could use my rumpus room as our lair.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That guy just don't get it, do he?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: My rumpus room with the new bumper pool table.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: / Bumper pool?! / You kiddin' me? You got bumper pool? / I'm there!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The first meeting of "Hell's Satans" is called to order.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I move we reconsider our club name. Make it something a little less blasphemous. After all we don't want to go to Hell.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: How 'bout the Devil's Pals?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: N-No... you see...

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Or the Christ Punchers.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: The Chri... I-I-I don't think you understand my objection...

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm the president and the decision is mine. We're Hell's Satans. Besides, I've already made our club jackets.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ooh, machine wash warm!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Tumble dry, ooh-la-la!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Wait up, guys! I gotta empty my grass bag.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hell's Satans, huh? I'm watchin' you punks.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can't hassle us, pig. We're goin' the speed limit. Oink, oink, oink.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah! Oink, oink, oink!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: You'll make a mistake some day. And then you're going straight to juvie.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You can lock us away, but you'll never defeat the Cobras.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Cobras? I thought you were the Hell's Satans.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oink! Oink! Oink!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How could I be down a thousand bucks?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Get away from my store, you young hoodlums.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And what if we don't, Pops?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: He's got a broom!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, let's get out of here!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Forget the pennies! Go! Go!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I know this is not your way, but we're in America now.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They printed my photo of our gang!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Carl looks great. Can't take a bad picture of that guy.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You took a picture of me when I was asleep?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If you'd've been awake you would have said no. You can see the bind I was in.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "Her turn-ons include thievery and liquor. Her turn-offs include underpants, pedestrians, and justice."

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What in the world?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're the Hell's Satans? What a fun coincidence. My gang's name is also the...

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Done.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Meathook, I think he learned his lesson.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Caps and frisbees, sir.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And some pogs.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You keep it.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I think it's great you've chosen to "crash" here, but do you have to be so messy?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, police? Can you send a SWAT team to 742 Evergreen Ter...

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Forget it, Simpson. Those pig noises you made really hurt my feelings -- looking like a pig as I do.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But you have so much inner beauty.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, uh, be that as it may, ah, the gang is wanted in eight other states and we have a little saying around here: "Let Michigan handle it".

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop that! If you want some food I'll be happy to make you some breakfast.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Ramrod.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All it takes is the right cleanser and a little elbow grease.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just put it on my sewing pile. Okay, I'm doing another load of bandanas!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze

spoken_words: Hey! Hey! That's a leave-in conditioner!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're done. Next!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I'm tired of bathing in the yard. Plus, I think Rod and Todd are watching.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, bikers, that's it. Benjamin Franklin once said that house guests are like fish at... huh? They're gone! Woo hoo!

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ... And those bikers saw that hard look in my eye -- you know that hard look I get sometimes? -- and they ran away like schoolgirls with their tails between their legs.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze

spoken_words: Way to go Dad. Hey, where's the food?

spoken_words: I've been better.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And why aren't I at school?

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, someone really dropped the ball here. Marge? Marge?!

spoken_words: Dad, there's a note on the back of your head.

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? Read it.

spoken_words: Hm. "Thanks for letting us crash in your pad. We had a very nice time."

title: Take My Wife, Sleaze

spoken_words: Oh, that's sweet.

spoken_words: What's that, a theme park?

title: The Mansion Family
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: No, the ocean. Once you get twelve miles out, there's no laws at all. That's where they held the Tyson/Secretariat fight.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They were so drunk. Gentlemen, get off your knees. Your rich uncle Homer is throwing the wildest box social the high seas have ever seen!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And you're invited.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no, you don't! I'm not going to let you trash Mr. Burns' yacht.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you know I normally listen to you, but I've gotta seize this opportunity. Just in case I never become a real billionaire.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homie, I don't care if you're a billionaire. I love you just because you're...

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, there's another way to get on the boat!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Propellers... SPINNING! Turn... LEFT! Boat go... THERE!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, Mom. I'm sure he'll be okay.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The boat's going sideways!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ships ahoy!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well done, Mr. Lenny. Well done.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Homer, have we hit international waters yet? Because uh, things are gettin' real ugly.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I can't sell ya beer till we cross the line!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Well, could you at least give us rubbing alcohol for our wounds?

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey. Sucker.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ow!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We made it, son. International waters -- the land that law forgot.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, you can do anything out here.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right. See that ship over there?

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They're rebroadcasting Major League Baseball with implied oral consent, not expressed written consent! Or so the legend goes.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There are no laws. We can do anything we want! Anything!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow, ow! Oh, real mature, Lenny.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, Doc, I think I did pretty well on my tests. You may shake my hand if you like.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Eh?

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You mean I have pneumonia?

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Juvenile diabetes?

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hysterical pregnancy?

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I see. You're sure you just haven't made thousands of mistakes?

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, this sounds like bad news.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well...

title: The Mansion Family
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: They got my bus pass. They got my bus pass!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Whoo, they're poking every nook and cranny. Well, every cranny, anyway. So far the nook is relatively... Oh, no it isn't!

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: So what you're saying is... I'm indestructible.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Indestructible...

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why are we cleaning this room? I don't think we were even in here.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, we want Mr. Burns to find this place exactly the way he left it.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at those poor saps back on land. With their laws and ethics. They'll never know the simple joys of a monkey knife fight.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Thrust... Parry... Stabstabstabstab. Oooh, he ain't pretty no more.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Coast Guard! Try and stop us now, you lousy Americans!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nice try. You're not gonna nail us!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, really? Then play some rock music.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, Bart. The Coast Guard is covering the Doobs!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who's the greatest billionaire in the world?!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pirates! Are you friendly pirates?

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What have you done with my party guests?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Third best for me.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Help, pirates!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, bless you!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that would be just... You're just yankin' my chain, aren't you?

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't wanna!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah ha! Prepare to die!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You too.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Agh! Rope burns!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, oooh, Charlie horse, Charlie horse!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Agh, my mouth!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In the net, right?

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Some party, Homer.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shut up, Net Face.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, you're in the net, too.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I said shut up, Net Face!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, we're gonna die and I never tasted canteloupe.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Eh, you didn't miss much. Honeydew is the money melon.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ahhhh!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, what do you know? It floats.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That was my plan all along. Now relax and the currents will take us home.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What about the people on the bottom?

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They're the greatest heroes of all. Hey, something's clawing at my leg. Okay, it stopped.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It looks great. I can't believe we scrubbed that old man smell out of a hundred and thirty-seven rooms.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, old chum, there's nothing like coming home with a clean bill of health. Oh, and sorry about your news.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Thank you, sir.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Do they know how many eggs it laid in your brain?

title: The Mansion Family
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I prefer not to know. Frankly, one is too many.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ugh. The foul stench of youth!

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, let's see. Ming vase on narrow column, not knocked down... priceless coins not used in vending machine...

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: ... yes, not bad.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Mr. Burns, pirates got your yacht.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What!? Well, I suppose some mishaps are unavoidable.

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Furious George! What have they done to your beautiful face?!

title: The Mansion Family
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: There, there. Smithers, this monkey's going to need most of your skin.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, it's good to be home.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know. After living like a billionaire, this place is kind of a dump.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nah, it's not so bad. Here we can spit on the floor.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, stop that! Now, we may not have antique furniture, or priceless art work, but we have everything we need right here.

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right. Just because we're not rich, doesn't mean that we don't have... Oh, I can't even finish. I wanna be rich!

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Like these guys. And look at all these rich people here. Not as rich as they should be of course. But still rich. All that big money. Look at all of these. Got all this money. I have lots of money. Oh look at all the other people. Oh, look at all the people who can buy and sell me. I should send a list of these names to the IRS. I'm takin' 'em all down. Oh, look at all the rich people. Oh, look at the rich...

title: The Mansion Family
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't shush me, you rich bastards!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good luck gettin' a horse to eat dog food.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hate to be a killjoy, but do you really think we can win playing "Stars and Stripes Forever"? It's so beginner band, and we're advanced beginner band.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I thought maybe, for once, we could play a song that wasn't written by Sousa.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, something fresh and bold.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: How about something cool, like "Camptown Races."

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, grandpa, the Civil War's over. How about "Little Brown Jug"? YA-HA-HA, HEE-HEE-HEE, LITTLE BROWN JUG, HOW I LOVE THEE...

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Take your arm off me.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Vietnam Veteran.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I.D.? Man, Charlie didn't ask for I.D. when I fought at La Choy and Chun King. I saw my best friend's head explode at Margaret Cho.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, give him the fifty cents.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why should I? Did my country give me a parade? No, man! They spat at me and...

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks. This closes the saddest chapter in American history.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't wait to do some shopping -- Look at all these innovative products. Miracle Shears...

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, the Drain Bugger!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That is the best version of "Living in America" I've ever heard.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Never, but it's my number one concern!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: A little late for Lenny.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who are those pleasant old men?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's B.T.O.! They're Canada's answer to E.L.P. Their big hit was "T.C.B." That's how we talked in the '70s. We didn't have a moment to spare.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Takin' Care of Business!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No talking! No new crap! "Takin' Care of Business!" Now!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get to the "workin' overtime" part!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Work out!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Play "Ain't Seen Nothing Yet!"

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What-everrr!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, Lisa's in that.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I stand by my disappointed groan.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Check out Lisa. She's a sax machine! Makes me think I should've done something with my life. Oh, well.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Anybody got a building permit? 'Cause we nailed it!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Way to blow, Lis!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Stars and Stripes Forever"? Oh, man. They're toast!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Glow sticks? But visual aids are against the rules!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hope you enjoy your plaque, cheater.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe those idiot judges were impressed by glowing plastic tubes.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Lisa. It glows. Oooo.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Let's forget about the band contest and just have fun at the State Fair.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You mean State Un-fair.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, right, that's what I meant, Lisa. State Un-fair.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Zing!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See, Marge? I told you they could deep-fry my shirt.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't say they couldn't. I said you shouldn't.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wish people would stop telling me to step right up.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Ah, this is clearly a case of animal cruelty. Ah, do you have a permit for that?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I'd rather let a thousand guilty men go free, than chase after them. All right, show's over, folks. I'm afraid this horse is going to the dog food factory.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You can't do that to Duncan. It's not his fault that his owner was a sleaze.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Look, I just want the horse to have a good home, or be food. You want to take him, fine with me.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm. Should the Simpsons get a horse?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Excuse me. But I believe this family already had a horse, and the expense forced Homer to work at the Kwik-E-Mart with hilarious consequences.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Anybody care what this guy thinks?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Tunnel!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my. Ooh-hoo. It's going to cost us $500 a week to keep Duncan!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But he'll bring us joy, Marge. Unlike all your silly gewgaws.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: At least you don't have to feed any of the stuff I bought at the fair. Well, except the mop.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, your pro-mop, anti-horse agenda has been clear for some time. But don't worry, I have a way for Duncan to earn his keep.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm, that's terrific, Duncan. You're ten for ten. Now, let's look in the rulebook and see if horses can play in the NFL.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's a diving horse. Maybe he could dive for pearls.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pearls, eh?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Dad.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This horse is pretty fast. Maybe we can race him.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Racehorse, eh?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dear Mr. President

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What are you doing, Lisa?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm writing a letter to President Clinton about that travesty of a band contest. As a fellow sax player, I'm sure he'll be outraged.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, don't get obsessed with that. Focus on the good things. Like this fire extinguisher I got at the fair.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Really -- Hey, what are you doing?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's the only fire extinguisher endorsed by both Lynda Carter and George Foreman.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wonder what would happen if they had a baby?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, if we're gonna race Duncan, shouldn't we hire a professional trainer?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, I learned everything I needed to know from "The Horse Whisperer". Step One: Seduce a lonely housewife.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ma'am.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now for the actual horse whispering.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: When the race starts, run really fast!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, c'mon, c'mon. There's got to be a winner on this floor somewhere. Bingo!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, leggo, you lousy, stinkin'...

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Whaaa?!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You're beau-tee-ful.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh-oh. This is a serious medical problem. I gotta go.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Champion horse, coming through!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good horse. Here's one taco and you'll get another when you win.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, where do you get those metal dealies for his feet?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's with the attitude? I just want some dealies.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He ran all the way here.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You can do it, Duncan. I don't care if your odds are... Five million to one!?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, boy. I'll love you even if you don't win.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That horse better win, or we're taking a trip to the glue factory and he won't get to come.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Yeah, that's a great tour, but you can't see it all in one day.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, be quiet.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Go, Duncan! / Go, Number "5"! Let's go, Number "5"! / Do it for Lenny!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, boy. I know you're scared, but you can do this. I believe in you!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Cheer up, son. I thought you looked damn good out there. Oh, wait. You were number "5"? Eew! You stin... Damn good.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Duncan's really fast, Dad. He was just intimidated by those other horses.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he's not gonna be intimidated anymore. We're gonna toughen him up -- give him a new badass attitude. All those other horses will be shaking in their horse dealies.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, I'd like to speak to President Clinton, please. I wrote to him and he never wrote back... No, I don't want Al Gore!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, you've got to learn that life isn't always fair. Try to channel your disappointment into something creative, like a sampler.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Is that Duncan?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not anymore. Ladies, say hello to...

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "Furious D"?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's the bad boy of racing. He's got attitude and bad-itude, so show him some latitude and you'll win his gratitude. Only in America!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ew, you used my bracelet for a nose ring!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Possessions are fleeting.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Get bent.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Mr. President!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So many horses. I don't know who to vote for. Can't I just bet that all the horses will have a fun time?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't listen to 'em, D. Just remember, you've got a new persona. A new per-so-na.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Lisa. I've got Furious D across the board, boxed with the three and the eight, and wheeled up and down.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I think you might be developing a gambling problem.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Hey, I'm watching you...

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's it, D. Don't let anyone push you around. Be as bad as you wanna be.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Oh man, that horse don't take no guff from nobody.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I mean shi...

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! In your little faces!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, I got more trophies than Wayne Gretzky and the Pope combined.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've been waiting all my life to hear that.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, where'd you go?... Little man?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What happened?!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What is this place?!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why are you talking like that?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But you're respected athletes! You own car dealerships and marry beauty queens.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do you want me to do?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: MY HORSE MUST LOSE?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: AND WHAT IF I REFUSE TO LOSE?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: MY HORSE MUST LOSE!

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Did that really happen? Or was it just a wonderful dream?

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, don't ask why, but you have to lose the big race.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You want me to lose the Springfield Derby? But you always taught me that winning was everything.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it is, it is. But we've been pushing that poor horse too hard.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe. But if Duncan wins the Derby, he can spend the rest of his days as a stud.

title: Saddlesore Galactica
name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm, I can see the house is falling apart without me, so here's the new order: Bart, you're the man of the house. Lisa -- I'm promoting you to boy. Maggie's now the brainy girl. The toaster can fill in for Maggie. And Marge, you're a consultant.

name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Like this, from the Book of P-salms: "God will shatter the heads of his enemies, the hairy crown of those who walk in their guilty ways. That you may bathe your feet in blood." As true today as it was when it was written.

title: Missionary: Impossible
name: Homer Simpson
