spoken_words: Oh yeah? What is it?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The bluebird.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Damnit!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: More wheat cakes, Mr. Mayor?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Read my lips: Yes.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you got syrup on your sash.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No problem.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: If you ask me...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stop right there.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ... it's stupid to divide the city over something as silly as an area code. It would be like you and mom splitting up every time you have a fight.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sweetie, you know your mother and I only stay together for the sake of my political career.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's not true.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Big grins!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That'll play great in the sticks.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that was fifty already?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Go long!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Give it back! That's my novelty flying disc.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My homework is in your park.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: All right, root beer, bananas and toilet paper... Fifty percent Out-of-towners' Tax...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Out-of-towner Tax?!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I'm sorry Mrs. Simpson, but we have to charge you foreign devils more.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right, but this better be the best toilet paper I've ever had.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, no worries there. That's Henderson's Toilet Paper!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, why didn't you say so? Hey, is there a bathroom here?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Not for you.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know why, but I just didn't feel comfortable until I was back here in New Springfield, with my own kind.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They were looking at me. With their eyes.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: As expected, New Springfield's bold experiment in slob rule is a disaster.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, the TV man is talking about us!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: A study shows their crumbling economy is due to their lazy attitude and shoddy work.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Scientists say they are also less attractive physically. And while we speak in a well-educated manner, they tend to use lowbrow expressions, like "oh yeah?" and "c'mere a minute."

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah? They think they're better than us, huh? Bart, c'mere a minute.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You c'mere a minute.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I don't think this is such a good idea.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Marge. Now, let's see how Olde Snobfield does without electricity.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Sounds like a wager to me.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I'll take a piece of that.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: In retaliation for the power outage, Olde Springfield patriots have intercepted a beer truck bound for New Springfield and dumped all the beer in the river.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Those rich, snobby Indians.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh, there's nothing like revenge for getting back at people.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: I don't know. Vengeance is pretty good.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Flood from water!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: They've got us now. Without water, we're doomed.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Wait a minute. That gold-colored substance in the riverbed...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Why that's gold!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We're slightly richer!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: With the money made from the gold, Olde Springfield was able to buy the Evian water factory and fly it over here from France.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Thanks, Mayor Simpson. Because of you, we're all taking golden showers.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: What?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We can't go on fighting with Olde Springfield. These people are our neighbors. We see them every day.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're right. We've got to block them from our sight with a giant wall.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Like the one in Berlin?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good idea. We should call the guys they used.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's ringing.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I'd like to thank Low Ball Construction for building this amazing wall... From ninety percent recycled materials.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so conflicted.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: 'Bout what?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Loyal citizens of New Springfield. You stayed on my side of town despite a total lack of hospitals and schools, and a sewage nightmare that threatens to consume us all.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: How will we get our food? All the roads are blocked.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, we have plenty of supplies to get through tomorrow. And then a wave of disease should help to -- hey!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stop streaming over the wall! At least wait till I'm through talking.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, now as for food, the following breeds of dog are edible...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe all those rats fled my town.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Guess it's just us and the tumbleweeds.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Dad, you're mayor of a ghost town.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe those traitors abandoned us. They couldn't take one lousy famine.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you're bleeding.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No problem.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Anyhow, those rats'll come crawling back...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We've got the Who playing here tonight.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, the arena's in Olde Springfield.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't give up, Dad. Maybe we can get The Who to play here instead.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, maybe we could. But we'll need some liquid persuasion.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, Bart. We're gonna bring back The Who.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, the chloroform!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh? Oh, right.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll give you this bottle of chloroform if you'll take us to The Who.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, The Who!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo! Rock 'n' roll!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Duh. Trashin' the hotel room.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whatever. The point is, I'm Homer Simpson.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right. And I implore you to move your concert to our town. Don't play Olde Springfield, or as it is sometimes known, Sun City.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, what happened to the angry, defiant Who of "My Generation," "Won't Get Fooled Again," and "Mama's Got a Squeeze Box"?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But those Olde Springfield squares are just gonna make you cut your hair, turn down your music and wear frilly shirts like Keith Partridge.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Somethin' wrong with your legs?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I opened for the Who at Woodstock! I came out in a Beatle wig with a ukulele. Hendrix said he almost plotzed, his exact words.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, why did you iron a crease in these dungarees? I look like a square.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh, that crease is in your leg, Sir.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, so it is.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hmm, it's not like the Who to be tardy. I'm worried.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: What's that?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Homer stole our rock performance. That fat, dumb and bald guy sure plays some real hardball.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: To be honest, it's a little chilly.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, don't worry. They'll be here soon. And then they'll see who's got the better town.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now these are the tunes I want you boys to play.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, c'mon, it plays itself. "Pacman Fever / A do do do do / It's driving me crazy." Look Lisa, Daddy's in the Who!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Give us back our concert, Simpson!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, New Springfield's lookin' pretty good now, isn't it? With our ample parking and daily Who concerts.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll talk.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, enough chit chat. Let's see how ya like flaming garbage!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ha-ha. You hit the tire fire! You'll have to do...

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why me?

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Magic Bus"!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Pinball Wizard"!

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well Marge, looks like your insane experiment is over.

title: A Tale of Two Springfields
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My experiment? You're the one who came up with this whole idea...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This watermelon won't know what hit it.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I love our Tuesdays together, Dad.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you two have a list of chores to do?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, we just took care of that dangerous melon that was threatening our garden.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, we're heroes... But where's our parade?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right. "Open stuck drawer..." All-righty.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, it's hopeless.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Or is it?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, it's hopeless.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I said, or is it?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I said, it's... Ohhh...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, what are you doing?!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Listen, do you want the job done right or do you want it done fast?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, like all Americans, fast.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Clear!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you can't argue with results...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, baby.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, don't worry. You'll be sleeping in this beautiful new doghouse. Target date: January, 2007.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And now, the grand finale... "Get Lisa's jammed tape out of VCR."

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oop, wait a minute...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fire in the hole!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm. It's gonna take a lot of fireworks to clean this place up.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's going on here?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, honey, there's a point in every father's life when he blows up his daughter's room.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah? You didn't blow up Maggie's room.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Lisa, this must be a rough time for you. Do you have any friends or family you can stay with?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You've ruined all my stuff.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, come on. Tell us how we can make it up to you. Hey, pretend it's your birthday.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It is my birthday.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's the spirit. Now, what do you want to do?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, the Book Festival starts today...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Anything at all. You name it. What do you want to do?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid Lisa.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hear ye, hear ye! One dollar off on all poetry books!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Their hands were everywhere.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Hello, Simpsons. Care to try a sample from my new cookbook... "Someone's in the Kitchen with Jesus"?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mmmm, these StigMuffins are to die for!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Ooh, if you like that, you should try Mary Magdalene's Chocolate Orgasm.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mmmm.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: okay.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So, Mr. King, what tale of horror and the macabre are you working on now?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's too bad.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, let me know when you get back to horror.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And you'll lose weight?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Finally, books for today's busy idiot. "Network Programming for Dummies"... "Christianity for Dummies"... "Mo"-- "Moby Dick?"... "Call me Ishmael, Dummy."

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How did you write all these books?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Maggie. Christopher Walken's reading "Goodnight Moon!"

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Eh.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I think I just seltzered myself.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: All right, does anyone have a question for our panel that's not about how much money they make?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Uh, yeah, I'm a techno-thriller junkie, and I'd like to know: is the B-2 bomber more detectable when it rains?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Ho, ho, what do you think, Tom Clancy?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: No, no, no. I was asking Maya Angelou.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Maya Angelou is black?!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh, Maya, you're a national treasure!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ms. Tan, I loved "The Joy Luck Club". It really showed me how the mother-daughter bond can triumph over adversity.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Book writing, what a scam, huh! It's only twenty pages long, and this guy wrote it for me!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What's your name again?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa. I didn't ask for your life story.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, he's wonderful. He would do anything for his fans.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hurry up, kid!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Name.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, it's me, Bart. Your biggest fan?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, good for you, 'cause I wanna...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "K. the C."?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, this pen's gotta last me all day. Now, if you could, up bup bup bup bup bup bup... ...Yeah.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Name.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, good luck with that.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Whaaa?!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Idiots.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Shut up, Updike.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Listen, honey, a lot of kids think of me as their daddy. But I'm just a simple TV legend. Here, have a keychain.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Uh, was your mother an Israeli flight attendant?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Cokie Roberts?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, boy. Now it's comin' back to me.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Saddam Hussein? They should call him So-damn Insane!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah. Heh, heh, heh... Now, just when you thought the desert couldn't get any hotter: It's the Cincinnati Bengal cheerleaders!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: During the show, a desert wind kicked up.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I sought shelter in a nearby tent.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: There was your mother, looking like a beautiful mirage.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Maybe it was the anthrax in the air. Maybe it was the fact the Arab women weren't bitin'. Whatever it was, it was magic...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: We slept late into the morning. And then...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Here's your mission: get down with the clown!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Wait a minute! You can't kill Saddam! He's half my act!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Stop!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I just saved my baseball bit. "Who's Sayin's" on first, "Iya Tol'ya's" on second and...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: When I came to, she was gone and the war had been over for eight months. Anyway, how'd you finally find me?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, how ya been? Remember me?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: You'd better get going. It was nice meeting ya. Thanks for coming out.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Look, you're a sweet kid, but I'm not exactly father material. I curse, I gamble, I pick fights with homeless people... I...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What's wrong with your eyes? You need a Claritin or something?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: All right. You get one trip to the beach... with my assistant.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Okay, I'll take you.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dear Lord, bless this humble meal, and did you hear about Krusty? Whoa, man! I mean, I knew he was a player, but geez, a kid?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, that's not a prayer, that's gossip.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fine, I'll just discuss heavenly matters. So, how's Maude Flanders doin' up there? She playin' the field? Ooh... yeah, really? All those guys? Amen.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Okay, kid. There's the water, knock yourself out.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Listen, kid. I'm not the kind of dad who you know, does things, or says stuff, or looks at you. But the love is there.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Where are you? Give Daddy a clue...

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, that's my girl.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I gotta sit up now? What am I, Baryshnikov?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, you beat me. What a great day we've had, huh?

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Boy, fatherhood is one tough gig. I don't get how other guys do it.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Ready, switch!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hey, uh, careful, boys. That arch is lookin' a little Romanesque.

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mush, Homer, mush!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Catch, Dad, catch!

title: Insane Clown Poppy
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, that stings Daddy's eyes, honey.

spoken_words: "Ages 8 to 80." Hmm... That's me! Dad, will you get me this magic kit?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gee, I wish I could, son, but we've already left the gift shop.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, it's approved by the Royal Magic College of Hyderabad.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's a party magic college.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It is not!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ya-huh!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nuh-uh!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ya-huh!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Could you cut it out, you two? Mommy needs some quiet right now.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the hell is that?!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It looks like a sturgeon.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But where did it come from?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know that. How much to fix it?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't afford that.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe I can make some money, Dad. My magic act is really coming along.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He couldn't breathe.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Step right up! See the magic boy! Witness mystifying feats that will leave you scratching your head until it's raw and bloody!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, my goodness!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, pony up, Flanders. The kid's not turning tricks for nothin'.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, no! I could never support the black arts.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Black arts?!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Yeah, you know... magic, fortune telling, Oriental cooking...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, we'll move. We don't want any trouble, fellas.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, only one of them is real.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know, but which one?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sixty cents?! I would've made more if I'd gone into work today!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, don't blame me. I gotta compete with TV, and the Internet.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A good son would come through for his dad!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, and a good dad wouldn't miss his son's Little League games!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I told you! I find them boring.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I showed up for all your stupid interventions.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's it! You can walk home!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, come back! I can't walk home with all this stuff!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid, non-magical son, can't pay to fix my car.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Homer! Check it out!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the?!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is that a steak?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I know a little place.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who gave you all this money?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: People. I guess they thought I was a charity case.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really. Hey, maybe we could do that again. Can you look even more pathetic?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh ho, ho, that's beautiful! We could make a fortune.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But wouldn't that make us con artists?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, yeah. But God conned me out of sixty-five hundred bucks in car repairs.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So in a way, we'd just be balancing out the universe.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There ya go! We'd be stealing from people we know. It's just like the seasons.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sounds good. Wanna eat my fat?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think you know the answer to that.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This book has all the classic cons. There's "The Pigeon Drop," "The Ear Wigger," "The Brillstein Grab..."

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They have any father-and-son grifts?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, there's the "Albany Ham Scam."

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Interesting.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, wait. Here we go...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What are you doing? Why are you frosting that old throw pillow?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I could ask you the very same question.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Should I just back out of the room?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Would you?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Dad. Ready for our first con?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You bet. Let's trim the mark.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nice use of the lingo, Homer.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ten-four, Kemosabe.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Well, I love you, too. Good night, and have a pleasant tomorrow.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Oh, excuse me!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What happened? Where's my cake? It's all right, isn't it?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Uhhh...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What have you done, you clumsy little ox?! That cake was for your deaf sister!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Sir, it was my fault.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, no. Don't protect him. You'll work off that cake in the acid mines.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: No, no, no. I'll pay for the cake.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you're the mark.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ... of integrity.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, look at all this loot! What should we buy first?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A singing rubber fish, of course.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There you are. How was the magic act?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What in the hell are you talking about?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, right, the magic. The magic was great. It's really... the way to go.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How'd you do your act? You left your magic kit here.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Or so it would seem...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Suckers.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I dunno, Mom. I think they're up to something...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, sure looks that way... But at least Bart and Homer are spending quality time together.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Is that a Long Island Iced Tea?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, this? Hmm. I think it is.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're a pretty girl.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here, boy! Here doggie. Oh where has my little dog gone?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Oh, you lost your doggie?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I saw him playing in the water, and then he was gone. He had a bright red leash, with bells on it.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Oh, I'm sure he's around here somewhere.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Oh, dear Lord!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's the bestest dog ever. He's light brown and he has a spot on him shaped like a heart.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Sorry son, but...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I just gotta get him back!... Or if not him, a similar dog...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dog for sale!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dog for sale!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: How much for the dog?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, he's not for sale.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Although if the right offer came along...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here's for the repairs, and a little extra for you.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My Bar Mitzvah cake! Oy, I'll never be a man!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, son?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why are we still grifting? The car's paid for. Doesn't that balance out the universe?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In a way. But I also remembered some other stuff... like my bike that was stolen in third grade. Plus the baldness.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I'm sold.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, is the lady of the house in?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, no, Homer, remember? Maudie got called up to Heaven.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, of course, of course. It's just that...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: What?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, before she died, she ordered this Bible especially for you.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Why, there's my name in gold.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, you weren't home, so we had to pay the delivery man...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, I'll just reimburse you right n-- Wait a minute. This seems an awful lot like that movie, "Paper Moon."

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Run, Dad!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll be safe here.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That was too close. Maybe it's time to quit the game.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Amateurs!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dad?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: That's right.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You don't smoke a pipe.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: That's right.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How'd you get wise to us?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Are you kiddin'? They used to call me Grifty McGrift. I wrote the book on flim-flammin'.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, he did.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, in the Depression, you had to grift. Either that, or work.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So what's the pitch, old man?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Team up with me, boys, and we'll go for the biggest honey pot of 'em all.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh... my... God.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know... Fleecin' old people?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, why not? If we don't take their money, they'll just give it to some televangelist.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's dust a few fossils.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Now, this scam was in "The Sting Part II," so nobody knows about it.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Which one of you youngsters is Abe Simpson?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm Abe Simpson.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You've just won 10 million dollars from that Publisher's Cleary-dealie!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Wha?!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe it! I can finally afford a young, crazy stripper wife.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I'm gonna get me the craziest, strippiest...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He's dead.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, this is terrible. Now who do we give the money to?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I guess we'll just have to haul the check back to headquarters. Too bad we couldn't just give it to these nice folks.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Forget it, Ed. Do you know what it costs to sign over a check this big? Why, the wealth transfer fee would run at least a hundred dollars a head.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're right. We'd better just take this check back for shredding.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you... no shoving... that's right, put your money in here... all of it... Is that everyone?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's your problem, Sport? Afraid to be rich?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Throw the book at him, Sonny.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Call me mint jelly, 'cause I'm on the lam!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So we're under arrest for fraud?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, woo, it took a lotta grifting.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Please, FBI man, don't throw us in jail. We just made one mistake.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. We're not criminals. We're just two crazy, mixed-up kids.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You'd do that for us?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, thank you, sir.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, son. I have an idea.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Chief, I'd like to scare my son straight. Could I show him a jail cell?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Oh, sure. I'll put you in the Rick James suite. It's super-freaky.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, we're all locked up now...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. Ya big idiot...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's not an FBI badge.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Colgate Cavity Patrol?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That guy was a grifter!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, he conned us good. Well, at least we still have our jobs at the sweepstakes place.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom's gonna wonder where the car went. We'd better have a good story.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's ten in the morning!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lies got us into this mess, son. From now on it's honesty all the way.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You were carjacked in the church parking lot?!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Absolutely. We had stopped in for a quick prayer, when... Bart, would you call him a crazy man?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Definitely. Well, crazy about carjacking.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What did he look like?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, hmm, let's see, he was foreign and he had some...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wild, bushy hair, like an animal.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Anything else?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, well, he seemed like a loner... kept to himself, mostly.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And he said if we went to the cops, he'd come back for Maggie.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, dear. We don't want that.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Anyhoo, the whole nightmare has really made us sleepy. Let's hit the hay.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie! Homie, wake up! They've captured your crazed foreign carjacker!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh? But that's impossible.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They're arresting him right now!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I didna do it, I tell ya.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: At least let me comb me hair. It's all wild and bushy.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: What do you care, loner?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, look at that. But who called the police?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We did.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: After we got Maggie to a safe house, of course.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ye cannot do this to Willie.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I'm innocent, I tell ya!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They always say they're innocent. It's such a turn-off.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, Willie got arrested 'cause of us!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Course he did, son. He's a filthy crook. Now, let's all hit the hay.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I guess you haven't heard of chloroform.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I was alone in me Unabomber-style shack. I had nothing to do with that carjacking.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: But didn't ya just say...?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, we've got to tell everyone the truth.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see how this plays out.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I told you, my memory is fuzzy. Fuzzy!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, exactly! No, no! I mean, the whole incident is hazy.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, exactly!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey? Mountain Dew?!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad! Tell them!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: When the time is right...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ten years?! But I didna do it!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Suuure, you didna. Now, let's get you to Attica, and we can...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: No!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: You'll never send me up the river!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Daa-ad!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see where he's going with this...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Willie! As your employer, I insist that you...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stop! This has gone on just long enough.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nobody carjacked me. I tried to pull a con and got conned myself. And then I lied to you all! So did Bart.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, players! That's a wrap!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nice work, everybody!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute. This whole thing was a set-up?!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Skinner got shot!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yep. Blanks and a blood pack.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hey, watch it!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What about that bullet hole in your hair?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Squibs!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, we hornswoggled you good.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But what about the guy who took my car?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He's doing "Dreamcoat" at the dinner theater.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe everyone was in on it.

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Willie wasn't!

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute. You're telling me the police force, the TV news, a courthouse full of people, and a popular entertainer had nothing better to do than to teach me and Bart a lesson?

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I know it seems farfetched, even insulting to your intelligence. But, there's a simple and highly satisfying explanation. You see...

title: The Great Money Caper
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cowabunga!

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heh, heh, heh. Tremendous.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lenny, are you watching this?

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Yeah, they really hurt that guy's feelings.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know!

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ready for the circus, Homer?

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Circus?

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The Cirque de Purée. We've had tickets since Septembre.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I wanna watch Bret Favre!

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Homer. They're only in town for eight months, then they're gone!

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I missed one of Jerry's zingers. Now I'll never catch up.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Finally, a circus full of whimsy and wonder.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah, that's way better than fun and excitement.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: As French Canadians, they don't believe in refunds, or exploiting animals for entertainment.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wanted to see 'em fire a gorilla out of a cannon.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just smash it open!

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They always pick the guy with the wires.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look at those exotic positions.

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Watching those women is giving me ideas...

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They made an elephant!

title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
name: Marge Simpson

spoken_words: You know, I'd like to thank God for all my success, even though I never worshipped or believed in Him in any way. But before I sweep up my last spotlight, there's one thing I've gotta say...

name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Over the years I've a lot of "wow," and I've my share of AA-OO-GAH! But there's only one thing I'm ashamed of.

title: Day of the Jackanapes
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Ashamed?

title: Day of the Jackanapes
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: There was a man who used to work for me. A man of grace and humor. But I mistreated him, and drove him to a life of crime. So, wherever you are, I just want to say -- Sideshow Bob, I'm sorry.

spoken_words: Oh yeah, it's good to see the spectacle back in rock.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Did you know it was going to turn into a riot, Dad?

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah... When you've been in as many as I have, you can sense them coming.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Did they ever find Tom Petty's toe?

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What am I, the lost and found?

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, sorry.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There's no need for apologies, guys. You're rock stars! You're supposed to be reckless and destructive, and be celebrated for behavior that would land normal people in jail.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you're very sweet, Mick, but the only rocking I want to do is in my living room chair, surrounded by the world's greatest back-up group, my family.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure you don't miss hanging out with your rock star friends, Dad?

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nah, I've got something to remember 'em by.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Have fun at school, kids.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Mr. Simpson, this zone is for school buses only.

title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Rock and Roll! Woo hoo!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Welcome back to "Animal Survivor."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I hate reality shows...

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A year ago you said they were the greatest thing that ever happened to us.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've grown, you haven't.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Announcer
spoken_words: And now we're back to "Touch the Stove."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't take any more of these shows. If I wanted reality, I'd finally have this lump looked at.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Networks love reality shows because they don't have to pay writers or actors.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid writers and actors, priced yourselves right out of the business. Nice going, geniuses.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, let's get one of those home satellite dishes! Then we can stop suckling on the six-network teat.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Get back, honky cat! Those systems are too expensive.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, we can't pinch pennies on the machine that's going to be raising our children.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, kids. Daddy knows a way to get the money... with no risk.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No problem.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Flanders -- check out my new satellite dish!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Boy, that's Jim Dandy roof candy! I'd love to come over some time and watch that Church Channel.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I bet you would.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, you'd win that bet. Seems like I'm spending all my money on religious pay-per-view. Or as I like to call it, "pray-per-view."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Damn your sparkling wordplay!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: And bless your humble home.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's red wire to red wire. What idiot dreamed that up?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And the Lord said, "Let there be crap."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cool! It's the NBC news feed!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm... feed...

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You get to see what they do during commercial breaks.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Lis, wanna try some satellite TV? We've got Japanese Friends.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
raw_location_text: CENTRAL PERK-STYLE COFFEE SHOP WITH JAPANESE DÉCOR
spoken_words: How about the Clock Channel?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
raw_location_text: CENTRAL PERK-STYLE COFFEE SHOP WITH JAPANESE DÉCOR
spoken_words: Wait a minute, I saw this one.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: CENTRAL PERK-STYLE COFFEE SHOP WITH JAPANESE DÉCOR
spoken_words: Bart, I have to study for the Elementary School Achievement Test. And so do you.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
raw_location_text: CENTRAL PERK-STYLE COFFEE SHOP WITH JAPANESE DÉCOR
spoken_words: Hey, I don't have to study on the weekend.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
raw_location_text: CENTRAL PERK-STYLE COFFEE SHOP WITH JAPANESE DÉCOR
spoken_words: It's Wednesday night!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: CENTRAL PERK-STYLE COFFEE SHOP WITH JAPANESE DÉCOR
spoken_words: Kids, kids, you're both right.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Announcer
raw_location_text: CENTRAL PERK-STYLE COFFEE SHOP WITH JAPANESE DÉCOR
spoken_words: We're back with "Who Wants to Marry An Internet Billionaire!" Uh, no, Millionaire! Oh well, now he's broke.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why don't you turn off the TV and join us for dessert? I made a pie.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Put pie here.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Would you like some ice cream with that?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Me not pig.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Announcer
spoken_words: We now return to "Robo Trumble." Oh, I'm sorry, I mean "Robot Rumble."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Homicidal robots... so like us.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, the test is in two hours. And you haven't slept in a fortnight.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's a fortnight?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You should know, it's on the test!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: No pressure, children, but these test results will follow you... for the rest of your life and beyond the grave.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now let's raise the roof for the bland informative rap of M. C. Safety and the Caution Crew!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Heh-heh-heh, watch out Beatles! Now I have one more important announcement to share with you. Would Lisa Simpson join me on stage?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lisa, because of your outstanding score on yesterday's big test, you're being immediately moved up to... the third grade!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She's not so great! She got diarrhea when we went to Carlsbad Caverns!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Okay Bart, since you like attention so much, I have a second announcement.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I was going to tell you this privately, but... because of your incredibly low test score, we're sending you back to third grade.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What? I've gotta be in the same class as her?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What? I've gotta be in the same class as him?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They're gonna be in the same class as each other?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: An old army buddy is visiting Mannix?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, the sun rises in the east, so the rooster would probably want to lay it on the cool side...

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Roosters don't lay eggs. They're boys.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mm-hm.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw haw.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Laughin' at jerks.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Quiet nerds burp only near school.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I'm doing my geography homework.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I know. That's how you remember the four original provinces of Canada: Quebec, New Brunswick, Ontario, Nova Scotia -- "Quiet nerds burp only near school." And here's how you remember the principal exports: "Dogs eat barf solely on Wednesday, Mabel."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop, I want to learn on my own!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Canada's Governors General: "Clowns love haircuts; so should Lee Marvin's valet."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Get out!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's this weird mark next to my "A"?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: M-m-minus?!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: An "A"? Copacetic.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You did better than me?!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, I took this test last year. The answer key never changes. B-C-B-C-A-A-B-B-C-C-D-False-False-True-William Jennings Bryan.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's cheating! Bart cheated!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, look what I got you for your third grade field trip -- matching fanny packs!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now your fannies match.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, get away from me! / Quit it! Ow! / Ew! / Quit it! / Stop! / Ow! / Let go!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop! You'll crush your juice boxes!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll take Kyle!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll take Ashley!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Punch buggy red!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! You are such an immature-- punch buggy white!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ow!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He started it! He did Punch Buggy first!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: When you see a Volkswagen Bug, you punch somebody and yell the color.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Big fish! Big fish!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The Capital City Goofball?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homework on a field trip? What have you been huffin'?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Bart's being his usual jerky self... but Mom, I'm really excited about this new flag design. Oh, and the hotel gives you a free USA Today outside your room... No, I'm sure it's free... Okay, I won't touch it.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, make sure you don't. And try not to let your brother get under your skin.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Believe me, he doesn't. His act is getting old fast.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He thinks he's really cool, but frankly the other kids are starting to wake up and smell the cooties.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: One last sunbeam... and we're done.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "To Fraternal Love".

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The status quo.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: When I get through with that flag, it's gonna be a Bart Mangled Banner.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We would, Governor Bailey! Team Simpson!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I spearheaded this one.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, how could you? The governor is crying.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw haw!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Biked.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I am so mad at you!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You should have seen the look on your face. It was something like this.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The bus!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wait! Wait!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ha-ha, they left without you.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They left without you too, you idiot.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: If I'm such an idiot, how come I'm the smartest kid in the third grade?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Because you've already done it once.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You've lost me.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, forget it. Hey, how do we get back?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No problem. We'll just circle around like those kids in "The Blair Witch Project."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I must be getting close! I recognize that girl.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Bart, I think we're lost.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I used to be lost. Until a friend turned me onto a book. A book that changed my life. It's called "Lisa is Stupid."

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You die now!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: There, there, Audrey. It's happened to all of us.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Willie, we have two more names for the wall.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ach... Why is it always the kids with the long names?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Principal Skinner.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: A-parent-who-waives-her-right-to-sue-says-what?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Got it.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you can't fool us. We're from the "Learn to Fart" state.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart and Lisa are lost in Capital City and presumed crying.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My poor babies!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'm so sorry. Lisa's a very special little girl, and we'll spare no expense in finding her.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, what about Bart?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: We're looking. But in the meantime, the Class Clown Pro Tem will take his place.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Cowabungaaa!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You cold?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What do you care?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks. Where'd you get?...

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you're my big brother. You should act like it more often. You know, protect me from the bad things in the world.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, as far as nerdy little sisters go, you're the coolest.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Bart.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And I'm sorry I sabotaged your flag.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry I got us lost out here.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, and I'm sorry I sawed the heads off your Malibu Stacy dolls. Okay, you go.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think I've done anything else.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I'll go again. Remember when your bike was mangled by "gypsies?"

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, funny story. One day, I was really bored. And Dad had left the steam roller idling in the driveway...

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is where the kids were last seen.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The plastic casing from the tip of Bart's shoelace! A mother knows!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he's not gonna get very far without that.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, is that you?

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Lord, please strike these mountain folk dead--

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Listen, we're really sorry. We got lost on a field trip from Springfield Elementary!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks for driving us back to town.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry. They don't publish that any more.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my special little guys. You're okay, you're okay!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And Maggie, you no longer have to live with the burden of replacing Bart and Lisa.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, if this episode has taught us anything, it's that nothing works better than the status quo. Bart, you're promoted back to the fourth grade.

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yay!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: And Lisa, you have a choice. You may continue to be challenged in third grade, or return to second grade and be merely a big fish in a small pond--

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: The status quo? Ay carumba!

title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: That's just sad.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dew-ey! Dew-ey! Dew-ey!

title: Large Marge
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I'm telling you, Truman wins.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! I win the bet! Who's your Daddy?

title: Large Marge
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Harry Truman triumphs by two million votes.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not if I can stop that inauguration!

title: Large Marge
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I win, Dad. That means I get to choose today's father-daughter activity!

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's hear it.

title: Large Marge
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We're building homes for the homeless.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know it's gonna be bad, but you just can't prepare yourself.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Domiciles for the Destitute? Is this that thing that Jimmy Carter does?

title: Large Marge
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, but now that it's hip, all the ex-presidents are doing it.

title: Large Marge
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: There's Clinton, Bush Senior, and the nice guy who finished last, Jimmy himself.

title: Large Marge
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, what is that?

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if Bart can be "El Barto"...

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, thanks...

title: Large Marge
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you're getting paint on your wedding ring.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh? Oh, right. Can you hold it?

title: Large Marge
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This is a Band-Aid wrapped in tin foil.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My real ring's inside a turtle.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can I help you?

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: DAD LEFT THE MILK OUT / YUCK YUCK YUCK YUCK YUCK...

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's good satire -- it doesn't hurt anyone. What do you think, Maggie?

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, look. There's your father.

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I've read enough articles about flirting to know it when I see it.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ... And that's how my beautiful wife brought our son Bart into the world.

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, Homie, are you as attracted to me as you were when we met?

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure, why not?

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sometimes I worry you might think about other women.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, why would I want Purina when I've got Fancy Feast right here?

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That doesn't sound very convincing.

title: Large Marge
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, it sounds like all you're looking for is a little reassurance. Well...

title: Large Marge
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Bart, remember when I was crying at recess? Well, I think I'm finally ready to tell you why.

title: Large Marge
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see what's on TV.

title: Large Marge
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh cool, the old "Batman" show.

title: Large Marge
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Sweet Valley High! Krusty played a Batman villain?

title: Large Marge
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, sure. He was also Uncle Velderschmoink on "Bewitched."

title: Large Marge
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cool! We should try that at school!

title: Large Marge
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey yeah, you can try it on me. Batman got out of it okay.

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Manjula, remember when Apu cheated on you?

title: Large Marge
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm worried Homer might do the same thing. What would make a husband lose interest like that?
