spoken_words: Look, I'm the first to admit it. I don't write good parts for women.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I'm a robber!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: All this does is shoot bubbles.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Aggh! Silly String!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, I'll go find your mother.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, we're canceling the rest of the play.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: What play? What the hell are you talking about?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm gonna sleep down here tonight.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Listen kids, your Mom is going to be living in the basement. But with our love, she'll get better soon.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What if she doesn't?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then we'll have to smoke her out.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, guys? Mom just left the basement!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: And may the peace of God be with you, amen.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Amen. Over.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Breaker, breaker. Bartman to shut-in. The big guy's asleep. Please advise. Over.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Whack him with the hymnal. Over.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I roger that big time.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little... oh, hi Jesus. I was just...

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow honey, eating dinner downstairs is great! Isn't it, kids?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The air hockey table makes passing the carrots a breeze.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, eat your spinach.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No way.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes way!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stop it, please! I'm trying to eat.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And all those feet going by the window are really creeping me out.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's like we're at Cheers. I loved that show. Because you always knew it was only a half hour till "Wings." Then you could just sleep till Monday.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: 'Bye, Mom!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sending the cat up with your lunches.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Goodbye kids.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What to do now. Too crazy to go outside, not crazy enough to have imaginary friends.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why did Homer buy those? No one's ever gonna use 'em.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ten... E-le-ven... TWELVE!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can bench twice as much as when I started! And look at my abs!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow-wooh-wooh-wooh! I'm married to Joey Heatherton.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, you know what would zest up this hollandaise? A lemon!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, do you plan to get in shape?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, actually, I'm going to eat twice as much.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I got all the way out to the tree before I realized I'd left the house.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm stronger than I've ever been! I don't have to go back inside. I'm not afraid!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Alright Mom! / Yay, Mom! / Woo hoo!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not afraid!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ned, I'm not afraid!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, aren't you a super-duper recouper.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa! I'm not afraid!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Then you're not paying close enough attention!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not any more!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You've just been Marge-inalized!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, that was amazing! It's like I'm married to Shaft.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Yep, looks like she caught her own criminal. Unlike the rest of you lazybones.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: You're not gonna find those criminals looking at your feet, people.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ruth Powers, my old neighbor? Oh, my goodness, look at you!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wow!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't have those kind of muscles.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Steroids!?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't take drugs -- I have so many anti-drug bumper stickers. I'd be making a liar out of my tailgate.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But aren't there side effects?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, no!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I feel good... with no repercussions!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A little of this and a little of that. Bulkenoids for my lats, mesomax for my delts, and estrogen blockers for that minty taste.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hurry up kids, you'll miss the bus!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not so fast, busboy!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bye Mom!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bye, kids! Bye, bye!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw-haw! Your mom changed!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, hot stuff. I've got a competition tomorrow. I could use a good-luck snuggle.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'd rather talk about our feelings. I feel that illegal performance-enhancing drugs are too common these days. Rebuttal?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Let's do it!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Listen, my bulky flower, I-I have an early day...

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wasn't asking.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Mornin' kids! I made your lunches. They're on the table.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Huh? Why didn't Mom make our lunch?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your mom has a lot of stuff to shave.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow... Ow... Ow... Oww...

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Now let's meet the ladies who our doctors assure us are women: the Iron Maidens!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ay carumba! I'm off women forever.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Announcer
spoken_words: In second place: Marge Simpson!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Second place!? Oh man, this'll just encourage her.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm tired of her criticizing my saggy glutes.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Quiet, her muscular ears can hear us.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So then I pop my delts, clench and bam! Not a dry eye in the house.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'm so proud of you, honey. You bulked up, but managed to keep your femininity.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And that's why I didn't win!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, sir, sorry.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Starting tomorrow, I'm gonna up my glyco-load, use a denser ripping gel...

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Denser?!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Damn straight, I didn't sacrifice my period for second place!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I hear that.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, listen Marge, how can I put this delicately? I don't got enough booze in this place to make you look good.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe death will stop your yammering!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Marge, easy!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Everyone pile on Homer's wife!

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Somewhere in that sea of bull hormones is the sweet, wonderful girl I married. The woman who instead of swatting a fly, will give it a bath and send it on its way. I'd sure like to go home and have Jiffy Pop with her.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my gosh, you're right: steroids have turned me into everything I hate. Let's go home, Sweetie.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Club soda will get that blood out.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, there's only one way to recoup my losses.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Whoa, Moe. Wait a minute. Don't you have to buy insurance first?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, crap.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know, I really do miss being a lady.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I miss being your knight in flabby armor.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homie.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ready for a real workout, Marge?

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mm-hmm.

title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good. Can you wax the car? Ow! Ow! Ow! I'm kidding! I'm kidding!

title: Pray Anything
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, it's so enlightened of you to take us to a WNBA game.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, well, nachos are nachos.

title: Pray Anything
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa! Check out Janeane Giraffe-alo.

title: Pray Anything
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's Fung Pang-Li, the seven-foot sensation from Szechwan!

title: Pray Anything
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Szechwan, eh? No wonder she's so spicy.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you're a little young to be growling at seven foot Chinese ladies.

title: Pray Anything
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Fine, I'll go back to being bored.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, I wonder what it would be like to be with a woman like that.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm... Farfetched.

title: Pray Anything
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look! That's Lisa Leslie! She showed little girls everywhere that they can grow up to be six foot five!

title: Pray Anything
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa Leslie, you got game!

title: Pray Anything
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You go girl!

title: Pray Anything
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Now here's something for the men to dribble over, our mascot, Swish!

title: Pray Anything
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ooh, I can see her logo and everything.

title: Pray Anything
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, come back. Hey, I love you!

title: Pray Anything
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Pray Anything
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Put the head back on.

title: Pray Anything
name: Announcer
spoken_words: And now, its time for our Fifty Thousand Dollar Half-Court Shot.

title: Pray Anything
name: Announcer
spoken_words: The winning fan is in Section A,

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes...

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes...

title: Pray Anything
name: Announcer
spoken_words: ... Seat 16!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Praise the Lord, my seat has scored!

title: Pray Anything
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, this ticket is for tomorrow's WNFL game!

title: Pray Anything
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The Cowgirls versus the She-gles. No love lost there.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think my leg is broken.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You betcha. It's a nice break from the male sports I usually watch.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh sure, speed walking, ballroom dancing, rhythmic gymnastics, extreme choir...

title: Pray Anything
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Can't we just pretend you're really a girl?

title: Pray Anything
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: The rest of our lives.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Gosh, fifty thousand dollars? I'm donating this whole check to "Bibles for Belgians."

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess Flanders doesn't have all the luck.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, hot dog!

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: That cuts the mustard with me.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's not fair. I always wanted to drive a food-shaped car.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: The steering wheel is a giant onion ring!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They thought of everything! How come all the good things happen to Jesus H. Nice? By which I mean Flanders!

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What are you doing?

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The grass is actually greener on Flanders' side.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's because you keep passing out on our lawn.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No that's not it. He's got some secret. And I'm gonna find out what it is, no matter what it takes.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders, what's your secret? You never get arrested, you don't buy your clothes at "Mr. Blob" and look at your beautiful lawn. It sickens me.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, whatever I've got I owe to hard work, honest living, and flossing my teeth, tail and toes. Plus a little prayer now and then.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So that's all it takes, a little prayer.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ugh, where's the remote?

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, since I don't have the remote, I can just get up and change the channel.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute. I'll do what Flanders does.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: O, Merciful God, who has blessed mankind with two kinds of clam chowder, help me find the remote.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There it is.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Die, monster!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It worked! I got my wish! From now on, I'll pray till my hands are chapped and bleeding.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: O Lord, please guide that diaper into someone's schnozz.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Vengeful God / Loving God. Vengeful God / Loving God. Vengeful God / Loving God. Vengeful God / Loving God. I could do this all day. And I just might. Vengeful God / Loving God. Vengeful God / Loving God.

title: Pray Anything
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Setting up a prayer station, eh, Homer?

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, I used to think God only helped professional athletes and Grammy winners. But now I realize he helps shmoes like me, too, Carl.

title: Pray Anything
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Makes sense to me. Ooh, by the way, did you see the judging in the monkey figure skating? Whose banana you gotta peel to get a five point nine? Could not believe that.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dear Lord, as I think of you, dressed in white with your splendid beard, I am reminded of Colonel Sanders, who is now seated at your right hand, shoveling popcorn chicken into thy mouth. Lord, could you come up with a delicious new taste treat like he did? I command you!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm. Move over eggs. Bacon just got a new best friend: Fudge.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh heavenly God, my son is plagued with homework. With your vast knowledge of the shore birds of Maryland, I know you can help him.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, God isn't some kind of holy concierge. You can't keep bugging Him for every little thing.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can and will. Now to un-stop this sink.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lord, please use your space-age, clog-busting powers on this stubborn drain. Then take some time off for yourself. Fly to France. Have a nice dinner.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll just call a plumber.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Lord, I see thou art working through thy imperfect vessel, Marge. For thou art most wise...

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know, most people pray silently.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, he's way the Hell up there.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How bad is it?

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we could live with a stopped-up drain.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You was hiding behind the drywall. Yes you were! I'm glad Social Services didn't see this. Yes I am!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, you coughed up some dry wall.

title: Pray Anything
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, are you hurt?

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So that's your answer! I'll sue the church!

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, we can't sue the church. They'll poke fun at us in the church bulletin.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It wouldn't be the first time.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I couldn't help it. Those pews are so comfortable.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer, please don't sue the church. I'm asking you as your friend and neighbor.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can I borrow your pen to sign this deposition?

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Okely dokely.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Why do I always give in to him?

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: It's his skull. It's hypnotic!

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Morning, Judge. How is your lovely wife?

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't see anything in this fog.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo! Can I get that in lottery tickets, please?

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Your Honor, we don't have that kind of money. We're not a synagogue.

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: You're giving him the church?

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He's not giving it to me, God is. Because I prayed for it.

title: Pray Anything
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I think this might be the work of Satan.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's all good.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, for the last time...

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Please give the church back.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That is gonna drive me nuts.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, this church is our only option. Don't you kids want to live here?

title: Pray Anything
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Anything's better than that dump we came from.

title: Pray Anything
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And there are so many places to cloister myself!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The dog's on board, too.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw... he thinks he's papal.

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Well, the court has spoken, so... here you go. The baptismal font tends to run, you have to jiggle the handle. Oh, and Wednesday is garbage day.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sweet.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so sorry, Reverend.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: And Rev, you'll be bunkin' with me!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I love this song.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I WAS MADE FOR LOVING YOU, BABY / YOU WERE MADE FOR LOVING ME...

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I CAN'T GET ENOUGH OF YOU, BABY...

title: Pray Anything
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, there's a bunch of people in the Community Outreach Center.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll just see about that.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so sorry for all your horrible problems, but this is our dog's room now.

title: Pray Anything
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You can come to my church.

title: Pray Anything
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Saint Paulie Girls' Cathedral.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, that was not very Christian of you.

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're right, Marge. I'll make it up to them. By throwing the bitchin-est beer bash this church has ever seen!

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bless you, bless you, how you doin'?

title: Pray Anything
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Wow Homer, this is like a party Dick Clark would throw.

title: Pray Anything
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, fun, but not too fun.

title: Pray Anything
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: So where's Marge?

title: Pray Anything
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: She went to Lovejoy's temporary church. She's worried about her immortal soul.

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: He said to his disciples...

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: In these times that test our faith, the Lord will be a holy sh...ining light unto us all.

title: Pray Anything
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, heh heh, sorry Padre. I didn't mean to embarrass you in front of the goyim.

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: As I was saying, if we keep our hearts pure we can-- Dr. Hibbert, must you play the claw machine?

title: Pray Anything
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: I'll be right there. I've almost got me a kitty cat.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I really enjoyed your sermon. Particularly the part about the pin in the gutter on lane fifteen.

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: That wasn't me, that was the manager.

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure? Because it really spoke to me.

title: Pray Anything
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Marge, it's as plain as the bruise on my shin -- there's no place for me here.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Where you going, Reverend? The town's that way. Reverend? You're goin' the wrong way!

title: Pray Anything
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, Ned. Looks like God has packed up and left Springfield.

title: Pray Anything
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: No, no, you're lying! You're lying! What makes you lie?

title: Pray Anything
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Good evening. Springfield is still grappling tonight with the departure of Reverend Timothy Lovejoy. Local bible nut.

spoken_words: I want to thank you all so much.

title: Brake My Wife, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're welcome. And now Marge, we cooked, you clean.

title: Brake My Wife, Please
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What?!

title: Brake My Wife, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Only teasing. We've flown in the finest busboys from France... I mean, America!

title: Brake My Wife, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And now, to all my dear friends, I say... get the Hell out of my yard.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I hear those kids' voices are done by grownups.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, there's nothing wrong with that. I just wonder how they keep it so fresh after forty-three episodes.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Cartoon violence! Cartoon violence!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: They wrote all the songs on Maggie's baby records.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, that cartoon's not life-affirming. We're going to watch a show about the everyday problems of angels.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I'm bored.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I've got an idea. Let's tie a string around a fly.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Cool. Do you think bugs feel pain?

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: If they don't, I've wasted a lot of my life.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I wish I could fly. Then I'd be the most popular kid in school.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Knowing you, you'd mess it up somehow.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The fly's stuck in Flanders' house!

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I'll go contact the nearest adult!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There's no time. We're going in!

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: My eyeglass repair kit!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Let it go.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, what do you know, cats eat flies.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Sometimes I wish a cat would eat me.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dude, we're in Flanders' house -- unsupervised.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Wow! Let's go nuts!

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Bright, brighter, brightest... off, bright, brighter, brightest... off.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That is so gay.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: These losers are out of peanut butter.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I know how to make some.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Peanuts... butter... now, we just put the top on...

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I didn't get where I am putting tops on things.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Now let's make jelly!

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I feel like luge silver medalist Barbara Niedernhuber!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, Mr. Flanders is really into the Beatles.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: What are the Beatles?

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who is he talking to?

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: John Lemon, Orange Harrison, Paul McIced Tea, Mango Starr? Hey Bart, how 'bout a blast from the past?

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: A forty-year-old novelty beverage? Hand it over!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yellow matter custard... dripping from a dead dog's eye...

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I don't feel so fab.

title: The Bart of War
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, the folks at the senior center sure will love that peach tree we planted.

title: The Bart of War
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Sin of pride, Roddy.

title: The Bart of War
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Sin of regret.

title: The Bart of War
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: The house is slightly askew! To the panic room!

title: The Bart of War
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Scared of what? All the funny camp songs we're gonna sing? WE'LL BE SAFE INSIDE OUR FORTRESS WHEN THEY COME / WE'LL BE SAFE FROM CREEPS AND KILLERS WHEN THEY COME / UNLESS THEY HAVE A BLOWTORCH / OR A POISON GAS INJECTOR / THEN I DON'T KNOW WHAT'LL HAPPEN WHEN THEY COME!

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Okay, home invaders! We don't want to hurt you -- we just want to talk.

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I thought the divorce was final.

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right, let's just move in.

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right, perps. We know you're in here somewhere.

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, well, well. Looks like a couple of punks are gonna be taking the last train to Clarksville.

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Go wait in the car.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Please don't call our parents!

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I'm afraid I have to for hijinks like these. Heh. "Hijinks." Funny word. Three dotted letters in a row.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I AM HOMER TRIBAL CHIEF / I AM WEARING TINY BRIEFS / BRAVES TEACH VALUE BOYS SHOULD KNOW / NOW EXTENDED DRUM SO-LO

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: It used to be. Back in the bad old days. Of course, every generation hyphenates the way it wants to. Then there's NSYNC. Ha. What the Hell is that? Jump in any time, Eddie. These are good topics.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ned, I am so sorry.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I never knew you were such a Beatles fan.

title: The Bart of War
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Of course I am. They were bigger than Jesus! But your boy went Yoko and broke up my collection.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, boys will be boys.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I am so tired of that tautology.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's not all his fault. I blame this latchkey kid.

title: The Bart of War
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: People, people. Calm down. Both these kids are total write-offs. Uh, I assume you're pressing charges. Because I get paid by the charge.

title: The Bart of War
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh our courts aren't fit to keep children in line. The only thing they're good for is telling women what to do with their bodies. What these boys need is adult supervision.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You are so right, Ned. There won't be a single minute where Bart's not under the watchful eye of myself or... Homer, get over here!

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at me, I'm Brian Epstein!

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now I'm Michael Jackson. I own all your songs, losers. Hee, hee, hee.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here are some supervised activities we can all do together. Future Veterans of Foreign Wars, The 5-H Club...

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Five-H?

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They had to admit homosexuals.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How come I'm not doing this stuff with Milhouse?

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You won't be seeing Milhouse for a while. Something about that boy just shakes up your soda. Ooh, this looks interesting: The Pre-Teen Braves.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, these freaks do a lot of cool stuff. "Cookouts, hayrides, bowling..."

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just like real Indians!

title: The Bart of War
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, maybe you could lead Bart's tribe.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You mean like some sort of madman?

title: The Bart of War
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ideally no, but...

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll do it!

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I will now give each of you your specially selected tribal name.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I am "Burger With Fries." Man, is that uninspired.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see. What Native American activities should we do? Making wallets... faking crop circles... respecting nature... jeez, no wonder these guys lost the Civil War.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Lazy Horse! Find us something cool to do.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The noble Chiefs outsmarted the treacherous Cowboys with a seven-yard screen pass. Unfortunately, after further review, the great father in the sky determined that the receiver's moccasins were out of bounds. I shall bet no more forever.

title: The Bart of War
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think Dad is accurately portraying Native American life.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Indians don't sit around drinking beer and watching TV.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I smell smoke.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Without the talking stick, we don't hear you.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I smell smoke.

title: The Bart of War
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I see you Braves received our smoke signal.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Wow! / Neat-o! / Awesome!

title: The Bart of War
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh no! The Pawnee have returned. They probably want their souls back.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow Mom, I wish you were our tribe leader.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hail to our new Chief! The surprisingly hot Mrs. Simpson.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, thank you. I'm gonna make sure you boys have the best possible Pre-Teen Brave experience.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I was chosen by the Great Spirit to teach these young braves the ways of the antelope and the ear of corn... which we call maize... that the papoose... eh, I'll be at Moe's talking normal.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Nelson, leggings?

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: No way! If my old man sees me in these, he'll kill me.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You haven't seen your dad in years.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, today might be the day!

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Poppa, is that you? You came back from the store!

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Let's admire Nelson's love of nature.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Poppa! Poppa! Never leave me again!

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right. Everyone inside. Let's go.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Our nature walk will be hosted by a full-blooded Native American. Say hello to Jim Proudfoot from the Mohican tribe.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mohican? I thought you guys were all gone.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, treadmill! How do you like this incline?

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I'm giving it back to the earth.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What are we gonna do to that field?

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And why are we gonna do it?

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yay!

title: The Bart of War
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so proud of what you guys are doing. I even tipped off the local paper.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Let's go, boys. Make sure you use Pine Sol on those pine trees, for that pine fresh smell.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Poppa?

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh for God's sake, I can see why he left. Now all of you, get cleaning.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! Some jerks cleaned our field!

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: It's awful. It looks like Wisconsin!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "Cavalry Kids?" That's pathetic.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: We're the bad boys of non-denominational community youth groups.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, surely there's room in this town for two well-meaning juvenile associations.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Then I guess this means war.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Those Cavalry Kids are bigger credit hogs than the Red Cross.

title: The Bart of War
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I must disagree, Mrs. Bart. They've painted this town with a fresh coat of give-a-hoot.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well you ain't seen nothin' till you've seen the Pre-Teen Braves.

title: The Bart of War
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Pre-Teen Braves? Is this another of those youth groups that apes the cultures of those indigenous peoples you invaded and destroyed?

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Exactly. The Pre-Teen Braves.

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This is a perfect opportunity. We'll beat those Cavalry Kids by selling candy!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "We will crush you and smother your dreams. Yours in Christ, the Cavalry Kids."

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you were an excellent peace-time Chief. But these times call for men of cruelty.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's too tight! Take it off! Take it off! Take it off!

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Men of cruelty.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Bart. Back up the truck.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Mr. Leonard, Mr. Carlson? Would you like to buy some candy bars for charity?

title: The Bart of War
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Oh sure. We were just gonna buy the same candy inside the store, but for less.

title: The Bart of War
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Aw man, that went south quick. I gotta find a bathroom.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Candy for sale!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Get your un-poisoned candy!

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's laxative-free for today's lifestyle!

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Melts in your mouth, not in your pants!

title: The Bart of War
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Greetings, fellow Springfielders. It gives me great pleasure to announce the group which has sold the most candy. Could everyone please lean forward expectantly.

title: The Bart of War
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: ...The Cavalry Kids!

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute. How could those stupid jar-heads win?

title: The Bart of War
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Who'd want candy filled with laxatives?

title: The Bart of War
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Holy moly, I'm movin' like Ginger Rogers!

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Looks like this is one time the Indians didn't win.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, that's it. They've beaten us.

title: The Bart of War
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: At least we made a lot of people sick.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well I'm not finished. Where does it say we have to be gracious in defeat?

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's on the back of our vests.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, remove that stitching.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: People will do anything a sign tells them.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, that slaked my thirst.

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Or did it?

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Dad, we're gonna be late for the game.

title: The Bart of War
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Welcome fans of America's favorite pastime... baseball? Here to perform the National Anthem are today's honorary bat boys, the Cavalry Kids, led by Milhouse Van Houten!

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: After this prank, everyone's gonna hate those Cavalry Clods as much as we do.

title: The Bart of War
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, show some respect! My dad died in some war!

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: It's a hoax! I'm the real Milhouse!

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Time to knock off this knockoff!

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You talk pretty tough for a man without health insurance!

title: The Bart of War
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Jeez, I don't remember this much bad blood when I was a Cavalry Kid.

title: The Bart of War
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I was a Pre-Teen Brave!

title: The Bart of War
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: I sang at your wedding.

title: The Bart of War
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Yeah, "The Best Is Yet To Come," real original.

title: The Bart of War
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw geez, how did this happen?

title: The Bart of War
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All I wanted was to glue feathers on felt and teach the boys good citizenship. And now it's a donnybrook!

title: The Bart of War
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, that's my wife, and she's crying.

title: The Bart of War
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Oh, Lassie, dry your tears.

title: The Bart of War
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ow! Ow! God help me!

title: The Bart of War
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I ain't doin' any fighting.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: How you got in my carpool I'll never know.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well, Bart. We've learned that war is not the answer.

title: The Bart of War
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Except to all of America's problems.

title: The Bart of War
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Amen.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Does anyone else want to know why that sign is so funny?

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, we're gonna be late to the blooming of the Sumatran Century Flower.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How come Lisa always gets to pick the family activities?

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Because I know every time you say "pick a number from one to ten," it's always seven.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's because there were seven apostles.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, there were twelve.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, that's a big staff. And still he wasn't that funny.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The Venus Flytrap is a carnivorous plant which uses bait to lure unsuspecting prey into its digestive tract...

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid prey. They never suspect anything.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, a hotdog!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flower power my ass.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That's odd. It's eleven fifteen in the morning and the bar is empty.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: I'm live at Springfield Botanical Gardens, where we're minutes away from the blossoming of the Sumatran Century Flower, which only occurs once every hundred years.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, those are my customers-slash-only friends! Where are they getting their beer?

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: A cooler! I've been replaced by a cooler!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And who could blame 'em?

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Eh, no point in mopin' around. I might as well join 'em and have a jolly old time.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Better set the alarm.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Here I am, one of the crowd. I'm comfortable I'm calm. If anybody looks at me I got a hypodermic full of bleach.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Um, people, we are officially over capacity. We've got to kick one person out. Someone who's alone, already bitter, someone whose feelings have been trampled on so many times one more won't make any... Oh, Moe!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, that's me all right.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Sorry, Moe. You can either walk out with dignity, or I can push you down this muddy hill.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'd prefer that you push me. Seein' how I'm desperate for any human contact.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Thanks a lot.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The flower's starting to open!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Man, the plant cut one!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, plants don't-- wheww!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Argh, that smells worse than James Coco's ski boots!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh yeah. That's mildly better.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Listen to those lucky people, enjoying that pretty flower. I got nothin' -- just this can.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: At least there's someone worse off than me.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So long, suckers!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Well, at least we're outside instead of sittin' home watchin' TV.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I hear that. Hey, that car has a TV in it!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Announcer
spoken_words: We now return to "The Beverly Hillbillies Down Under".

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You still got us, Moe.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Can you put on the baseball game?

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: My kids are watching a movie!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: C'mon, help a brother out.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Why don't you call my secretary and make an appointment, "brother"?

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: A dream deferred is a dream denied!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, the traffic's moving.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo! Pedal to the metal!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My baby!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your baby!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: NOOOOOOOOOO!

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, this is it. The last call for Moe. God. God, God...

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Whaaa--?

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe! Thank God you saved my baby...

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Heh. Life don't seem so hard no more.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Maggie's in the paper with Moe. How cute.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at those pants. They're standing up with no one in them.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, I was in the neighborhood and uh, thought I'd, y'know, check in on Maggie.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, I'm glad you're here! I wanted to thank you so much for saving my baby, so I knitted you a nice warm sweater.

title: Moe Baby Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
