spoken_words: Thanks for the meatloaf recipe. I claim it as my own.

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Mona, I'll always remember raspberry trolley cars... because my mind is shot.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bear?!

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your last act as a mom was to make me a better dad. But at least now I'll never lose you again.

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, it's two in the morning.

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I couldn't sleep, because I thought there might be a sign of my Mom in one of these articles. They never did find her body.

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Then what was in the coffin?

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Last week's garbage. I missed the pick-up date. But it doesn't matter, because my Mom is alive. See?

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words:
"I-M-O--,i-m-o--,1
91096,315,285,Homer Simpson: --K". Get it? "I am OK."

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Homie. If it makes you feel better, I think your Mom's all right, too.

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, as long as we're thinking about her, Grandma's still alive.

title: My Mother the Carjacker
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, big guy. This'll help you get to sleep.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh boy, casino night! Finally, they'll teach our kids the dangers of doubling down on a six.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I really shouldn't be here -- I have a problem with games of chance. I played Candyland with Maggie and ended up throwing vodka in her face.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw Marge, I bet you've gotten that out of your system.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bet... system... betting system! God is telling me to gamble!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Deal! Hit me! Hit me! Hit me! Busted!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so proud of you Lisa.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Congratulations Mr. Student Body President -- your casino night is a huge success.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: That was always on too late for me.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll put everything on lucky seventeen.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo! Woo-hoo!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And the winner is, seventeen!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I win!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is it, baby. First thing tomorrow, we're getting a Playstation One!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'd like to cash in these chips. Give me most of it in cash and the rest in suitcases to carry the cash.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I'll be bringin' sparkplugs to chuck at people I don't like. Like you!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I'm up two hundred thousand dollars! Give me my money!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You think I won't manhandle a little boy?!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Look at me! I'm a big man!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: But I break... just like a little girl.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, this was a disaster.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Care for a milk?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Martin, in light of this fiasco, you're going to have to resign as president.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Easy there. That's whole milk.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, I guess we're gonna need a new student body president.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Uh... yes, we all are.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey... student body president...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I could join past presidents. Like Otto... or Krusty!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nelson, you're running for President?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I'm not sayin' I have all the answers. But I do have all the answer keys. To every test.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Fractions? Dinosaurs? Foreign money? The first Thanksgiving?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Nelson, what are you doing?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Real estate license exam?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: My ticket to freedom!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm doomed.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't beat Nelson.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why don't you start a rumor that he's...ding-a-ling-a-ling hello-oo!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, what a delicious quiche! I drive a pink Miata.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe Nelson is more popular than me.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: La, la, la...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, you could be popular, you've just got to be yourself... in a whole new way.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, I'm gonna stick to my platform of incremental policy amelioration: fluoridated water fountains, vegan lunch options...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My name is Nelthon! I use a thalad fork. La-dee-dah! I wash my face!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Where did you get that tutu?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Clothesline.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ... and we deserve a French teacher who actually speaks French. J'accuse, Monsieur Kupferberg!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I rest my case.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Nelson, rebuttal?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Yo everyone, it's me, Nelson.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: My pleasure, Sir.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'M NOT THAT COOL, I DON'T WEAR JEANS / I'VE POLISHED AN APPLE OR TWO / BUT EVERY GRADE THAT I GRUBBED, I GRUBBED IT FOR YOU... / SO CALL ME BOOKWORM / BUT I'LL NEVER SQUIRM, WHEN THERE'S WORK TO BE DONE / YES I'LL TAKE MY LUNCH AT MY DESK / WHILE YOU'RE ALL OUTSIDE HAVING FUN...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: DON'T VOTE FOR ME, KIDS OF SPRINGFIELD / UNLESS YOU WANT AN EFFECTIVE LEADER / I'LL TALK TO TEACHERS / I'LL HANDLE SKINNER / A VOTE FOR LISA / MAKES YOU THE WINNER...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, I've got a song too.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I AM IRON MAN DO DO DO DO DO DO DO VOTE FOR ME... Eh, screw it.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: "Lisa..." "Lisa..." "Lisa..." Wow, she even beat perennial write-in candidate "Skinner Sucks."

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skinner!! I'm worried. This girl is extremely popular and thinks for herself. She's like a female Eleanor Roosevelt.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The students will do anything she says. She's captured their imagination like a bright piece of construction paper.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Hm, yeah. Well we've got to find a way to control her.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Hey, maybe that escaped mental patient you hired has some sort of toxin in his shack...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Yes, hello Willie.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Well, if you ask me, a woman's weakness is her sense of vanity.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Vanity? You might have something there, Edna.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: So, when's my inauguration?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Hm, let's see, uh, when Hell freezes over, tough guy.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You wanted to see me?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Actually, Lisa...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: I wanted you to see you. You're our President now, but you look like the first lady of "yawn"!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What would you change?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're like Geraldine Ferraro, except you won, where she failed miserably.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I MAY BE THE NEW GIRL / BUT YOU CAN'T BRAINWASH ME / JUST OSH-KOSH-B'GOSH ME / AND THEN LEAVE ME BE /

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: TO FIGHT FOR KID-POWER / I MUST BE HEARD NOT SEEN / I HAVE TO LEAD WISELY / NOT JUST PRIMP AND PREEN!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: THIS CUTE-ING-UP SUITS ME / THERE'S BEAUTY WITHIN ME / SO LET'S OLSEN-TWIN ME / GIVE THEM SOMEONE TO LOVE

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: THIS GROWN-UP MAKEOVER / HAS MADE ME A SUPER-TWEEN / FOR THEY ARE MY PEOPLE / AND I AM THEIR QUEEN!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, you look so successful. Like you're the wife of a businessman.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wish I'd married a businessman. Then I'd have nice things.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's a little over the top, but there's no reason I can't look good and take back the playground from the gypsies.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey, Lisa! Can I get a photo for the front page? It'll either be a picture of you or the drinking fountain that won't stop running.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Make it snappy, Milhouse. I've got an important meeting in the teachers' lounge.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: The teachers' lounge. Is it true they make fun of students in there?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, don't be silly.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Look at me, I'm Milhouse! I tuck me shirt into me underpants!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: And I've got no friends, so I confide in Willie!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh hello, Lisa. We were just uh, discussing Vasco De Gama.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I have some ideas for ways we can improve the classroom experience.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We need to get teachers more involved! Have them meet with struggling kids in the morning before school.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Or, we could hand out teachers' home phone numbers -- ­so kids can call them whenever they have questions.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: I've got a question: you're crazy.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, in the Swedish public schools, the students grade the teachers on their performance--

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Outstanding notions! Each more implementable than the last.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: It's a shame you can't stay to discuss them. Here's your schedule for the day.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Photo op helping Kindergartners take off snow boots..." "Move the brushfire hazard needle..." Um, shouldn't I stay here and work on school policy?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lisa, you were elected to be seen and enjoyed. Don't hide your light in a smoky back room, making dusty old decisions.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I am proud of my light.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: But just in case you want to do any more thinking, I'm proud to present you with an official key to the study hall.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Use it anytime you like.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You mean I can come to the school after hours, weekends, even during the summer?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yes, it's like you're Harry Potter without the magic and wonder. Just sign these authorization forms and you can be on your way.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: That little girl should learn to read things before she signs them.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me? I was wondering if I should read what I just signed.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: No, it's just standard key release boilerplate.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Boy, she'll believe anything.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Key release boilerplate? I find that very hard to believe.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Uh hmm. And yet there it is.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'll just lock this door.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, this key opens everything.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And then, as school president, I don't have to take the hearing test.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I think I can say with all humility, I am gonna be the best school president ever.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Bravo, Lisa. Bra-vo.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, isn't that sweet? Even your brother's adding his kudos.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I was being sarcastic.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You were?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No. I was being sincere.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'm so confused.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lis, Skinner is using you. Like a pawn on his unholy chess set.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: On my chess set, the pawns are all Hamburglars.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'M SO HAPPY WITH MY EVIL PLAN / SAY GOODBYE TO MUSIC, GYM AND ART / SOON WE WILL HAVE THE PERFECT SCHOOL / WHERE FUN AND EXCITEMENT NEVER START!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I'M SO DRUNK I CAN BARELY SEE...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: BUT IT HELPS ME GET THROUGH ANOTHER DAY / MY STOMACH IS FILLED WITH HAGGIS AND HURT / I'VE GOT TO GO PUKE IN SOME HAY.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: LISA IS A FOOL!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I THINK THE RULES ARE COOL!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I'VE FALLEN IN THE POOL!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hmm, not a cloud in the sky -- a perfect day to unveil Operation SLAAAM: So Long Athletics Art And Music. Care for a T-shirt?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: T-shirt? Why don't you just give me a sandwich board that says "Male Prostitute"?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh well... I... Forgive me, sir.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They've taken everything!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I'm doing it! I'm almost to the top! Hello, self-esteem!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "All extra-curricular activities are hereby canceled, to be replaced by nothing."

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Who would sign such an order?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: As ordered by Principal Skinner and approved by student body president Lisa Simpson!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: And to think I was gonna ask you to the dance.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I would have gone with you.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well, you still can.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I don't feel like it now.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: That's cool.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Stupid! Stupid! Stupid!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I'll be cookin' ma Lean Cuisine in your kiln tonight.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: WHAT HAVE I DONE?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: WHAT THEY WANTED YOU TO.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: SKINNER BETRAYED ME!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: BUT A TANGO TAKES TWO!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I almost had a date. I've gotta tell Willie about this.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lis, you made this school even worse. And it wasn't exactly San Diego State to begin with.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They made me pretty and popular just so they could exploit me and ruin my good name.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, you've got to stand up to these guys. And when you do, people will remember you. Just look at these postage stamps.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There's Bugs Bunny... Fat Elvis... Autumn in New England... Bats of the Southwest... all heroes. Wanna see Elvis kiss a bat? Hey baby come here lemme kiss you...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Squeak, squeak, squeak. No, don't kiss me.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You tricked me into betraying my fellow students!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lisa, student government is meaningless. Look at your constitution. It's written on the back of a placemat.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: And not a good placemat. It's from some place called "Doodles."

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I see. Principal Skinner, may I make an announcement to the school?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I can't see the harm.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hereby resign as your president. And for my last act, I call a general student strike, effective immediately!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Gimme that. Any student caught striking will be severely disciplined. Unless all of you do it. Then I'm stymied.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lisa, please. Help me lure them back. I had to do what I did. Our budget is stretched tighter than mother's sauna pants.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yes, mother.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Principal Skinner, I will not call off this strike until you bring back music and art.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: What about gym?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Meh.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Why didn't I cancel sign-making and creative chanting?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Principal Skinner, can't you just reinstate those programs?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Would you be willing to pay an extra dollar twenty-three in taxes to fund them?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No way! I'm saving for a speedboat!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, what are you doing? This is the kind of troublemaking I expect from your brother.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You do? Cool, a blank check for mayhem.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I was elected to make this a better school.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, couldn't you just hang some colorful crepe paper in the gym?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They've taken away our crepe paper.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Those Fudruckers!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no, they heard me.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Remember boys, these are little kids. Take out your tiny batons.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ugh... oh... umph... Oh, Smithers, guide me in.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Chief Wiggum, we're just like you policemen. Don't you ever feel like the mayor doesn't care about you?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: You mean the mayor who kept me waiting for two hours in that restaurant? I ate so much bread! Sit down, boys. We're joining this strike.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, I can't take that rattlesnake out of his mailbox now, now can I?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Let me ask you this. Shut up.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: The Springfield student strike has entered its fourth day with no end in sight. Today, professional buttinski Michael Moore arrived on the scene:

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Where did you get this statistic?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: The student strikers have been joined by other unions, including the Springfield Goat Milkers... the Association of Newsroom Cue Card Holders...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Ow. And the United Federation of Theme Park Zombies.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: The heart of the strike is former student body president Lisa Simpson. Her brother had this to say:

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa is a nut. She has a rubber butt. Every time she turns around it goes "putt putt."

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Indeed. But that rubber butt doesn't have much time for turning around these days. It's pointed squarely in the face of the administration.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skinner! We have got to get these kids back in school.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Willie, can't you turn your hose on them?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: They're wee children. I'd sooner turn it on maself!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, that's a good idea, too.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Now see here ya nose-wipin' hair-combers. Back in Edinburgh we had a coal miner's strike. All we wanted were hats with a wee light on top. Then one day the mine collapsed. No one made it out alive. Not even Willie.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skinner! I don't mean to interrupt your advice from the janitor. But I say, cut off the head and the body will die.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You want to get rid of Lisa?! But she's such a good student!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Yes. In fact, I think she's a little too good for this school.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: If we stand together, we are strong!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lisa Simpson, you have just been transferred to the Springfield magnet school for the gifted and troublesome. Please climb into the idling bus.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But... but I...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: DON'T CRY FOR ME KIDS OF SPRINGFIELD / YOU CAN STILL REACH ME THROUGH E-MAIL / AT SMART GIRL SIX THREE / UNDERSCORE BACK SLASH / AT YAHOO DOT COM / AT YAHOO DOT COM...

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, this place is paradise.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not driving forty-five minutes a day! You can't go to that school!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But this is my dream.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why can't you have a normal dream, like being an Olympic figure skater?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, let me take figure skating.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are you crazy? I'm not getting up at six-thirty every morning so you can prance around a frozen pond and think you're better than me!

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, what can I be?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'unno. How 'bout a horse whisperer?

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: The President Wore Pearls
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Over my dead body!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Look, Smithers... crackle-berries! Spot me a federal, will you?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, I've spotted you over a hundred thousand dollars this year. Perhaps you could carry your own money.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Money is for the poor.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Why don't you use your ATM card?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah yes, the automated teller machine-eola-trola-maton.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, what's my password?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It's your age, Sir.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Let's see... what's the smallest amount of money I can think of? A thousand dollars!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: My moolah! It's escaping my clutches!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Hockey dads -- commence fighting!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "Hockey Dad" rules! Feel the drunken wrath of Chuck Shadowski!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ignore, ignore!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Announcer
spoken_words: You are a big man! Big man!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: What?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Umm... there's a ladybug in your hair.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Get it out! Get it out!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Got it!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: You're a good friend, Bart.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The best you'll ever have.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: One thousand dollars. Do you know how much furniture we could rent with this?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You'll rent nothing! This money is mine. I found it!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Which means someone lost it. You'll have to put up flyers and see if anyone claims it.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, this is why people don't tell you things.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we put up a flyer.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see someone claim that money now.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know the drill. Try to land on my back-fat.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can you describe the bill?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Describe. Sure, of course.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whose picture is on it?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh... it would have to be somebody famous... I'm gonna say Hitler?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Next!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, it doesn't.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's the last of them. You did the right thing, Bart, and now you can keep the money.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sweet! What am I gonna do with a thousand dollars?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No one's touching the hors d'oeuvres.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: IT'S BART'S MOON PARTY FROM OUTER SPACE...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, why don't you spend the money on something for Mom? She does so much for us.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well... someday I'd like to go on a nice vacation.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We've gone on plenty of great vacations.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, but you always wind up kidnapped, or on a chain gang... and I don't even want to get into what happened on our honeymoon.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I still don't know why you had that photo enlarged.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, forget it. Bart, don't waste your money on me.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Great lady.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Look at the cross-hatching on Grover Cleveland's tie...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: ...I completely buy the illusion of shadow!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: This must be worth like a million dollars.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Time's up. Beat it, doo-rags.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Aww, I wanna see it some more!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: If you let me keep looking at it I'll give you a quarter.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hm, this gives me an idea.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I'm charging five bucks to get in. They deserve to see the boy behind the bill.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, that exhibit over there is biased, insensitive and anti-feminist.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You can't whitewash history, Lis.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: What do I get if I join the museum as a "friend of Bart"?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A subscription to "BartForum" magazine, , and Bart will say "eat my shorts" on your home answering machine.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: How much to have Bart crank-call me? That would be hilarious. Eh, that's just me, though. You know, I love to laugh.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Young man, I believe you have something that belongs to me.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Prove it, Bony Curtis.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: When the errant bill struck my chest, it left a distinctive bruise. Had my heart been inside at the time, it could have been fatal.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's a perfect match!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yoink!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Without that bill, this ain't a museum. The Hard Rock Café in Phoenix has better crap.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, your museum took in over three thousand dollars!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Finally, I can get what I've always wanted... a used Toyota.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I don't care what Mom said. I think you should use this money to take her on a nice vacation.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well... okay. For Mom, I'll do it. Where should we go?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'd like to return to Brazil. But I hear the monkey problem is even worse now.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I want to go to England.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How come?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Back in nineteen forty-four, I was stationed over there and I met a beautiful girl...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Little did I know I really was shipping out in the morning.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: But I did -- until just now.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa, that's so romantic! We gotta go to England!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That sounds great -- But only if your father promises to behave.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I'll be on my best behavior -- you have my word as a gentleman and a lady. Now let's see, which rifle should I bring?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Prime Minister Tony Blair!?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why are you greeting low-lifes like us at the airport?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Would an American dollar encourage you to leave us alone?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Tony... I mean Mr. Prime Minister... what should we see first?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The place I was born is now a gator farm.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe you could give us a personal tour of your country.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. I can't believe we met Mr. Bean.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: England is so classy. Every cab has its own butler.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Make with the tea, Jeeves.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We're bigshot tourists from everyone's favorite country: the USA. We saved your ass in Vietnam and shared our prostitutes with Hugh Grant. So give me some free maps, and none of that dry British wit.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Did you spend an unforgettable night with a soldier from the U.S. Army in 1944? You did? Was he from the first infantry division? He was? And was he a gentle caring lover? He was? Sorry I bothered you.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know if I'm ever gonna find her.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw Dad, I wish there was something I could do.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Touch that mini bar and you're dead!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, it's J.K. Rowling, author of the Harry Potter books. You've turned a generation of kids onto reading.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Can you tell me what happens at the end of the series?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fish? I don't know, I'm not really a vegetarian...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Marge, you've gotta admit. I've been on my best behavior this trip.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You punched out three people on the street.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That was over soccer results! Can you believe they gave Giggs a yellow card in the box?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Do you understand any part of what you just said?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I understand the word "gave." Unless it means something else in this country.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, teabag, just fork over the brown.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, I don't think we'll be able to find the kids from up here.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, now, let's just look... there's Big Ben, there's Piccadilly Circus, there's Jimmy Page, one of the greatest thieves of American black music who ever walked the earth. Bup, there's the kids.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You can't bet on my kids. This is America, pal!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, look at all these classy British plays.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sir Ian McKellen! You're my favorite Shakespearean actor!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What? What play?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You mean "Macbeth"?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What? By saying "Macbeth"?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Saying what?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This is cool. Macbeth! Macbeth! Macbeth!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! Stop saying Macbeth!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, you said Macbeth!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Macbeth, I'm really sorry.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But please, find it in your jewel-encrusted heart to forgive me.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Good luck!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, you're doing a great job driving on the left. This is turning out to be our most enjoyable trip ever.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, this trip is entirely uneventful.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, no! You turned into a roundabout!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Turn, turn, keep turning, keep turning, keep turning, keep turning...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I see an opening.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, it's too risky! We'll just wait till the traffic thins out. Turn, turn, keep turning, keep turning, keep turning, keep turning...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's it. I'm acting the way America acts best -- unilaterally.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I'm gonna go over there and see if they're cool.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, let's see. Oh, you can buff that out, you can buff that out, that's factory error, that thing's supposed to be on fire...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lady, please. Get back in your overturned car. Let the guys handle this.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your Majesty?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you rear-ended the Queen of England!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The Queen of whaaa?!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait! We have to exchange insurance!

title: Today I Am a Clown
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Back cuts?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My Lord, we Americans love queens, be they homecoming or Dairy. This woman, however, is an imposter.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Her luggage is inscribed "H.R.H." -- which means her real name must be... Henrietta R. Hippo.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why did you let him be his own barrister?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What difference could it make? He hit the friggin' Queen!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I guess it's just too much for me to ask for one vacation where we don't go to jail or to a condo sales pitch.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your Honor, I've completely disappointed my wife. That's punishment enough. You understand these things, you're a grandmother.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ohh, and a very manly one, if I may say so, m'lord.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, she's good. If she were a hundred years younger... and I were a hundred years older...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: America rules! Our Beatles are way better than your precious Rolling Stones!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: 'E claimed he was me father, he did.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you're not helping.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Poke the monster with a stick! Tuppence a jab! C'mon, queue up, lads.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Marge, I Am so sorry. I should've listened to whatever it was you were saying.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's partly my fault. I've been nagging you so much on this trip, you couldn't know which nags to focus on.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Dad, why don't we try the "Sprawl-Mart"?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well Marge, if I die here, there's one thing I want you to remember: don't buy any videotapes in England. They won't work in our VCR!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dear God of England: please let me go. In return I will spell the word "color" with a "u" and I'll use the metric system with every cubic milliliter of blood in my... oh, I can't do it. It's so stupid!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We found a secret tunnel out of the tower. It was used by Sir Walter Raleigh!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A secret tunnel? I don't know. Won't that get me in more trouble?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you couldn't be in more trouble. They're going to put your head on a pike. They're practicing with melons.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, what do I do?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Push the gray brick in the back of the fireplace.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sweet freedom, here I--

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Put out the fire first.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, it's a good thing I'm leaving before I went nuts. Goodbye Sparkly Elves.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my God! We've made a terrible mistake. This tunnel comes out in the worst possible place.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: An elephant's butt?

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, Bart. An elephant's butt.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, a Krispy Kreme would really clean up down here.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, this place is amazing. It's fit for a Duke, or even an Earl...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Please, your Majesty, I know that I, like many other Americans, have behaved like a total buffoon.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But we Americans are England's children. I know we don't call as often as we should, and we aren't as well-behaved as our goody two-shoes brother Canada, who by the way has never had a girlfriend, I'm just sayin'.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Only my hairdresser knows for sure.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That was very sweet of the Queen, letting you go in exchange for taking Madonna back to America.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Englishwomen don't pump gas naked!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See ya in Atlanta, jerk!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Edwina, you got my message!

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry I never saw you again. I just felt the cultural differences between us were too great. Plus, as the boat pulled away from the dock, I thought you looked fat.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Fifty-eight? Well, fifty-nine years ago, your mother and I were...

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, gotta go. See ya in Heaven.

title: The Regina Monologues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lady, you're gorgeous. You make Dame Edna look like a dude!

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Mother's Day gift check. Let's see what you got.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I picked Mom a bouquet of Erigeron

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: elatiors.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Daisies.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Flowers.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flow... yeah.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lis, your stupid present will only last a week. Mine will sit in a closet for years.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, we made her the same thing!

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This is even worse than you think -- look!

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, we're going Mother's Day shopping! I'm glad this holiday only comes every four years.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see, what would she like?

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Twenty on the trifecta?

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Her wedding china back?

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I could get Marge a new window, just like this one.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I love Sprawl-Mart. They've got everything. Even Christian videos with talking vegetables.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm, Moses.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Welcome to Sprawl-Mart!

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa! You have a job?

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How dare you challenge my perceptions of what old people can do?

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm a Greeter! I'm here to make every visit special! And to size up potential shoplifters!

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Like I can't shoplift with my mouth.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw haw!

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, look at all this stuff.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh look, Jaclyn Smith has her own line of axe heads!

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, it's impressive. But I still haven't found the perfect gift for Marge. Only imperfect stuff for me.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, well, if it isn't Fatty and Smell-ma.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aunts Patty and Selma, can you help us pick out a Mother's Day gift?

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! It's a machine that makes carnival food at home.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Endorsed by the American Carny Association.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! I never thought I'd say this, but you slags are all right.

title: The Fat and the Furriest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All this attention! I feel like a secretary on Administrative Professionals Day!

title: The Fat and the Furriest

spoken_words: You're right, this is it. They're selling us to be crash test dummies.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, please let it be Volvo.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you children are too suspicious. It's go time.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's shot day!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Welcome to Hell...man Avenue Medical Plaza.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Children, you should be grateful you live in a country where childhood diseases have been practically...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Karaté!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! That hobo skeleton is not a toy!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This is ridiculous. Only babies and ex-junkies are afraid of needles. Stick me, Chuckles!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Can I have a lollipop?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Well, that just leaves Bart.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't forget Maggie!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Oh, I got her when your heads were turned. Got her good!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Now Bart, just look out the window. It'll take your mind off the pain.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: And when you're done, I've got more lollies!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No thanks. I already helped myself.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: See ya later, inoculator!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: He can run, but nobody escapes the needle.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Darlene, cancel all my appointments.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't feel bad, Doc. I won't even let my Mom clip my toenails.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Thanks, Barney. Moe, we won't need you now.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, well, I really enjoyed being you, Dr. Hibbert. Uh, oh by the way, you're not welcome in the library no more. I'm sorry.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now, that wasn't so bad, was it Bart? You know, sometimes the fear of some...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, something's wrong! Ah, ah, I can't hear!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Doctor! Perform a diagnosis!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: I'm afraid the inoculation has swollen his ear holes shut! Maybe this would be a good time to talk about side effects.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: The boy's hearing should clear up in a day. If it doesn't, call me in the Bahamas. For now, he can express himself with this complimentary pen.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Cool!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Oh, it's a good pen. Try it out.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: That was a malpractice waiver, fool!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop it, Homer!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I know what you're hiding, lad. Willie's been deaf since the boiler explosion of eighty-eight. But I taught meself to read lips.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, fellas! My hearing's back.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: What'd you say about me mother?! For your information, her feet stank 'cause she works in manure all day! But it's still the best darn Starbucks in Glasgow!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, pass the ketchup. Bart, pass the ketchup!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, he's deaf.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, sorry, right.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, pass the corn. Bart, pass the corn!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I THINK YOU SHOULD STAY HOME FROM SCHOOL TOMORROW.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But Mom... tomorrow's the big donkey basketball game.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The kids are gonna play the teachers!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Donkey Basketball? Now I've heard everything! Unlike you!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Everybody remember that for when his hearing comes back.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Swish!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Welcome, everyone, to the annual Donkey Basketball Classic. I'm sure that mule enjoy it.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hm, tough crowd. Uh, would everyone just rise for our National Anthem?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, donkey, want a carrot?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Psyche!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Good Lord! Bart's mooning the flag!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Don't look, Buttermilk.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: When you insult the flag, you insult my flag tattoo!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: What did ye say about me mother?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: You'll fry up nice tonight!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Your child's behavior appalls me, not just as a principal, but as a veteran of America's only losing war.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: To date!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I swear Bart didn't know what he was doing. He was deaf!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh sure, Marge. Just like "blind Bart," "wheelchair Bart," "pregnant Bart" and my personal favorite, "railroad spike through head Bart."

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you. And let me say I missed your sweet, sweet voices.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
raw_location_text: When You Wash Upon a Car Wash
spoken_words: I did not come to this country illegally to see it mocked.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No one calls me unpatriotic.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, guys.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, cold shoulder, huh? Well, I'll just talk to myself. Hey, how ya doin', Homer? Oh, not too bad, how about you? Oh I'm fine. Your wife was great in bed last night. You keep your hands off my wife! Oh yeah? Well I give her what she needs. And she likes...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homer, stop it!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Homer... this bar's only for real Americans. And people on permanent visas, like me. What? What are you all lookin' at? I'm Dutch. Eh, forget all of you.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I'm leavin', too. I'm gonna go listen to the President's weekly radio address. And not the rebuttal!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Goodbye, Homer. I can't get drunk and vomit next to a guy I don't respect.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Even my best friends have left me! I'm all alone!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We've become pariahs! In the last two hours I've gotten one thousand hate spams.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Y'ello. Appear on your TV show?! Tell our side of the story?! You'll see us there?! Goodbye?! Dial tone?!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: If there's one way to get the truth out, it's on a cable news channel.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: When we explain our side of the story, the hate calls will end. I won't have to hear "suck my such and such" or "hell this" and "bitch that..."

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We get it, Mom.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, no, let her finish.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, what should I say to make people not hate me?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, I've learned one thing in this life: to stay out of trouble, just say nothing. Don't rock the boat. Don't even get in the boat.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just buy some ice cream and walk around the pier. But don't go in the bathrooms, they're filthy.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I am going on a talk show. I have to say something!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Talk about boats! Then when he asks you if you hate this country, you just start crying and pretend you don't.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But I don't hate this country.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There there, save your lies for the American public.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nash, I've realized something. I'm the worst kid in the world, and the last thing I deserve is forgiveness. But with a little help from Jesus and our fighting men and women overseas--

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, America's not perfect--

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: If by us you mean loud-mouthed talk show hosts, which everyone seems to be in this country, then yes, I do hate Americans!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What'd you say?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll have you know I am very well liked in Springfield.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Turn that off!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: This could destroy our town! Look what happened to Hitler City, North Carolina -- if they hadn't changed their name to Charlotte, they'd be sunk.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Not the Boneys!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: I am honored to announce that we are changing the name of our town to Liberty-ville!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm as patriotic as the next person, but changing the traffic lights to red, white and blue just seems dangerous.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Okay, Mr. Teeny. Before the cops come, swallow all these illegal pills, then run to the vet.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homeland Noodles with Uncle Sam balls? Apu, aren't you going a bit overboard with the patriotism?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh I don't think so, it is a heartfelt expression of my true desire to protect my mahogany noggin.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh oh. Poonam and Uma are fighting!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: No, no. Those are their pre-witch hunt names. Their new names are Freedom, Lincoln, Condoleeza, Coke, Pepsi, Manifest Destiny, Apple Pie and Superman. And together we're the MacGillicuddys.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Lord, give us the courage to worship the American flag. Be it on a car, a belt buckle, or on your holy person.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ay carumba!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'd like to say something about the current climate of repression and fear.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Ah, put a book in it.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Congress shall make no law... abridging the freedom of speech, or of the press."

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's from the first Amendment to the Constitution. Thank you.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Thank you, Lisa. I'm sure your opinion will not go unnoticed.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Martha! Play something to lighten the mood!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: BUY ME SOME PEANUTS AND CRACKERJACK... / I DON'T CARE IF... OW!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe they put us in jail.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's not a jail, it's a "reeducation center."

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, where do you think we are?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, let's see, after they blindfolded us, it was left, right, left... then a three hour plane ride.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Do you get time off for snitching on your cellmates?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You were right, Homie. We shouldn't have rocked the boat. Then none of this would have ever happened.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we're not the only ones to be unjustly imprisoned. Check out all the left-wing celebrities.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bill Clinton? What are you doin' here?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know why they put the real ones in with the joke ones.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, that's not funny. You believe in the Bill of Rights.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know whether it's the lack of sleep, the sodium pentathol, or that it's the only cartoon I've seen in two months. But this is what I believe in now.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, we've got to get outta here.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah. Next commercial.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who are you?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't want to be in any stupid talent show. Not without my Tennessee walking horses.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, people have accused this family of not loving our country. But you can't spell U.S.A. without us... eh?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: O BEAUTIFUL / FOR SPACIOUS SKIES / FOR AMBER WAVES OF GRAIN...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: FIFTY STARS AND THIRTEEN STRIPES...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: OKAY, KIDS SHOW OFF YOUR PIPES...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: AMERICANS ARE / BRAVE AND LOYAL / SO C'MON JERKS, GIVE US YOUR OIL...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: MY CARD HERE SAYS "ACLU" / NOW LOOK WHAT I'M GOING TO DO...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: TO LOVE OUR COUNTRY IS NO CHORE...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: WAIT RIGHT HERE FOR OUR ENCORE...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We mean it, don't move.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: OKAY, KIDS SHOW OFF YOUR PIPES...

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, why are you still singing that stupid song?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Because if they catch us, we may have to do it again. And this time I want it tight!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What genius put a prison on the middle of an island?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Does everyone remember their swimming lessons?

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Great, dive in.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Swim toward San Francisco!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not made of money! We'll swim to Oakland.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There's a ship! We're saved!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, what's the use? Even if they pick us up, we'll go back to jail 'cause they think we hate America. I don't want to end up like Elmo, hanging himself in prison.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I've always wanted to go to France. Your women don't age -- like Catherine Deneuve.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maman, please pass ze baguette.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The food is so delicious here. And these Chanel suits are five for a dollar! I'm using a jacket as a napkin.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And here no one calls me a fat jerk... I'm a gourmand!

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And yet, I miss America.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I miss America, too. The United States has its grandeur and its follies, but mostly it's the place where all our stuff is.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wish we could go back, but I don't think we're welcome there.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, Marge, there's one group that's always welcome in America: immigrants without I.D.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, kids, this is the first chapter of our brand new lives... in America.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Simpson.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, that'll save some time.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, kids, it'll take us a while to assimilate. I'll start out as a cop, and then, with time, become a dirty cop.

title: Bart-Mangled Banner
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I think I'm going to like this "America."

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman, live at Springfield's most beloved tourist attraction, the man-shaped mountain crag known as "Geezer Rock."

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Carved by centuries of wind and rain, Geezer Rock will soon be more than just a place for teens to have sex and commit suicide.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Today, Geezer Rock will be officially designated a national landmark!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! You promised you'd stop making that comparison.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Per... our... agreement!

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Knock-kneed home renters. Can't we thin this herd with some smallpox-infected blankets?

title: Fraudcast News
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: We're already immune, ya jerk!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Gee, I never noticed that before.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's got a tree in his eye!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If that tree gets too big, it'll ruin the beauty of that rock. We'll lose tourists! And then who will buy my roadside corn?

title: Fraudcast News
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You don't sell roadside corn.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There's a lot you don't know about me, Marge. A lot that would shock you.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Thank you, Blood and Tears. Sorry to hear about Sweat.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Now, before the Undersecretary of the Interior...declares Geezer Rock a national landmark, we shall hear a poem written by honor student Lisa Simpson.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you. Geezer Rock -- an appreciation in verse.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now to do something I've never done before -- help out an old man.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Postcard image, thing to see--"

title: Fraudcast News
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Gotta go, sweetie!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But I didn't read my poem!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here's a poem: "run fast, or lose your ass"!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Mr. Burns!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Mr. Burns is gone! And tonight was the night I was gonna show him my tattoo.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe that historic rock is gone.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: My poem has become an elegy. An elegy no one will ever hear.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, at least some good came out of today.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you're grounded for a year.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll just pay the fine.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, three bucks.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why don't you publish your poem?

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Don't I already give out turkey slices to the poor?

title: Fraudcast News
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Publish it myself? Why not? I could put out a whole newspaper dedicated to the rock. I'd be a publisher, just like Katherine Graham!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Or that lady who wheels Larry Flynt around!

title: Fraudcast News
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, perhaps it's best you were snatched away before time could diminish your beauty.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Stop your wailin', Waylon!

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'm alive!

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oops, that stays in.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You're alive! But, but how?!

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Because of my svelte physique, I was able to fit in a narrow air pocket.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I survived on whatever sustenance came my way.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Thankfully, a mother mole nursed me as her own until I was strong enough to continue.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now, let's see how the common folk are grieving for their fallen god... me.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: And so, a day after the tragedy, the town still mourns the loss of its venerable old man.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Here it comes.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Beloved by children...

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, yes, the little ones.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Thought to be thousands of years old...

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I have been "eighty-nine" for a while now.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: We'll miss you... Geezer Rock.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Quickly, Smithers. Re-hydrate me.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: But one old man we certainly don't miss is the late C. Montgomery Burns. As owner of the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant, he generated both electricity and contempt.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Thank you, Geezer Rock, for doing what none of us had the courage to do -- smoosh Mr. Burns.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: This town cared more for a soulless piece of granite than for me! I don't have a friend in the world.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You have me, sir.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Don't be so needy.

title: Fraudcast News
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, I'm going to change this town's accurate impression of me.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, you could improve your image with various good deeds.

title: Fraudcast News
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You eliminated that program in the thirties, sir.

name: C. Montgomery Burns
