title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's it, a plane!

title: Midnight Rx
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Smuggle drugs in a plane? That'll never work!

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure it will. All we need is a pilot!

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I've got everything you need.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Katharine Hepburn?!

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No, you fool. 'Tis I, Burns! Now come with me.

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: At last, my plane shall be used for its original purpose. To subvert the laws of the United States.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Typical Canadian wimpiness. That's why you have snowballs and we have the H bomb.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We really appreciate your help, Johnny. Is there any way we can repay ya?

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? In America we do it four times a week. You come on down and I'll get us front row seats.

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We're losing altitude. Time to dump all unnecessary weight.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't dump me out! I can lose weight! Just give me a chance.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: One... two... Eh, I'd rather die.

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's no use. We've got to make an emergency landing.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, at least we're all in this together.

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now, we have three parachutes.

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: This one's for me...

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And these two are gifts for my nephews. Tally ho!

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll make it, Dad. On a wing and a prayer.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dammit.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right, you're under arrest.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: On what charge?

title: Midnight Rx
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Making a Police Chief go .

title: Midnight Rx
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Get in the car -- and don't touch those guns, I just loaded 'em.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: You'll have to arrest me too. Abe Simpson brought the Propecia to keep grass on Willie's field.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: He cured my lumbago. Thank you.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: My diaper rash.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well Simpson, you have helped a lot of people... So, like it says in the Springfield Police handbook, "If you can't beat 'em, join 'em."

title: Midnight Rx
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Yeah well look a little closer, Lou.

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh I hope I'm not too late.

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Take, potion! Hurry!

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, it's not working. Only my sour, curdled breath will quicken him.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, you saved my life!

title: Midnight Rx
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes. Smithers, I was a stingy old fool. But from now on, I'll provide drug benefits to all my full-time employees.

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Great news, honey! Burns made me a freelance consultant!

title: Midnight Rx
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's this lump?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now, before we eat, let's remember what we're celebrating today -- after many years of hard work, your father finally paid off the mortgage.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See you in Hell, document!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All right, Dad!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Way to build equity!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now remember to eat smart, people. Go for the fancy foods -- don't let 'em fill you up with THAT cheap stuff.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Screw you.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Smoked salmon... Shrimp... Crab legs!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I win...

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thinner... thinner... thinner... thinner... too thin.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Better luck next time, "Tommy - Virginia Beach."

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You ate meat! You ate meat!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You ate fruit! You ate fruit!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stow it, you two!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop making a scene!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: How rude! What do I have to do to enjoy a Sunday brunch with my secret other family?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've never been so embarrassed. And the worst part is, this is brunch so you've ruined two meals! I'll see you all at lupper!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why did I ever have kids? I could have written symphonies, or been Shakespeare.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Here, Homer. Have a big frosty mug of Fuhgetaboutit.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, who are you, the health inspector?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Guys, this is Frankie from the Health Department. We go way back. Lenny, you don't have to hide that rat.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Off you go, little fella.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: When we were kids, our dads used to get drunk and make us fight each other.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That time you blinded me, he gave you a bike. That sure was a good soundin' bike...

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh my God, he's dead.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Okay, which one of you guys parked in front of the hydrant?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Uh, look, I didn't see nothin' here, okay? Just a bunch of innocent guys, sitting around, none of them dead. Buy yourselves a nice dinner.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So, uh, Mr. New Guy. Whaddya think? Is everything... hunky dory there?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You gotta be kiddin' me. Like what?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh yeah. Uh well, ya see, uh trash day ain't 'til Wednesday...

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh man, I can't afford to fix all that stuff.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, nuts. If anybody needs me, I'll be in the john.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe's, a tribute. "M" is for Moe, the owner of Moe's. "O" is for the "O" in the middle of Moe's. "E" is for acceptance. The feeling I always got here at Moe's. Oh Moe, don't let 'em close you down!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: It's too late -- I don't got the cash to clean up the bar. From now on, you guys are gonna hafta do your drinking across the street.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, a beer's a beer.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't go to a gay bar, I'm too fat! Moe, I'm gonna help you reopen your bar no matter what it takes.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ... Marge?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Put up my house? But I just paid it off... what would Marge say?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Do whatever you have to do to save Moe's. I love my Homie.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay honey, I'll do it.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's going on here?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Nutin'. Nutin'.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Thanks, Homer. No one's ever trusted me before -- except for that one guy who shouldn't have.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That was me.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh yeah.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, those kookoo-birds at the bank goofed up and sent us a mortgage statement.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! How dare you open a letter addressed to both of us?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: M631700000642J?! This is a new loan tracking number -- you got a new mortgage?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I had to! Or Moe's would stay closed forever!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You gave the money to Moe? How's he gonna pay us back?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, look. I can see you're upset. If you need me, I'll be at Moe's.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, maybe I'll go to Moe's too, seeing as I'm now part owner.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you can't go with me to Moe's. I mean, how would you like it if I came with you to your mother's?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I would like it. You never come to my mother's.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's because I hate her.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Until you pay us back, you're answering to me! And there's gonna be big changes.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa, now wait just a minute. One thing Moe Szyslak has never had is a partner. Nor a wife, a friend, a chum, a casual acquaintance, a pen pal, a parrot, a meaningful conversation, a brief hug or eye contact.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'm just going to call the suicide hotline now. And they've blocked my number! Oh God!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just made it!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, I can't wait to get my lips around an ice cold...

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm here protecting our investment. I'd like you to go home and make dinner for the kids.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I don't wanna take care of the kids... Um... how many cigars are they allowed to have? Bart sleeps in the microwave, right?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Quit playing dumb.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How many magic beans should I sell the baby for? Three? Duh, der, duh. That's me, jerk-ass Homer. Duh, der, doy.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, go home.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe some cheerier paint would make this place less of a "dive."

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Marge, my customers don't like themselves. Therefore, they seek the darkness.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well... as fabulous as your regulars are, a remodel might bring in a higher class of lush.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Look, I like Moe's the way it is, all right? And I ain't changin' it for any dame, skirt, Susie-Q, or face-macer.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I had a feeling you'd say that. So I prepared something that might help you "change your tune."

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: THIS PLACE IS A DIAMOND / BUT IT'S TRAPPED IN THE ROUGH

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: YEAH WELL THE SIGN STILL SAYS "MOE'S" / SO ENOUGH OF YOUR GUFF

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: HERE'S MY NEW IDEA TO SELL BOTH BEER AND GRUB / WE WILL TURN THIS FILTHY DIVE INTO A PROPER OLD-TIME BRITISH PUB!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: A British whaaa?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: DARTS AND MEATPIES, AND LAGER IN PINT GLASSES

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: WHAT A CLASSY WAY TO GET DRUNK OFF YOUR ASSES

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, hold the phone. An English Pub, that just might work.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: IN SO-NG!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh... MY BAR COULD BE BRITISH / INSTEAD OF ARM-PITTISH / SO WHY DON'T WE ALL Eh, screw it.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Let's get renovatin'.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I was thinking more like drapes and a paint job, but your idea's good too.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Thanks.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: My first credit card! Wow, the numbers are all bumpy-like.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: So, Mr. Boswell. What do you think of the new Moe's?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Thanks, Freakazoid. I'd just like to say that there's one person to whom I really owe my newfound success: Marge Simpson.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Moe.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, Mom's spending more time at Moe's than you are.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And they seem awfully chummy.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just what are you inferring?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not inferring anything. You infer. I imply.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whew, that's a relief!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, what a night! Moe showed me how to give someone the bum's rush. Here, watch.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Get lost, rummy!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah yes, Detroit-style. Very nice. So, you've been at Moe's every night this week.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I know, I used to think of Moe as a scabby, dead-eyed hunchback. But now that I've gotten to know him, we kind of bonded.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bonded?! How many times?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, Moe and I are just work friends. You and I are... marriage friends.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, honey. My mind is completely at ease.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, it's me.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe? What's up, partner?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Marge, sorry to call you so late but I had a great idea: put cutesy signs outside the restrooms that say "dukes" and "dames" instead of the ones we have now that say "standups" and "sitdowns." Huh? Tell me honestly, what do you think?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, that's a great idea.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Thanks! Wait, are you sure I'm not interruptin' anything?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Of course not! I'm in bed with Homer!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, also, I wanna....

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I might as well use this pucker for something.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Coming this summer from Dreamworks:

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Cards!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Fifty-two jokers playing the game of their lives.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Announcer
spoken_words: With Eddie Murphy as the Jack of Clubs.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Announcer
spoken_words: This summer, the house is full and the deuces are wild! In "Cards"!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Marge, don't you love it when our hands meet in the popcorn tub?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mm-hmm.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, Marge!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Howdy, partner! Why don't you sit next to us?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Moe... haven't seen you in a while.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh yeah, how ya doin' there, Homer? Did you ever pass that G.I. Joe you swallowed?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How do you know about that?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, Marge told me. We share everything.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You do?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, can you hold my wedding ring for a second? My finger's itchy.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Somethin' wrong, Homer?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... I'm worried about Marge and Moe. They've developed an intimate bond of thoughts and feelings completely separate from me. But it's not physical. So everything's great, right?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Homer, it's time you learned the sad truth.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can I learn it at a happy place?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Moe and Marge are having an "emotional affair."

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Although there's no physical intimacy, there's a deep spiritual connection that threatens to destroy your marriage.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do I do?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Engage her feelings, become her friend... ooh, get her a Life Magazine from the week she was born. I'll always treasure mine.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're absolutely right! Stop this ride!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, my darling! Thank God you're home! I've been dying to hear your feelings!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'm too tired to talk.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I can go all night, baby. I could listen to you two, maybe three, times.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, I'm tired. I have to get up early to catch my flight.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Catch your flight?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe and I are going to the Tavern and Restaurant Owners Convention in Aruba this weekend. Don't you ever listen to me? I told you ten times.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's a cuckold?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Where's Mom going with Uncle Moe?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He's only your emotional uncle! I'm your real uncle!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if Hollywood movies have taught us anything, it's that troubled relationships can be completely patched up by a mad dash to the airport.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm off!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh you know, Marge, I've really enjoyed you workin' at the bar.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Me too, Moe. What a nice surprise that we've become friends.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, your upper lip is trembling.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, I'm just excited because they're showin' an episode of "Boy Meets World" on this flight. Oh no, wait. That's only on flights from Europe. We just get that little plane.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey wait a minute, what the Hell is that?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hang on, Marge, Homie's comin'! I won't let that man make you happy!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Simpson, you were going a hundred in a twenty-five zone. And you're not gonna flirt your way outta this one.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I have to get to the airport to save my marriage!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Really? Well, why didn't you say so? Let's roll!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Wake up, Lou. She was way outta your league.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh my God!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, did you see something troubling on the tarmac?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: No, why you say that?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You gotta get me closer, Chief!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Anything for love!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, time to chase this pig into the sty. Uh Marge, you deserve a man who listens to you. Who respects you. Who understands what a treasure you really are.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know what to say.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Just say you love me, Marge. Love me like I love you. Please?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That sounds like Homer.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: No-it-isn't-I-don't-hear-nothin'-you're-crazy-get-outta-here-will-you-marry-me?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! How'd you get in here?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Toilet hole.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You leave my wife alone!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You don't deserve her! You know nothin' about Marge -- what's her favorite food?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... ice?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Wrong. It's buttered noodles.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He's right.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's true. I don't know Marge at all. I'll just go home now.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Shut it! Shut it!

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, you've won. I'll see you at baggage claim.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hot damn, I won! Marge, I swear I'll be the best man you ever had. It's gonna be all flowers and back rubs and how-was-your-day dear and--

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe! No I don't love you. And I'm certainly not going to leave my husband.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You mean I listened to all your touchy-feely yip-yap for nothin'?

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm afraid so.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: At least I had a couple sips from your coke when you went to the bathroom.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie...

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I just wanna say: if you ever feel like cheating on Moe, here's my card.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I made a vow on our wedding day, to stay by you -- for better or worse. And besides... I love you. You're my Homie-womie-romie-domie...

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And you're my Margie-wargie-bargie-fargie-gargie-margie-targie-glargie.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I may have dodged a bullet here.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Might as well face it, I'll never find anyone. Come on tide -- take me with ya. I just don't wanna feel no more pain.

title: Mommie Beerest
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, I need to tell you something.

spoken_words: Not affiliated with American Idol. We've never even heard of American Idol.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: The winner will be animated into an Itchy and Scratchy cartoon!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: So enter today -- especially if you're a funny-looking kid who doesn't know he sucks!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I'm-a comin', Krusty!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, you should enter that contest. You've got a great voice. It made us all feel better.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Bart. That's really sweet.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I think I puked up all of my meanness.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ow!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Praise the Lord! I'm on the road to recovery.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hope we didn't camp out here for nothing. It's like every kid in Springfield showed up.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry about the competition, sweetie. Whenever I enter a contest I tell myself I'm going to win because, sometimes, if you believe hard enough, God cuts you a break. After all, he works for us. Our prayers pay his salary.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And if I win, I'll be on Itchy and Scratchy...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nicely done, Wind-dancer. But seriously, cruelty to animals is no laughing matter. You can make a difference!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And remember, save the violence for cartoons!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: All right, kids. Let's do this quick. After this, I gotta record twenty-seven seasons of DVD commentaries. And I remember nothing!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Today, we'll pick the lucky children who will get to compete on the air. I was going to be your celebrity judge, but then I realized I'd have to pay attention. So instead, we'll use the Applause-O-Meter. Eh? Eh?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now, let's get this over with!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe I used to date him.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lis, you're a shoo-in.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh God, I miss Lisa's cat so much.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, that sounds like a fancier version of the song you're going to sing!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And she's giving us the emotional experience of a lifetime. Oh, thank you for this angel, Lord!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Well, I may not know much, but I do know talent when my producers point it out to me. We have our first contestant: Clarissa Wellington!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: There's no way I'm gonna beat her.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why? Just because she sings like Whitney Houston brought to life?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't lose hope, sweetie. I'm gonna write you a song so great, you can't lose. And that's not just the beer talking. Your father's in here too.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: WHEN A MAN LOVES A WOMAN...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Which one are you, the man or the woman?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Questioning the kid's sexuality -- well done.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here you go, honey. Sing this.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How did you write a song so quickly?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Much of the tune is plagiarized. Now go, go, go!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'VE BEEN TO PARIS / AND LONDON AND TOKYO TOWN / BUT ONE CRAZY BURG / HAS 'EM ALL BEAT HANDS DOWN...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'M TALKIN' SPRINGFIELD / YOU CAN BUY CHIMICHANGAS / TALKIN' SPRINGFIELD / THE CHICKS HAVE BIG GAZONGAS

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: THERE'S TIRES / ON FIRE / A GUY NAMED APU

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: AND SKINNER / AND GRAMPA / AND OL' DISCO STU...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Did I forget to mention yoooouuu?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You?! That's me!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'M TALKIN' SPRINGFIELD... WHERE NOBODY SUCKS! Except for Flanders?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I get it, I get it! She's good!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Looks like they love ya, kid. And the audience is always right! I wish I could say the same about my stockbroker.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Ah, what do you jerks know? That's a quality joke.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You did it, sweetie!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, we did it, Dad.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I really do like working with you, Dad. Will you keep helping me?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Of course, Sweetie. You and I are gonna write and sing our way out of this godforsaken Hellhole.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But your song said you liked Springfield.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wrote it about Shelbyville, then changed the names.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: LA LA LA LA LA LA LA LAAAAAAA.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good job, sweetie. Every time you hit that note, I'll shoot a glass with my BB gun.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I really appreciate your taking such an interest in me, Dad.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, our time together is precious to me. I didn't want to say anything, but I don't think I'm gonna be around much longer.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Really? What's wrong?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Moe's getting a big screen TV in February. Just in time for the Pro Bowl. Maybe this time my beloved blue shirts will win.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Is it possible to get a green spotlight?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let Daddy go talk to the man.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: May I have a word with you?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is that green enough for you, sweetie? 'Cause I can make it greener...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, it's fine.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's Cameron. Girls go crazy over him. He's cute, unthreatening, and his smile brought a puppy back to life.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry honey, the song I wrote you is so schmaltzy, it'll make "Moon River" sound like a farting Orangutan.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: MY KITTY DIED ON CHRISTMAS EVE

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: DADDY TOLD ME TO BE BRAVE

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: BUT INSTEAD OF SINGING CAROLS / I WAS DIGGING SNOWBALL'S GRAVE...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: All right, you know how it works. Every week we eliminate one contestant based on the votes cast by you, the audience.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Disclaimer: All ballots were lost and vote totals made up.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: The first contestant eliminated is... Katie Anderson!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Katie, you were the first victim of the Buzz Cola trap door. Fall into the flavor hole!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: And the next contestant to be eliminated is... Clarissa!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, it's you, honey. Please don't cry. Keep cryin', it's dynamite!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sweetie, tonight you were perfect...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, Lisa and I were just discussing how to improve tonight's performance. Now you're confusing her by telling her she was perfect.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My little girl likes Red Vines! You little...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You think I can't kill you? There's a hundred little punks graduating from Syracuse this year that would beg to kiss my ass! Get outta here!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, these are Red Vines. Here you go, sweetie. Daddy got you your candy.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, I'm worried you're turning into some kind of super koo-koo stage mother.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. For once, couldn't you just turn into a good father? Would that be so hard?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, gimme a break. Living through Lisa is the healthiest thing that ever happened to me.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But Dad, you don't need to help me by humiliating people.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You love sausage but you hate to see it getting made.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't like sausage.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then would you like to see it getting made?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad... you're fired.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fired... me?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Everything I did, I did for you.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I'm sorry you're hurt, but you left me no choice. You were obnoxious at a level not even permitted in show business.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Do you know the hours I worked? The people I had to yell at? The tires I had to slash?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No one asked you to yell and slash!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's called smoozing!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you wanna go to the video arcade?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hell, I'll even go shoe shopping.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, come back! I'm calming down! We'll have family fun! Family funnnnn!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, everybody...I brought a guest.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Someone who appreciates my in-your-face management style.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ha! Smart move. Soon the whole world will be lining up to suck my nose. After I make my new client a star.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're working with Cameron now?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: His name isn't Cameron anymore. He's now "Johnny Rainbow."

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not Mr. Simpson. That ship has sailed. I'm Colonel Cool! And I'm the Captain on this rocket to the stars.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So, are you a Colonel or a Captain?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Neither. I'm both.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, I wanna teach you a little something about jazz hands.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't stop till it's as natural as breathing.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad looks so happy.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Actually, I think your father's still upset about the way things went down.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge. Bart. Maggie. Santa's Little Helper. Lisa!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I don't want things to be awful between us. I made you some cookies.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think cookies are gonna make me feel better.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh God! Oh, they're delicious! Oh, so happy! Oh God, they're... They're gone.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi! This lighting's a little bright. And um, could I get a red wash in the background?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We are!

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders?

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay Morty, gimme a rose-colored spot, tight to the mid-chest and an aqua background with an astronaut on a surfboard.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Um, at the end of your song, remember to look into the spotlight. It makes your eyes twinkle.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Dad.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're welcome.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: This is our final night. Thirty contestants have already fallen through our Buzz Cola trap door.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey! You're supposed to clean this out every night! Whaddaya mean, talk to your shop steward? Eh.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now let's welcome the first of our two finalists... Lisa Simpson!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ladies and gentlemen, I have a confession to make. I didn't have my usual songwriter tonight...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So I took a stab at writing my own song. Something that expresses what's really in my heart.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bernie, if you please.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'M IN THE FINAL TWO / I SHOULD BE HAPPY / BUT ALL I WANT TO DO / IS SPEND MORE TIME WITH MY PAPPY... NOW THAT YOU'RE GONE, DAD, I MISS YOU SO MUCH / AND YOUR THREATS AGAINST TEAMSTERS AND TECHIES AND SUCH / YOUR MANAGEMENT STYLE IS LIKE ATTILA THE HUN / YOU WERE VICIOUS, MALICIOUS, BUT YOU GOT THE JOB DONE...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'M SORRY I HURT YOU, BUT PLEASE DON'T BE SAD / YOU'RE NO LONGER MY COACH, BUT YOU'RE ALWAYS MY DAD...

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Even the Applause-O-Meter is crying.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh God, that's battery acid!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you know the best part about this whole thing has been the time we've spent together. I don't care if I win, just as long as you're in my corner again.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I always was, honey. Look. Cameron's about to sing the song I wrote for him. He's about to learn the most important lesson in the music business: don't trust people in the music business.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What the Hell?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: You suck, Johnny Rainbow!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I believed in you!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you sabotaged Cameron for me!

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure did. I'd do anything for you, honey. Especially if it's easy.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I think you're the sweetest Dad in the whole world.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll always be there. Not even death will stop me.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Now you're getting creepy.

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How 'bout "I love you, honey?"

title: A Star Is Torn
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Good.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, kids! I scream, you scream, we all scream for...

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Haircuts!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, Bart and I have been talking...

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You have?! That's so nice!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What Lisa's trying to say is... there's a new kids' barbershop in the mall, and we'd like to start going there.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A kids' barbershop? But they don't have my templates.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, the templates had a great run. But we'd like our hair to look like um... people hair.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. I see. Well, good luck getting to your precious mall barber, 'cause I'm not driving you.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, wanna go to the mall?! They're baking fresh Cinnabons... which means they're throwing out the old ones!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yay!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I guess I'll just cut my own hair.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Left! Right! Stab! Stab! Stab!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, you look worse than Aunt Patty in the morning. And there ain't nothin' looks worse than Aunt Patty in the morning.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My bad-boy spikes!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: My good-girl points!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The best photographs, or "photos", will be prominently displayed in the school lobby all year long.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: After 'em!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I love you, Dumpster-bons.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad?!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, big surprise. The fat guy's eating garbage.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Come on -- we'll hide in the theater!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, I guess you didn't find anything interesting to photograph.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Check it out! The principal's got a shirt wiener!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Leave your body, Seymour. Leave your body.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Left Below." Ooh, a "He Is Risen" production!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Finally, a character I can relate to. I bet good things happen to him.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Left below?! Where have I heard that before?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's the title of the movie.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's everywhere!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This movie will haunt me for the rest of my life, just like Cannonball Run Two.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge... what if the Rapture is coming and I haven't led a good enough life? I could be... left below!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sweetie, don't worry. God wouldn't spring the Rapture on us unannounced. He'd send us signs, like, I don't know, all the dogs getting on a spaceship and leaving.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I'll bet the cats would be psyched about that. Thanks Marge, you've put my mind at ease. Now how about a little "rapture" for Mama?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, I could be the Rachel to your Jacob.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, but it's tough for me not to think about their hardship.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge is right -- the Rapture isn't coming! There haven't been any ominous signs!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Blood is raining from the sky!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Judgment day is at hand.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Begat. Uh, do you have any books on the Rapture?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll take everything you've got!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, thank you.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here's a pretty little wig for Lisa, and a handsome toupee for Bart!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So, you still think I'm crazy for saving all your hair trimmings?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, ma'am.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay then. Let's get the rest of this hair back in the freezer.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you didn't touch your second dinner tonight. And you're reading books! Word books! What's going on?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, the Rapture is nigh. These books will help me figure out how nigh.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This whole deal is scientifically proven. The Book of Revelation has four hundred and four verses... add the number of people at The Last Supper...

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...minus the number of Filipinos in the Bible...And you get...

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He writes "3150518" on the board.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Three million, one hundred and--

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Up bup bup!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Three fifteen p.m., May 18th! That's when the Rapture will be!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: May eighteenth? That's one week from today!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A week? That's...seven days from now!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The world will end next week! Spend your children's college fund! Thaw that turkey now!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman reporting live from downtown Springfield, where overweight doomsayer Homer Simpson is predicting the world will end... next Wednesday! Homer, what turned you from sad drunk to mad monk?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Funny story, Kent. It's the end of the world! God loves you! He's gonna kill you!

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: That must mean you're right about the Rapture too.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here's my angle: there's no way in God's Heaven I should get into God's Heaven. But maybe he'll let me in, if I warn others the Apocalypse is coming, as I previously shouted.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: I see. Well, we have thirty seconds left -- any other cuckoo yip yap?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uhhh...

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here's one -- Revelation 6:13. Just before the Rapture, "the stars will fall to the Earth." So all you hippies out there might want to for that one.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: There you have it, folks. And if I can make a prediction of my own, this weekend's Springfield Lettuce Festival is gonna be bigger and better than ever. We've got romaine, ice berg, radicchio, and everyone's favorite, baby bibb. Even a few cabbages are getting in on the fun.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I'm glad you're getting exercise, I just wish it wasn't crazy exercise.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, in a world gone mad, only a lunatic is truly insane.

title: Thank God It's Doomsday
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, we love you, but we just don't think the world is coming to an end. Yet. A hundred years, global warming... we're goners. But for now, do you think you could lighten up on this "left below" stuff?

title: Thank God It's Doomsday

spoken_words: Like a woman who's made the biggest mistake of her life.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer? What are you doing here?

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I was just driving around the mid-Atlantic states, ringin' doorbells at random, and I just... oh, who am I fooling with my awesome lies? I want you to come back to Springfield.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Why? So you can make me a laughingstock again?

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: After the party.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, I wanna make you a respecting stock. I don't know if you've noticed, but I've borrowed a lot of your stuff over the years...

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, that is true. In fact--

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Shut up, Flanders. But some things I could never take from you: your kindness, your gentle spirit...

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...and your infinite patience with a big, dumb jerk like me. Oh, Ned, I don't deserve you as a neighbor, but will you forgive a young, handsome fool and come home?

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer, that's really touching. But my boys and I are trying to make a new start, and the people here are a little more my cup of...

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: That tears it! Boys, put on your goody two-shoes. We're moving back to Springfield!

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Now you've got a pen pal.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: So you see Mr. Roberts, I really would like my house back.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I am a little pudgy. You got me. Yeah.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Now coach, I've tried to be Christian and respectful, but I guess I'm just gonna have to point out your two hundred thousand dollar check bounced. Legally, I still own this house.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I saw my advantage and I took it. That's what heroes do.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Ned. Get ready for your welcome home surprise.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Did you steal the organ from the church?!

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe. We don't know that for sure.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, you've gotta take it back!

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: It sure is great to look down my nose at everybody again. Mind if I waggle my finger a little bit?

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Go nuts.

title: Home Away from Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders. Okay, that's it. Really irritating!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Good news, children.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: This Friday, we'll be holding a school-wide Medieval Festival.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Medieval? Like "Lord of the Rings?"

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: No, not at all.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Can't we just keep going forward in our textbooks?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: No. Now, I've already assigned each of you a role in the Medieval Court. Martin, you shall be our king.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Not so fast, Nelson. You're one of King Martin's guards! Haw haw!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You'll pay for this!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: My liege.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What'm I gonna be? Black knight? Court ninja? Bart the Impaler?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Bart, you'll be playing the village cooper.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What kind of a knight is that?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: The kind of knight that makes barrels and isn't a knight. Ha!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ay carumba.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, this stinks. But I bet Lisa got something even stupider.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now as queen, you shall be entitled to eat the same French Fries the teachers do.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The ones made from potatoes?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The very same.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: My coat of arms is a Spider-man couchant on a field vert.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: What's couchant mean?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Lying down.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You mean like you? Now, what's "vert" mean? Say it means punching.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: So Willie, during the festival, you'll be wearing these urine-soaked rags. You're the village idiot!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now, allow me to apply this rubber cement to your face -- to represent the ravages of plague.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ach! My face! What drunken call girl will have me now?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now peasants, since the middle ages had no compact discs or Super Mario Men, people found entertainment in abusing the village idiot. So, let history come alive!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Wait! Let me take out my contact lenses!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Pelt all you want, but revenge will be Willie's. Ow! That was a stapler!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Cooper! More pink lemon-ale!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Cooper! Thy staves are not flush!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You'll pay for this, my Queen.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Guards, take him to the tower!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: It's the backseat of my Merkur. There's thirty-seven cents in the coin caddy. And stay out of my diary!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Quiet, my pretties. Soon we'll have revenge on those who mocked me. Also on those who were kind to me. And on parents who took time from their busy schedules to make today such a success. Ooh, I hate them all!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Noble idiot! Bring in the pie!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I dedicate this pie to the backbone of the feudal system: the serfs.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Scurry, me beasties... nibble and gnaw at their overstuffed buttocks!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse! Don't open your mouth!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Wha?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: This is no accident.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nice party, dink.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You're responsible for this, Simpson!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, get your things. You're leaving with me!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No way! I didn't do it! Unlike all the other stuff I told you I didn't do, which I did!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart, I'm sick of playing the tomfool. You are hereby expelled from Springfield Elementary!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, I can't believe you got expelled. Well, don't expect to spend all week lying around on the couch like a bum 'cause that's my thing!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, a school-sponsored Medieval festival is supposed to be the best day of a young girl's life, and you ruined it. You deserve to be expelled.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't do it! Mom, you believe me, don't you?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I love you. But sometimes I don't love your choices. Now we have to find another school for you.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And if you get kicked out of that one, you're going straight in the Army. Where you'll be sent straight to America's latest military quagmire. Where will it be? North Korea? Iran? Anything's possible with Commander Cuckoo Bananas in charge.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, this could be a good new school... Oakwood Academy! Huh?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, that's a school for the blind.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Think of the leg up you'd have!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How can we afford any of these private schools? They're all so expensive. If we want to throw good money after bad, why don't we just get Grampa that new pacemaker?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I need two double A batteries. Now!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get 'em from the smoke detector.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What if there's a fire?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The smoke will wake us up.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How 'bout this one -- St. Jerome's Catholic School?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Catholic schools are usually the most affordable private schools.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Catholic school, eh...?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That'll straighten you out, boy. There, you don't just get bad grades -- you go to Hell!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: My pacemaker!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Classic Grampa.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm Bart Simpson, ay carumba, do the Bartman, etcetera, etcetera.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks for the history lesson, sis.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll show you, I'll move thirty-three inches away.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now you tell me.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess they'd help me hold the dictionaries up.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid Catholic school. Suffering for my hip attitude... I'm the real Jesus here!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's it to you, Irish?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm only here because I got blamed for a prank I didn't do.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You do?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't need that new fact! Now I forgot who won Bud Bowl Eight. Boy, I'm pulling you outta that crazy school!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Stealing pairs of what? Hubcaps? Reeboks? Human eyes?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cool.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: St. Sebastian was a pious Roman soldier...

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: For preaching Christianity to the Romans, the Emperor Diocletian sentenced him to death by hail of arrows.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, this stuff is great! It's way better than the comics I get at the dentist.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: ...Then Father Sean quoted Eminem in his sermon. And in art class, we painted Saint Joan burning at the stake, and mine was the grossest! Catholics rock!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I'm glad you had fun, but I wouldn't get too into that Catholic church. With all the sitting and standing and kneeling, it's like Simon Says without a winner!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, that's blasphemy! I'll say a rosary for you.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you touch bead one! Homer, maybe we should be concerned. Catholics can be a peculiar bunch -- no birth control, no meat on Friday...

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No meat?! What do they eat, light bulbs?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Let's just change the subject. Bart, would you like to say grace?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yes'm. Anima Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto...

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! What the Hell are you saying?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's Latin, Dad. The language of Plutarch.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mickey Mouse's dog?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, Plutarch. He chronicled the lives of the Roman emperors.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! I'm Bart Simpson's father, and I'm sick of you teaching my son your time-tested values! Hey, what's that smell?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You've transformed breakfast into dinner. It's a miracle!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Log Cabin full of taste, my stomach is with thee. Blessed art thou among syrups and...

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All pancakes aside, I really came here to talk about my son.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bingo? That's my favorite game. I just can't remember what to yell out when you win.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's my favorite game. I just can't remember what to yell out when you win.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bingo!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You have to cheat.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, listen, is it true you priest guys can't ever... you know...

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Celibacy?! I was talking about the meat on Friday thing. Man, you guys got more crazy rules than Blockbuster Video.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait. No matter what I did, no matter how many people lost their pensions, it's forgiven like that?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, let's make some magic here. I wiped a booger on your shirt, I made a dog and a cat kiss, I swiped a bolted-down TV from a Holiday Inn...

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry Mom, but this is the Catholic church. Chicks don't have any authority here.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...I coveted the wife in "Jaws 2," I lied to a waiter, I masturbated eight million times and I have no plans to stop masturbating in the future.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! I'm clean! In your face, Lord!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Right. And how do I join? Do I whale on some Unitarians?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you've been out all night! And you look like you've accepted someone as your personal something. Were you at that Catholic Church?!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Marge, I know I was supposed to yell at that Priest, but he's so cool. He plays drums in a band with a bunch of other priests!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I knew they'd try to convert you! That's what they do! Well I'm not having another twelve kids.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, no one is saying twelve. Nine, ten, tops. See...

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Forget it! And you know, I went to a Catholic wedding once. The incense ruined my pantsuit!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, relax. I've never heard of anyone getting so upset about religion.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Marge! All by yourself today?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Homer and Bart are well, they're under the weather.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Um-hm. Under the weather? Or under the spell of a man in a pointy white hat?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right! I admit it -- they're both at the Catholic Church! Reverend, what should I do?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Marge, this calls for an emergency meeting of the church's spiritual council. To Stuckey's!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Back off, Popey LaPew!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Bart and Homer can't go Catholic! The Romans have been separate from us since the Schism of Lourdes in 1573. And that was about our holy right to come to church with wet hair. Which we've since abolished.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I guess it's good that they're taking an interest in spirituality.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, spirituality's great, Marge. Hey, I'm Mr. Spiritual. But remember... a different faith means a different afterlife.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Marge rubs her chin thoughtfully as we see...

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: where's Homer and Bart?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! Up here, that feels good!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wish my family was with me.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well then, I'd like to speak with Jesus.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Noooo!!!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Don't worry, Marge. We'll get your boy back.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Excuse me, that better be decaf.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Her husband's sleeping with her sister. Who said that?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Transubstantiation!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Welcome to the jungle, Kevin!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: First Communion?!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, we've gotta stop 'em now! Once they seal the deal, there's no turning back. Like the Jews with their snippity-snip.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, what are you doing here?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you're physically an adult, and what you do in the privacy of your own soul is your business. But I didn't change Bart's diapers for five years to see him become a Catholic.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I thought there was a monster in the potty.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Let's go!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: I think we've lost them.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They weren't following us.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Then why did I drive through that barn?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why did you guys have to take me away? You're always nagging me to go to church, and now that I am, it's the wrong one.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I just don't think your father's the right person to pick out a religion for you.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I'll pick a religion for me. Judaism.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: DON'T HAVE... A COW MAN / DON'T HAVE... A COW MAN / DON'T HAVE... A COW MAN / HAVE A PIECE OF FISH! Oy!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Bart, we're here to bring you back to the one true faith -- the Western branch of American Reform Presbylutheranism.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Homer.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you bring Bart home now! Once you go Vatican, you can't go back again.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It wasn't a fair fight! Your church suckered him in with gory stories, just like we were suckered into getting Cinemax.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Face it, Marge -- Catholics rule. We've got Boston, South America, the good part of Ireland, and we're making serious inroads in Mozambique, baby!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm gonna show Bart that Protestants can be hip too. How do you like those croutons?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why does that woman thwart my sporadic interest in my children? Shouldn't Bart and I be able to choose our own religion if we want to?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Strange as it sounds, Dad, I agree with you.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bwa?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Everyone should be able to choose their faith -- just like I chose Buddhism.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll ignore that. In fact, I'm gonna help you. I have a pretty good idea where they are.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now Bart, isn't this the kind of religion you'd like to be a part of for all eternity?

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's wrong, Bart? You love youth culture!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, a religion isn't cool just because they've glommed onto some crappy rock band from the nineteen forties.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You just don't get it. I've made a sacred commitment to the Catholic church, and... paintball! Awesome!

title: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Guest Star
name: Bart Simpson
