title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh! "Truck drivers needed in Iraq."

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Trucks are like big cars.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: So what are we going to do as a family today? Mini-golf? Pedal boats? Indoor rock wall?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Botanical garden? Build-A-Bear Workshop? Arena Football with the Springfield Stun?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Why are you laughing? Tell me! Private jokes are rude.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: But it's league night!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: This trial un-separation stinks. My parents used to compete for my love, and I cashed in every time.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And I always got the spillover. Drive-in movies, two Christmases, soda with dinner -- we lived like kings!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Remember when you told my Dad to go to bed and he did?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That was some New Years. Now listen. I think we should consider breaking your parents up again.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I don't know, Bart. I've wanted them back together for so long.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, you know they're gonna separate again. So why don't we just speed up the process?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: You know, Bart, my imaginary friend never made me do things I thought were wrong.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's why he had to go away forever.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I thought you were gonna let him come back!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm afraid he has to spend another year searching for his brain.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh, Dad... Mom says you're stinky and gross.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Mom, I don't wanna get Dad in trouble... but he just let me drink a beer.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I am drunk -- I'll prove it! Watch me... kiss this picture of Nana.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I can't do it. She's so mean to me. She wouldn't let me eat Fruit Loops!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Maybe my Mom and Dad are meant to be together, Bart.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You'd better hope not, 'cause you know what comes next? Your worst nightmare: a baby sister.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Bart. I baked you some cookies.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Skanks for nothing, Lamerella.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: If you two don't mind, I'd like to watch that cool Fox show about teenagers in Orange County.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I bet that bra was planted by Sterling, to break them up.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's a brilliant idea. Those TV writers are geniuses!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Whatever they're paid, it's not enough.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This bra is really gonna lift and separate: lift your mother's suspicions and separate your parents!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okey-doke. And you are...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Will she know what this is regarding?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's ridiculous! No woman would want to have sex with that loser! And, uh, congratulations on snagging him back. Good stuff.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This-this is Marge's bra. I bought it for her boobs!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Of all the people for Marge to cheat on, why did it have to be me?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh boy, am I beat! If you wanna return a melon to the grocery store, clear your day!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, that answers the mystery of the missing melon, but I have one more question: did you sleep with Kirk Van Houten?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How could you ask me that?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I repeat: did you sleep with Kirk?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you're crazy!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're not saying no.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Fine... No!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm still not hearing no.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, no!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, methinks the lady doth protest too much!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You don't trust me? After I salved every chicken pock on your ungrateful body! How dare you!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Get out of this house!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gladly.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We tried to break up your parents and we broke up mine!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Wanna call my therapist and tell her how you feel?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hello, Dr. Wexler?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I thought Mom kicked you out of the house.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I came to get my mail.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Resident... occupant... I can't open these. Ooh, a traffic ticket!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'd do anything to get your mother and that donut back.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay look, you and Mom can fix this. What exactly happened between the two of you?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, we don't need to know how. It's just a natural thing that happens, like a hurricane or going to war.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'd better go.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where are you staying?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know the Four Seasons? Well, I'm experiencing them first hand, because I'm living in the park.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I think you're behind this whole thing.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I can see how you'd think that. But on the other hand...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can read you like a book.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ha, ha, you read books.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: If you don't tell Mom what you did, I will.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh come on, wouldn't it be easier if our parents divorced and you compensated by marrying much older men? Meanwhile, I'll be one of those weird guys who's thirty-five and shows up at high school basketball games.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why did I marry that selfish jerk? I've asked him to flip the mattress a thousand times, and he never does!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Mom?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, sweetie.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... you know that bra that broke up our family?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-hmm.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I looked into it, and it turns out I was responsible.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Really? Well, just for that I'm gonna erase all the saved games on your PlayStation.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What?! How do you know about things like that?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I learned about it in here.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But now Dad can come home, right?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But he's innocent.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Innocent?! After all I do for your father, he still doesn't trust me. I'm finished with him.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Does this mean you and Dad might get a D-A-V-U-R-S?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Young man, you go work on your spelling... or I'll delete all the custom ring tones from your cell phone!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nooo!!!!!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse, our reverse parent trap just made everything worse.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Maybe we should use a different movie as our guide. Like "Oklahoma."

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: OH THE FARMER AND THE COWMAN SHOULD BE FRIENDS / OH, THE FARMER AND THE COWMAN SHOULD BE FRIENDS

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: ONE MAN LIKES TO PUSH A PLOUGH

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: THE OTHER LIKES TO CHASE A COW

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: BUT THAT'S NO REASON WHY THEY CAIN'T BE FRIENDS.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: What do you think, Bart? A hoedown could solve all our problems. I just need your chap size. It's two more than your pant size.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How many times do I have to tell you: no Rodgers and Hammerstein!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Rodgers and Hart?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well, what will trick your parents into getting back together?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Enough with the tricks!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid movie schemes do not work in real life. Mom and Dad have a marriage on the rocks and they need to work through it in therapy to make sure it doesn't shatter.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Rocks... shatter... jagged cliff... Lis, you've just given me an idea for the most insane, hair-brained, fool-proof scheme ever!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I don't want to live in a world without Bart!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. When Mom and Dad see this dummy fall in the river, they'll think it's me, and they'll realize what really matters: each other.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Do you like the dummy, Bart? I even made it smell like you.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now, to make sure Homer and Marge are in proper viewing position...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So, I got your note saying you wanted to meet here to apologize.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I got your note saying you were gonna bring me a bucket of potato salad.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Where's my apology?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where's my bucket?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now, I'll get my Mom and Dad's attention, and you shove the dummy in the water. Any questions?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Yeah. What are you going as for Halloween?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Pile of dog doo. Let's roll.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, Dad! I'm playing on a dangerous cliff -- because you're too busy arguing to pay attention to me!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! We're all disappointed there's no potato salad! But for God's sake, don't jump!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I can't tell which is which. Oh no! I'm already running!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I did it, Bart! Bart?

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm a-comin', boy!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This is all my fault! I planted Mom's bra in Milhouse's parents' bed!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little...

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! I can save you both! Just let go of the rock!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just do it! Trust me!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom... Dad. I'd give a kajillion dollars for you to get back together.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Make it two kajillion.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We'll lose the first kajillion to taxes.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess you showed you do trust me after all.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Of course I do. The only thing I can't believe is that a woman as great as you would be married to me.

title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homie...

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Lis, I bet I could jump in the swimming pool from here.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, that would be the stupidest thing you ever did.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, the stupidest thing would be doing it backwards.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cowa--

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Mom? Remember how you wished we would never grow up?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: I'm afraid your son is in a deep, deep coma from which he will never emerge.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I guess we should count our blessings he's not dead.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Don't I know it. This way I get to keep billing you.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, wake up. I got that bike you wanted!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Now, Marge, if you miss your boy that much, you could replace him with one of these.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A robot?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. A robot kid would be a blast. We can confuse him and make his head explode. "This statement is a lie. But if it's a lie then it must be true. But if it's true, then it must be..." Kaboom!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: And a robot would take your mind off your dead son.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I thought he was in a coma!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: They're pretty much the same thing... except this way I get to keep billing you.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You already said that!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Well, you didn't laugh the first time.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, he knows how to push all my buttons.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Time to destroy the one who did this to me.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, I'm a man who likes to strangle his kids. Do you think I could...

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you metal...!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, the windpipe is incredibly responsive!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: David is so helpful...

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And he's great with the neighbors.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hi-diddly-ho! There's "no bot" like a robot!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ow! My Flander-doodles!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Having a robot brother troubles me. The ethical implications are really tensing me up.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Goodbye, implications...

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: --bunga! What the?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nice and hot-o, Mr. Robot-o!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: David, you're by far the best son I've ever had. Uh-oh.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Did you replace me with this tinkertoy?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Replace is such an ugly word. We upgraded.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Eat my shorts.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here, make me a kitty!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hate going to the zoo. I feel so sorry for the animals.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, the zoo opens up a whole new world for the animals. In the wild they would never experience boredom, obesity, loss of purpose... you know, the American dream.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thank God I landed in a bunch of fruity birds.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This is where stem cell research led us!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: David and Bart just aren't working out. We have to do something.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm really sorry, but our family just can't handle both of you boys. I hope that somewhere deep in your data banks, you process fond memories of us.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The sad part is, there were times when I actually had feelings for you. I almost felt I was your father.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What are you talking about?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: David feels, and your mother will agree when I tell her, that it's best for our family if you're no longer in it.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We're still going to the toy store, right? And I can pick out as many toys as I want?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No toys!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There should be a law against abandoning your child...

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not a robot, I'm human.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I said I'm a human, not a girl.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Can I stay with you guys tonight?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, maybe. What did you used to do?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I get it, I get it! Sucks to be you. Goodnight.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heyyy, it's Bart! Super!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm ho-me!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You told me he was at culinary school!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You wanted to believe the lie!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Those were my good pants.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, the important thing is we're a family again.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This stinks! I've got stubby little robot legs and an ass that's not equipped for an adult diet.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad! Dad! Wake up! You're not a robot!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're just possessed by the Devil.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll call work and tell them he can't make it.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Suckers.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "Dear Homer Simpson -- Mr. Burns invites you to a hunting party at his private estate." Parenthesis, sinister laugh, closed parenthesis.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Please don't accept this invitation, Dad. Hunting is cruel.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, animals don't feel death. That was proved by the scientists at Black Angus.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No fair! Dad gets to kill wild animals, but I shoot one bird and I have to go to a psychiatrist.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He still thinks that hobo was a bird.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: This is a pretty sweet deal, Burns invitin' us over. What kind of motive do you think he has?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ulterior.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Welcome, all! Now to explain why I summoned you here.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh God, here it comes -- time-share pitch. Well I got bad credit, so the joke's on you!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You're here to participate in a hunt for the world's most dangerous game.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The game I am hunting... is all of you.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now, because I am too kind, I will give you all a five-minute head start. You may commence running.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Five minutes of running? Shoot me now.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, that broke the ice. Now, any man who lives till noon tomorrow shall win his freedom.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You tell me, you're my lawyer.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The game is afoot! I smell fear... mixed with curry!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You got me... but I shall be reincarnated!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, Mr. Burns is gonna kill Dad!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I should've known something was wrong when we got this week's TV Guide.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Dying is just like golfing. Except in golf...

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, hey, Homer!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Burns is coming, climb up!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ya fat ass.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Nyah, nyah, ya missed me.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, before I die, I'll just scratch that lottery ticket I got in my pocket.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: It was the first day of summer...

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: ...I was headin' to the restaurant supply store to buy some urinal-cake mix, when I was suddenly sideswiped by love.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: There she was -- the gorgeous new girl in town, Edna Krabappel.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, you poor man.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: She had gossamer hair, limpid eyes and the rack of an angel.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I see you're new to town -- maybe I could uh, show you around? I know a terrific tavern...

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Ha! My ex-husband was a drunk. I hate bars, saloons, nightclubs, and most of all... taverns.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, yeah, me too! Why, that's why I'm not a tavern keeper.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: What do you do for a living?

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Me? Well, I, uh, for a living? Well, there's all kinds of things a fella can do, such as... hemming, and hawing, and uh, but me, I'm a highly respected uh... therapist for alcoholics.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I knew that in order to win her love, I needed to get rid of the human garbage otherwise known as my best friends.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Barney, how do you keep gettin' back in?

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So uh, where were we?

name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I had to get Edna out of Springfield -- make a fresh start in a new town, far away. A place where we can play bridge with our neighbors. And if they're interested in wife-swapping, who am I to say no? I'm just the new guy.

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
name: Moe Szyslak

name: Moe Szyslak

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story

title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now if you'll excuse me, I have to rehearse my "Desperate House-flies" sketch. Buzz, buzz. Ooh, here comes that sexy young garbage man. I'm gonna need a shoebox full of blow to get through this dreck.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, there's something I have to tell you father to son. I passed out on your turtle and killed it. Someday you'll thank me.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Milhouse.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It worked!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now, there's something I've wanted to do for a long time.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Can't you read my writing? I didn't say kick Homer's "walls".

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's goin' on?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's better.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think so. In fact, why don't you give me your lunch money?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, my go-- Yes, him.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Finally, someone who does whatever I say.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey Bart, I shaved my head, like you told me.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Get lost.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Yes, Master!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, did your mystical Jewish monster beat up those bullies?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's always the Jews' fault.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm, well I think your golem doesn't like hurting people. And I'll prove it.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Speak.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Do you feel bad about what you did?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey boy, where's your mud buddy? I have a little job for him.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He was driving me crazy so I sent him on an errand.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skin-ner! Just let him kill you already.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: That's the man I was telling you about.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skin-ner! I wish we'd been closer. Get him out of here, Willie.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: You'll make better mulch than you did a man.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I may be bifurcated, but I still have feelings.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He sure is neurotic for a monster.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The cure to any man's problems is a good relationship.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, get him a woman. That'll end his misery!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This hurts so much.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Just write a scroll, asking him to stop.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Writing's for nerds.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Will you shut up?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Not so fast! You're wanted for the murder of Seymour Skinner.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Latkes? What the hell are those?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Case dismissed.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: I don't get it -- what's so "Great" about this Depression?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Well, I like how everything's sepia-toned. Makes me feel all nostalgic.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I never thought it would come to this when I fought in the first world war.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: First world war? Why do you keep callin' it that?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, you'll see.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Announcer
spoken_words: We interrupt this dance music from the Meridian Room in Capitol City's fabulous Hotel Hitler, to bring you a special bulletin.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I'm not done dancin'! This bulletin better swing!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Reports are coming in of giant metal cylinders landing on the outskirts of major American cities.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Cylinders?!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Astronomers say the ominous capsules originated from Earth's closest neighbor...

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Mars!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, it's a war of the worlds. Good thing we've got the sun on our side.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Go ahead and hide, you coward!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Settle down, children. Have a cigarette to calm your nerves.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay boys, we're under attack! Let's drive 'em out of town the way we did with the Irish!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Burn everything!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You know, Homer, we haven't actually seen these aliens.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's alien talk!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: We have nothing to fear, but the aliens and their vastly superior killing technology!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Boys, we have to assume our guns are useless. Throw 'em in the lake.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Good. Now, the police car.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Wait -- did you get my sweater out of the front seat?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well where is it?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, I have an idea! The Martians are only killing humans, so we should pretend to be animals!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What is everyone doing?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We're outsmarting the Martians.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Martians? You do know that radio broadcast was a hoax?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. It was an Orson Welles radio play of "War of the Worlds."

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm proud of what I achieved during my rioting.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It was either kill him or kill no one!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad! A flying saucer blew up that statue!

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, that was just a radio show.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Paw.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Oh yeah? Why don't I just punch you in the nose, Bud?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Fine, fine, I'll do it right now.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Uh, we've been invaded... by a pompous, radio ham.

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: How's it feel when the hoax is on the other foot?

title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Tell it to the Great Gildersleeve.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Bart, can we go to Banana Republic? There's a mannequin there I have a crush on.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse, that is the most pathetic thing I ever... oh my God, she's beautiful!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Bullies!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait -- they're employees! They have to be nice to us! Let's go.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh shoe-boy? I'm looking for something in a cross-trainer.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What size do I smell like?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: You're lacing it wrong! I want it overy-undery, not undery-overy.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Re-lace them all!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: What's this assembly for? A surprise Doodlebops concert?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Standardized tests, standardized tests, standardized tests...

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who are these wonderful people?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Dearborn, Michigan?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: No, here!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Announcer
spoken_words: The Army -- It's everything you like!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, I'd do anything for my beloved Army.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: How about you bite me?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Great news, Ma! I agreed to join the army when I turn eighteen!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What?! Homer! Our son joined the Army!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, big deal -- by the time Bart's eighteen, we're gonna control the world! We're China, right?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now listen, Bub. You go down to those recruiters and tell them Bart is too young for the Army. I don't want this to be the only memory I have of him.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How come I can't join the army but Lisa gets to be in PETA?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I think she just answers their phone...

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Fur is murder! When's the Krusty movie coming out?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: This one's ruined! Gimme the backup.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now the babies.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: And the monkey-head mittens!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, I'm a real class act.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, guys. You know, his mother's the one who made me come down here.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Go on.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wouldn't that take me away from my family for two whole years?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Where do I sign?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now where's my parade? Where's my parade?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, "Who makes what in America." Army private: fourteen thousand a year.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, with all the things you've done -- go into space, attend clown college, join the Navy -- I never thought you'd join the Army!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, even the Army has Humvees now!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, don't do this -- you have a wife and three young children at home.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I have to Marge. Who else is gonna keep oil under a hundred dollars a barrel?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You? Don't make me laugh! You couldn't--

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, no, daddy's just teasing. Of course you could. You could keep it under a hundred. Yes, you could.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No she couldn't.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are you gonna ask us our major malfunctions? 'Cause mine is I care too much.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Snowflake?! What happens to me in the summer?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't understand. How does punishing them teach me a lesson?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, you've got an awesome voice.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can you say "Side effects may include drowsiness and loss of appetite?"

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hm, sounded better in my head.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Everyone got an assignment but us.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wonder what makes us so special.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's an odd way to start handing out medals.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are we that stupid?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So they're not shipping you overseas?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nope. I'm gonna stay here and let them test their laser-guided super weapons on me -- like that one!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, Dad. You'll do great.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, these are war games and I'm head of my team. I have to think like a great military leader.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I will!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stay crunchy, men! Stay crunchy!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, I just remembered. It's Chinese New Year!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gung hay fat choi! Gung hay fat choi!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Americans!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Is this war?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: This pain feels so real.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh. Guess I'd better do my part.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bring it on, chumps!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fingers, fingers, fingers!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Whatcha doin', Moe? Drawin' a wang on Marmaduke?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Heck no -- I'm challengin' myself with one of these "Sudoku" games.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: What, that Japanese puzzle in which no numeral can be repeated in a row, column, or box?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That's how it works? I was just drawin' wangs on the numbers.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, Moe, you gotta hide us from the Army!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: The Salvation Army? You got it.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not that Army, the one from "Stripes!"

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Moe. How can I ever repay you?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, some things mean more to me than money...

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: ...like a whole lotta money!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Eh, long story.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, what have we got?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Rise my pretties! Find our enemies and capture their image in your filmy fortress!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you'd better hurry. I don't think Dad can last much longer where he's hiding.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not gonna surrender. You've seen what the U.S. Army does to prisoners. How would you like to be stacked naked in a pile with a hillbilly girl pointing at you and laughing?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Marge always loves your cards. Well, you may not be the smartest guys in the Army...

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'd give anything to hear Homer's voice.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "H" means "hot"?!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid Army, searching for me with that giant helicopter in the distance.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's not giant and it's not in the distance! It's small and it's in our room!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Predator drone!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Excuse me, I don't belong here -- I am not bald! I am balding! Why will no one honor the ding?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I honor the ding, sir.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: What the hell are you talkin' about?!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, we've got to stop them from pacifying our town!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry. I have a secret weapon -- one more powerful than any gun.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa's face?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A phone tree.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Dorothy's daughter comes every Sunday and brings all kinds of wonderful soups.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: And Melvin's son brings a banjo. And he works our names into his songs!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Helen? I'm calling about the recent destruction of our town. Well, I have a little plan to fix their wagon.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes Nelson, of course I'll help... And a haw-haw to you!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: So that's the plan: we're meeting at the reservoir at eight p.m.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Terrific. Now call Lindsay Naegle.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We're going to dump it in the water to get the army drunk.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Wow. This'll be the first time I ever watered down my booze.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Moe, why're your eyes dartin' back and forth so much?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, I-I'm just thinkin' about a-a great tennis match I saw once. Yeah.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Now I'm thinkin' about ping-pong... a very fast chess game... a snappy David Mamet play...

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Colonel, we're here to discuss the terms of your surrender.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you dare go limp!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm... Let's see what your hangover has to say!

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Colonel, I hope you've learned that an occupying foreign force can never defeat a determined local populace. Among the many things we learned in Vietnam is that a well-motivated...

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right, but no combat.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dudes! Wanna make some extra spending money? Get a free pair of boots? Hey baby, you like obstacle courses?

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thinking it over, huh? I'm cool with that.

title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, pal. Like the way you handle that mop. You like killing? Hey, ladies. Are you tired of waiting for sanctions to work? I know I am.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm... I must be supposed to remember something.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, memory, wake up!

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is it our anniversary? No, we don't have one this year. Hmmm...

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't forge? Don't forge what?

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh, don't forget. Don't forget what?!

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hustle your bustles, gang! We're going to the Senior Olympics to root for Grampa!

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The Senior Olympics? That's what I was supposed to remember?!

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Too late. The deed is done.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, grab a fold.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh hey Homer, I hope you didn't forget that today's our big day!

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I sure am looking forward to my birthday fishing trip... Well I'll see ya soon, this is Moe, big day... uh, waitin', feeling uh, kind of fragile... Moe, the birthday boy, listenin' for your car...

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I can finally win a gold medal. I came close at the 1936 Olympics...

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I threw a javelin that barely missed Hitler...

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: But I did hit an assassin who was trying to kill Hitler.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: The next time I saw Hitler we had dinner and laughed about it.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's with the lined composition book?

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: My report on a "Fascinating Springfielder" is due Monday, and everybody I've tried to interview is so boring.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You could interview me. I collect Absolut ads.

title: Moe'N'a Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How many others do you have?

spoken_words: Well, there you have it, people-- Sweet Morley Safer -- do I see a telegenic housewife making art out of popsicle sticks? Set this baby down -- I smell soft news!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Ma'am, I'd like to feature you on my award-submitted segment, Kent Brockman's "Kent-resting People"!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Really? You think people would be Kent-rested in me?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: I do.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: I'm here with local sculptress Marge Simpson who works in, of all media, popsicle stick! Our viewers want to know two things: why, and how come?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why did cavemen paint on walls? Why do you scratch your name on Tupperware? So when you die, something's left behind that says, "I was here. I mattered. That's my Tupperware."

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Human feelings, expressed by a human!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: And here's a local nobody enjoying his likeness. Let's take a sneaky-peeky.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: My God, it's beauty-ful! I-I-I finally see the goodness in myself. C'mere, you.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so glad you like it, Moe.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That's right, tell me all your little wooden dreams. You're not alone any more. No you ain't.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, you're shivering, are you cold? Where you goin', Marge?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, I brought you more sticks.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, this sculpting has made me feel so fulfilled. I'm as hopeful and full of life as I was in the years before I met you.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's good to see you smile again. I was lonely being happy all by myself.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well no one's gonna be lonely tonight.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let me just put on some romantic music.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, we got the whole night, baby -- let's slow things down.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're from Texas?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My own art show?! I'm so happy... do you mind?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yee-hah!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey lady, you gotta pay to use my likeness. It's a registered trademark!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, I do more than TV. I had a one-man show on Broadway. That's who showed up -- one man! Long story short, I won a Drama Desk Award.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, everything looks wonderful!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm off to pedal my frosty wares!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You can't go to work! I need you here for emotional support -- plus you make a small crowd look huge!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sweetie, I can't abandon my route even for one day. If those kids discover the link between eating right and feeling good, I am screwed. But I'll be back in time for your show.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The show starts at three. You promise you'll be here?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I would never let you down. Our marriage is like soft-serve ice cream. And trust is the hard chocolate shell that keeps it from melting onto our carpet. In cone-clusion, here's the scoop: I love you.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the hell do you kids want? Oh right, ice cream.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God! It's the opportunity of a lifetime!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Attention, losers: this is your chance to buy your kids some frozen love.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Mom would.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, I'm all out of ice cream.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge's show!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Must jettison excess weight!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, I've only got nine seconds till Marge's show!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, where are you?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll never make it! Unless...

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! I'm gonna be on time!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: No, no, no -- save your energy. Eh, eh -- don't try to talk.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I don't know where Carl ends and I begin.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: See, statements like that are why people think we're gay.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I made it back for your show, honey...

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Homer, you destroyed my artwork and my dreams. Good job. Very thorough.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, let me explain: I had a chance to make a little more money by exploiting broken families...

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, stop. Just stop. You don't care about anyone else's happiness but your own!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well excuse me for having enormous flaws that I don't work on!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge? Marge?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, you've been in there all day. You gotta eat something. Why don't you come downstairs and cook dinner? Lasagna would be awesome. Marge?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I wrote you a check for three hundred dollars to pay for all the sculptures I broke. Okay?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I see. You'd prefer a wire transfer. What's your routing number?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's okay, I can get it from the bank, honey. I just need to know your birthday.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge? I have an apology that I hope is better than all the other ones. So please listen carefully. The thing I liked best about being an ice cream man wasn't the free ice cream, or the colorful toppings, or the love I received from obese children. It was giving you those sticks, and watching you smile as you turned them into art.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If it would win you back, I would gradually eat all the parts of a motorcycle. I hope it doesn't come to that. Could you please just give me a sign that you still love me a little?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If you won't talk to me, I'll send in Polaroids to show you how sad I am that I let you down.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm laughing in the last one, but it's only 'cause the cat fell down the stairs.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She's been gone for a while.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa's been watching us.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You kids have been real good tonight.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom! Mom!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, where are you? Did you change your name? Is it Kelly? Kelly!!!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Comic Book Guy! Have you seen our Mom?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: A complete list of things I have seen or not seen is available on my blog. Your mother is on the "not seen" list, along with a Star Wars film that was any good since the first one. And even that has been ruined by CGI additions! Bravo, George.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There's Mom!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God. She's gonna jump. Marge, don't do it! Give divorce a chance!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I wanna show the world how I feel about you.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The world's not that interested!

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They will be! Ready, bullies?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you wanted a sign that I still love you, so here it is.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! You made me a sculpture of Magilla Gorilla.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, Homer. It's you. My sweet, perfectly imperfect you.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Okay boys, on my command, fire.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Geez, if everyone was like you, our morgues would be empty.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, I realized that my most enduring creation is the life I've sculpted with you.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now I know that my lega-she is really a lega-we.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I just have one question, my darling: what did you do with all the ice cream that was on all those sticks?

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's in that dumpster.

title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not that one.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom! Bart's drinking coffee!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's not coffee, it's hot Pepsi!

spoken_words: You're the worst husband in the world!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah? Well I wish I'd married Patty and Selma!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wish I'd married Lenny and his friend!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Man, Mom and Dad are really going at it.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hope everything's okay.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you spit sunflower seeds at me!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You used to love it!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Recording that fake fight was a great idea.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now the kids won't bother us during our morning snuggle.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dear Lord, thank you for the physical intimacy we are about to enjoy.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And, as always, have fun watching.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: GOOOO... LOVEMAKING!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I hate the cutesy way you make Jack-o-lanterns! I like scary Halloween, not funny Halloween!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: County Fair music?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse, steady my duds!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Trust me, Bart. It's better to walk in on both your parents than on just one of 'em.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey dinks, gimme your lunch money.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: But what will I eat at mid-day?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I can't solve all your problems -- just hand over the money.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Thanks, wads. And I hope to see you both Saturday!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Come to my party or die! Come to my party or die!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I hate Nelson's parties -- he makes you look at his baseball cards and tell him they're good. They're not good!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait. What if... NOBODY goes? He can't kill all of us.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well said! If we all stand together, Nelson's helpless. Hell no, we won't show! Hell no, we won't show!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Hell no! I won't mow!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Willie, you're fired with complete loss of pension.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Dammit!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You actually convinced people not to go to Nelson's party?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yup, he'll be all alone on his birthday! Oh, I wish I could see it. Boo hoo! I'm Nelson. No one likes me.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bartholomew J. Simpson, how can you be so mean?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What are you gonna do about it?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll whack you with the whole salad set if you don't start thinking about others! You are going to that party.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I can't go -- no one else is!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if no one else jumped off the Empire State Building, would you not jump?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Kind of?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah c'mon Bart, the party will be fun. Nelson's not bad -- all he needs is a little kindness.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, you're never gonna get a husband by being sarcastic.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All right, no husband.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're getting a husband! And you are going to that party!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, don't make me go! I'll give you a back rub!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, your elbow's like an angel's kiss. But you still have to go.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, we all have to do things we don't want to. Like have jobs and families and responsibilities, and having to be Mr. Funny all the time -- You think I wouldn't rather be living nude in the forest? Like some ancient pagan! Just dancing around playing the pan flute! And here we are!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, just walk in, say happy birthday, and get out.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This party doesn't suck. Pizza, that's a nice touch.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Uh-oh, do I hear a dial tone? 'Cause this party is off the hook! What up, B?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um, happy birthday, Nelson.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Uh... I know it seems a little quiet... must be a lot a traffic today. Is highway eighty-eight backed up?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah. It's a parking lot out there.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Of course! That explains everything. Stupid highway eighty-eight!

title: Kill Gil, Volumes I & II
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Too late.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: They're coming! They are! I love you, Spidey!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Don't go! My party peeps are en route! I swear!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nelson... nobody's coming.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: But... how could nobody come? I ordered them to.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, that's the thing. Sometimes, you can be kind of a jerk.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: True... but I thought I had some friends.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe you can have fun with just me.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Okay, why not?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: C'mon, Bart! Let's knock him down!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait... I have an idea.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. How'd you afford this kick-ass party?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So, how was Nelson's party?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Not bad. We had pizza, cake, and then sang songs with Nelson's Gramma. But, it was a one-time thing, and now I'll never see him again.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey... it's my birthday bud!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, it was uh, super fun. Good times. Hey, Ralph! Have I got a half a sandwich for you.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Bart, where you goin'? I saved you a seat, best friend.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Haw haw!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, best friend, I got you a present. An entire case of pool cue chalk! Huh? Huh? We can make the tip of anything blue!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Um, Nelson, I was just thinking about us being "best friends."

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Whoa! Me too! We are so connected!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, um, I don't have time for new friends. I got a lot on my plate. I've got a big report due on the Nile river: topic sentence, bibliography, page numbers... it's nuts.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Bart is my best friend now. Which means no one picks on him ever again.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Isn't he? I've known him for years, but I ran into him at a party and we really clicked.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, we're best friends now. So why don't you go pick on someone smaller and weaker?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie...

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: When you're done putting Lisa to bed we can, uh, finish what we started the other day.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Marital sex!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, tucked in tight, glass of water, nightlight on, no barn owls, don't do drugs, love you, good night.

spoken_words: Dad, can't you read me a story for a little bit?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple

spoken_words: But your mother smells like coconut!

spoken_words: Okay sweetie, which book should I read?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Dad, I'm tired. We'll read more tomorrow.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! We have to read it together.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, of course. Whatever you say, sweetie. Nighty-night.

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, gas ball -- you suck!

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nelson, do you ever wish you weren't a bully?

title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hmm, sometimes. But it's not up to me -- it's who I am. I mean, a shark can't stop swimming or it'll blow up.

name: Bart Simpson

spoken_words: So, Scotty, how do you like school?
