title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, thank God there's a fire. Marge's birthday's comin' up.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I think what she would treasure most is a gift bought through honest effort. Because...

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: ...integrity... trust... exploitation... the golden rule... role models... serious crime... zero tolerance... the Ten Commandments...

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Next time Maggie does that in a pool, tell me quietly, don't announce it.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But Mom, the lifeguards have to know.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just let the chemicals deal with it.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at me! I'm a fireman!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Mom, can we go see Dad put out the fire?

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess every boy should see his father as a hero.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey guys, check out the radical-free air generated by my stolen Ionic Breeze.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, bogus gizmo, grant me eternal life.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, is Dad stealing from people he's supposed to help?

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: King of thieves. We worship you.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He is stealing!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, uh...

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at me, guys!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm stealing five Segways at once! And speaking of segues, I'm off to my next morally questionable activity!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're nothing but a diabolical master thief. The kind that haunts the slopes of San Moritz or the casinos of Monte Carlo.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We're not thieves, we're scavengers! Like the beautiful vulture, or the heroic tapeworm, or America's sweetheart, the maggot.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You should've seen the faces of your children when they caught you stealing. Kids, get in here and show your father the faces!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Make them stop!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You make them stop -- by doing the right thing.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, can we talk?

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Are you crazy? It's five hundred degrees in here!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh no, wait, it's only four ninety-five. What's on your mind?

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, I think we may have perverted...

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: First Skinner, now you. Well, maybe you've got a point. Maybe we... ...a solid gold grandfather clock!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: This thing's hotter than Ellen Barkin!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, I can save you but you have to let go of the clock.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: But it's been in my family for over forty seconds.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait! What about Nabu?

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You've just been Apu'd!

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So Daddy saved Apu and Moe, and believe me, we learned our lesson.

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What'd you do with all the loot?

title: Crook and Ladder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We sent it to skid row where it would do the most good.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh man, I love Oktoberfest. Oktoberfest!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Springfield squash -- the most fibrous variety of yellow squash!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We drove fifty miles to look at a stupid pile of vegetables?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's it, buster -- you just bought yourself ten minutes watching that man make a wagon wheel.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yes'm.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Really?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This winning cornucopia is magnificent.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Styrofoam?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You stuffed your horn?!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can testify at the trial.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, look! Pine-cone first ladies!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where the hell is Abigail Adams?! Oh, there she is. Where the hell is Mary Todd Lincoln?! Oh, she's right there. Where the hell is Ida Saxton McKinley?! Oh I see. Where the hell is--

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, look, a corn maze!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Betcha can't solve our maze?" I didn't come here to be insulted. We're leaving!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure is a lot of corn in this parking lot.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, we're in the maze.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, why don't you throw me in the air, and I can see which way is out.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Corn... More corn... Another kid getting' thrown in the air... witch's coven... Seattle Space Needle... Amateur production of "You Can't Take It With You"... I'm getting dizzy... And corn again.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe we should split up.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Split up?! Marge, no! We can fix this marriage!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, I didn't mean--

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fine, you want out? Then go! I can make it on my own! Before I met you I had friends and dreams!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I was talking about--

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh please take me back. The dating scene is a nightmare. I'm begging you!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I just meant we should split up to get out of this corn maze.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Deep down, I... I guess I knew that.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now there must be a way out!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Of our marriage?! I don't want to live!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, this maze is made of corn!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so sick of being lost. To hell with maze etiquette! I'm walking straight outta here!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dammit!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How come things that happen to stupid people keep happening to me?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Finally! I knew we could solve that maze using Tremaux's algorithm.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Told you.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No you didn't -- your plan was to burn the corn.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That was never my plan.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm lost and I'm starving!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Eat some corn!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't have any holders!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Now don't worry, ma'am, we'll send a member of our elite canine unit in to find your husband's corpse. Living corpse.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Say hello to Officer Jaws!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Okay, everyone -- puppy party at my house!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry! Our dog'll find my Dad! We need you, boy!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We need you!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Good boy! Now go find Homer!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He needs something with your father's scent.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe there's something in Dad's backpack.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A sports bra?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He just needs it for walking upstairs.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "To my wife Marge -- in case I don't make it, here are my Oscar picks for next year: Best Sound Effects Editing, the team from--"

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Say... has he ever thought about a career in law enforcement?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Um... I don't think he's ever thought about anything.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Santa's Little Helper would be an awesome police dog! Can he, Dad? Can he?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No. And never bring it up again.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Please, can he?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's the matter, Bart?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, it is gonna be so cool when you're a police dog...

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Good boy! Now, transform!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cool.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: All right, listen up!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: For the next two weeks, I'm gonna be your worst enemy. Except this Thursday is the fourth of July, so we'll take Friday off as well. Well, I guess Wednesday everybody's gonna be thinking about the long weekend, so, meh, what the hell? Why don't we just take the whole week off?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Why'd you let me do that? We are so far behind.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Nice work, K-9s. Bring in the next group!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa: "Blow?" "Cage?" You're in uniform, Lou. Don't slang it up.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: It is my privilege to welcome this fine group of animals into the Springfield police force.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Keep your noses clean, and your hearts free of worms.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, since the dog's not here, I'm gonna take you for a walk.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I miss Santa's Little Helper. I wanted him to be a police dog, but now he has no time for me. I even have to eat my own homework!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Attention K-9 unit. We got an eight sixty-six in progress at the park. Over.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Fine. Let's not use any of our police equipment.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, you're back!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ow! You bit me! My own dog bit me.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe it. My own dog bit me.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now that he's had a taste of human flesh, the dog will be a slave to its succulence! Look at him eyeing me -- he knows I taste best.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Don't blame the dog, folks. A cop's life is so intense, he has to channel it somewhere. Me, I knit violent imagery.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Pretty grim, huh?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I love Santa's Little Helper, but I don't know if we can have him in our home anymore.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, you can't send him away! He's a dog, not Grampa!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What if Santa's Little Helper stops being a police dog? Then he can get a non-violent job, like barking songs on novelty Christmas records. You can do it, boy!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, boy, that's Hanukah.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Forget it, kid -- he's a cop now.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I bet he can't resist this.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Fetch, boy!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My God. I've lost him.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh relax, Marge, I'm just messin' with ya. I know I'm not a dog. I'm a people, like you.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's just Flanders. You know him.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I don't want a new dog. I want my old dog, the one who bit me.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Cheer up, boy. We'll get you their most vicious street cur! He'll bite your ass raw!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No street curs!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's it! I want a snake!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa, we're not made of money!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He is so awesome. I already love him more than I love Lisa.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It says here don't bother naming them. Snakes have poor hearing and only live to strangle.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I like it -- "Strangles." Hey Lis, wanna touch Strangles? He's not slimy at all. He's scaly.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ew! He is slimy!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's because I soaked him in slime!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little... I'll teach you to trick your sister!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, can you breathe?!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I can breathe out okay.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't... give snake... attention... it's what... he really... wants.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm okay.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Bart Simpson, you can't bring a python to school!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, don't ask me to show if you can't handle the tell.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Well I'm gonna show you to the principal and tell him all about it.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Mine was as funny as his!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: No one's arguing with you, lady. Now can we just learn something?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Lou, he's gotta get over it. I miss Shamrock Shakes, but they ain't comin' back till March!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I taste the flavor -- it's a very mild mint.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I know what I taste!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hey Lou, what's your favorite thing in the world so I can dump all over that?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Time for a head count. Children, line up according to height... no, weight... no, the sum total of the letters in your last names if each letter is assigned a numeric value according to its place in the alphabet! Quickly now!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Deadly toxic cloud! Deadly toxic cloud!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart's missing! He must still be in the school!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Let him go, Lou. He's not following his nose this time -- he's following his heart.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here, Strangles! Strangles?

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aw man, it's like some chemicals cut one.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Strangles, you came to save me!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Santa's Little Helper, you came too!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry... but a boy's gotta go with his dog.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: And... saved!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hero cop saves boy! Hero cop saves boy!

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I knew you loved me boy! Now you can be my dog again.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Don't worry. I'll give ya a home.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: That'll do, snake.

title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: That'll do.

title: 24 Minutes

spoken_words: Behold -- our new state-of-the-art weapon in the global war against misbehavior!

title: 24 Minutes

spoken_words: CTU -- the Counter Truancy Unit!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw haw.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've got something!

title: 24 Minutes

spoken_words: The sixth-grade security camera shows three empty desks!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Enhance!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Dehance! Dehance!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Good work, Database.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: We helped.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, get your own yogurt!

title: 24 Minutes
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Vile curd!

title: 24 Minutes
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Simpson, you can take your putrid mess far out of my sight, you songless land-whale!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo! Business trip!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Simpson! I'll teach you to make a Poupon "me!"

title: 24 Minutes
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: If someone did eat Bart's shorts, they'd have a tummy full of pocket garbage!

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The school's having a bake sale today! At three o'clock!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I promised them a cake!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I've only got twenty-seven minutes! The pre-heat is on!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Apu, I'm returning a yogurt I wasn't a hundred per cent satisfied with.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh my God, if a dead fish and a homeless person had a baby, and the baby puked, and a dog ate the puke, this smells like the rear end of that dog! I'll give you any yogurt in the store, just take that thing with you when you go!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Truants moving into the Kwik-E-Mart.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've got a visual.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: We've got what we need -- Milhouse, bring them in.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Roger that.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: And Lisa, if I don't make it back, there's a letter in my locker I want you to read.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I already read it.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: We've all read it.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, Milhouse -- hold your position. Something doesn't add up.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look what the bullies could have stolen...

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Big Chief Rotten Cheeks Chewing Tobacco...a take-a-penny tray with a quarter in it!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So why steal the yogurt? We have to find out what they're up to.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hmmmm... Milhouse, change of plan -- observe and follow.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Permission to buy a Hostess fruit pie to keep my strength up?

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Denied.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Milhouse, who're you spying on? Those bullies?

title: 24 Minutes
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, lay off -- you're the fat one of you guys!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm still alive! You call that playing to win?!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Mr. Simpson, I'm scared.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is our life now, Milhouse. We're dumpster folk.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've lost Milhouse.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: He'll be somewhat missed.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Whom do we send now?

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Principal Skinner, you know we have only one agent who stands a chance with those bullies. My brother.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lord, give me guidance. That's right, the guidance department -- detention room. Thank you, Mrs. Lord.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All out! I can't make my famous raisin sponge-cake without raisins! Kids love the zing of raisins!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: If I help you, I want full immunity for all pranks past and future, and you have to teach me a swear word I don't already know.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: No deal.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, suit yourself -- it's not like you have any major events coming up that the bullies would want to disrupt.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The bake sale!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Principal Skinner, as we both know, but you might need reminding, the annual bake sale provides ninety percent of the school's funding.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Okay, you have a deal, you conniving little...

title: 24 Minutes
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, that's a swear?

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Used as a noun it is.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sweet. Now I'm gonna need some wheels.

title: 24 Minutes
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Yes, of course -- I think we can wrangle you a used bicycle. Do you prefer Schwinn or Huffy? Bart? Where did he-- My car keys!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I saw it first! / You are such a liar!

title: 24 Minutes
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You give that to me!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, my family's gone, my dog hates me, and I can't remember what happened last night. Was I here?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Was you ever. You came in sayin' you really needed to forget something, so I mixed you up the most powerful drink I got... the "Forget-Me-Shot."

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A "Forget-Me-Shot?" Never heard of it.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That means it worked. No one ever remembers. That's why I made this video to explain the process.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You start with a splash of Jaegermeister, then add sloe gin, Triple-Sec, Quadruple-Sec, gunk from a dog's eye, Absolut Pickle...

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm, pickle...

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: The red stripe from Aquafresh...

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And the funniest ingredient... the venom of the Louisiana Loboto-moth.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: C'mon, sweetie.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You stir it with a home pregnancy test till it turns "positive"...

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And presto: the Forget-Me-Shot.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw jeez, I don't look like that.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: The point is, this drink is the ultimate brain bleacher. One swig wipes out the last day of your life.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Gimme one of those forget-me-drinks -- I made a mistake I gotta wipe out! I was trying to do a Don Rickles about Arabs, but it turned into a Mel Gibson about Mexicans.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

spoken_words: What the hell am I doin' here? I gotta get back to the Latin Grammys.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, why would I wanna wipe out my memory? What horrible thing did I do?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: You don't remember, huh?

name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: There was a domestic disturbance at your address yesterday.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Chief Wiggum! I remember seeing you...

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge had a black eye?! I could never do something like that! Could I?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Why don't you ask the person who filed the complaint? Not that I am authorized to release that infor--

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Fine, it was Flanders. Now since you know everything, who was Jack the Ripper?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The queen's private surgeonnn!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Wow.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Flanders, why did you call the cops last night?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

spoken_words: I had to -- I heard a hubbub, Bub.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What did I do?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

spoken_words: I can't say for sure, but as a Christian, I assume the worst.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What happened in this room? If only these walls could talk... people would pay to come see my amazing talking walls. And I could use that money to-- Hey, a memory!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah. Me too.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

spoken_words: Ya know, doin' this is just confirming a stereotype for you Mexicans.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Thank goodness you come to visit me, son! I can't take one more minute of this high school glee club pretending they don't hate being here.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You'll eat our cookies but you won't look at us!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I can't remember what I did last night. Do you have any idea?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your memory bubble and you.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You come to me for help rememberin'? That's like asking your horse to do your taxes, which I did back in nineteen ninety-eight.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm afraid I did something to make Marge and the kids leave me.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, I know someone who can help ya -- a doctor who helps people dig up old memories.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Really? Well, that's great, Dad. How can I ever repay you?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Punch that orderly who takes sips out of my juice.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Done.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: No wait, that's the guy that saved my life.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How 'bout The Deja Viewmaster?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is great! I'm finally gonna find out how I ruined my family! Strap me in, nerd!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bo-ring.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow. Ow. Ow!!! Three, two, one. Owwwww!!!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the hell?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "This bubble allows you to view any past event from your life." It's got that new bubble smell.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, I landed in a pleasant memory -- look at happy me and playful them.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I miss those bygone days of earlier this week. But I'm needed in a darker place.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Another man... with my wife... in my house... on top of my TV Guide?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've gotta find out who that guy is, but I need help. Someone like Bart, only smart. Lisa!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, I'm about to probe the most shattering moment of my life. You wanna join me?

spoken_words: With new Synergy Wireless, nighttime minutes start at six-thirty, and you get four free d-cast downloads per month. Synergy -- it's your call.

spoken_words: Kids, your mom is with another man, and I need you to help me find out who he is. Hm... is this really something I should show you kids?

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's okay -- we're not really your kids. We're just representations of them, that you created in your mind.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See? That's where my memory stops. Who the heck is that guy?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are you kidding? The mother of my children with the reason for my children! This is gonna be the greatest party ever!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God! It's like Christmas in December! Let's celebrate now.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop, Homer! Please!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My eye!

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry honey, I'll get you an ice pack. Where's the ice pack?

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So Marge wasn't cheating on me, I never hit her, and my family is throwing me an awesome party. Thank God I figured it out before I did anything stupid.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I got just the drink to wipe your mind clean... the "Forget-Me-Shot." Fellas, if you got anything that you want to say to Homer that he'll never remember, say it now.

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
name: Carl Carlson

name: Moe Szyslak

spoken_words: Hmmm... The only problem is, I'm sure to retain some image of coming home and finding Duffman. No doubt I'll misconstrue that as him placing a cuckold's horns upon my brow. And that will make me want to jump off a--

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: For the love of God, make sure the party boat has a moon-bounce.

name: Homer Simpson

title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind

spoken_words: I think I'll miss you most of all, Captain Corndog's Schnitzel Palace. No tears, Homer.

spoken_words: I can't stand to see a grown burger cry. We must rebuild Fast Food Boulevard!
