title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, keep it together. People are looking!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you weasel out on me!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Y'know, something bugs me. Martin was afraid of heights. What's he doin' on a cliff? It don't add up.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Into your hands, I commend this crap.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Well, enough burnin' ants. Time to investigate.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hmmm.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I now declare you chips and salsa.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, hey, kids! Um... What's up?

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What do you mean "what's up"? Why would something be up?

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, nothing's up and nothing's down -- except for Martin, who died.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Idiot!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... I certainly wasn't eating chips and salsa from this briefcase.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's up?

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm, lamb.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What?!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Act like you're shopping! We can't be seen together.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But we're brother and sister.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Exactly.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Give me an Indian burn!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But...

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't make me say Indian again!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: 'Afternoon!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Doing a little shopping, huh? Shopping at the Kwik-E-Mart. I like how "Kwik" is spelled with a "k". It's a quicker way of spelling "quick". Well, you're busy people, I'll let you get on with your day.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Oh, there is one other thing. I was up in Springfield National Park, you know, where Martin bit the big one? Found this bone tied to a string.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Almost like someone was playing a prank on him.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You like pranks, don't you, dingus?

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I like pranks. Everyone likes pranks. Even Dr. Hibbert.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: I hate pranks.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Well, I better get going, the Missus is cooking meatloaf tonight. My mom, Missus Muntz.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I have a plan: we go to the morgue and come back with a hand. Put its fingerprints all over the railing...

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why are you being so quiet, Bart? Are you judging me? Please don't judge me.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't live with the guilt. I'm going to Martin's house... to end it all!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, pick up, pick up! I know you're there.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Listen, baby. The other night was great, but it can never happen again. Oh, who am I kidding? I have to see you right now!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! No! Don't do...

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ...whatever the heck you're doing.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm tending to Martin's butterfly enclosure. His butterflies are emerging from their chrysalises tonight.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You said you wanted to end it all.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, look! Raccoons!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: By which I meant bring Martin's butterfly project to completion.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't take it anymore! The stress is killing me! I'm on a freight train to Crazytown!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Calm down!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You calm down!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What was that?

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The butterflies are hatching!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aren't they beautiful?

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's a tape. Martin must've set it to go off when the chrysalises hatched.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I thought I turned that tape off.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe you just put it on auto-reverse.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Congratulations on purchasing the Sanyo DL30, the finest non-reversing tape player..."

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer Jay Simpson!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pudding power activate!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sweetheart, I didn't want to deceive you. I just couldn't stand to see the disappointment in your beautiful eyes.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Zack, you're not trying to help our marriage, you're trying to split us up! I'd rather have a chubby hubby than a sexy exy!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Aw Marge, if there was a reality show called "Fat Guys Who Really Love Their Wives", not only would it be an enormous ratings success, but I'd be the first one on it.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where is this music coming from?

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Get off me!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: His foot is caught in my button hole.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I almost flicked an innocent butterfly. Bart, we're turning into monsters!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cool!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, not cool! We have to do the right thing, and come clean! Listen, world! We killed Martin Prince!

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: That's all I needed to hear.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You almost got away with it, but here's where you got sloppy: shouting out that you did it.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh man, I'm too pretty to go to jail. You don't know how lucky you are.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm just glad it was you who brought us in, Nelson. Remember when we used to date? If you let me go, we can get back together. I never let you cherry bomb my Malibu Stacey -- I'll let you do it now.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Save it for the warden.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Yeah, and rumors of your wussiness are a hundred percent true! Now tell us how you survived the fall.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Well, it's good to have you alive, Dorkburger.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: As for you two, I hope you learned your lesson.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I learned that beneath my goody two-shoes lie some very dark socks.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And I learned that killing a nerd is not as fun as it sounds.

title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: There is just one more thing... You folks have a good night now.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, it's me!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm Lord Evilton from the "Angelica Button" books.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The last book in the series goes on sale at midnight, and we're gonna go stand in line.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait in line for a book? You tell 'em Bart says "Hey".

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, boy. All the nerds are doin' it.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not a nerd -- I'm a jock who's too cool for sports.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I read a rumor Spider-man's in it!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Shut up! Shut up! This is a spoiler-free zone!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Nice Angelica Button costume, Lisa. Althooough... the gryphon on your coat of arms is facing left not right, and F.Y.I.: Angelica wears two tortoise-shell barrettes... nice try though.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I based my costume on the books, not the movies.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Move or die!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Now read it to me!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Do the character voices!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Angelica's first kiss, da, da, da... Subplot about her cat, who cares?... Professor Skizzletwitch is a Were-bear... And, uh, no, no he's not... Maluicious Krubb is actually Kraluicious Mubb!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Beef jerky? The queen of all the jerkys!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All is lost... Angelica uses the spell she learned in chapter six... Magic, magic, magic... All is won!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, that's our book for the year -- I think we've earned some TV.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: TV! TV! TV!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But kids, I want you in bed by three a.m.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, somebody's gotta be the bad guy.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I saw this. He trained his dog to do it.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's Lisa Kudrow.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stop saying things, Bart! That's the TV's job!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: ...and the First Lady has agreed to sit on the egg until it hatches. More after this.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A ballet academy here in Springfield?! Move over, Europe!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't know you cared about ballet.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, have I ever shown you my Shattered Dreams Box?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's upstairs in my Disappointment Closet.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. Oh.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right. Now I'll cut and you soak.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There were so many things I wanted to do in life that I never got a chance to do: doctor , safecracker , stethoscope sales lady ... none came to pass. But the thing I really wanted to be, ever since I was little, was a ballerina!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So what happened?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My bosoms came in and ruined my balance.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Really? How?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They came in one at a time.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Do you think mine...

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, I'm pretty sure you'll have your dad's boobs.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, it's not too late to un-shatter your dream! Martha Graham danced well into her seventies.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, you mean she danced well, into her seventies? Or she danced, well into her seventies?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well... she danced into her seventies.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I think you've got a point! Homie, I'm gonna be a dancer!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Go-go or boring?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Boring!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, while your mother and little mother are out, I'm gonna let you in on a deep dark family secret.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You have a drinking problem?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I said secret.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Have you ever wondered what I do in that locked room?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gay out?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well wonder no more!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad... marinating with you is cool.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, son.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Some of that is cow blood.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Lis! I'm as supple as ever!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It won't go down!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Teach?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This is how I always stand when I tell adults what they should be doing.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I don't know I--

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We accept!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, I got confused.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This is so hard!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How do you cope with it?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Cigarettes?! They could kill you. They did a whole episode about it on "The Suite Life of Zach and Cody"! Zach tried to impress a girl by smoking. But she went for Cody instead! Zach's life wasn't so sweet then.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wowww... No! All I need to stay focused is good old-fashioned fresh air.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing like fresh air.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Fresh air.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've gotten better since this morning. How could that have happened?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I thought they were cancer sticks.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My Hindu friend, this is a chance for your Kwik-E-Mart to get in on the ground floor of a delicious new taste sensation.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You talk a good game -- but do you have the product to back it up?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Step into our Jerkatorium.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What the?!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where's our jerky?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You have wasted my time! You have made a very powerless enemy. Good day and be well!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, wait, wait, wait! You haven't seen our Power Point presentation. Bart?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: J -- Just the product you need. E -- Excellent value. R -- Retailer's dream. K--

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You can skip the "K" and the "Y" -- I do not thank you and I will not come again.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who could have done this?!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, something chewed through the cellar door... and the floor is covered with paw prints...

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This can only mean one thing.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders! You ate my jerky!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: As the oak said to the beagle, you're barkin' up the wrong tree. I spent the whole morning blackin' out the "goshes" and "darns" in these Hardy Boys books.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know you ate my jerky. Just like I ate your earthquake supplies!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You stay right here.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Okily dokily!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ah, "heck," "darn" -- I don't think so.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, everyone knows that cigarettes are where flavor lives and a cool choice for a hot night. But they're for losers!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: My feminist heroes!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, that's it, don't be shy...

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Enjoy your jerky laced with sleeping pills... nobody outwits Homer Simpson... Hey, they're not sleepy. They're just turning fuzzy...

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you ate their jerky.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I thought this might happen, so I brought the best weapon to operate while drugged: a crossbow.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Chazz Busby says you're really making progress! Do you need more leg warmers?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, stop buying me leg warmers! I'm already wearing six pairs!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, the important thing is, someday I'll be watching my little Marge dancing at Lincoln Center.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, Mom. I'm Lisa.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Of course -- you're Lisa. Lisa the dancing Marge girl.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you never win a fight with animals. Remember when you lost that war with the worms?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That wasn't a defeat, it was a phased withdrawal.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah? They made you build this statue.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad! Dad, a little help?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're on your own.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: When you cut 'em they multiply -- I can't fight that! Now let's take care of those raccoons.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Awww, they're using the jerky to feed their family! Look, there's a Homer and a Bart and a Marge and a Lisa. Aww... and they even share my views on parenting!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Enjoy your jerky, little critters, and one day you'll grow up to be people. Bart, get some more jerky for man's new best friend.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: When's our next break?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What am I doing? I don't need secondhand smoke to do ballet.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I need firsthand smoke!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gimme that!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe how easy it is in this country to get cigarettes.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe you were smoking. Do you know the sturgeon general said you're not supposed to?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A sturgeon is a fish.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And a very wise fish he is!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I'm taking Lisa out of that stupid-- What the?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Homie, I've been so happy lately. I'm completely fulfilled, both as a mother and a fan of youth ballet! Now what did you want to say to me?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... are you sure you want Lisa to keep dancing?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There's nothing that makes a mother's heart soar more than seeing her child take wing. Look at me, I'm glowing!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe you're drunk.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, Lisa's dancing has made me really, really, happy.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fatherhood hurts my brain.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Because it means so much to your mother, you can keep doing ballet. But you have to stop smoking -- including secondhand!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's easy for you to say. You've never had to be thin and focused.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What'd you say?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm just saying it's gonna be hard for me to quit, especially before the recital.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I thought you might have trouble with this. That's why I'm assigning someone to keep watch over you. Someone you'd never expect.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Is it Bart?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on out, boy.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: For the next three days I'm gonna stick to you like waffle syrup on a shag rug. I'm gonna be on you like fish stink on a Gloucester dog. I'm gonna be all over you like-- Hey, where'd she go?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't -- I promised I wouldn't.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, since you cared enough to apply peer pressure...

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Y'ello. She what?! Oh, my God! Well I'm gonna settle this once and for all! Meet me at the place we discussed.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Who was that?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wrong number.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Bart, it's time for operation: crazy-plan. Step one: we chuck the raccoon in there.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What if someone catches him?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry. I have a perfect way to conceal his identity.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See? Now go, boy!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not keys, cigarettes!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, that's what I mean.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: For three boxes?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hee-hee. Okay, now we get rid of the cigarettes...

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Lord, I could use a smoke.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Thank you, God. Cigarette?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Uh... One more favor?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Wow, what a great first act.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I hope Sleeping Beauty never wakes up.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All right, that's enough!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I want to talk about a horrible practice afflicting millions of Americans. For years we've known how dangerous it is. It stunts your growth. And it's marketed to children. I'm talking about ballet.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ballet is unnatural and unfair to women. I shall now cast off the shoes of oppression!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is my favorite family tradition -- ice cream after a botched recital.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And I'm happy to be smoke-free -- thanks to these children's nicotine patches.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And I realize it's wrong to try to live your career dreams through your children.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Does that mean I can stop training to be a Mexican wrestler?

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now practice preening to the crowd, El Guapo.

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, preen harder! Make them hate you! You feed on their hatred... and you are so hungry!

title: Smoke on the Daughter
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No me gusto. Que lastima.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, are you sure you're okay to drive at night?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: It's night?!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, that's it, pull over.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Now don't you worry. Just sit back and relax to the smooth sounds of Tommy Dorsey's All-White Orchestra.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Son, let this music take you to a time when girls were girls and a Hershey bar was as thick as a phone book -- I'm sick of this song!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't like this one either -- too optimistic!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Too slow! Too fast! No zazz! Too much zazz! More boogie! Less woogie! My back hurts! All my friends are dead!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Son, call me an ambulance.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: And while I'm in the hospital, you'll have to visit me every day. And then I'll have to come live with you while I recover.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Eventually I'll die in your home, which'll hurt the resale value, but it'll all be wor--

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad... Dad? Wake up!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I was having the most wonderful dream. I always wake up just before the good part.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You can just drop me off here.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll see you later, honey.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Er, uh... yes?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm delivering your Scout Gal Cookies, Mayor Quimby! That'll be thirty dollars!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The money helps us serve the community! We plant trees, pick up litter, cut up milk bones for old dogs...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: It was a rhetorical question.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And I used rhetoric in my answer!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Let's just move on.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: ...Twenty-seven to the left... and open.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where's all the money?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Why it's right...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Uh-oh. We spent all our money on that new slogan for Springfield.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Um... what say you leave the cookies, and I pay you double next year?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sir, I didn't get this "skepticism" merit badge falling for promises like that.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: If you don't give me those cookies, I'll pass a law forcing your organization to accept gay scout leaders.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I would strongly support that measure.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Just give me those cookies!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Let go. This is a low point for my administration.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: People of Springfield, our city is broke.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, when you say broke, do you mean really broke, or uh, "O.J. Simpson broke?"

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Really broke! I've been reduced to using this cheap novelty gavel.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Order! Order!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Homer Simpson. I know a lot of you from church, and the market and such. And I'm not much for talkin' -- but seems to me, in hard times like these that we Americans come together.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So I say we roll up our sleeves, and fake a disaster to trick the federal government out of relief money.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Rip off the federal government? Hm, I have reservations... for dinner in five minutes. So all in favor, say aye!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: The "ayes" have it.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Er uh, five minutes ago. You just missed it.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: And that's how...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: ...a fake FEMA official scammed us out of twenty-five hundred dollars. We are now worse than broke.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Panic not, fellow Springfielders!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've gone through the town's financial records, and it turns out there are millions in uncollected city taxes.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: We shall collect each and every back tax owed! Everyone from...Comic Book Guy to...Milhouse. No one shall be spared!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Dozens of swindling deadbeats, as well as this respected reporter who made an honest mistake, have paid their back taxes, leaving only one outstanding debtor: country music star Lurleen Lumpkin! Seen here at the height of her fame.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Dad, that's the singer you used to manage!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, right. Dad was Colonel Homer and he wore that awesome suit and Lurleen wanted to bunk his brains out! But I forget how Mom felt about it...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, marriage is like a car. Along the way it has its bumps and dings, and this country can't make one that lasts more than five years. With Lurleen I just walked past the showroom and didn't even go inside. Now let's return to watching the news.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Ms. Lumpkin owed fifty thousand dollars in back taxes. With penalties, interest and the celebrity resentment tax, that sum has grown to twelve million dollars. However, she's been missing for several years, since her career went into a downward spiral.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I told her not to go into one of those.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Double ew!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: The entire city is searching for her. Not for any reward, but for the pleasure of destroying someone they once admired.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Save some for me!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Got her!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Krusty?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I just wanna win one thing in my life!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: It's not real.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Don't you dare ruin the moment!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Look at those idiots. I bet Lurleen's a million miles away right now...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, you can stay with us. I'm sure Marge will be cool.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm taking you to your home, before you wreck mine!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You live here?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, at least she's got a friend.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Get in!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Are you calling me fat?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lurleen, this barbecue is delicious.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ew!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well I think it's wonderful. My diet starts tomor-row!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Listen, I'm sorry I called you all those mean things like, oh, I don't even remember...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Confederate degenerate?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Southern-fried succubus?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hee-Haw Ho?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Freeze, Patsy Crime!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I just wanted to be extraordinary.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I don't get it, Lurleen -- how did you lose all your money? Did it go up your nose? Between your toes?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, you sure have married a lot of super-hunks.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, I need you to get the rats outta the jukebox, and clean the vomit out of the pool table pockets, and then you've got the job. Oh, and you've gotta share your tips with Manuel, who's actually me with a fake moustache.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ees good job, you should take it.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Say Lurleen, are you Jamaican? 'Cause "Jamaican" me crazy.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: No, I'm glad you said that. 'Cause you reminded me that I'm not looking to date, either. So... so great.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey Lurleen, I'm going down to the rock quarry tonight to throw stones at the woodchucks. Wanna come?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: It's okay, I understand.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Someone's lookin' at a snake in her mailbox.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: She turned down Lenny... and Carl? That's like someone who doesn't like hamburgers or hotdogs. What could make her hate men like that?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So that's it. She's been burned by the most important man in her life... her father.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How could a man just abandon his family? By which I mean, what is the method he would use and could anyone do it?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where you going?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lurleen Lumpkin has a hole in her heart, and I'm gonna fill it.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I've talked to over five hundred men named Lumpkin... everyone at Lumpkin, Lumpkin and Rosenthal Associates, an Asian or Pacific Islander named Cho Lum Kin...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: ...but still no sign of Lurleen's dad!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, are you Royce Lumpkin?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The father of Lurleen Lumpkin?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: She's thirty-four, and she's having a rough time!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: She needs to see you right away!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I made that hug happen!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute -- he's a deadbeat dad, and yet he's getting as much love as me, a Dad too lazy to run away!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And he has hair! Bart, get me my suicide axe.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No suicide axe!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Later.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just sit still in my lap!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What lap?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, all I see is a gut with knees!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little--

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get back here so we can put our love on a shirt!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All right, I get it, I get it.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lurleen's daddy comes back after thirty years and he's father of the year. Why can't I leave for thirty years?

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Fine with me. Look, I packed you a bag.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... it might be cold outside.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No problem. I bought you a hat.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I see. It's reverse psychology. Well in that case I'm not going and I'm not staying. And I'll cut my steak with a spoon, then take a walk on the ceiling.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: DADDY'S BACK AND SHE'S FEELIN' LIKE SHE OUGHTER!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: KEEP IT DOWN, I'M READING "HARRY POTTER!"

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: MY BODY WASH IS ESTÉE LAUDER...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: AND HERE COMES GRAMPA WITH AN OTTER!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Song's over, Dad.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I took three buses to get here.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm really worried about Lurleen.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, me too. Since her father re-abandoned her, she's cut the word "pop" out of all of our foods.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You'd think a house full of crazy people would be fun. It's actually really depressing.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, cheer up, you've still got your talent, and that new song you wrote is gonna be a really big hit.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And Major Marge!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lurleen, you're giving your Dad too much power over the way you feel about yourself. Stop getting your self-esteem from the men in your life.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, yeah...

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, my fringes are knotted again.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There's only one person in the world who can tell you what to do. And that person is right here!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, that's just our old Christmas decorations.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes! It's time for you to take control of your own destiny. You're not a doormat, you're a door prize!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, hey kids, it's a beautiful sunny Saturday morning, so get ready for six hours of cartoons!

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And remember, you can do anything you want in the world of country music, western wear merchandising and TV movies. Regular movies, don't hold your breath. But TV movies, the sky's the limit.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ten percent Lycra.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, I think he's a keeper.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you're very welcome, Lurleen. Of all the women who've hit on Homer over the years, you're my favorite.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Awww.

title: Papa Don't Leech
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: If you ever come near Homer again, I'll strangle you with your own hair extensions. That's right, I know.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Today's Krusty's Korean Kartoon Kavalcade starts with an exciting adventure of the "Trans-Clown-O-Morphs!"

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom! We need to throw out all this Krusty cereal and get Robot-Clown cereal!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Every week we have to buy something else to save that transforming clown that morphs! I want you to watch a show that isn't just one long commercial!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom! We need a Callaway titanium perimeter-weighted driver!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It adds yards to any swing!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You two have been bombarded with enough commercial images! Lisa, I've got a big bunch of black bananas. You know what that means...

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Banana bread!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And Bart, you go with your father to Shelbyville to get the beanbag chairs re-beaned.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I hate the beanbag store. The clerks are always shouting in Hebrew on their cell phones.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So Dean Martin would show up at the last minute and do everything in just one take?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But Wikipedia said he was passionate about rehearsal.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you worry about Wikipedia -- we'll change it when we get home. We'll change a lot of things.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, check it out!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I wouldn't mind driving that over a prairie dog village! Honk to the driver!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Martin?! What's a tool like you doing on something cool like that?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, what's the deal, loser?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: 4-H club? Is it dangerous?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Can I join, Dad? Can I? Can I? Can I?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, a lot of these youth organizations encourage parents to get involved in the activities--

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sold.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See ya!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "I pledge my head to clearer thinking, my heart to greater loyalty, my hands... Man, how many H's does this thing have?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: ...Raise articulator, set hydraulic brakes and endorse farm subsidy check for crops I didn't grow.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I want a tough one.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Whoa. I didn't come here today expecting to fall in love.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, it's the runt. I'll take anything but the runt.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Awww... looks like we're partners. You're a scrappy little misfit, just like me... Anyone want to trade? No reasonable offer refused. I'll take a chicken!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Keep it down! I'm trying to feed my runt.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm Bart, and this is my calf, Lulubelle.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. I thought she was peeing out of her nipple.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's great, it rhymes with "moo"!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So, what do you think of my calf?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're the greatest cow in the world! I'm gonna be your friend forever!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart... you do know what happens next.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Something happens next?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lots of feed, that sounds good.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But he won! Why don't you kill the loser cows?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, they're gonna kill Lou and make him into food and fringe vests for gay cowboys. Can we buy him back? Can we?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey... we'd love to, but... a prize-winning bull is thousands of dollars.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh man.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, let this be a lesson: never work hard and don't form emotional attachments. Also, don't be a cow.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lou?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh man, now I feel so bad I'm imagining I hear your voice.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Leave me alone! It's not my fault there's nothing good to eat on this planet except meat!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't help you! I'm just a little boy!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, are you all right?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I hear Lou mooing in my head!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What you heard was your conscience telling you to stop eating meat.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: If I could save Lou, I'd never eat meat again. Not even prosciutto and melon!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "Anguished Animals III?" That wasn't my conscience mooing -- it was Tress MacNeille!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All right, so I put that there to get you to stop eating meat. But your body is going to miss the protein. So you'll have to take these pills.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry Lis, I can't be a vegetarian -- I love the taste of death! But please, help me get my cow back.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. Meet me halfway -- stop stirring your lemonade with a sausage.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Give me a minute.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Come on.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's a no-brainer.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, man. I never figured the gate would be locked. It's like they knew we were coming.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry. I called some animal activists who can help us get in. I'll just give the signal. Milk is murder!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Windsong?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, it's my code name. This is Compost. And this is Solarpanel.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's my code name?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa's Brother.

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lou! Lou!

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lou! Where are you, little buddy?

title: Apocalypse Cow
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lou? What happened to you? You got fat!

spoken_words: No, sorry.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'm not leavin'. / Sorry. Not leavin'. / Not quite yet. / I'm sorry. / I'm not leavin'.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: So, what are you doing?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I like creating disappointment. You know that little moment where people's hope dies? I feed on that.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You know, as a matter of fact... it ain't.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, that's Heaven.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, you tricked us!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We thought this was gonna be a fun trip to the mall!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We listened to music radio in the car... and, since you kids behaved, we'll pick one fun thing to do here.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I wanna go lecture the food court businesses that are still using Styrofoam!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lead-based toys! Lead-based toys!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sit on a bench! Sit on a bench!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: For once, we'll do what Maggie wants.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maggie's thing? She won't even remember that we did it!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: None of you kids ever remember any of the nice things we do for you.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Like what?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Food?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Pass.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Shelter?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That dump?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Clothing?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I wouldn't blow my nose into this.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm used to buying my critters pre-made. How does your store differ?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I want a poodle!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'd stay away from poodles. They give the dog... ideas.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Doctor.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Professor.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Chef!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: CEO!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You know, it's a boy dolphin.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We fooled her... Betsy.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Bart is awesome.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow -- this guy could put Milhouse out of business.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, this is kind of a cute outfit.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What did you say?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's a medical condition!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who told you these things about me?!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't want to get mad, but I will!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's it...

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Mom? We've got a code four.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It didn't have to go down like this!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The door's open! I think someone broke in!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry -- I'm ready for this. Bart, fetch "The Defender."

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sir!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hear noises coming from the kitchen!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's where the food sleeps!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute, I smell apples... cinnamon... crust... it's a pie!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why would a robber make pie?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who cares? If you kill him, we'll be on TV!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're right, boy!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mom!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: My aquarium!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're alive! And you baked a pie!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, what's going on?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm fighting the robber -- you go get ice cream!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I can't believe you're here. You keep disappearing and reappearing and it's not funny. You're just like that show "Scrubs".

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No thanks.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Every time you go, I feel abandoned. But not this time. I'm not gonna let myself get hurt.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's what your mouth says, but my ears are too smart to believe it. In fact, I don't even want your pie.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well I'm not going to digest it!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, Dad was so cute as a baby.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: When did he lose his cuteness?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You left a hole in my heart that could never be filled. So I filled it with food. But I'm never full.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Welcome back to the ESPY Awards. Our next presenters are Lance Armstrong and Fozzy Bear.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I don't even care.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm fine -- it's my feelings that are mad.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No! I can't forgive you -- and I don't accept your tuck-in!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I feel terrible. My own mother reached out to me, and I rejected her. I'm gonna make her a card.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mom?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are you asleep?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Asleep with your eyes open? Mom?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mom!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My mother's dead.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm still with you, son.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, this just gets worse and worse.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: After your mother left me, I always planned to dance on her grave. First, it was gonna be The Hustle. Recently, I've been taking tap lessons. But now... well, I don't feel much like dancing.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Homie -- your mom wouldn't have wanted you to stay in bed forever.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll tell you what she didn't want -- me to be a jerk to her and then she dies.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Say something comforting.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, comforting, comforting... Uh Dad, whenever I would hang out with Grandma, she would always ask me about you. And I'd say you suck, and she would say... you don't suck that bad.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: She said I didn't suck?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That bad.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That bad. Wow.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Sorry about your ma, Homer.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I just wish she hadn't died thinking I hated her.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, you should always make peace with your loved ones.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I think I'll give my ma a call right now. Hey Mom, I just wanted you to know that you mean-- Yeah, he's here.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, Mrs. L. Those butter cookies you sent were tasty, and the almond ones, ooo! Aw, I wish I was your son too. All right, I'm gonna pass you back-- Okay, okay, I'll tell him. Uh Moe, Lenny's Mom says she loves you.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Apu, what do you think happens after you die?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Manjula will sell the store, dye her hair blond and marry my cousin Jangelvar.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I mean, do you think my mother's out there somewhere? Does she know I feel bad about things I said?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, perhaps she's around us now. She may have already been reincarnated as... that newborn baby, or that tiny mouse in the nacho cheese...

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh for crying out loud -- people aren't mice!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Oh, what a surprise -- Joe Jesus Junior is gonna set us all straight.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Look Homer, people don't come back as anything -- except for our Lord, who came back as bread. That's it.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's it.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: That's the thing with your religion -- it's a bummer.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Even the sing-alongs?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: No, the sing-alongs are okay.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, look what I found with your mother's things.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A donut from the future!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Announcer
spoken_words: The following video was recorded at Garry's Video Wills.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maggie, that's the same Garry that filmed your birthday party. Remember, he brought his girlfriend and they got in a fight.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cool.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grandma, I accept your gift.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You got nothing! You got nothing!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm, it smells like concerts!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, ma. You always knew just how to make everything all right.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It works on so many levels.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've gotta get out of here!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No...

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, this is it. I've got one last chance to make up for the things I said to my Mom. I will avenge you!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's not really avenging her, Dad. Just the fulfillment of her last wish.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm really glad you corrected me, Lisa. People are always really glad when they're corrected.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is hard work. Isn't it, boy? Boy?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Homer! Your butt still looks big from down here!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little...

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You know, spiritually speaking, Grandma's ashes won't know where they've been thrown from... So, in a way... uh... I'm lying down now.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I always knew that at the end, it would all come down to me.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me, I think I'm holding up better than you are. In fact, I've got energy to spare.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: To spare, eh?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, your back is so sweaty. I'm starting to slip off.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's the highest point. And only fifteen minutes to go.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Made it!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, we didn't know each other very well. If we did, you never would have asked me to climb anything. But even when you weren't around, I always felt good, knowing you were out there somewhere.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Three o'clock. Goodbye, Mom. You're finally free.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute... Mom's ashes stopped that missile launch. Mom! You used me to pull one more stupid hippie protest, didn't you!?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hm, what could I make from those two things?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm safe as long as nothing disturbs this incredibly delicate balance.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wheee!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Show me the law that says I can't! Wheee!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't think so.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You can have her. To me, she's been nothing but trouble.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What's the delay?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, well, well...

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Who's this delightful young lady?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Pity. You and I could've shared the world.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hey, I've seen your wife. She's no Mamie Van Doren.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just what are you guys up to?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I suppose there's no harm in telling you. I'm using the rocket to dispose of Springfield's nuclear waste -- by sending it straight to the heart of the Amazon rainforest!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The rainforest?! That's that thing Lisa likes!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, maybe she'll like it better filled with dying trees and mutated animals.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You monster! On another subject, next Thursday I have to leave work early. I assume that's cool.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I'm so sorry. You just wanted to stop one more senseless act of madness in the world. Well, if I get out of this I promise you I'll grant your last wish.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! Hey, Homer!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here's Gramma's knife!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Toss it down!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, boy.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How am I ever gonna take on all those guys?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My purse is made of hemp -- if we burn it, the "silly smoke" will mellow out those guards!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We can ignite it with these crystal earrings Grandma gave me.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I thought she gave you her rebellious spirit.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I found them on her nightstand.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What? Bart got a Swiss Army knife.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: God Bless America!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Send in reinforcements!

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Fine.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That'll do, brick, that'll do.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie?

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now I'll just add water to these ashes and bring my mother back to life.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It doesn't work that way, Homie.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But she'll live on forever in what you did today.

title: Mona Leaves-a
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well then, Mom, this was for you.

title: All About Lisa
name: Announcer
spoken_words: And now, in honor of Krusty's four thousandth episode, put your hands together for Drew Carey!

title: All About Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pee?!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Thank you. I never thought I'd make it past four hundred episodes -- what with the drinking and the smoking and the fact that I'm just not that good. It seems like just yesterday that we started the show, with the original Krusketeers!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: And here they are today! Come on out, Krusketeers!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Isn't that great. They all came back to see me!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now guess what, kids... the Krusty Show is searching for a new Krusketeer. It could be any of you...

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: As long you're willing to sign a twenty year personal services contract where I get ninety-nine percent of all your earnings.

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I am so gonna try out for that!

title: All About Lisa
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Me too! But I hope you get it.

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, I hope you get it.

title: All About Lisa
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well I really hope you get it.

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I hope I get it too. Later!

title: All About Lisa
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: For a second there, he hoped I got it.

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: A great man once observed: "Ninety percent of success is showing up on time." Sorry I'm four hours late. Now let's pick a Krusketeer!

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: For my first impression...

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm a lantern fish.

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now I'm a Jack-O-lantern...

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: E.T.

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: B.E.T.

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yay, Bart!

title: All About Lisa
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My son's a good-for-something!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What are you lookin' at?

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Uh, yeah, okay. You kids were all terrific! I wish I could make each of you a Krusketeer, but we only have enough money for one. Plus, I don't really want to. So after much consideration of all your talents...my new Krusketeer is...

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What's your kid's name again?

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Wilbur Mudd!

title: All About Lisa
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: That's me! Here's Mudd in your eye!

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe I lost.

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's not fair -- Bart was great.

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Krusty, you're making a huge mistake not hiring my brother. Why don't you hire them both? It won't cost you anything -- you could call Bart an intern.

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: In fact, the intern thing could open up a whole new world of free labor for you! Did you know the Discovery Channel doesn't have a single paid employee?

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hm. Okay kid, you've convinced me!

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: To make Bart a Krusketeer?

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hell no! To make you my new intern. You're a real go-getter. Now go get me my dry-cleaning, which is my code word for scotch, and get me my scotch, which is my code word for my bookie. Also, go get my dry-cleaning.

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wha... but...

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Wha, but, wha, wha, wha, but... What are you standing around for?! I wish I was paying you, so I could dock your salary!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Cancel my one o'clock. Move my two o'clock to one o'clock and cancel that. Oh, and go to my joke file, and make all the "Sophia Lorens" into "Lindsay Lohans".

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So do a global change?

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What am I, Al Gore? Just do it!

title: All About Lisa
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I'm just trying to hit my marks.

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: And I don't? Is that what you're saying?

title: All About Lisa
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: No, no! I think you're a consummate pro!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, so now you're judging me. Well, whaddaya think of this: you're fired!

title: All About Lisa
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Yeah, well my mom says you're a selfish lover!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I know what I want and I get it!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I'll trash you in my memoirs!

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Pay attention! You'll be writing my memoirs!

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll never last here.

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I got pastrami stuck in my teeth, and that's everybody's problem! Who's got floss?

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Here you go, Krusty.

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Nicely done, kid. You're the best thing that's happened to this business since...

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mitzi Gaynor?

title: All About Lisa
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I was gonna say "cheap Korean animation," but sure.

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe you're working for Krusty and I'm not. I know everything about that clown. Favorite blintz -- blueberry. Favorite horse in the 2004 Belmont -- Smarty Jones. Krusty lost a bundle and had to endorse baby wipes in Norway. Which I have a case of!

title: All About Lisa
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty Klovnen Baby Visker?

title: All About Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart's having girl trouble. You better go talk to him.

title: All About Lisa
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's clown trouble. That's your responsibility.

title: All About Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I thought I was in charge of bedtime stories and pets dying.

title: All About Lisa
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, well, we're adding clowns.

title: All About Lisa
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fine -- but you just bought yourself "ear piercing" and "strange new feelings."

title: All About Lisa
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Fine.

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa's got school, career, posture -- why'd she have to steal Krusty from me?!

title: All About Lisa
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "The Inverted Double-struck Penny, or 'Kissing Lincolns'..."
