spoken_words: It was apt.

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let me say I've always admired the Irish. Knute Rockne, Larry Bird, and especially Mr. Potato Head.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: There you have it -- news has never been softer. What's that? The parson is here!

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I ask you, who does smoking actually hurt, except the smokers, those around them, and the unborn children of the pregnant women we let in free on Expectant Mothers drink free night?

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So I hope you'll forgive two well-meaning Americans for trying to take Ireland back to the good old days of "Angela's Ashes." Thank you.

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, Your Honor. And may I say: I'm glad I could see Ireland again, even if it isn't what I remembered.

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Top of the morning to ya! Chief Clancy Wiggum here to pick up the Simpsons, and take them back to the--

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Jeez, that smarts. Better put a little "Ouchie" spray on it.

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Oh, boy. I better call for some backup.

title: In the Name of the Grandfather
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: This is unit one-niner-ninerrrr .

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: ...And so, in summary...There are only two real commandments, and the other eight are just "filler".

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: And now, I have some exciting news. Tomorrow we'll be blessed with a visit from the highest ranking clergyman of our Presby-Lutheran faith, His Holiness... the Parson.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: The Parson?! He's coming here?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, she fainted! Let's go get smelling salts!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Suckers!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Springfielders have camped out all night to get a glimpse of the most saintly person to visit our town since Mother Teresa stopped here to gas up her Vespa.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And I'm sellin' all sorts of faith-based knick-knacks.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Let's take a look.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'd commit arson for the Parson, clergymen can kiss my apse, all kindsa gems. Surprisingly, none of them have sold. Except for this one.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Oh, my God! It's him! The earthly embodiment of the Elected Chair of the National Congress of Deacons!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Parson! Parson! Give us a quick official church position on family.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You just made my moustache tingle!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Settle. Settle down.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: He's like the Pope of this thing! This would be like Mary Kay visiting you when you were selling her cosmetics. That is, if you had stuck with it.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Not now, he's here.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Welcome, Your Holiness.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Of course, my office.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: 'Nilla wafer?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, yeah, the bank put on a security hold after they saw a charge from an "Offshore Poker Club." Helen had bought a fireplace poker from Nova Scotia. She says it shifts logs better than American pokers, but I disagree. We'll get through it. We always do.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: You what?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, well, I'm sure the Lord is understanding...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: I'll notify those affected right away.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Helen, I was briefly uncertified.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Due to a bureaucratic snafu, I wasn't an official minister when we laid your dear Estelle to rest.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: I'm afraid not.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: So, Captain. When I blessed your vessel, it didn't count.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: ...So I'm afraid I wasn't a minister when I blessed your tin-roof shanty.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I want to talk to Howard.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Reverend Lovejoy? You deliver pizza now? But we didn't order a pizza. But you forgot the pizza anyway. Marge, the pizza place screwed up again.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Do you remember when I remarried you two after Homer got that divorce?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Like it was yesterday...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kirk and Luann split up...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So Homer, fearing we would do the same, preemptively filed for divorce...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But then you remarried us, and we were as solid as ever.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And I think Apu got lucky with my sister.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Well, I'm afraid that joyous occasion fell during a time when I wasn't actually a minister. Uh, since that time, you two have not been legally wed.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You don't get it, Padre. My old lady and I have a thing goin' on. We don't need a piece of paper to keep it real.

title: Wedding for Disaster

spoken_words: Who are you calling an old lady?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I need that paper quick!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So you and Mom aren't married? Does that mean I'm a bastard?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You were born while they were married so legally, no. But in the sense someone calls you one when they're angry, yes.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's not a big deal. We'll just go to City Hall and get married there.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I think it's romantic. You can pretend you're newlyweds starting a life together.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, instead of exhausted zombies running down the clock.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little bastard...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's the angry one.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This isn't the most romantic place to get married.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sweetie, any place I'm marrying you is the most romantic place in the world.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, this time I'm going to give you the wedding you deserve. Let's get out of here!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hello?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello. It's me, Lance Romance.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your first mission is to look out the window.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Whatever you say, "Lance."

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, what's going on? The violin, pants with a crease, why?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you deserve a wedding day that unlike our children, was planned in advance. So -- will you marry me -- in style?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yes, Homer! Yes!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Did you hear that, Santa? She said yes! Yes! Now, back to your cold, airless tomb.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it's beautiful. But that's an awful lot to pay for a dress I'll only wear once.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... a princess?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This one's a little gay, isn't it?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How'd you check?!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Check out this rocket ship cake, Marge.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's for a child's birthday. We're going to get this one.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe we could bury the rocket ship inside the cake. And that would be a big surprise because I'd forget about it pretty quick.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No rockets! You can pick the frosting.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Chocolate.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We'll take lemon.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I want white roses at the altar, red roses along the aisle, and blue roses in the centerpieces.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, did he take all the blue roses with him?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right, people, I want every table to have two baskets of bread but only one plate of butter -- that will stimulate conversation.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What if we...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There is no "we" in wedding!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But there is, Marge! The first two letters...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe you're ruining the second Thursday before the wedding!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe you told Lenny and Carl they could bring dates! 'Cause they're not even coming to the wedding!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why not?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Because their R.S.V.P. cards arrived one day after the deadline!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, uh, maybe you should take a break from wedding planning. I think you're becoming a... Bridezilla.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bridezilla? A combination of bride and Godzilla? How could you say that? More like you're a... King Wrong!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No matter what I do, Marge yells at me. If she's like this now, what will she be like after we get married?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay, everyone back off! I want to see myself.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A pimple! Not on my day you don't!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, it's go time.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dim the lights.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Cue the band.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And... release the groom.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, that's you!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We are now eleven seconds behind schedule!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe Homer left me at the altar.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's going on? What's with all the darkness? Hello? Marge! Where am I?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the? I'm chained up like a common bicycle!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who would do this to me?! It would have to be someone who could afford a chain.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I have to marry Marge!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just so you know, you're making a pretty bad first impression.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's all my fault: Homer wanted to serve those little cocktail hot dogs. But no. I had to have spring rolls! They taste like nothing!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't understand. Dad would never miss an open bar with chicken wings. Plus he loves Mom, and us, yada, yada, yada.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I found something!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sideshow Bob!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He ruined the wedding -- getting his revenge on us at last!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Because he knows that if Mom and Dad don't get married, I'll never be born!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm afraid I'm just... Ms. Simpson now.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I miss you so much.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You idiot! How am I ever going to find the key to the... ooh, here it is!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: To get the key I have to lick through a lollipop? Oh, how awful.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whose side are you on?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sideshow Bob! Drop that knife and give back our Dad!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: I'm working on a bust of Krusty and using this knife to aerate the clay.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Anyone for peppermint tea?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Not for me, but the monkey needs to keep his strength up. We're gonna drop him out of a blimp tomorrow and see what happens.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, don't worry. Nothing's gonna happen to you, Mr. Teeny Number Seven.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Bob, did you take any breaks yesterday... to kidnap our dad?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Impossible. I was with Bob the whole day. Then we watched the deluxe DVD of "The House of Sand and Fog." At night we slept in the same bed for warmth. Then we woke up, had a little nosh, watched "The House of Sand and Fog" again with commentary...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: The director was an ass.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Fine. But how do you explain this?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Sideshow Bob
spoken_words: Nice of you to think of me. However, "SB" could be anyone -- Scott Baio, the Sultan of Brunei, the former Polish secret police, the Służba Bezpieczeństwa... Or...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Malge! Ahmiss oo. Ahmiss oo so mug...

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm gonna say this for the last time: Bart, if this is one of your pranks, very funny.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's fun about fire ants? They're-- Oh, you're being sarcastic.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, that's very... More sarcasm.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just see that my fiancée Marge gets this -- my wedding vows.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! Moe and Maya are here for a double date.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I hope this day is as perfect for you, as the day we met was for me. You always find the one grain of sugar in the salt shaker that is I. With each marriage I get a little better -- maybe after a thousand, I'll be worthy of you.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I miss you. I miss the kids. God help me, I even miss your sisters.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Excuse me!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: But, I have been waiting forty-five minutes for you to slide my license over to me.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Okay, you are hereby banned from my store. You will have to shop at the Kwik-E-Mart across the street from me. You know, the much nicer, much newer one. Good day to you!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom! Mom! We know where Dad is!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He's right here.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not sure what happened. I was kidnapped, then tortured, then I fell into a surprisingly sound sleep. When I awoke, I felt refreshed. Then I was blindfolded, and two sobbing trolls threw me out of a van onto our lawn.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm just happy you're back. Now let's get that chain off you.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Won't it dry up in a few days and fall off in the bath?

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I've missed your nonsense.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We know it was you Selma Bouvier.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We don't want your cookies.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What she means is, we'll eat your cookies later. If you don't want us to tell our Mom what you did, you're gonna have to pay.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ask her, she's the brains. I'm the thing that's not brains.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, honey. I wanted so badly to give you a fancy wedding.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, one thing I've learned is that you don't need a fancy wedding when you're marrying the man you love.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just what I always wanted.

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: A rocket ship wedding cake -- just what I always wanted!

title: Wedding for Disaster
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Blue roses!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I love to see this!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is no time to pat the bunny, Maggie. Daddy's watching a very important Mid-Atlantic Hockey League Conference Semi-Final do-over game.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stop him, Babando!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're supposed to be spending time with your daughter.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I will, when it's not sports season. I just want to know how the game ends.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wha-wha-what's the score?!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The score, damn you!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I will never... know... the score!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You want to know the score? I'll tell you the score.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Marge. This is a definite high point for our marriage.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here's the score, Mister:

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Your daughter barely knows who you are!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's ridiculous. Who's your daddy, Maggie? Who's your daddy?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He is pretty good with her.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look Marge! It's just what you want. Me spending the day with Muggsy.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maggie.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you're not naggy. You just set the bar impossibly high.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Can you at least bring a sweater for Maggie?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Impossibly high. Now, let's get started on the greatest daddy-daughter day ever!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not even heated up. Typical dog.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is it, Maggie -- the place where Daddy goes every morning.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, you learn your numbers from these billiard balls while Daddy gets happier and happier and then sadder and sadder.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, what are you doing?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'm spiffin' up the place! Jeez, can't a guy clean his bar for the first time ever without people makin' polite inquiries?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Huh. I got a window here.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Maggie could play out there... while I watch her from in here. Whaddaya say, Maggie?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, her first enabling.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hi, Maggie! / Up here, beautiful! / Yo, Mags!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So, uh, I s'pose you guys are still wonderin' why I'm cleanin' the bar.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ooh, hey Maggie! Maggie, Maggie, Maggie!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello Maggie... hello Maggie.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey Maggie! Maggie look at my face!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: It all began about a month ago...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: It was a typical Friday night: me surfing the net at the public library, with occasional drinking fountain breaks.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, just how I like it: warm and rusty.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I couldn't believe it -- I finally found an intelligent sophisticated woman who hadn't heard any of my knock-knock jokes.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: "Orange who?" All right Moe, give her the punchline nice and easy.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Orange you glad I didn't say banana?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: The gargoyle has landed!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: "You're funny. Very nice. Now, how can I put this? Um... "Are you sure you're not actually some creepy guy in a public library?"

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: "No. How 'bout you?" Actually, there is a much creepier guy right next to me.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I would do anything to chat with Maya, short of actually purchasing a computer. We decided to take the next big step -- exchanging photos...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, this is it. I finally get to see what she looks like. Dast I click on this j-peg? No. I dasn't.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yes I dast!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: So, what does she look like?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Whoa!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, she was a knockout. Which meant I was screwed. Because now I had to send her a picture of me.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, before I send this, I'd better, uh, un-beady the eyes... de-Neanderthal the brow... smooth out my hate lines... lighten up the ear hair... switch my lips...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Then, black tie the whole deal.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Aw, I can't build a relationship on a lie. The lies come later.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: She thinks I'm cute?!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh frabjulous day! Calloo Callay!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So, that's why I'm cleanin' things and flushin' things, and makin' this place look respectable.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: She's coming to meet me. Here. Tonight.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Moe's rat-free tavern! Oh, ah, heya, Marge. Yeah, yeah, Homer's here.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, you want Homer. I'm sorry, I thought you meant Himmler. Heinrich Himmler. You know, the guy who invented the Heimlich manure?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Those are two different people!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, well they're both here, and neither one's your husband. This press conference is over.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, Maggie made some new friends.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, burrowing your head into your Daddy. A sign that my baby is happy and confident.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, she said she'd be here at exactly eight o'clock.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You callin' my girl a liar?!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I've been stood up.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, you're a little person? I-I'm sorry, I didn't mean that. What's the correct term?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Whoa! Look at me bein' polite!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh of course, of course. Um, I-I just have to -- I have to tidy up the place! Just one second.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So Maya. Um, you always been this size, or is this like a Benjamin Button deal? No, I mean is, I just...your picture just made you look more... life-sized.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh! Okay, I'm coming.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Are you kiddin' me? You're the best thing to come into this bar since cable TV. And unlike cable TV, I ain't stealin' you from the Chinese restaurant across the street there.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, that's great there, Ling Chow.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So, uh, you still want to go out?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Great. Let me get a car seat.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I took out the passenger seat to save gas. But I'm gonna use it now. 'Cause we're gonna do the town!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: ...so instead of getting a new bar sign, I saved three hundred bucks by changing my name to Moe...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa -- not so fast, garlic press. I'm here with my date.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I practice by siphoning gas out of other people's tanks. But I never tasted super-premium that was half as good as you.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: How'd your date go, Moe?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Incredible. I've never felt like this before. It's like my heart wants to do her.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: So, when are we gonna meet her?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, I can't wait till you guys get to uh...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Let me ask you guys somethin': how would you treat a person who's generally dynamite but uh, in some way... a little different?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You mean like how we treat Homer?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: 'Cause he can't remember limericks?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can too! "There once was this guy from an island off the coast of Massachusetts... uh, Nantucket, I think it was. Anyway, he had a most unusual personal characteristic... which was... um... uh...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Look at him struggling with the simplest rhyme.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: It's a-a-b-b-a, dumbass!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There you are!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aww. Innocent babies whistling nonchalantly. How sweet. Maggie will be back to play with you tomorrow.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Maggie. Have some grapefruit.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: She seems upset. Maybe if I lay down a beat on my bongos, that'll soothe her.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, do you have any idea what's gotten into Maggie?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How would I know?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You've been spending so much time with her.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I have not! Oh right, you think I do.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Announcer
spoken_words: When you leave your children, do you really know who you're leaving them with?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Announcer
spoken_words: When you can't be there, Prying-Eye Surveillance can.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Announcer
spoken_words: We take images from your camera, scramble them, beam them to our orbiting satellite, unscramble them, then scramble them again, then unscramble them that all-important final time. Our competitors claim we scramble our images too much. We say, "Can you love your children too much?"

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Announcer
spoken_words: The only thing better than Prying-Eye watching your children, is you watching your children.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Announcer
spoken_words: And we all know that's not gonna happen.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a second, Marge: do you really want to use your baby as a tool to spy on your husband?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes you do.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wasn't talking to you.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: When you say it, it's not just in your head.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh... So is there a knob or an "open sesame"-type deal, or what?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: No, hey, a lot of people live in trees... uh, Tarzan, the Berenstain Bears, flood victims...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Gah! Why should I be watchin' anything when I could look at the most beautiful thing in the world: youse.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Dat's right. Kiss the troll and win a prize.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Is it my religion? 'Cause I am a snake handler, but not an observant one. If we have kids, they just have to have a ceremony with a cobra by age three so grandfather will be happy.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, I do know this one couple -- the Simpsons I believe their name is -- that ain't too judgmental. She's a standup dame and he's a fall-down drunk. We'll make a double date of it. Now, let's get back to what we were...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey. What's goin' on? You've turned into a doll!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Here she is, uh, Homer. The wonderful girl I been tellin' you about.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pleased to meet you. Uh, perhaps this is inappropriate, but I have a mechanical question while the kids are out of the room, that I can't help wondering about.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: In a nuclear power plant, just how is nuclear energy turned into electricity?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man oh man, slap a ring on that!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right, Homer. Let's see what my baby's been up to.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Here we are, Maggie. That park you love...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See you when the moon comes out.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, that made me thirsty.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: For you.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: She's beautiful, Moe.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah. She sure is.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Here comes ours, honey.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Would you look at me. I'm the happiest bartender in the world.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Sorry, fellas.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Maya... there's something I wanna ask ya, um... I don't know why I'm so nervous... this makes more sense than anything I've ever done... well, other than keepin' all my Netflix movies and sayin' the post office lost 'em. Anyway...

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Um... will you marry me?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: As long as you don't mind having a small wedding.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And we can drink champagne out of an acorn top. Our first dance will be on the head of a pin! I've been hoggin' all the good ones. All right, now you go. But hey, keep it short!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What's the matter, Doll? We were just having fun.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! Forgive me, kitten... I mean cat... I mean, tiger... I mean saber-toothed tiger. I mean--

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay. I screwed this up pretty bad and, uh, I'm sorry. How long do you people remember things?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Guys, after all the years I've given you advice, now I need a little advice from you.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: We never follow your advice.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: The one time I did, I went to jail for three years.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You made some good friends, didn't ya?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Just 'cause you're chained to a guy don't make him your friend.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Tomato, tomahto. Now how am I gonna win Maya back?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Well, if I've learned anything from romantic comedies, is that you've got to make a grand, reckless gesture, the kind that looks like it might blow up in your face.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: But what if it blows up in my face?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: With your face, who cares?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: ...you gotta make me shorter, Doc.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: What do you mean?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I mean take out bones, guts, whatever you gotta do to make me a micro-Moe.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: What you're asking is completely unethical. No licensed physician would perform that operation.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: No, no, no, no, no -- I want to be shorter for a woman.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Maya is gonna love the new me!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I ain't done nothin' yet.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: But I'm considering it because I want to share your world forever.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, I see you, Maya. I see you every time I look at the moon. I see ya in puddles after it rains. I see ya in the glazed eye of a barfly who's had one too many.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So cut me down to size, Doc. And can you wrap up the bones so my dog can have fun with 'em.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, no more delays. I've got to watch this.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll save you, Maggie!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm telling!

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now what?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, sweetie, you saved me. Well, I promise that wherever you go in this world, I will always be there for you.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Maggie, I love you from the tip of your toes to the bow on your hair with the red blinking light. God bless your mother for making you with me.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whatcha watchin', honey?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer Simpson, you are a strong finisher.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I'm good at beginnings.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What's the matter, Homer?

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not a thing in the world.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I wish I could say the same.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, this was a great thing for you. You went from sitting on the sidelines to getting in the game. And sometime when you least expect it, you'll realize that someone loved you. And that means someone can love you again. And that'll make you smile.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey! Homer was right.

title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Who'da thought such a little woman could make me feel so big?

spoken_words: Bart -- you're a true friend.

spoken_words: Byyyyyye.

spoken_words: You know, I think Milhouse is "El Barto." Hmmmm.

title: The Good, the Sad and the Drugly

spoken_words: Huh?

spoken_words: Whoa, she gets to use the real scissors. Nice.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're just a tiny ant, but you were strong enough to pull my brother and me together. Now go and be free.

name: C. Montgomery Burns

name: Lenny Leonard

name: Carl Carlson

name: Homer Simpson

spoken_words: Uh, hey 'Pu. I just want you to know that I got one of your kids here. This ain't a kidnapping thing, but if you're in the mood to give me a million dollars, that's cool. This should not be interpreted by federal agents as a threat. Once again, no threat, but will take the dough.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
raw_location_text: Street In Front Of Apu And Manjula's Apartment
spoken_words: Well, one of us has to go back to Moe's... maybe have a beer or two... shoot a game of pool, and if I win I have to play the challenger, such are the customs of billiards...

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
raw_location_text: Street In Front Of Apu And Manjula's Apartment
spoken_words: If only that mark on your forehead was an off-button!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
raw_location_text: Street In Front Of Apu And Manjula's Apartment
spoken_words: Hours later, she returned -- smelling of beer and pickled eggs. I know no more.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: Street In Front Of Apu And Manjula's Apartment
spoken_words: Uh... I do.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
raw_location_text: Street In Front Of Apu And Manjula's Apartment
spoken_words: You do?! Tell me!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
raw_location_text: Street In Front Of Apu And Manjula's Apartment
spoken_words: I was there when your wife got to Moe's, being my usual effervescent self...

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Sounds like you had a rough day.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, that's probably a good one. Here, I got somethin' that might cheer ya up.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I got this for women that came to the bar, and Low-Blow Boxing for the guys.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So uh, would you like to cut one? I mean a rug. Oh God, I always say the wrong thing.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You said you'd be home by seven to help with my mother's birthday!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Then what happened?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What's so damn funny? I mean,

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, how can you be so sure your wife is not the putty in the bartender's hands?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Padre. How innocuous are your flashbacks?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Well... I... uh...

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The ferry will be back in ten minutes. It'll take us home... to find out the truth.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: The truth...

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm still mad at you from last night.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Today's the first, which means it was last month, which means you're being ridiculous.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: I'm glad we never argue like that.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Way to bitch up the conversation, Helen.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Me and Helen? We're as happy as Adam and Eve before Eve munched us all to Hell.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Happier. Where a clam only has one pearl, she has many.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Is the preacher here? 'Cause there's somethin' I gotta get offa my chest. Somethin' more suited for the town gossip than the minister's wife.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh... well, there's this uh, married woman that I have feelings for. And her husband don't realize how upset she is with him.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I'm gonna need some help getting this off.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Otto, you got to get us back to town!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Here it comes. The moment of truth.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: She's packing her bag!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: So it is you, Mr. Homer. But let's be honest -- a woman of her age married to a man of-- how old are you? Sixty-five?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thirty-nine.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Dear God, this day gets more and more disturbing.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! No! Stop packing your--

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Painting supplies?!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grandma?!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What do you think?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're not leaving me?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My mother explained that what happened at the party wasn't your fault.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Marge, you not leaving with Moe is the best thing that never happened to me.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: You were my favorite uncle, Uncle Otto.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Two tickets to Istanbul!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: You're leaving... with me?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh, Helen!

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Both.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: And so it is me.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I feel the pain of a thousand Squishee headaches.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: My worst fears confirmed.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: You mean you are not leaving me for him?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, hey, I'm right here.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: It is true. The tastiest ice cream is the hardest to scoop.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Very nice. Well all's well that ends well, huh?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Yes, except for... Why did you write that horrible letter?

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: When I saw how much trouble your marriages were in...

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I knew I had to act fast.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I got Marge's mother to go to Marge, convinced Helen to ride the rails of romance with the padre, then I bought some roadside corn, ate it raw, got a kernel in my teeth, flossed with the corn silk, and then I came over to fix things with Manjula.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And I wrote that letter so you three chumps would realize that you have not been treatin' your wives the way they deserve. Think of it as a wakeup call from a man who ain't got nothin' but a blowup doll. And even she left me. Should not have used helium.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, I don't know whether to punch you or kiss you... so I'm gonna do both.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So all you mugs out there, be sure you don't take for granted the woman you love. Oh, and it's Mother's Day, so call your ma.

title: Moe Letter Blues
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Take her down to the diner at the department store there. Get her a roast beef on rye. Oh, and make sure she gets a fruit cup on the side -- she's worth it.

spoken_words: People of Springfield, this town is in the worst financial meltdown we've ever seen. No longer can we cook the books and fudge the numbers.

title: The Bob Next Door

spoken_words: And so it is with regret I announce the following cost-cutting measures: eliminating dead animal pick-up...

spoken_words: Dramatic cutbacks in our education budget...

spoken_words: How shortened?

spoken_words: Take 'em home, Otto.

spoken_words: Now that it's empty, who's gonna buy their house? What if someone moves in with two Barts? Or four teenage Barts?

spoken_words: Eh. At least they're learning their fractions.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's that delicious smell?

spoken_words: Cookies!

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop that sniffing! It's not for you! They're making the house next door smell like cookies so people will subconsciously want to buy it.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh come on. What kind of big fat moron would fall for...

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Cookies... so delicious... must buy house.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, no!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge... get loan pre-approved... offer over asking... waive inspections... two-day escrow!

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Homer Simpson

name: Homer Simpson

name: Marge Simpson

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, it's so superficial to judge our new neighbor based on his furniture. He drives a hybrid!

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's got koi!

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And where there's exotic fish, there's gotta be a...

spoken_words: Hello, Bart.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sideshow Bob!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, you're good with the tools when you want to be.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why on earth do you think that harmless-looking man...is Sideshow Bob?

name: Bart Simpson

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, his name is Walt Warren, and he's a very nice man. He stopped me from driving away with my coffee cup on top of the car.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Really? Hm. Maybe I...

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sideshow Bob!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid kid, fooled by a silhouette.

spoken_words: Ice cream!

spoken_words: Nothing is ever boobs or ice cream.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll prove I'm not crazy. Sideshow Bob could never resist singing along to a Gilbert and Sullivan operetta.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Who am I again?

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yum Yum. I'm Peep-bo.

title: The Bob Next Door

spoken_words: Mom! Dad! I got the lead!

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And a one, and a two, and a...

spoken_words: Uh-oh, Bart. Who will sing the next verse?

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We need a third maid. Maybe someone will step in and help.

name: Bart Simpson

spoken_words: Shut up.

spoken_words: I can see there's only one way to settle this once and for all.

spoken_words: Thank you... you're very sweet...

name: Bart Simpson

name: Bart Simpson

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We better go.

spoken_words: Guys, guys, I'm married!

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Great day to be alive!

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The paper's here.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The Cascades?! They totally stole the Federal Cup from us last year! Can I go Mom? Can I?

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is your room clean?

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No.

name: Marge Simpson

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, the bathroom scale is lying again.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's like you're a Chinese empress!

spoken_words: You could just rent it till the market recovers... which'll be never!

spoken_words: Mexico! Andalé! Andalé! Arriba!

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Walt, it's a nice face, but I don't think it would drive a professional waitress to lie.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Bob, you don't need to kill me. I'll probably kill myself pretty soon with all the stupid things I do. Oh no, I swallowed my tongue.

spoken_words: You know, the great ones can kill without explaining.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I haven't gotten to that part yet!

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm a slow reader!

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you here to teach me or to kill me?

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ruining your plan -- if you shoot me while we're in the same state, you go to jail.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: See, Bob. Even you hate to see you.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Help us! Help us, for the love of God! Won't somebody help us?!

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh yes, I'd like... um... how do you say taco in Mexican?

spoken_words: Homer, can we please find Bart?

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah, yeah, right. Uh, just give me one of those crispy shells with meat in it.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: So before he left for the game, he called us and warned us to track you.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Which we were able to do through the dashboard of your car, which like all hybrids, is secretly monitored by the government.

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Yeah, tha-- Wait a minute, why so familiar?

title: The Bob Next Door
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Bart. I am so glad everything's okay.
