spoken_words: Really?... They sound like... I mean... well, the thing...

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, bottom line: I need an extra-curricular activity, and no one else will coach you loveable losers.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We're not losers. Last year we finished six and five.

title: MoneyBart
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: And we're not loveable. We had a tall freckled-faced kid on the team that we picked on till he quit.

title: MoneyBart
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey Splatter-face! How's the weather up there?

title: MoneyBart
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: It's too bad 'cause he's a great hitter, but it's worth it.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, if you want to play liability-insured baseball, I'm your only shot.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Fine, you can be our coach.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks. You can be the free safety.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wrong sport.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I mean the point guard.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Also wrong.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm gonna do a little research.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: A little's not gonna be enough, honey pie.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't call me honey pie.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You got it, tootsie pop.

title: MoneyBart
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Get a room, you two.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We're brother and sister.

title: MoneyBart
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: So are my parents, I think.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Dad.

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey pal, howya doin'?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Fine. I was hoping you and your friends could tell me something about baseball strategy.

title: MoneyBart
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: The only thing I know about strategy is that whatever the manager does, it's wrong, unless it works, in which case he's a button-pusher.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I hate guys that just push buttons all day.

title: MoneyBart
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: You just push buttons all day.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You know, ever since Obama came in, you've got all the answers, don't you?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Does anyone here actually know anything about baseball?

title: MoneyBart
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, the guys in that booth down there.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, I'm surprised you guys know so much about a sport.

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, let's hold hands and skip inside!

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, guys.

title: MoneyBart
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, speaking of stats, I'm none too pleased about your ratio of "seats occupied" to "beers ordered."

title: MoneyBart
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Why did I advertise my drink specials in Scientific American?

title: MoneyBart
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Shut up.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Everyone shift towards right!

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, everyone study two-out situations, count management, and I'll be back with some gluten-free crackers.

title: MoneyBart
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Your spreadsheets!

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My stupid sister's taken the fun out of baseball. What happened to stealing bases, the suicide squeeze, throwin' a little chin music?

title: MoneyBart
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: We're no longer cellar dwellers. Well, the team isn't.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This isn't the game I grew up with, the game played in the misty ballparks of Enron Field, or Pac Bell, then S.B.C., now A. T. and T. Park. And from now on, I'm gonna play my game.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, this guy's walked the last two batters, and if he walks you, we win the game. Don't swing at anything!

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But I'm on a hot streak.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hot streaks are a statistical illusion.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I wish you were a statistical illusion.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, there's a ninety-seven percent chance I'm not, so do what I say.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Don't swing.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You disobeyed your manager!

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So what? We won.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Here's what: you're off the team! Get him outta here, boys.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, guys. I had to get rid of Bart.

title: MoneyBart
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: But he socked a walk-off dinger!

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That dinger was a fluke! Not that I have to defend myself to you. Managers manage and players play.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know... yes.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here's my uniform, since I won't be needing it any more!

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Underpants dinner!

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No it's not!

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Lis, I'm glad I'm not playing baseball anymore. I think I'm more interested in soccer!

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Cut it out! You're upsetting the gravy boat!

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll put a stop to this nonsense!

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, can't you let your brother back on the team? Fly balls and fungoes come and go, but family is forever.

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry Marge, I gotta call bullcrap on that. The '69 Mets will live on forever, but you think anyone cares about Ron Swoboda's wife and kids? Not me -- and, I assume, not Ron Swoboda!

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What about Bart's feelings?

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boys don't have feelings, they have muscles.

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why do you say such ridiculous things?

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They sound good in my brain, then my tongue makes not the words sound very good, formally.

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mama Bear said 'I'm sure Sister Bear will come to her senses.'

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...Then Pete Rose plowed into his friend Ray Fosse...

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Brother Bear said "Sister Bear is inconsiderate."

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...dislocating Fosse's shoulder in a meaningless game...

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...He had earned the nickname "Charlie Hustle..."

title: MoneyBart
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Excuse me! With all this racket, my boys can't get their sixteen hours sleep.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ...So because of your on-base percentage, Nelson, you're the new leadoff hitter. Questions?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's not! He thought he was better than the laws of probability. Anyone else think he's better than the laws of probability?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you're not!

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, no, no. I got a lot goin' on.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Dad! "Players and Coaches' Entrance!"

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, let's go to the bleachers. I brought an air horn and a megaphone.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Testing...

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Actually, I'm taking you on a "special little guy super happy fun" day!

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you taking me to the dentist?

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're not going to the dentist!

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Y'know Mom, after only seven hours in this amusement park, I'm finally enjoying myself. I'm actually starting to forget about...

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa? She wants to talk to you.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Lis.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I need you! Ralph can't play 'cause he's too juiced.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry sis, I've moved on, and my days of listening to my manager are over.

title: MoneyBart
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mike Scioscia! Didn't you get radiation poisoning working at the Springfield Nuclear Plant?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What am I gonna do? I need a pinch-runner with speed!

title: MoneyBart
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: How about a benchwarmer who's afraid of puppets?

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Did someone order a happy ending?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Now get out there a kick a field goal! Kidding!

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! No, don't steal!

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay, he's stolen third. But surely that's the limit of his cockiness...

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm stealing home!

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! The computer says it's statistically impossible!

title: MoneyBart
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Bah! Computers! They'll never replace my Huffnagle autocollator!

title: MoneyBart
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Crank it, Smithers! Crank it!

title: MoneyBart
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: It's, uh, seizing up, sir.

title: MoneyBart
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, well apply more goose grease!

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Stealing home. It's so impossible. It's against every sensible instinct... it's, it's...

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's the most exciting play in baseball! Go, Bart!

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If he makes it, that's my son!

title: MoneyBart
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You stink!

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Did I make it?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No. But you did do something. You made me love baseball. Not as a collection of numbers, but as an unpredictable, passionate game beaten in excitement only by every other sport.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I guess your computer was right.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe it was, but according to my calculations, you're a great brother fifty-one percent of the time.

title: MoneyBart
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And according to my gut, you're okay too.

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Can you put a number on it?

title: MoneyBart
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Awww...

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse! Do we have enough points for a weapons upgrade?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Yeah, we really racked 'em up eating all those elf babies.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing beats a weapon made of weapons!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This is that videogame Reverend Lovejoy said you shouldn't play!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well, he's playing it right now.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I still think it's too violent.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's a game. We're not hurtin' anybody.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: My non-lazy eye!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: These classic board games are fun and safe.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: My other eye!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: So which of these "bored lames" shall we play? Taffyland?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Drops And Risers?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Consternation?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Ravenous Ravenous Rhinos?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mousecatch?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Battleboat?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Funopoly?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Crate of Apes?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yahtzu?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Tiddlywonks?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I've never seen this one before.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Satan's Path?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, it's gotta be good if Satan put his name on it.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here, I'll be the demon, you be the thimble.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh, I'm always the thimble.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: One...

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: ...two.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: All the games came to life!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Don't worry, we're safe. He's two steps away and one to the right.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: For me it's game, set and match.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Just got crushed by a giant horse, Lou. You wanna cut me a break.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh man, I'm never comin' down.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Another ladder!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ridin' high! Sinkin' low! Top of the heap! Down I go! On top for good! Oh, cruel hubris!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How do we make this stop?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, my Latin's a little rusty, but I think to get everything back in its box, you have to finish the game.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: And if we don't finish?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're gonna have to deal with more nonsense like that.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Yahtzu.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Here we go, back in the cup.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey Mister Positive, shut the hell up.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: We'll be safe on this Battleboat.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Set a course for B-7.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: They dunked our battleboat!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I wish I could see my Mom one last time so I can say "this is all your fault"!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Colonel Ketchup, I say it was you that killed him in the parlor with the letter opener.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, man, climb up!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: No, I might sink the letter. And Q is just too valuable.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That blank can be any letter we want!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Maybe I'm just tired of living.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: The final challenge! Mousecatch... a game so lame, no one's ever finished it!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Crazy eights!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Think Bart, think! What was that lesson I learned from videogames? Oh yeah, kill, kill, kill!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: There comes a time to beat the crap out of childish things!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Sure is a hard way to catch a mouse.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This stupid thing never works.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's it. From now on we'll just play hangman.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wait, wait! We still get one more letter!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Is it... three?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That's not a letter!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Stupid! Stupid! Stupid!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, it's been a crazy morning. Champagne?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Homie, what a great idea to take a cruise in uncharted waters.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, charts are for squares, baby.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Whew, sure is hot out here...

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's my cell phone.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What is it? Lenny, I'm on a second honeymoon. You'll have to pick your own lotto numbers. Now, where were we?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh baby. Let's give those seagulls something to squawk about.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah baby, I like it when you're distracted.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, help him up!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fine, I'll get the hook.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't fight it... That's it... That's it, a little more... How's that?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're safe now, my friend.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This poor man must've been out there for days!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He's nothing but hard bronze muscle.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: O-kay, this guy's taken care of so, uh, you know...

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not really in the mood anymore.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fine. I'm going for a walk.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Poor man. You've been through so much.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, I've had a hard trip too. One of the lenses fell out of my sunglasses.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Roger! You really know what you're doing!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, can I have a word with you in private?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't trust that guy. I bet he killed everyone on that boat himself.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's crazy talk!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That is so sweet!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why do pie makers get all the girls?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why did you do that?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It was poisoned.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No it wasn't!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it was rhubarb.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No, it was berry-peach!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Berry-peach?! That's my favorite!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Please! Homer, I am so sick of this unmotivated, jealous...

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The pie was poisoned. You were right! I guess we've got to kill him before he kills us.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we'd better do it quick. Because he's making scones!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They should call this one "recipe for murder."

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What do you mean, this one?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Never mind.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Roger, would you hand me the suntan oil?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, got a text.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dear God. We just killed a man.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, the decent thing to do is bury him at sea.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come 'n' get it barnacles!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Roger was telling the truth!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This proves nothing. Roger could've been the one that killed them!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Soy sauce!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Low sodium!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then... his story was true!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We killed an innocent man. We're murderers! Murderers!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey pal, how ya been?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The pie you baked us killed that shark!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why did you do that?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We had to kill him, or he'd tell people we tried to kill him.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're alive?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Looks like you've got a flair for avoiding death.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, come on! Just a second...

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bankers away!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I repeat: no one will ever know.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We'll know.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, what are you doing? That pie is poisoned!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't live with the guilt.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: She just wanted to ride bikes through New England. But those seats hurt my ass!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ever wonder what she thinks about?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just sugarplums and buttercups.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, what's that weird look on all those girls' faces?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's something you've never seen: they're smitten.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh I've seen it, especially when I do this.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he is cute. But I'm sure a boy like him would never say hello to me.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I love your pallor.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: How'd you do that?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: They're just dots in circles.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're a vampire! I should be scared, but I'm not.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Lisa's fallen for a vampire? That makes me so angry. I feel the change coming!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Edmund's almost here, so PLEASE nobody be themselves!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know, I know. Don't serve garlic... don't stab your guest in the heart with a wooden stake... don't ask him if he knows Frankenstein. It's racist somehow.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dinner is served. I tried to make what Homer said you liked.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I get the drumstick!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay. If a mosquito bites you, does it become a vampire too?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay. If you bite your tongue, does it become a vampire?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I know just how you feel!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Get them back -- she can't get neck-holes! It's picture day tomorrow!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, you vamps got it made... you sleep all day...

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, this place has every kind of vampire there is.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Have you seen these kids?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Super-Team -- fly!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hyah! Hyah!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bite me now, Edmund -- and we'll both be vampires!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sir, I'm not trying to take your son away from you. I plan to be a part of your rich culture, and organize media-friendly events to help combat all the unfair vampire stereotypes.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Eight forever? Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! I can't spend eternity using kid scissors. They barely cut anything!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Back off, you unholy dreamboat!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pretty ironic -- a cross being used to kill someone.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, you blood-sucking freaks love your kids too?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, nobody loves his kids more than me!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come and get it.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And not the good kind!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Dad? They turned you into a vampire.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes! I can fly! See you back at the house!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nooooo!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Mousey and Catsy, aren't they great? Now listen up, kids -- Krusty's sponsor, the Texxon family of gas stations, wants you to know that today's the last day of their "Happy Little Elves" giveaway!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: It's Texxon's way of saying "Sorry about those million dead pelicans."

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: You'll really love, the intentionally scarce "Baby Must-Have."

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Don'tcha want her beyond all reason?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Maggie, you can't climb into the TV. If you could, I'd make Alex Trebek answer some questions.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I think Maggie's just sad 'cause her set is missing "Baby Must-Have."

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No child of mine will go without anything, ever! Except quality healthcare!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Didn't there used to be more Texxon stations?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, but they sold a bunch off to that frozen yogurt chain.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'm not cheap, baby, I'm embarrassed to be seen with you. Big difference.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nice part of town you got here. Too bad you keep it so far away. Now that we're best friends, can I get the baby elf?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You can't tell what's inside! Of all the times not to have x-ray vision.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll take... that one.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, this isn't the right one -- she wants the baby!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're lucky you're behind glass.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure, it's easy to slap people when you're hidin' behind that glass!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Drive all the way... get the wrong elf... ain't no glass... I'll show 'em -- I'll buy ten more gallons of their stupid gas!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Homie, maybe we should call it a day.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh I'm sorry, Maggie, but even at your age, I'm sure you understand things can't always go your way, and that's why... I can't believe we didn't get that stupid elf!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Where the hell are we? I've never seen stores like these before.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I know where we are! This is the neighborhood where I grew up!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooo, everything's changed! That tree used to be a smaller tree. And that food bank used to be a regular bank.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The march of progress.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There's my old house!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Someday when I'm a grownup, maybe I'll go back and look fondly at our house.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, stop in and say "hi" to me 'cause I'll still be there -- chillin' in my basement bachelor pad.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Be sure to water the flowers on my backyard grave.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: As long as I can dig you up and stick you on the front porch every Halloween.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just don't dress me up like a woman.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We'll see.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We're not here for rabbit. I used to live in this house as a girl.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'd love to, if it's not an imposition.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Tell her "no deal".

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Everything's just the way I remember it...

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You see that mirror? I discovered that if I sat in the kitchen I could see if the bathroom was free using the reflection from the mirror off the toaster.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This was my bedroom! My bedpost smooshes are still in the carpet!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I wanna go read books in the car.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There are no books in the car.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I just wanna sit in the car!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My memorables!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My whole childhood is in this box! My scrunchies! I never really had the hair for these.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, Mom -- you got first place in the science fair!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's ancient history. Ooh, here's my paper on ancient history.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, these grades are amazing! Just as good as mine!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Comin' through!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Just when you think I'm out of ideas!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Get your affairs in order.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Oh, Mama!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Buying those extra trophies from cash-strapped schools really filled out the old case.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Principal Skinner? Quick question. Is it true my Mom was a great student?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh indeed. Your mother was as fine a student as you.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Keep up the good work and you'll probably wind up just like her.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well... of course that would be great. But I see myself making an impact... outside the home.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lisa, one of the hardest jobs I have is throwing cold water on young children's dreams.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Ralph, you're not a kangaroo.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The point is, I've learned a lot about human nature by sitting in the park with mother. And one thing I've learned is children turn out like their parents. Behold, your future!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Ralph, you're also not a trophy.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skinner! I warned you about interacting with students!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: I don't want to have to yell at you.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You yell at me about everything.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Well I can't yell at anyone else! Teachers have a union, students have parents.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: What about Willie?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: I like Willie!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maggie, something happened to Mom and I'm gonna find out what and when.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom's looking good through elementary school... ninth grade, tenth grade, still ridin' the A-Train... Then suddenly, when she was a high school senior BLAM!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You kids play nice up there!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What could've happened?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, can I talk to you for a second?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What is troubling you, my son? I mean, my girl son?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, um, I was looking through Mom's old schoolwork, and I noticed her grades went down when she started going out with you.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, if it hadn't been me, it would have been someone or something else. Sooner or later, everyone meets their "Homer."

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No offense Dad, but no boy is gonna distract me from my dreams.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It may not be a boy. It could be anything: scrap-booking, high-stakes poker, or the Santa Fe lifestyle. Just pick a dead end, and chill out till you die.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! That's not gonna happen to me! I'm gonna make sure nothing distracts me ever!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Look at you, struttin' around, like you're Toad of Toad Hall.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm just whistlin', man.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But it's not good enough, is it?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You think you're so smart, don'tcha, Simpson?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We're both in the same reading group. I think you know how smart I am.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: That's an insult to me and the rest of the inchworms!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not a bully! It's just a series of incredible coincidences!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well Bart, I guess his parking spot is yours now.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well done.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I've gotten rid of all of my distractions, diversions, hobbies and... Oh my God!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Are you a distraction, or a higher calling? All right, let's see. How many jazz musicians led long and happy lives? There's, um...

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's odd. Lisa just threw her saxophone out the window.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's probably because to her, the saxophone is a me, and she doesn't want to end up like you. G'night.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: She doesn't want to end up like me?!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, she does, totally, but uh... with a happier ending. Goodnight!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's so wrong with me?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nothing, sweetie, nothing! Here, let me explain.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: She does not want to... turn out like... you... didn't... not until... diplomatic... trapped... help... remember nothing!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I remember everything.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if you check your purse I think you'll find... the seven of clubs!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No. Just a picture of Lisa. Who wants to be nothing like me.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I am so sorry, Marge.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid pan.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, could you keep it down a little? I'm trying to study.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-huh, yeah. Here's your breakfast.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not a good time!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, is something wrong?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Would it be so bad to turn out like me?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I admire everything you do--

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's plenty good! It's great! It's just... not for me.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: School bus!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What kind of kiss did you get?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Normal. You?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ice cold.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're just imagining things.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hm.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What does your note say?

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The seven of clubs.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ta-da!

spoken_words: What's the point of getting rid of all the distractions at home, if I have to do my learning here?

spoken_words: OH I'LL WAX THE UPSTAIRS / AND I'LL WAX THE DOWNSTAIRS / THEN I'LL GET DRUNK IN THE LI'BRY!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Willie!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Do you have to wax this floor now?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: No, no, I can come back later.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Should I get the nurse?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Nae. Just keep studying. I'll scream this out.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I can get to you whenever I want, Simpson. But I'm gonna bide my time. You won't even hear the punch that wastes you. And you'll crack like one of those chicken turds rich people eat.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You mean an egg?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I mean you're dead!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Let me outta here so I can put you in here!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ha! You're not so tough now.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad was right -- I might as well give up.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: "Cloisters Academy?!" That bus could pick me up any day of the week!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Lord Buddha, I know I'm not supposed to want stuff, but c'mon.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, Dad! Please, can I go here? I'll study so hard I'll make the old me look like Bart.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That would be one weird-looking kid.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We'd love to send you here, sweetie. We just can't afford it.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, Lisa, could you please step outside? I have a few choice words for this gentleman.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, please don't.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: Oh, I've seen that look before. That's the "I ate the piece of wedding cake she's been saving in the freezer ten years" look.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You what?!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Run!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I have a future! Thank you, Mom!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you, four-eyes!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so exci--

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What time Monday?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: An academy! I'm attending an academy!

spoken_words: Awww.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, I don't really play.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Count me in!

spoken_words: What's wrong, sweetie -- you seem upset.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: I don't wanna talk about it.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's not Milhouse!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is it a girl?

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's Nelson!

spoken_words: Hm, I never figured him for the bully type.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: How do I do that?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: Did you get that the pony was actually me?

spoken_words: Self-published?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: Haw-haw!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: This is it, Simpson. After this, your nose will not be an outtie.

spoken_words: Uh, Nelson... for someone who never goes to the dentist, you have pretty good teeth.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: They're dentures!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... you do a lot with a limited wardrobe!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: That's Social Worker talk for "I'm poor."

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, uh, you punch really good!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You think?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah! And-and you always avoid the face around picture day. People appreciate that.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, those memories are forever.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You really care, man. A lot of bullies just phone it in. Kearney.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That school is so great! Teachers teach so much better when they're paid in money, and not in chickens. Is Mom gonna come up and say goodnight?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your mom's doing laundry, but she authorized me to say goodnight for her. So, by the power vested in me, I now pronounce you sweet dreams.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: Mom?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: There we go. Clean... and white... and soft.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life

spoken_words: Mom?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I see what happened. There was no scholarship. They said I could attend if you did all their laundry. I can't live with that knowledge while trying to get more knowledge.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, honey, I insist. Because it's important to you that you don't turn out like me.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom... I don't want to go to that school.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why not?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Because, it's too elitist. Everyone's parents are in "the business."

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What business?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know! They won't tell me! And besides... you were willing to do all this just so I would be happy! Mom, I'd be honored if I turned out like you.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, thanks to you, this box sucker didn't beat me up!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: We've been pokin' foil all night. Musta put away two eight-packs by now.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so glad you two are friends again.

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look what Maggie got!

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer? How did you get...?

title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Up, a father has his secrets.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Housecat Flu is coming, people! The Center for Disease Disinformation predicts with some degree of probability that the Housecat Flu might spread in the following hypothetical outbreak pattern...

title: The Fool Monty
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: So petter beware, that warm body on your lap just might be...ready to destroy your tender vittles.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Springfielders are advised to stay tuned for more info if they experience any of the following symptoms: mild thirst, occasional hunger, tiredness at night...

title: The Fool Monty
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: You know, I don't know when this was ever a good idea.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hurry up, boy. We have to burn everything the cat touched before the virus makes us paranoid.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Stop burning!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They have a vaccine!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right. We'll get the vaccine.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, did you know he was in the pile?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I thought he was an old clump of rags.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Don't worry, people. We have enough vaccines for... one child per family.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I don't even have a kid that I admit to having!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Please use your time in line wisely to "Sophie's Choice" your child.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What a crook.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This isn't the line for a movie. Why are you wearing that costume?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Because, you see, I am afraid of needles, but Wolverine is not.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Snikt! Snikt!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Need... acceptable currency... for delicious treat...

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns? Where's he going?

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, I'd like thirty-seven snifters of your influenza syrup. One for me, one for Smithers here and the rest for my hounds.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Give him what he wants -- he's the only taxpayer in this town.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: But Mr. Mayor, these people have waited in line. And dogs can't even get the disease.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: They'll see me take it and they'll want some. Yes 'oo will. Yes 'oo will. You little jelly belly.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, perhaps we should get out of here before people start resenting you.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hurry up and get in -- I'll drive.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hurry everyone, roll in the shards!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Come on! Like this!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Healthy. Gettin' healthy. Ow! Gettin' healthy... and very sleepy.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ahhh. I feel as hail and hearty as an eohippus.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Spit it out, Doctor! I haven't got all day.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Dying?!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: How long do I have?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You want me to tell the employees, sir?

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No. It's better that they hear it from me. I'll tell them the truth in the simplest way I know how.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why did Burns make us all come here?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: I bet he's got something up his sleeve.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I don't like that he hired a band to play ominous music.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Good evening -- I have very sad news for all of you.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, maybe he's going to jack up our electric rates. I will have to hand-crank my wiener warmer. Hand-crank my wiener warmer.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The truth is... I'm dying.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hell yeah!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Finally! A break for the black man!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: This better not be a gag!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's not! My days are roman numeraled!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Stop this! Stop this at once or I'll...

title: The Fool Monty
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Or what? You're just gonna die soon anyway!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'm warning you! You are making a very powerful temporary enemy!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, you'd better not rile them up. The first course is oysters on the half shell.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I see. I am well and truly hated. However, you will change your tune when you see the legacy I'm leaving behind me.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'm leaving all my money to an orchard that will grow inedible "me"-shaped fruits.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: They're as addictive as they are poisonous.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Melt his ice sculpture!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I haven't a friend in the world.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You have me, sir.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I pay you, Smithers. And no kind of love can come from one man paying another.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Well, but there's...

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'll just retire to my bed.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Uh, that's where we put everyone's coats.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Shred them in the wood chipper and use the rags to wax my car.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Why does everyone hate me?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, what are you doing?

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, I want to die quietly, on my own terms, crushing as many of those baby sea turtles as I possibly can.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Goodbye, insufficiently cruel world!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Anthill, wasp nest, moose poop, Mr. Burns... Mr. Burns?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My poop stick has brought him back to life! But which end?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What do you want?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, man, leave me alone.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Friend?

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You my mommy-daddy-puppy?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa! Your brains have turned to oatmeal!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: My name Oatmeal?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This is too weird, man.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Wait for Oatmeal!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What am I gonna do with you?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, I know you're cool now, but my Dad hates you more than celery, and my Mom said no new pets -- so I'm hiding you in my room.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oatmeal accept premise.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, who are you talking to?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's all that noise?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm playing with my Sergeant Activity Doll.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hm... Well, okay.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay. I'll find you some food.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Me not feel good.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: He was more than a friend. He was the reason I got up in the morning. Because he would inject me with coffee at six a.m. in the back of the head. My new boss will never take his place.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh, a lot like my old boss. Ruthless. Went to Yale. Made a fortune in energy. Basically hairless.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: He likes to stack men naked. I guess that's a start.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: A Philanthropist, a Humanitarian, a Man of Peace. These are among the people who've come today to spit in Montgomery Burns' open grave.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: The fact that Mr. Burns' thirty-seven pound body was never found did nothing to lessen the salivary salvos.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I hope they use that spit for a good cause, like sealing wedding envelopes.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Or helping a railroad worker grip his sledgehammer!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Now they're dancing on his grave!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thank God Mr. Burns isn't alive to see this.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come back! I'm not finished giving you your bath!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hm, apparently Mr. Burns is in a state of shock from the trauma he underwent.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh man, this is great. The most evil man in town is in our power. He will do my bidding... at that fantasy football auction. And anything else my limited imagination can come up with.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just because Mr. Burns was mean to you, that doesn't give you the right to abuse him when he's helpless.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, it's the golden rule: treat others the way they mess with you.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's not up to you. We're going to take him to our moral and civic leaders. They'll know the right thing to do.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: All those in favor of treating Mr. Burns the way he messed with us say "aye."

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: People of Springfield, to quote Shakespeare, "the quality of mercy is not strained..."

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You know, it takes a lot for an eight-year-old to stand up in front of the whole town.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Eight-year-old? I always thought you were a midget!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We're called "little people" and I'm not one.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: People of Springfield, as a nerd, I understand your desire for revenge, but this sweet, harmless man is not the same remorseless monster who tormented us all.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: He's close enough!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Almost, Mr. Vice President. May I ask why I'm doing this?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: When my old boss got bored, he liked to listen to Thomas Edison reciting "Mary Had A Little Lamb" on a wax cylinder.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now boy, everyone in town gets Burns for half an hour to do as they will.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This town can't teach its kids or collect its garbage, but we lead the nation in pointless revenge.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Amen.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Burnsie, follow the carrot!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, you're gonna wreck him for everybody!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, boy, another girder always swings in for you to walk on right when you get to the end.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Where's the other girder?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I believe you want the "Assistant Manager, sir."

title: The Fool Monty
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Well, that is your bad luck because he is mine right now. Come back in half and hour and he can be your accomplice.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: What was that?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: What was that? Ice skating? Do you do axels and Salchows? What do you do?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Check out my new Dad!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What did you do with him?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, Mr. Burns is here for you again.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Already?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A little tired of revenge, are we?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, I've done all I can do in that medium.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: All right. Mr. Burns, I'm gonna show you that not all of us in this town are vindictive and cruel.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Not today.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I thought after all you went through, you just might want to spend an hour in a place where you felt at home.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Lots of room for friends.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Actually, sir, the man who lived here didn't have many friends. But you're a better person than he ever was.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That's me!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, technically it's you. But like I said, people change and--

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: --and they can also bloody well change back!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Daddy's home.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I'm sorry, but no.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers! Trading me in for a younger model, I see.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Mr. Burns! You're alive! I'm so happy I could hug you!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And me smell like drugstore cologne the rest of the day? I don't think so. You may hug... my shadow.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, there's a number on him. What is it?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Oh. Mr. Vice President... I've loved this time we've spent in this dormant volcano, but...

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I... I am.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Can I go now?

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Attention, insects! The foot of reckoning has arrived!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hey there, Mr. Burns! For our half hour I thought we'd have a picnic in the park.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Silence, you sadistic monster! I've got my memory back, and I'm going to wreak a terrible vengeance. Taking an idea I got from a Stephen King book, I'm going to cover this town with a dome!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: It's been done!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Really? You don't say. Did you know about this?

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I see. Well, what if I cover you all with... a cube of bulletproof plexi-glass!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Uh, it's pretty much the same thing.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Set 'er down, Smithers.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, you can't hurt us after all we've done for you.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What the devil are you talking about?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You were given six weeks to live. And you've outlived it! I think what kept you alive was that for once in your life you were helping other people.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Could it be? Perhaps kindness did keep me alive.

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Young man, would you like a lemon drop?

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It wasn't kindness that was keeping me alive, it was bile building up inside! Loathing is my life blood and rage my royal jelly! So yes, thank you, Springfield, for giving me the secret to eternal life -- hate!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're welcome!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What are you doing here?

title: The Fool Monty
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You were my father for two hours, and I'm not letting this Dad get away!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Preposterous! I won't be Bismarcked into fathering anyone!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Listen, old man. I need someone to cheer me on in the school play. And it's gonna be you or this copter's goin' down!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You know I'll do it!

title: The Fool Monty
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thank God your son can't see the way you're behaving.

title: The Fool Monty
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: My son? My son? The truth is... I don't have a son! Haw-haw! Haw-haw! Haw-haw!

title: The Fool Monty
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That's my boy!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, don't be scared, boys. That's just the angels bowling.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Homer Simpson

spoken_words: KER-SHAW, KER-SHEW / I'M AFTER YOU / WITH MY BLOODY NOOSE / STRONG ENOUGH TO HANG TEN MOOSE / KER-SHAW, KER-SHEW / IT'S JUST A STORY, BUT IT'S REALLY TRUE!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, are you scaring those kids?

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, I'm no-ot! Yes I am. The Bloody Hangman walks on his stubby bone feet through the plague-ridden streets of London...

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You said it was Boston.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Did I? Anyway, the Bloody Hangman set to his gory work. Bodies piled up like those stackable plastic chairs.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Like those chairs in the music room?

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Possibly!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The Hangman's here!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ker-shaw, ker-shew, my lies have come true!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Huh. It's a pigeon.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The poor guy hurt his wing.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I bet it's a combination to a safe!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Or, more likely, the phone number of the bird's owner.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ask about the safe. No, better yet, act like you know about the safe.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, I believe I have your pigeon, "Raymond Bird," and I need to know how to return him to you.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, he could fly home, except that he has a broken wing. Perhaps you and your sarcasm could come to Springfield and retrieve him.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Looks like you're gonna have to take care of him, Bart.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Me? Just what in my long, sad history with frogs makes you think I can take care of a bird?

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, no... Listen, don't tell anyone, but... I can't stand pigeons! They're like rats with wings!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's crawling on your arm.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh... Okay, maybe he's not so bad.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No! No! No! Get off! Get off! Get off!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Ray, your wing is healed. Go on. Live your life.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, c'mon, man. Admit it -- you knew this day would come.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You and I have shared too many seed bells to just walk away from this.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Go ahead, make fun of me. I lost my heart to a bird.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw-haw.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Man, you were not into that. What's wrong?

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: My mom ran off with my birthday clown.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All finished, boy.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That coop looks a little flimsy.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flimsy? This gentle pat says different.

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Opossum!

title: How Munched is That Birdie in the Window?
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, it's just Maggie.
