spoken_words: I'm going to bed.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You don't understand me. Only she understands me.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Another round, kid?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... I got here after you did.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry to bother you at home, Mr. Marlowe...

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: ...but my husband's acting pretty odd. Coming home late. Drinking in the morning.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't suppose you'd consider taking your old job back so Homie can go back to his old job?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you certainly won't be bending me-- Wait, how did I end up in your bedroom?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look, I came to talk about my husband, and... How did we get in here?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm a happily married woman!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I know! And I don't want him to stray from anything except his diet. And I don't really want him to do that.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: See? Luckiest man in the world.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Luann?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: You're reading a chapter book! For fun. Bullies! To me!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, I had to read it to my sister.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nice save.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "...and Amy and Jo hugged one another close, and everything was forgotten in one hearty kiss." End of chapter eight.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, come on, guys, it's getting dark.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Tell her I'm at a meeting, not drinking...

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I want you to come with me and the kids on a family vacation.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Of course, of course. Family is everything to us company men. Now, where shall we go on your vacation?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The farthest thing from this office I know: rafting down Rattler River Canyon.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's great, let me run the numbers because I really want the Simpson account. And give these cigars to your children.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Don't talk to me like I'm a client!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're not a client. You're the client.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Simpson! Put on your charm-their-pants-off pants! The mumpish oafs in Washington are sending their sternest band of nuclear regulators, handpicked to resist all blandishment.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll handle it. I always do.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Rafting, eh? It's a perfect way to entertain them. Finally, humanity has found a use for water.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, I can't go rafting with you because-- wait a minute, could this all work?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh no you don't.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Coggily-doggily.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It all fits. Mr. Burns, rafting it is.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now relax, Dottie. Leave everything to me.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Marge, this is the most romantic trip you ever nagged me into.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And maybe when we get home we can ride down something else.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not sure what you're going for, but

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... Marge, why don't I catch us some salmon?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's about time. We've been making small talk about Mussolini for fifteen minutes.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well I, uh, found that contact lens I was missing. Lemme just screw her back in.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, everybody good?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh. If you've got that, then...

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Enjoy the outdoors you stupid kid!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This family time is so precious. Gotta go.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! Are you... schmoozing those men?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Um, I think we're supposed to get off here.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Take us out first! Anyone can start a family! These days, no one can find a job!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see, my family gives me love and sex. My work gives me money and sleep...

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hurry! We're heading for the falls!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My co-workers are like a family. But in some ways my family is like a family too...

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: For God's sakes, Homer! I've given you three children!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whose side are you on?

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yours, Homie. I'm always on yours.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: How ironic. I survived the Titanic by making a raft out of steerage passengers and now this!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Marlowe? I thought you retired!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, Simpson, you were willing to let me go over a waterfall, but you cut operating expenses by six percent, so you're forgiven.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks. Now if you'll excuse me, I don't really like bourbon or business talk, just good old Simpson family fun.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey kids, I'm it!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm okay! And I found some gold!

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I'm so glad you're not an Accounts Man anymore.

title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yep, your worries are over. I'm back to being a boring old Safety Inspector at a nuclear power plant.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey-hey! Can't get enough Itchy and Scratchy! And now it's time for-- Another Itchy and Scratchy?! Who's the star of this show, me or--

name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Why is my show all cartoons? And all the movies they're making fun of are over a year old! It's like those parodies were written when the movies came out, but it took so long to animate them that we look dated and hacky! Why can't we--

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, that's enough TV. Maggie's eye is starting to wander.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mo-om, what are you doing?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What a rip.

spoken_words: No more TV! We're gonna get some fresh air, and visit the Museum... of Television.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why can't we visit a real museum? One that doesn't have the skeletons of the Three Stooges in the lobby?

spoken_words: We have to see the Museum of TV before next Wednesday when it closes forever.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution

spoken_words: It's closing?! But where will people find clips of old TV shows if they're not housed in a giant building? Where? Where?

spoken_words: You're killing me here with this Catchy and Patchy. I'm barely on my own show!

spoken_words: Wikipedia, Twitter... who names these things? Percy Dovetonsils? Get it? Come on, he was on... Ernie Kovacs... with a smoking jacket...

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What kind of changes?

name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, no. My contract states there's only one way you're allowed to fire me.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yep, everything's nice and legal.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Could this be more awkward?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: ...They took my dressing room, my parking space, even my writer -- so I don't have a funny third item. But at least I've got you, my agent and best friend.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: But we shared everything. Boats, girlfriends, condos. And when I finished, every one of 'em was spic and span.

name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What? I'm on your garage door opener?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Little help?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So, what was everyone's favorite moment at the museum?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I liked the knowledgeable docents.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I like the early closing time.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Fate is so cruel. This morning I was a star, with a top agent. Now I'm strung out in a ball pit. Go Away! No kid should see his hero sunk so low.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you're not exactly my hero. I see you more as a cautionary tale.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What?! I'll show you who's a cautionary tale!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I'll show everybody...!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're not licked, Krusty. People love a comeback. Look at Robert Downey Junior... Mickey Rourke...

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I don't know if I've got it in me.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, people also love a quitter... Sarah Palin... The Beatles...

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Eh, it's hopeless without an agent.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You need an agent? We met a ten percenter today. She'll get you meetings with the eye, the peacock, the alphabet web. You'll have a skein on the sked before you can say "Krusty's wardrobe furnished by Ha-Has of Beverly Hills".

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: A new agent? I better freshen up.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Also better get back on those anti-psychotic meds.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: This is a bad sign. I've been to classier gas stations.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty, you know her?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: She sure knows me.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ms. Dubinsky, can you please just tell us why you hate Krusty?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now I hate him too.

title: Holidays of Future Passed
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wha'd-she-do?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This is the part where I get the kids out of the room.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Deep down I'm doing this to get back at my father.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What about mimes?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Annie, would you ever consider taking Krusty back as a client?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What about a comedy candle? You know, that relights itself?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: They're pretty funny. Once I used one on Milhouse. He was wishing for his parents to get back together, but the flame never went out.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good one, boy.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Annie, I'm down on my rebuilt knee. Can't you forgive me? Please? For the sake of me getting what I want?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Let me get this straight: you want me to do my kids' show for adults? They're gonna want F-bombs and all I can give 'em is "ka-ka" and "ta-tas."

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: What'd he get in trouble for?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: That's all?! I did that while you were on the phone!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Y'know, I'm a little nervous about doing live theater again.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yeah, but they were kids and we gave 'em candy if they laughed. And if they didn't, until the seventies I hit 'em with a stick. Some jerk tracked down the kids and made a documentary. It's called "Circus of Shame" or something.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey-hey, kids!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Who here likes nostalgia?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Everything's perfect about the past except how it led to the present!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Then welcome back the original Tick-Tock the Clock!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Ooo, looks like Tick-Tock is telling us it's time for...

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I've pulled out everything but my Little Krusty. Aw, what the heck.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: No one knows better than me that it's "here today, gone tomorrow." But I'm here today! Thanks to you, honey.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Let's just keep smooching till everything sorts itself out.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I'm done.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Krusty, you're getting the best reviews of your career!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yep! I'm back on top! And this time I'm not blowing it on cocaine for my horses. They start well, then they get paranoid around the third turn.

spoken_words: Which ones? Telebozo? Shtick at Nite? E.S.P.U.?

spoken_words: Wait a minute -- there's soft porno?

spoken_words: Even the Boston Phoenix?

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: All good. I just have one non-negotiable demand:

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: This brass begonia here is my producer now until the end of time.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Yep. And you know that anything said at a network pitch meeting can be taken to the bank.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution

spoken_words: Krusty, my man, you finally hit it big.

spoken_words: Too hot! Too cold!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Genius.

spoken_words: Annie, it's your first day on the set. Scream something nice.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Hey, birthday parties got me through some tough times. For years I lived on piñata candy!

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Whoa, that's Beyoncé volume.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution

spoken_words: Wha? What'd I do?

spoken_words: What's going on? Yanking me out of my schvitz?! I look like an unwrapped mummy. Ooo! Idea for sketch: rapping mummy. Notorious T-U-T. It writes itself. Find someone to write it. Where's Annie?

name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Oh, I see what's goin' on here: if a woman does it, she's a bitch. But in a man, those traits would be considered... Uh-oh.

title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: That hallway looks familiar.

spoken_words: Wow, I can't believe we're in the audience of a pay-cable show!

spoken_words: Hey-how-are-ya-don't-talk-to-me-the-show's-starting.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sure, what've you got? Puppy Goo-Goo comin' my way?

name: Bart Simpson

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches

spoken_words: I'm glad it's over. I wasn't comfortable having the upper hand.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: From now on I'll dominate you... in ways you don't realize.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: That's all I ever wanted.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Moe Szyslak

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches

name: Marge Simpson

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You've got my rag! But how?

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Marge Simpson

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Num-num-num-num-num- num.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It seemed a little... "ripe", so I brought it home to clean it for you.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Thanks, Marge. That rag is my only friend in the world.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Marge Simpson

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So yaz all like me? Even you, maestro?

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Milhouse.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I, I knew it was something stupid. Well thanks, everybody. I... I'm always gonna remember today as the day that I learned to open my heart to human beings and not old pieces of cloth.

title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Crazy me. Thinkin' I needed a rag for a friend.

title: The Daughter Also Rises

spoken_words: Maybe we should just watch TV.

spoken_words: Oh Marge, this is brilliant.

name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Hey, Bart, why don't we become MythCrackers? I bet those guys get so many valentines.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: That might be a good idea, but then again, you thought it up. Eh, why not?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Okay, first myth. Using a cell phone at a gas station is dangerous.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well, at least I'm cool now!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why does the guy have to do everything for the girl on Valentine's Day?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We show girls love on Valentine's Day, and they let us blow stuff up on the Fourth of July. I just pray they never fall on the same day.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, read this.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "My darling husband. This Valentine's Day, I have a present for you..."

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks for reading it to me.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: My pleasure.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: ...I want you to have a fun night doing guy stuff. Don't worry about me, I'll be fine.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I just think we should do things every day to show our love for each other.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's okay, Homie. Go. Have a good time. Take Bart with you!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Which one do you want?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You have the most wonderful Mom in the world, which is why I have no idea where she is or what she's doing.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, sucker! It's Valentine's Day, and I've got a date with some fastballs!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, I love spending mother-daughter time with you. We have so much in common, like... um... Oh no! Someone's about to put the thousand island ladle into the vinaigrette!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, sorry, I didn't mean to be nosey.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You have a way with words.

name: Marge Simpson

name: Lisa Simpson

spoken_words: Noooo!

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa. Now this is the most important place in the world.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa?

name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, Midge! You want a piece of my ziti?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: That cost a nickel, but we'll settle up later.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Today we tackle the most terrifying "myth" in the history of Springfield Elementary: that if you press E-8 on the candy machine, you get electrocuted and die.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Something like that.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ladies and gentlemen, that myth is... cracked!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Candy cigarettes? I didn't know they made these!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: How dumb do they think we are?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I can quit any time I want!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This place is great! If I cover my peripheral vision, I feel like I'm in France!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ew. How 'bout I'll just look at you.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It's... nice.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I'm sorry I'm late! No excuse, I just forgot all about you. Huh? I'm not sure that patch really represents who I am right now.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well. I usually take Lisa, but I can just go with Bart.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, if you'd been here for the design phase, you could've registered that objection. Now start quilting!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now there's three of you?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: According to the wisdom of our elders...if you go all the way around on the swing, your body will turn inside-out.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Cool, now my beauty will be on the outside.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's still inside-in, folks! And just to prove it:

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "She had now come to the part that Peter Pan hated. 'I do like a mother's love,' said Tootles..."

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, I have a crush!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Is it on your father? Little girls always get crushes on their fathers.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Somehow I missed that phase.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Almost there, boy. Almost there. Almost there.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm getting' closer. It's just within reach.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The boy I like is Hemingway-esque!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. Let's "esque" him to dinner.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, Nick here in our house. I hope it doesn't make him think less of me.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This house is not an embarrassment!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Usually when I say something like that, something extremely embarrassing happens. I'm gonna say goodnight before it does.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, my. I don't know if anyone's ever kissed my hand before.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, your arms are lanky. It's kind of a long trip down there.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hm, the French have gotten into the wine game. Good luck catchin' up with the big boys.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'll get a couple glasses.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're going with me! But Lisa, after this, I don't want you to spend any more time with this boy. If you do, it'll mean you're a separate person from me.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom can't appreciate the kind of boy Nick is, because although I love Dad, he's a completely different creature.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, there's a lot of fish in the sea, but she picked out a drunken walrus. But you and this Nick fella sound to me like the story of Pyramus and Thisbe.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Pyramus and Thisbe were lovers from ancient times!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: They lived next door but their families despised each other.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: The lovers had to whisper their sweet nothings through a crack in the wall.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nick and I met talking through a crack between two booths!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: And the power of that forbidden smooch made them love each other forever.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Man, that company thinks every time it adds a wisecracking parrot to a story, they own it.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa, would you help take me on a foolish romantic mission?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Let me check my schedule.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: That might work... I think I'm free... Tuesday's open...

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You got it, kiddo.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Legend has it a girl named Eleanor Mackie drowned on this very spot. Now they say if you call her name three times while looking in this mirror, you will die. Milhouse?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Eleanor Mackie. Eleanor Mackie. Eleanor Mackie!

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. That was the last school myth and it's officially... cracked.

spoken_words: So school is just... everything we see? That's sad, man.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You into cigars now?

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: It's a Twix.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't be the guy who killed everybody's fun. That's Skinner's job.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Don't blame me. You killed the fun, fun-killer.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse, I've just figured out a way to make school cool again.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: American Girl doll day? You might be surprised at the number of boys who have American Girl dolls. It's not weird 'cause they're historic figures.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I have found one last myth to destroy -- the so-called legend of Groundskeeper Were-Willie.

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Prepare to be disappointed!

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Gentlemen, we just created a myth.

name: Lisa Simpson

title: The Daughter Also Rises
name: Lisa Simpson

name: Lisa Simpson

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Good evening. It is with great sadness I inform you that America and China have declared war, and a massive nuclear attack is expected to reach our shores within the hour.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: That's the sort of hypothetical emergency today's disaster preparedness drill is designed to get us ready for.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: All Springfielders should now move off the streets and inside their homes. Please avoid the superstitious panic which marked the recent lunar eclipse.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, Dad. I was afraid the dragon wouldn't cough the moon back up.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: You idjit! The dragon always coughs the moon back up!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I know it's futile, but I must again point out there is no dragon.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then why am I paying eight hundred dollars a year in dragon insurance?

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Again, I maintain that money would be better spent on car insurance.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, everyone knows dragons do not attack cars. Jeez, pick up a book.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I pick up books like you pick up beers!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then you have a serious reading problem.

spoken_words: Now remember, this is only a drill.

spoken_words: Aaagh! The missiles really are coming! The so-called "drill" is just a way to get you into shelters without causing total chaos!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is not a drill!

title: At Long Last Leave

spoken_words: I can do this... I can do this...

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Do we really have to sit here the whole time? I mean, if we went out now, it might be cool to see the town empty.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah! I could sneak into the school and write whatever I want on the chalkboard!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I could see a planetarium show without the secondhand marijuana!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And I can drive drunk while I'm actually sober!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's fun, but not as fun.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's odd.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why are all those cars parked at City Hall?

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ay carumba!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: If I didn't know better, I'd say it was a town meeting.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not without us, it isn't! Pull over.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Welcome to this secret meeting, made possible by the fake disaster drill. And a special thanks for the hard work of the Mystery And Secrecy Committee.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Quit complaining! You only meet once a month!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Yes, but the meetings last eight hours!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: And now for the reason we are here.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's going on? Why is there a picture of us? This isn't good.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh honey, why must you always assume that a huge picture of us, at a secret meeting we weren't told about, is a bad thing?

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: The results are in: this town has voted unanimously to get rid of Springfield's unending nightmare: the Simpsons.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: They're here! The monsters are here!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, it's me, Marge! I'm your friend!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: The monster queen is comin' on to me!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why would you want to banish us from Springfield?

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah. We're like family to you. I'm talking to you, headphone-bus driver guy.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: This is not about who wore whose hair where. We are here to banish the Simpsons, although we are not pleased to be doing so.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I am!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Me too.

title: At Long Last Leave

spoken_words: I believe you know my position.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: I know we're all happy-- I'm just trying to spare their feelings.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why would an entire town go to all this fuss to get rid of one family? What have we done that's so terrible?

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: I'm glad you asked.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: The simple fact is, the city is going broke cleaning up after Homer's drunken shenanigans...

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We won! Woo hoo!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! That is not banishment-hearing behavior!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Bart's pranks, which dwindle in humor as they rise in destruction...

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: And Liser's environmental initiatives...

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: If I may speak.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Um-hm.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We're not monsters. We're just people. People who love each other and love this town. The only place we've ever called home. Thank you.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Marge, you are a sweet woman and you make us see your family in a more forgiving light.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you.

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Which is why you're the worst Simpson of all!

title: At Long Last Leave
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, now, now just a second here! Now, I know we're not perfect. But, uh, I believe it was Sammy Hagar who said--

spoken_words: Don't worry, Marge. We'll get 'em. Unless we die on this icy mountain road. Then they've won forever.

spoken_words: What if they are better for the kids than us?

spoken_words: Marge, let me set your mind straight about something -- that spectacular young couple is definitely better for the kids. But those kids are ours, because we made them, by accident. And now, we're gonna take them back because we love them, especially now that we've had a little time apart from them.

spoken_words: You should never tell on a bully, Lisa. Everyone knows that.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Can I ask you guys something? Why does someone become a bully?

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But why would my teacher be a bully?

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I dunno.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Do not cross -- it is that monster that terrorizes the jolly fat man!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Come on, people! You're safe as Sunday with me. I wouldn't hurt a fly!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fear not, people. I will lead you safely across.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Help me, Flanders!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Never get into Heaven... took harp lessons for nothing...

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's wrong, Sweetie?

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: My teacher's still bullying me.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Even after we came to school?

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That just made it worse.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Every time I try to fix things it just makes things worse. But I'm gonna fix this!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think I have an idea.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders, I've come to forgive you.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: My prayers have been answered! Well actually, just this one.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But, there is one condition...

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You wanna hit me. Well sir, here's a roll of quarters to put in your fist for extra punching power!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Now you can shatter my orbital bone! That'll knock the wax off my candle!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't wanna hit you. I want your wife.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: To elaborate, I want your wife, the teacher, to help get rid of Lisa's substitute...

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Edna!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You know how you said you could help me with any desire and nothing was forbidden? Well, sir, I want you to rid of Lisa's bully teacher.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: There's only one way: the nuclear option.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How much plutonium do you want? Gotta warn you, it might take me twenty minutes to get it.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Ms. Cantwell?

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: I have a new student for your class.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yo.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Yes, this is a very rare mid-year two-grade send-back.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Right. I can't be around him 'cause he's so delicious. Ha!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I know. Posted a video online.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ms. Cantwell, I can make this stop. All you have to do is... like me.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Wait! Wait! There's no need to leave!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You showed up before the students! That's all we asked!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ms. Cantwell! Wait!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've got to know before you leave! Why don't you like me?

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That is so unsatisfying.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You think I'm pretty?

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: She hates me because I'm pretty!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Can you sign my yearbook?!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I'm glad the only beef between us is this burger!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: They sure are getting along.

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: How long has it been since we prayed together, neighbor?

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is praying?! Let me outta here!

title: Black Eyed, Please
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Help me God!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: A plague is sweeping through Springfield...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: A blue bonnet plague!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Springfield's ladies are wearing colorful Easter hats to celebrate the resurrection of... Jesus Christ.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: We'd better get this concert started. The giant chocolate bunny's melting!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hollow?! We paid for solid!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I thought that was where they lived!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Look at those delightful children, Smithers... all those healthy organs, ripe for the harvesting.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Not here, sir. Not now.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Not sure what I'm expecting to happen here.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Easy, easy. Let's not jump to conclu--

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's Easter! Why aren't these people at work?!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Good Lord! Look at all these comical booklets!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Yes, yes. Just don't exhale your death breath directly on them. Thank you.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: You know, I used to collect these bestapled fables...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: How much for your entire collection?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Comic Book Guy
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Um, the speed of light, expressed in dollars.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
raw_location_text: The Android's Dungeon & Baseball Card Shop
spoken_words: Just give him Faraday's Constant.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nice going, Bart. You've ruined Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas and Easter. The legendary grand slam.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You guys, I swear I didn't do it.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't like the sound of that funeral march.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay! I'll pay for your damn band candy! What was it, seventeen hundred dollars?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now do me wearing a sombrero!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now have me sleeping under a cactus!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I know this looks bad. And I admit, I would totally lie in a second to Lisa or Mom or Dad. But I would never lie to Maggie.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I did not do that prank.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Wow -- he passed the Maggie test. And remember how Maggie solved Cookiegate?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All too well.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: To prove my brother's innocence, I demand a youth court!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's right! Bart must not be judged by these kids, but by a jury, of kids. Mostly these kids. There's only so many kids.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'm afraid once a youth court has been demanded, we are legally obligated to shut down mob rule, as decided in the case of "Rubber v. Glue" and reaffirmed by "I Know You Are v. What Am I."

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, if there's one thing I've learned as a defendant, and a juror, it's... stay out of the courtroom! It's so frickin' boring! Run, boy! I'll create a distraction!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Good news, bad news. We're allowed to select the judge, but it's impossible to find one who doesn't hate you...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I know someone who would make a great judge! Would you kids believe your Grampa once argued in front of the Supreme Court?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Not a chance. I mean, it's true! It was back in nineteen ninety-eight...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: The Attorney General and I have been playing chess through the mail ever since.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I find that a little hard to believe.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, why would you play chess through the mail when you can play chess through the internet, or preferably, not play chess at all?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: See here, sass mouth, you're not too big for me to tan your hide!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's not a threat if I don't know what it means.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: I'll fix your wagon!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, I'd like that.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I get a whiff of the immigrant from these newfangled superheroes.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hmm... reclusive millionaire, stately mansion, damaged psyche. He's just like me!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, I too shall become a crime-fighting bat!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: But I won't become just any bat -- I shall be the terrifying bat who swoops from the sky and sucks the vital essence of his prey. I shall be: Fruit-Bat-Man!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Great, great! I don't suppose you'll be forgetting about this tomorrow?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No sooner than I'd forget my own mother!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: That's not your mother, that's your bear.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, then, where's my stuffed mother?!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: All right, you soft-skulled nitwits, sit up straight because we finally have someone in this school who deserves your respect: Former Attorney General Janet Reno!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Grampa's story was true?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Dagnabbit!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Over the next few days, you're going to hear how the defendant, Bartholomew Simpson, a/k/a the "Springfield Egger..."

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Objection! Prejudicial!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: She sustained me!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: ...how Bartholomew Simpson wantonly egged this town with Milhouse aforethought.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: No Ma'am! Sneakers!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh God, the press is gonna have a field day with this.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This case is goin' great. Although as usual, I look nothing like the courtroom artist's drawing.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nice try, pop.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Very dramatic, sir. A little more brooding, and...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: There's my superhero! Now let's get you to bed and...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hist! Look there!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: This looks like a job for Fruit-Bat-Man!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Perhaps we should just call the police.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The police? Bah! Every last man on the take. And I should know, because I'm on the give.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I've never felt more alive!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Look. I'll give you each a thousand dollars if you pretend to let that old man out there stop this crime.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Feel the crumbling fist of justice!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Who are you, mysterious octogenarian of the night?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I am the squeak in the rafters, the flutter in the chimney, the tiny teeth-marks in the peach... I am "Fruit-Bat-Man!" Now, back to my natural realm, the inky night!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I'll just take one of these keychain penlights.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You have to keep squeezing this thing?! Who has the strength for that?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And do you think this boy took those eggs?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Objection! Unhealthy!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But could Bart have gotten those eggs?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No further questions.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: A toast, to our enigmatic new protector -- who certainly isn't me! Smithers, wink my eye!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, I hate to get all pruney, but heated tubbery is what we playboys do!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Great work, everyone! That's a wrap!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: It's nice to make an old man feel good about himself.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You said it.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: So Bart couldn't've taken the eggs. I was with him the whole weekend.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You'd make up any lie for that Simpson boy, wouldn't you?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Yeah, but I'd pee my pants.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Nelson?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Dry as a bone.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Now that's what I call legal briefs!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Why are you here?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: I thought of the joke and rushed over.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Your Honor, I think we've seen enough. I have demolished the prosecution's claims and made the prosecutor sweat through two shirts.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I move that you dismiss this case, and release this sweet, lovable boy.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The prosecution calls everyone in the world!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Mr. Szyslak, what name did the defendant ask for when he called you at your bar?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: He asked for, uh, Mike Rotch.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: And then what did you say?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, I said, um... I said "Mike Rotch. Um, Mike Rotch." And then, I... I'm sorry...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Take all the time you need.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I-I-I yelled out, "Has anybody seen Mike Rotch?"

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You see, they, they thought I was askin'... if anybody wanted to see... my... oh man, this is so painful... my crotch.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Thank you for your bravery today.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I just had to make sure that he never did this to another bartender.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Pass the gravy, Gloria Allwrong.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The trial's not over and gravy is dead animal juice.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Just remember this: a Simpson never gives up.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You gotta be kiddin'.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: A civilian! She mustn't know I'm a hero! Gouge her eyes out!

title: The Fabulous Faker Boy
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My wha?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, I came here because my brother is about to be wrongfully convicted. And the man I'm looking for would help me find the truth.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Don't you get it?! I don't care who you are or what you want.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Now get lost!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I think you just sent away the first person you could've actually helped.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: What do you mean "actually?" I've punched out four Homer Simpson-shaped burglars tonight alone.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: All those crooks were fakes! Set up by me.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Even the abominable Doctor Lenny?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: No, he was a happy accident. But the rest were fakes, just like you. A man who claims to be a hero but is nothing more than a fraud with a cute little bod.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: They're calling for you, sir. But who's gonna answer?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And so I've learned that the only true Batmen are Christian Bale and Adam West. Why are you washing Bumblebee Man's pants?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I volunteered to wash the egg stains off everyone's clothes. It's one of those things you say and hope nobody takes you up on it.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's odd.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What's odd?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This skirt has a small splatter...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Splatter?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Splatter, as if the egg had been crushed against it by hand--

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: I don't follow.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: --like someone faked being hit so they wouldn't be a suspect.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Interesting. Except you missed one thing.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's that?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's not a skirt. It's a kilt!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Ah... the wood chipper. Is there any sweeter music?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why'd you do it, Willie?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Because the world is better off with four fewer Welshmen! Wait, what are we talking about?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This kilt says you framed my brother! Why?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Because I hate Easter! You see, ladies, I'm not just a Presbyterian.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I'm a Scottish, "Old Believer" Presbyterian.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Old believers don't recognize holidays not celebrated by the original apostles. Especially one named after the pagan god "Eostre!"

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But how did you get the key?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I made sweet love to Lunchlady Dora then copied the key as she slept.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Now, as for your evidence...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Behold the pointed ears of justice!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: A human fruit bat!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: He's so light -- it's like fighting a silk scarf... or a kimono sash!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, feel the weightless tickle of justice!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Which side won, good or evil?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Good.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And which side was I on?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Also, good.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, there's two surprises!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's amazing how much exercise I've gotten from those words.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Pause the inquisition!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Behold the real egg-flinging fiend!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Aye, 'tis true. I pulled the prank for some daft Scottish reason.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: I'd fire that man if he weren't so damn good at what he does.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: We have a school full of professionals, sir.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Really? Where is that school? Inside your head?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You saved me, Lis! For the rest of my life, you'll always be my "one phone call."

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Aw... but I do hope you'll try to be good from now on.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't need to. I've got you.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Today you were truly a hero. Thank you.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You know, if you're gonna be a hero, you might not want to tent your fingers like that.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Is this better?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe you should wrap your hands behind your head.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Maybe I could wrap them around your gabby little throat!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ah! Tenting! Tenting! Back to the tenting!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Acquitted?! Then my nightmare isn't over?

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: And then there was the time I taught a dog to make oatmeal...

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I open one, no trump.

title: Dark Knight Court
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Double!

title: Dark Knight Court
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You've just made a powerful enemy.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Keep it under your hat, guys, but I've got a date with a married woman.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Let me guess: is it Marge?

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Her husband's gonna be there too.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Got it. You and Marge.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Give up? It's Marge -- I'm having a lunch date with my wife.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Good one. / Yeah, you got us, man.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Date with my wife.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah, well I got plans for lunch too. I'm lying under a tree!

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Everybody's got something.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This is the coolest sushi restaurant in town! It got three-and-a-half stars in the Springfield Tire Guide!

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: When we got married I promised you a life full of romance. Now here it is.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: If they can be that rude, the food must be great!

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, this is amazing. I never realized some restaurants are better than others.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's as yummy as your poorly-produced local commercial said.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So without the kids we can have sophisticated grownup talk.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, I'm thinking of getting Maggie swimming lessons.

title: What Animated Women Want
name: Homer Simpson
