spoken_words: What are you doing?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Trying to kill Moe so we'll get his emerald. By the way, I haven't checked, but emeralds are valuable, right?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Strong man, Moe may be ugly on the outside, but inside, you are the true monster. Leave my trailer forever!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You're rejecting me? But I'm in the best shape anyone is, in the nineteen thirties.

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I said go!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the hell does gooble goo mean?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You killed Burnsum? Now who is gonna say "Step right up"?

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Tar and feather him!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is exactly why circus attendance is plummeting!

title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ...and that, kids, is how I met your mother.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Poor Chip. Such a big part of everyone's life.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: People called him the sixth Simpson. Not sure why.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Chip was the life of Sector Six-F at the nuclear plant...but Chip once confessed to me... he did have a few regrets.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Chip regretted never ascending Mount Springfield from the south face. He regretted that the high school long jump record he set was wind-aided. We often spoke of that asterisk. He never broke par on hole seventeen at Springfield Mini Golf.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not me!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Let us kneel...

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He's such a little dickens. Although Dickens was pretty well-behaved.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I have no regrets about that. It was a perfect pregnancy. Didn't smoke, didn't drink, lost three pounds. And every night before bed, Homer would give me a little kiss... music. Could Bart have been prenatally screwed up by the KISS music?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: GET UP / EVERYBODY'S GONNA MOVE THEIR FEET

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: GET DOWN / EVERYBODY'S GONNA LEAVE THEIR SEAT

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: YOU GOTTA LOSE YOUR MIND IN DETROIT ROCK CITY!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, this is the weirdest pregnancy craving ever.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, for some reason it relaxes me. Now do that thing Gene Simmons does.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Overstay my welcome for forty years?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman, live at the Springfield Peach Parade. Sir, could you give us eight seconds of your homespun wisdom?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: We'll have more regrets at eleven tonight following an all-new bottle of scotch.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm thinking about it!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's the coolest bowling ball I've ever seen.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Bear Stearns? I'd like to sell all my Apple stock so I can buy a fancy bowling ball. You heard me. Technology is a fad. Heavy blue balls are the future.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Now, let us text on our ubiquitous Apple tablets and phones...

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You cost me a piece of all of that!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, don't cry.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: If it makes you feel worse, I'm the man who bought the stock you sold.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll bet a rich man like you has no regrets at all.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Just one.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The girl that got away. She broke my first heart.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: So, is there truly anyone among us without regrets?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Really, mother?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm Father O'Greedy! Dimes for the needy!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh...

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Uh... uh...

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My pants, like the Lord, work in mysterious ways.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Return those vestments!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Speaking of return on investments, my Apple stock is up thirty-five hundred percent!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You misheard that on purpose!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Tithe denied! Tithe denied!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Must find way... to blame myself.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Um... it says I should give you "lumbar support." Better go to the lumberyard...

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lumbar! It means lower back. How many times will you make that mistake?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Just put on the KISS record.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Anything from "Love Gun"!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey book, are you expecting this?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And while I'm at it... burn dumb helpful books!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That is a good fire.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: You're going down, Bart!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, reckless youth.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: He'll be okay.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I was referring to him.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I had a spring in my step like that once, back when I met Lilah.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Anything she wanted I was willing to do. Anything. Except...

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: All I have left is my drawing.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It looked a lot better in my memory. But do you know what, Smithers? I will find Lilah and win her back... I'll just check with the old gang. Hemingway!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Picasso!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Matador Juan Belmonte!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: And Stalin!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: That man could really put pressure on you.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Why are you doin' this, Bart?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Well, well, well, Rachel Maddow. Everyone came back for Chip's funeral.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Look, let's get this out of the way. Just because we both worked at Channel Six and you made it big and I didn't doesn't mean I'm bitter.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Maybe.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Just tell me already!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Great! We have a clip.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: I'm not a newsman anymore, I'm a geologist. I keep discovering a new rock bottom.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: When did that happen?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Rachel, can I come? We can share blazers!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Willikers! In my three years of soft news, I've never seen anything like this.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Those are tires from my ill-fated Krusty Town Car. It would explode if people gripped the wheel too tightly.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: You're not tellin' no one! As the four p.m. clown, I have complete control of Channel Six's news division.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Cable news? Bah! People only want news at six p.m. from white guys on weekdays and black guys on weekends.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: He ain't comin'. This little piggy's afraid to leave his cushy anchorman slop trough.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Could you uh, phrase that a little more nicely?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Sorry. He "isn't" coming.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Don't worry, piggy, you made the right choice.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: Eh, it'll burn out in an hour or so.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Lilah's alive?!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Married to Jesus, eh? Does he beat her?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Those raked rocks could've been me! Now since you're so good at finding things, find the exit!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You're becoming very tiresome.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Who moved my desk?!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Here I am. Cable news alley.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Fox News. Is this really how I want to get back in the big leagues? Let's see how print journalism is doing.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Sir, do you sell the New York Times?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Fifty percent attention-seeking, fifty percent to drop things on people.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We've had some good times.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And you sat on the gas pedal when my foot fell asleep. So I'm gettin' you shined up nice.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay Bart, be cool. Calm down. You're not gonna die up here.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well then, I should disrobe at once. Housekeeping! Send up a Chinese dressing screen! And one of Firestone's finest vulcanized prophylactics! Be right back.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers! Which do I take first? The rhino horn or the tiger tongue?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I have my doubts about both, sir.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Bah! I'll just do it the old-fashioned way. With my pump.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Just powdering my nose, darling!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers! Run down to Sears Roebuck and get a five-eighths inch Phillips head bolt!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Here I am, slowly dying every day at five, six and eleven.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Help! Help!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Child in danger with exciting visuals!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This kid's corpse could be my magic carpet. Get me a cameraman!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: The movie "Up" has come horribly to life over Springfield. A local boy clings to life in a story that proves this reporter's relevance!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ay carumba!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's Bart!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Pray for a miracle, boy! God can hear you better from up there!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dear Lord, please help me land safely, or transform this basket into a flying killer robot that I control with my mind, amen.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: That's not a prayer!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: My God says it is!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, I see you're ice cold with anticipation.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Dead?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh Lilah, even at the end I waited too long. What if I give her the breath of life?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hoo boy. I guess one regret just leads to another.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You know, sir, maybe it would bring you peace to honor the one thing Lilah ever asked of you.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: There you are, my good man. A little broth will cure your mental illness.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, that's five minutes. You can stop thinking of other people now.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You know what? I think I'll give it another five.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Chief, what are you doing to save our son?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Well, I've placed marksmen on the roof to shoot the balloons one-by-one, but frankly, they're not very good.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Oh c'mon guys, spread out! Arms length!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's all my fault. I should never have listened to those KISS albums when I was pregnant.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Marge, with all due respect, that's ridiculous. My Sarah listened to Mozart and Churchill speeches when she was pregnant with Ralphie, and he can't even open a refrigerator. Pushing, always, always pushing.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Really?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Hey! Only I get to criticize him, Lou. The kid's scared to flush. He thinks its his brother.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Can we focus on my son? Up in the sky?

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Mayor Joe Quimby
spoken_words: Unfortunately, all our cannonballs were melted down to make a statue of Joe Paterno, which we changed to look like Eugene Levy.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I think I just might have what you're looking for.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Today I'm glad that I sold that stock.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why does everyone know?!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: That kid's not dyin' on my watch. Which ends right now, fortunately.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Homer's rising faster than Apple stock!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My boy's okay!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I won the science fair! I get to go to Chicago!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Eh, Bart, Bart, Bart.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You know what I think about regrets? As long as your family is together, every choice you've ever made is the right one.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And together we are.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Would you guys knock it off? He's down safe already!

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: And there you have it. A family reunited, and a grateful nation gives thanks for some solid reporting. Back to you, Rachel Maddow.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: No thanks, Rachel Maddow. I'm happy right here. No regrets.

title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Ha!

title: YOLO
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Now, I, Bart Simpson, shall send the first coaster down the track.

title: YOLO
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: No. For once, I wanna go first.

title: YOLO
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But Milhouse, I already let you push me on the swings.

name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: And it's an honor, but I'm doin' this!

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Milhouse!

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Eat safety bar!

spoken_words: Why are we best friends?

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Because your seat was behind mine!

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Feels like this play date's gone on forever.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll handle this. "Dear Weirdo, pick up weirdo kid." And send.

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Did you eat a peanut?

name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: No, I just sniffed a nectarine. It's okay. I can breathe through my tear ducts. Tell me if this gets annoying.

name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I think I'm gonna throw up the mac and cheese you fed me. I'm not supposed to have it. That's why I had so much.

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What the?! If this kid's Dad isn't here in one second he's going in the garbage can.

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yolo?

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Once again, cats have it better.

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kirk Van Houten, I hope you're not having a midlife crisis.

title: YOLO
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Dad? You got me a skateboard?

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, but does Kirk know how silly he looks?

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look at me, I'm afraid of dying!

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Homie, I'm so glad you're happy with your life just the way it is.

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You've had the same job, same car, same house for twenty years. And that's all you'll ever have. A cycle you'll never ever, ever, ever, ever, ever change. And you're okay with it!

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Like I say night after night after night: nighty-night.

title: YOLO
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: So, Kent, what brings you here? The miraculous tale of how we lost, then found, our Lost and Found box?

title: YOLO
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Actually, Principal Skinner, I'm here to talk about something else: cheating.

title: YOLO
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I thought this was a puff piece! You're wearing a sweater!

title: YOLO
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This journalism just turned... gotcha!

title: YOLO
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: That's right, Channel Six will uncover the truth in a five part series two minutes a day. People, make room for your local Emmy nomination certificates.

title: YOLO
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: No, do not make room! Except for Mr. Largo and his diet, there is no cheating in this school.

title: YOLO
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: These thirty identical "What I Did This Summer" essays say different!

title: YOLO
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Um... Myra, don't I have another appointment?

title: YOLO
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Let's take a look at this monitor.

title: YOLO
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This school is more corrupt than an Italian parliament! If these children are our future, then I, for one, do not want to live!

title: YOLO
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Haw-haw.

title: YOLO
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Please don't air this. I'll tell you the winners of the kickball games in advance -- you can make a lot of cabbage betting on k-ball.

title: YOLO
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: And that's what we'll end the story with.

title: YOLO
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Noooooo!

title: YOLO
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: This is Kent Brockman, pleased with himself.

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: NO DREAM WILL COME TRUE,

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: YOU ONLY LIVE ONCE.

title: YOLO
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, well at least ya got your health, huh? Now let's see if I can take that away from ya.

title: YOLO
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Pure poison.

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm tired of livin' once.

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe I'm saying this, but I'm starting to regret saying Yolo.

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, if you don't mind, I'm gonna quit complaining about my life and start wallowing in the past.

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Postage, marked in pesetas? Who are those letters from?

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My old pen pal from Spain. Eduardo.

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Back in fifth grade, you either had to write to a foreigner or a prisoner. I picked a foreigner because the prisoners wrote back too fast. We'd write each other with our dreams of the future...

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I was gonna be King of Cheeseburger Mountain. Did I change or did they stop making mountains out of cheeseburgers? Probably a little bit of both.

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So sad.

title: YOLO
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Please, calm down, everyone! You know, maybe this so-called cheating scandal is actually an opportunity... to, uh, initiate a dialogue... that would, uh, create a teachable moment... uh, something something buzz word, I got nothing.

title: YOLO
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Quick! Get a picture for the yearbook!

title: YOLO
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I have a solution!

title: YOLO
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: You took your sweet time coming to our rescue, Lisa.

title: YOLO
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe the best way to keep students from cheating is to trust them not to cheat.

title: YOLO
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: That's it?! That's all you've got? Something I can read on a tea box?

title: YOLO
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What I'm suggesting is we create an honor code.

title: YOLO
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The students would do it.

title: YOLO
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: If every student pledges not to cheat, and to turn in any cheater, no one will cheat the system because they'll be the system.

title: YOLO
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I did it! I saved the day! The same way I won that battle in Vietnam! By fainting!

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: If you're my wife's secret lover, come in. There's nothing I can do for her anymore.

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Eduardo?! Is it really you? why are you here?

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm Homer Simpson!

title: YOLO
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wish.

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Marge Simpson! It's so nice to meet a friend Homer met through the mail who isn't a sea monkey!

title: YOLO
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, I thought a visit from your old pen pal would cheer you up.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This one whistled at me!

spoken_words: Ooo, that could be the one.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, but that orange guy looks like a pumpkin! But this fella is so fuzzy!

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, they all have their charms...

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, Mom.

title: The War of Art

spoken_words: I'm sorry, Mr. S. I cracked!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This one's nibbling a sunflower seed! Look at that hair -- Oh, I just wanna comb it forever! Have you seen a pinker nose? I have now!

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa! You've just gotta choose one. Lisa!?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: She's gone, honey. She's gone.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That one's fur looks like a tuxedo! A Band-Aid on its tail, awww! Albino!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I'm definitely getting this one. Oh, but I forgot about this one! Oh my God I never even saw this one!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe I should get that sick one. If I don't, no one else will. Bart, list your top five, best to worst. No, no, no, no -- worst to best!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I just wish the grey one had the brown one's personality!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, give me your phone. I need to look at the pictures again!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, this is the guinea pig that will make me happy.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: She thinks she's decided. Don't say a thing. Don't blow this!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I could get two...?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fighting Tweakers rule!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've tried to give Pokey a perfect replica of his natural habitat:

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Peruvian feather grass, an Incan sleeping mat, and a portrait of Marisol Espinoza, the Vice President of Peru.

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Are you sure you didn't create a perfect habitat for you?

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I wish I could live in there.

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well there's plenty of room... because Pokey's gone.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Where'd he go?

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This looks like a job for... fireplace tongs.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nooooo!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God, he's in the walls!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I hear chewing!

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No, that's a much bigger animal.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kettle corn... the heroin of the farmer's market.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I've lost my guinea pig!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Pokey!

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's okay sweetheart. Your pig thingy didn't mean it. It's just... it felt comforting to know that while we watched TV, there was art going on behind us.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess we have to go to an art gallery and buy a new painting.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure we could go to a fancy gallery and spend a bunch of money. Or...

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, these seem great. Oh, too bad someone used cello rosin.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my gosh, that's beautiful! I've never seen a painting with a lighthouse before.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This could be our new living room painting!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know. How 'bout this poster of a really rockin' jukebox?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know it's rockin' 'cause music notes are coming out of it.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh please, Homie...

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, it looks great!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, to me, it looks like... garbage salad, but that's the great thing about art: everyone can have their own opinion about why it sucks.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I've got to get rid of this ugly chrome frame from Kirk's bachelor bad. I hate to think of the things this mirror has reflected.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, look... there's a signature that the frame covered up: "Johan Oldenveldt."

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Here he is! "Johan Oldenveldt, painter, lived in Amsterdam, Paris... prolific early 20th century naturalist... I think this was painted by someone famous. Maybe it's valuable.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We should have it appraised!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You guys are crazy. I've never even heard of that guy. It's not like it was painted by Leonardo Da Vinci Code.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, ere's what makes art valuable: 1. Nudity. 2. Holograms. 3. Something terrible happening to Jesus.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh my God!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nobody touch it! Bart, stop looking at it!

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But I want to see it!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, you'll wear it out!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Baby, you saw something in this painting, and you were right.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, the Van Houtens owned this for years and never knew how much it was worth. Think how happy they'll be when we sell it and split the money with them.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Split it? Whoa. Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa...

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa...

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa...

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa...

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa... split it with them?

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Kirk and Luann didn't know what the painting was worth when they sold it.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, they sold it to us. So now it's our painting. We can hang it on our wall, cut eyeholes in it to spy on people, or... sell it for lots of money which we keep.

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: For ourselves?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This dude gets it.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But the Van Houtens are our friends!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know what you're talking about. Hide the treasure!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Are they, Marge? If you think about it, aren't they really just the parents of a kid who happens to hang out with our kid?

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All our friends are like that!

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well how would you feel if we sold them something that turned out to be valuable?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I would feel: A). Happy for their good fortune, B). Proud to know rich people, and C). Grateful for an opportunity to learn from a mistake.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How about this... what if we give the Van Houtens twenty-five percent of the money?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then they'll just be mad about the sixty-five percent that we're keeping!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, you like kindness, right?

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sure.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So even if we gave Kirk and Luann some of money, the knowledge of what they could have had will eat away at them, like piranhas devouring a wounded yeti.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Homer looks into Marge's eyes.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's kinder never to tell them.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Okay... I see your point. We should sell the painting, keep all the money, and never, ever tell the Van Houtens.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What'll it take to buy your silence?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay Milhouse, the guys in back are putting your new bike together.

title: The War of Art
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: And all I have to do is not say anything about some painting to my Mom and Dad?

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh sweetie, you want your parents to be happy, don't you?

title: The War of Art
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I guess.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "I guess." You're funny! No wonder Lisa's in love with you.

title: The War of Art
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: She is?

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: She is?

title: The War of Art
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: ...so if I keep my mouth shut, you get me new wheelie sneakers, and Bart agrees to promote and encourage use of my new cool nickname, "C.J."...

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You got it, Ceej.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We had a deal. And now we've got nothing...

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: If you knew you sold a valuable painting for nothing, how could you live with yourselves? We were just trying to be... kind.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We were gonna treat you to dinner at an upscale chain restaurant and never explain why, but now forget it!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's exactly how it is.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh it is.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Luann, I hope we're still on Thursday for collecting used cellphones for the troops.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that was cold, Luann. So cold! BRRRRR! SARCASTIC BRRRRRR!

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: See what happens when we get greedy?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Honey, there's something I wanna show you.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: An ATM receipt?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know whose this is. I found it next to the cash machine, and I've always kept it. Look at the balance.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Five figures!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: With that painting we could have what these people have. A money cushion. No more living paycheck to paycheck, one lost retainer away from the gutter.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I could write a check with... today's date on it.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's the cushion.

title: The War of Art
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: Interesting.

title: The War of Art
name: Kent Brockman
spoken_words: So if you see the Simpsons walking down your street, lock your doors and hide... your friendship.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Great! Now we're raccoons -- the masked bandits of the animal world!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry. No one's gonna see this stupid show.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: "Give back the painting!" The whole town's turned against us!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "You have no obligation to share the money from that painting." Ooo, a support rock!

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This one's against us. This one's for us. For, for, against, for, against...

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We don't even get this many Christmas cards.

title: The War of Art
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, shut your bone hole! That painting belongs to the Simpsons!

title: The War of Art
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: All sales are final!

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You really think we're still doing the right thing?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Just close your eyes and think of the cushion.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The paddles, Marge! Look at the paddles!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Our cushion!

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: See what your greed has done?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me, we're trying to find "Café Artiste."

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I guess I can't help but feel fully responsible.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What you need, my friend, is a Canadian Duff. Beauty, eh?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, why does that chick think she owns the painting?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not your fault, man. Those parasailing guys take whatever they want.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, all I gotta do is take a quick ferry to Isla Verde, find Café Artiste, and they'll back up Kirk's story. That will prove the painting was his -- and now ours.

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homer Simpson, that painting has torn the town apart, destroyed Kirk and Luann's marriage, and everyone's very worried about Milhouse.

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He's been playing Dancing Revolution for hours, but the TV is off.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But our cushion...

title: The War of Art
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That picture has brought out the worst in everyone! Please... just let it go!

title: The War of Art
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You're not gonna let it go, are you?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wish I knew how.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: This is so exciting! My first time establishing provenance!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Just remember, if your mother asks, I took you to a wine tasting.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's a terrible thing for a father to do.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's why she'll believe it.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hmm... this quaint artist community has gotten a little touristy.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sounds delicious. It's not. Hey, a friend of mine, uh, bought a painting here.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And that man sold it to me!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That proves the painting is mine! And nothing can stop me from selling it and keeping all the money!

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I love art!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes we do. It's a Johan Oldenveldt.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Prove it.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh... crap.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You're a... forger?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Then why did the auction house say it was real?

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What you do is horrible: ripping off geniuses who spent years perfecting their styles.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What!?

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now let's play human foosball!

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well... no, but now when I look at it all I'll see is a fraud.

title: The War of Art
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But, you still, I mean... I suppose you're right.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What if I never liked the painting, and only wanted it for money?

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, great. The painting is worthless...this was all for nothing. And when Marge finds out she's gonna kill me.

title: The War of Art
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: While you're at it... could you make me a couple more?

title: The War of Art

spoken_words: I'll pay you in Strupo...

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, perfect. Now that's art.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Children, you're in for a treat. Today's assembly is devoted to a special kind of history.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Living history.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: End this madness!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: We have two guests who have come from Springfield!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: We come from Springfield!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Illinois! Eighteen fifty-eight! Please welcome, here to debate the important issues of the day, Stephen Douglas and Abraham Lincoln!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Skin-ner!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: I have seven other principals and I've never yelled their names, not even once! You know what these kids lack?

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, certainly not a caring superintendent.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Well, I, uh... Respect. That's what these kids lack. So we will hold a contest to make them tell us who they respect. Who their heroes are.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: A contest? But, sir, we don't have any money to pay for prizes. We had to rent out our multi-purpose room to a Japanese-American social club.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: The answer is simple, Seymour. Get a corporate sponsor. But don't worry, you won't have to compromise yourself.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: So, from now on our cafeteria will only serve... delicious "Stuffwich's" heroes, hoagies, and torpedoes.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: What about po' boys?

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Sorry, Nelson. Poor boys such as yourself will go hungry. Now please welcome the star of "Stuffwich's" ads, who lost four hundred pounds eating only "Stuffwich" subs -- Ezra.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What makes you a hero?

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: So the chained-up dude cuts off his own foot to save his family from Jigsaw! My hero is my Mom's boyfriend who took me to that movie when I was three.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: I call him Uncle Rob -- because he robbed us.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Madame Curie, we just might have this one in the bag.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, calm down. Maybe he's talking about Margaret Mead.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No-no-no.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Martin took my topic. What do I do?

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, just make a speech about Dad.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Everyone does that.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Everyone does that with good dads. But with our Dad, it's like climbing Mount Everest. You either plant your flag at the top of the world or get frozen in agony forever. Either way, Hell of a show.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: People, please! Martin has left the building. He had an orthodontist appointment.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, Dad's my hero. Why is he my hero?

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, it happened again!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Lisa? Lisa Simpson? You have ten seconds to get to the podium!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Our final contestant is Lisa Simpson, who was last seen leaving in tears.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Near tears.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: But not in them?

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: My hero isn't famous...

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Loser.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ...isn't rich...

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Pathetic.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ...and isn't in any history books...

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: He makes me sick.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He's my Dad.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: He worked two jobs to get me a pony... he started me playing the saxophone you all love...

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ...and anyone can put a band aid on, but my Dad knows how to take it off so it doesn't hurt.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The trick is, wait several weeks.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ...And when my Dad was a soccer referee, he had the guts to red card me, his only talking daughter, because he knew I was diving.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: In the history of soccer, he's the only parent to ever take sides against his own kid, and he was right. He made me a better person, because that's what heroes do.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: That's what heroes do.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm so glad I was forced to come.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: People, people... we have a tie!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Gary Chalmers
spoken_words: Yes, which means that nobody wins. The money goes back in the school general fund. But we will put both speeches online, behind a pay wall. Now, please fold up your chairs and stack them.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'CAUSE I'M A GRADE SCHOOL HERO / LISA NEVER LIES / I'M A GRADE SCHOOL HERO / AND HEROES NEVER DIE / JUST ONE GUITAR! SLUNG WAY DOWN LOW / YEAH ONE GUITAR! / WHERE DID MY LAWNMOWER GO?!

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, look who's back.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Dad.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, your speech was one of the nicest things anyone's ever done for me.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: When did you come up with the idea? You must've worked on it for days.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, dad, you don't want details. No one wants to see the sausage being made.

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There's sausage being made? Where?

title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee

spoken_words: You know, as long as we're opening this up and I'm glad you are, I wanna tell you guys that when you call me a gargoyle, a troll, or a homunculus, it kinda hurts my feelin's.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: What? You're kiddin'.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We never dreamed.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Who knew goblins had feelings?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ya see, that's what I'm talkin' about. Because--

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, fellas. There's a movement I have to join. I've learned there's something more important than drinking: eating.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Okay people, show's over. Nothing to eat here. Now move along... if you can. If not, we're gonna have to take you in.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: You're right. Take me in Lou.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Jeez, Lou, you seem to be enjoying this.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: That's some nice tase work, Lou.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Right here.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me, pardon me, coming through.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Comin' back, 'scuse me, pardon me...

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There we go. Comin' up... what can I do for you?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Thank you. Although, I think the worst thing that ever happened to my husband was joining your group.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you have to choose. And I think the choice is clear.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Guys, I'm comin' back in. Suck in your guts.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Whee! Whee!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Who's he giving a piggyback ride to?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We don't know.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, what's wrong?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How come Dad's not with you?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Are they settin' bail by the pound?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He chose to spend the night in a jail with strangers instead of with me.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, Lisa and I learned we could solve any problem through song. Lisa, let's go write something that'll change Dad's mind.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Do you really think that we can write a song that does that?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I just wanted to get out of the room. She was really bumming me out.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, geez, I thought writing another hit song would be easier.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it would've helped if you hadn't crumpled up all the paper before we wrote anything on it.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I was distinctly promised no math!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I want to say something extremely important the way a woman does: subtly through someone else. Kids?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Take it, Bart!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You take it!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I gave it to you!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I refuse to accept it!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Just start the song!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We couldn't write a song. We're one-hit wonders! But, is that such a crime? Look at J.D. Salinger.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Franny and Zooey.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Rubik's Cube!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Rubik's Snake!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Charles M. Schulz.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: You've got me there.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's her fault! She was suckin' all the gangsta out of everything!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well you're the only "gangsta" I know with a nine o'clock bedtime!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Nine-thirty, starting in summer! Mom said!

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, kids, stop arguing. Or keep arguing. I don't care. Homer, I'm sorry I tried to help you control your weight. I'm not sure of anything anymore. Sorry I ever open my mouth.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, it's not your fault that you can't win against a superior being like Albert.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Marge, I don't want you to ever stop caring about me.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: How can you follow a leader who won't even get up out of his chair?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I believe you're forgetting America's greatest wartime wheelchair-bound leader: Professor X of the X-Men.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's not that Professor X wouldn't get up, it's that he couldn't.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Oh, dear God. Stick a forklift in him, he's dead.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I've never written an eulogy before, but this time I did. Unfortunately, I left it at home.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, lady.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What Albert taught us is that all people have pride and no group should ever be insulted. He knew what was important was how you lived your life every day...till he was taken from us too soon at the age of...

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Twenty-three?! People, for God's sake, join a gym.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Comic Book Guy
spoken_words: Kumiko, would you still love me if I lost weight?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I'm sorry I was proud of myself.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: That's not really what I was--

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It will never happen again. Now come on, let's walk home.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Absolutely.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Can I ask you something? What is it that keeps you with me?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's because everything you love, you love so much.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And because you love me, I will not stop yo-yo dieting till I get it right.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: At last.

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Bart's very mature. Take it from the little boy in his tummy. Now when do I get to be the head again?

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: It's always "soon."

title: Walking Big & Tall
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: You finally reached emotional maturity. Unlike Bart.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! Stop that crazy thing!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I've printed out our driving plan! If we work together, we can get Bart to his sports...Lisa to her music...and Maggie to the five birthday parties she's invited to today.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm not spending my precious Saturday chauffeuring those over-privileged kids to a better life than I ever had.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie! Are you dressed? You have soccer setup in twenty minutes! Homie?!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, quick! Beer me before I answer the phone!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ah, the first pour of the day. Let me just tie on my apron, limber up the ol' tap-pullin' arm...

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I need it now!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Marge. I'm supposed to help drive the kids? Oh, man, I wish I knew that sooner, but I just had a beer.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're already drinking at eight o'clock in the morning? How much have you had?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo hoo! Off the hook!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Looks like this is all me.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, while you're at it can you pick me up some beer?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Chief Wiggum
spoken_words: Okay, but I'm buyin'.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: See ya at the bake sale, sucker!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: ...So Sideshow Mel is drinkin' here all afternoon. When I show him the tab, he says he left his wallet in his other skirt, and he pays me with this!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, this is a ticket to see Laney Fontaine -- she's the brassiest broad on Broadway!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: She's funny and vulgar and fulla Hollywood stories, like, uh... Jimmy Stewart was a super-nice guy.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Geez, now I wanna go!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Why can'tcha?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I can't close down the bar on a Saturday. That's when you guys can drink 'cause you're not workin' for three days.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Moe... I'll take care of the bar. You did me a favor today.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Huh... well, okay. Uh, let me just show you where everything is... shotgun, shotgun shells, blood mop, bag of lime -- and that's it. Now boys, I gotta get dressed for the, uh, "theatah"!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: And done.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Dare I say it? Yippee!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, I didn't know we could decorate our cars.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: So you're a taxi?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I drive all day and I don't get paid a thing. With the money you make, I could buy a fridge with... an icemaker.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Sure!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: What the? When I was a young car I didn't sit around smilin' like I had nothin' better to do!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Man, Moe's barely got two nickels to rub together.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: I know a way we can make this Moe's biggest Saturday night ever.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: How does Moe make money if ladies drink free?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: That's the beauty part. This place is about to be filled with guys, buyin' beers, hoping to meet ladies. Huh.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Brilliant! Ooh, and thanks for telling me what the beauty part of it was.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: She changed the lyrics... for me!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Not a man in sight. We got the...Cheery Red Tomatoes...a bachelorette party...

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Ooh! Lady Duff!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There's no guys! We haven't made any money.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Not yet, but at least we're hearing some interesting conversation from those two book clubs.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Let me help you up.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Okay, stop here, please.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yep. Nice and cozy and... Whaaaa?!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: My craphole! My precious craphole!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: This is nuts!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Tell me you still work, Love Tester!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I'm ruined!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You guys cost me my chance with a woman of a certain age!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Hey, come on, all is not lost. This coaster's fine.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You are not my friends. To me you're just mouths drinkin' beers!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: You can't mean that!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We don't look at you that way.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I-I'm sorry for snappin' at you guys. But, but I'm ruint. I-I'll have to live on my savings here.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, who rubbed my nickels?!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Hey, wait a minute! We can get you a job! There's an opening at the nuclear plant 'cause of that guy that defected to North Korea.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good ol' Dae Ho. Used to give me the pickles off his sandwich. And all I had to do was let him copy some keys.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Moe, can you pass a background check?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Ummmmmmmmm... ehhhhhhhh... errrrrrr... ehhhhhhhhh... ehhhhhh sure.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Well, then you're in!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, how far do they go back?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Six months.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Kay, I'm gonna apply in a week.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh, Mom. Someone wants you to give them a ride.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: At last! I'll earn money for schlepping!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Wow, your mom has a job and my Dad still doesn't?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You're welcome. And if you really want to get your belly button pierced, go see a professional.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Welcome to Springfield Nuclear, Szyslak. We'll start you off in janitorial, but there is room for advancement.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: How come on your badge you got a mustache, but now you're not wearin' one, eh?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, I sure appreciate this, fellas. What you guys did to me, then for me, I'll never forget slash forgive. So, thanks a lot. Also thanks a lot.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: What's for dinner, mom?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm... I'm sorry, but I'm not your mother.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Hey, I'm the one paying.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Fine. There's meatloaf...

title: My Fare Lady
name: Nelson Muntz
spoken_words: Ooh! What's meatloaf?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Left, left, left, leffft, left, left...left, left, uhhh... left...

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Why are you telling me all these things?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Faster!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: ...stop sign...

title: My Fare Lady
name: Krusty the Clown
spoken_words: ...girl with big...

title: My Fare Lady
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hey, swabby. You've missed spots there... and another one there... and there... Every other spot is begrimed!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: It's called a checkerboard floor, ya unwrapped mummy.

title: My Fare Lady
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You're f...

title: My Fare Lady
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Sir, the N.R.C. is here for a surprise inspection!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's where all the problems are!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I'll handle this. So, you're the head inspector?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, well, I'm thrilled for your musical career and everything, but, uh, we got no way of knowing that this is you.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I mean, we gotta be careful here. This is one them, uh, highly-sensitive joints.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, well, that's your problem, ain't it?

title: My Fare Lady
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Young man, how do you fit such brilliance into such an ugly ethnic head?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, if you own a bar, you either keep it clean or learn to deal with inspectors. And Moe don't clean.

title: My Fare Lady
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Interesting attitude for a janitor. What say we make you the new supervisor of Sector 7-G?!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Me, a supervisor?! I feel like I overdosed and went to Heaven.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Whoa, fellas, that is not acceptable. This is a nuclear plant.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Huh... no one was in there.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look Moe, the least you could let me do is anything I want.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: All right, let me be honest with yous. After all the money this plant lost on that nitwit Elon Musk, they're lookin' for cutbacks. So I've been goin' over your record.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, the only reason you haven't been fired is because your file here was holdin' up a sofa that was missin' a leg.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, that's the logic. Where's the affection?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well as supervisor, I can't fraternize with the... uh... what's the word... scum. Anyway, because I am your friend, you are safe. But you're gonna be reassigned.

title: My Fare Lady
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, what profit a man if he gain the world and lose his soul. Seriously. I need an amount. In round dollars.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Plant-watering guy.

title: My Fare Lady
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes, yes, go ahead. And be careful with the Venus flytrap!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right.

title: My Fare Lady
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: They say you catch more flies with honey. I say with flytraps!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do I do now?

title: My Fare Lady
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Just lean into it. It'll be over soon, one way or another.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, all right.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey guys, you mind if I join you? They ran out of Beaujolais Cru in the executive dining room and I ain't drinkin' white with my coq au freakin' vin!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: I think I'd rather sit somewhere else.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Carl Carlson
spoken_words: Yeah. I'm gonna take my lunch back to the core.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Now they won't even have lunch with me.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, you know people can kinda act like they're in grade school.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, now you gotta throw your grade school education in my face?!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, Moe, you're a real jerk. I didn't mind so much when it came with beer.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I don't need youse. I'm all the company I need.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I just lost my appetite.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, which can makes me look cooler? The Drizzler or Mr. Drip?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, your leaves are drooping. Here, let me turn that gloom into bloom.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer Simpson. Working with those plants is great! It's helped you get in touch with your feminine side.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Feminine?!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't mean to use that word! It's okay to have a feminine side. It's good in fact!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Mind if we drive in silence for a bit?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Whatever you want.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Moe, I think we'd both be a lot happier if we quit our new jobs.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: You know, I think you're right there, Midge. I'm gonna build my bar back up better than ever. How hard can it be, eh?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh God! This is so much worse than I remember.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He's not my lover!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Let the man speak!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Step away from the social media-enabled, peer-to-peer ride share platform!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Now, promise me you'll leave her be, and wipe down your back seats annually...

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Now beat it!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Uh, I think it might be time to hang up the ol' beaded seat cover there.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yup. And I know a place that could use this smile.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: It's sure great to see you jerking our suds again, Moe.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Yeah, I figured out that the best way for me to get along with most people is to be kept behind a two foot chunk of solid oak.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Lenny Leonard
spoken_words: Looks more like poplar to me.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Why youse! Correcting me on my knowledge of wood products!

title: My Fare Lady
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So good to be back.

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Well, I'm back where I belong, eh?

title: My Fare Lady
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What the Hell was that?!

title: The Princess Guide
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: How come there's never a "Take Your Son To Work Day?"

title: The Princess Guide
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Cause boys are already on track to get all the good jobs. The Dirty Dozen? All guys. Twelve Angry Men? Men! The X-Men? Mostly men.

title: The Princess Guide
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Good one, Dad.

title: The Princess Guide
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, despite all that, today's gonna be fun, Dad! Will there be lots of other girls there?

title: The Princess Guide
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: ...after we show you the wealth of jobs in the steno pool, a hearty luncheon of bison with lake beaver will be served...

title: The Princess Guide
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: ...and upon leaving you will each receive a piece of orangewood to bite down on during childbirth. Excellent.

title: The Princess Guide
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: It's getting harder and harder to maintain my sunny disposition, Smithers.

title: The Princess Guide
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You're always my ray of...

title: The Princess Guide
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Shut up.

title: The Princess Guide
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Is it called the cooling tower because there's--

title: The Princess Guide
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not my department.
