spoken_words: Don't worry, Homer. We'll just have to stretch your Christmas bonus even further this year.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah my Christmas bonus. How silly of me. This'll be the best Christmas yet. The best any family ever had. Heh-heh.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I get the feeling there's something you haven't told me, Homer.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. I love you, Marge.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you tell me that all the time.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, good. Because I do love you and I don't deserve you as much as a guy with a fat wallet and a credit card that won't set off that horrible beeping.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But I think it does have something to do with your Christmas bonus. I keep asking for it, but...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, well, let me be honest with you.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... I want to do the Christmas shopping this year.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, sure, okay...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, Marge, Marge. Let's see. Oooh, look! Pantyhose. Practical and alluring. A six-pack... Oh! Only four ninety nine.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh... pads of paper. I bet Bart can think of a million things to do with these. That just leaves little Maggie. Oh, look, a little squeak-toy. . It says it's for dogs, but she can't read...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ow. Oh, Simpson, it's you.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, Flanders.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, my, what a little mess we've got here! Well, which ones are yours and which ones are mine?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, let's see.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: This one's mine. And this one's mine. This one's mine... and this--

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: They're all yours.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Gimme that!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, happy holidays, Simpson.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You bet.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Dad, you're finally home.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Daddy! We're so glad to see you!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What's the matter, Homer? Somebody leave a lumpa coal in your stocking? You've been sitting there sucking on a beer all day long.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: So it's Christmas!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Moe.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's with the crazy getup, Barn?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow. Can I do that?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What do you mean? All the time? Even when they're nuts?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I certainly do.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Huh, when do we get paid?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dasher, Dancer...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Prancer...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nixon, Comet, Cupid... Donna Dixon.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And what would you like, little boy?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Why you little eggheaded...!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, I knew that one, too.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer! Why are you seven hours late?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Not a word, Marge. I'm heading straight for the tub.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: But Homer, my sisters are here. Don't you want to say hello?

title: Bart Gets an "F"
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You both look well.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, well, Merry Christmas.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And why is that?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I was just on my way out to get one.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Can we go too, Dad?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Can we?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So, what do you think kids? Beauty, isn't it?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Homer.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Way to go, Dad.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's an ornament.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, son, you don't need all that junk. I'm sure you've already got something much more important, a decent home and a loving father who would do anything for you. Hey, I couldn't afford lunch. Gimme a bite of that donut.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Get a load of that quote unquote Santa.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Milhouse. I dare you to sit on his lap.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Oh, yeah? Well, I dare you to yank his beard off.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, touché!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I will when Mrs. Claus's sisters get out of town. Thanks for listening, kid.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey Santa, what's shaking?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's your name, Bart... ner? -- Er -- Little partner?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm Bart Simpson. Who the hell are you?

title: Bart the General
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Here?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm Jolly Old Saint Nick.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah? We'll just see about that.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I want a word with you in Santa's Workshop, little boy. Cover for me, Elfie.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't kill me, Dad. I didn't know it was you.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nobody knows. It's a secret. I didn't get my bonus this year, but to keep the family from missing out on Christmas, I'd do anything.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll say, Dad. You must really love us to sink so low.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now let's not get mushy, son. I still have a job to do.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, little ones, Santa's back. Ho! Ho!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Arrgh! -- Damn it to...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, son. One day you're gonna know the satisfaction of payday. Receiving a big fat check for a job well done.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, son. Let's go cash this baby and get presents for -- Thirteen bucks? Hey, wait a minute!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Santa?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But... but...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Dad. Let's go home.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thirteen bucks. We can't get anything for thirteen bucks.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, did you hear that? What a name -- "Santa's Little Helper". It's a sign! It's an omen!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, Barney. I may be a total washout as a father, but I'm not gonna take my kid to some sleazy dog track on Christmas eve.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-uh.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, come on Dad, this can be the miracle that saves the Simpsons' Christmas. If TV has taught me anything, it's that miracles always happen to poor kids at Christmas. It happened to Tiny Tim, it happened to Charlie Brown, it happened to the Smurfs, and it's gonna happen to us.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, okay. Let's go.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who's Tiny Tim?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, brother!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He said he went caroling with Bart.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe I'm doing this.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Barney, which one is Whirlwind?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What! That scrawny little bag of bones?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Dad. They're all scrawny little bags of bones.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, you're right. I guess Whirlwind is our only hope for a Merry Christmas.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Attention racing fans. We have a late scratch in the fourth race. Number eight, Sir Galahad, will be replaced by Santa's Little Helper. Once again, Sir Galahad has been replaced by Santa's Little Helper.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's a coincidence, Dad.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What are the odds on Santa's Little Helper?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa! Ninety-nine times thirteen equals MER-RY CHRISTMAS!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I got a bad feeling about this.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't you believe in me, son?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, boy. Sometimes your faith is all that keeps me going.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, go for it, Dad.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's my boy. Everything on Santa's Little Helper.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yay!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Grampa Simpson
spoken_words: Unadulterated pap.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What, Aunt Patty?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well I wish you wouldn't because aside from the fact that he has the same frailties as all human beings, he's the only father I have. Therefore he is my model of manhood and my estimation of him will govern the prospects of my adult relationships. So I hope you bear in mind that any knock at him is a knock at me. And I am far to young to defend myself against such onslaughts.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Bart. Kiss the ticket for good luck, not that we need it. Heh-heh-heh.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Here comes Screwy the Mechanical Rabbit. And they're off!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Around the first turn.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, "Santa's Little Helper!"

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, dog! Go, man! Go! Come on Santa's Little Helper! Run baby run!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on Santa's Little Helper! Go, go, go! Run your tail off!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Announcer
spoken_words: It's "Whirlwind" in the lead...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Announcer
spoken_words: And coming up on the left is "Quadruped", followed by Dog O' War and "Fido".

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Go! Go!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Go Santa's Little Helper!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, boy.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, get that rabbit.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Announcer
spoken_words: ...Dog of war coming up fast on the outside... And with a lock on last place it's... "Santa's Little Helper."

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Don't worry, Dad. Maybe this is just for suspense before the miracle happens.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Around the clubhouse turn, Whirlwind is staking out a big lead, a couple of lengths. Quadruped fighting it out and coming up fast, Chew My Shoe.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Announcer
spoken_words: And it's "Whirlwind" by a country mile, and in second, "Chew My Shoe" followed by "Dog O' War".

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It doesn't seem possible, but I guess TV has betrayed me.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I don't want to leave till our dog finishes.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, forget it. Let's go.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Find any winners, son?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, Dad.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Look, Dad. It's Santa's Little Helper.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no you don't. No. No. Get away from me. Uh-uh.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, can we keep him Dad, please?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But he's a loser. He's pathetic. He's...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: -- a Simpson.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe I should call the police.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Bart the Genius
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll pay! How much?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, look everybody. I have a confession to make.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I didn't get my Christmas bonus. I tried not to let it ruin Christmas for everybody, but no matter what I did, I just couldn't --

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, everybody. Look what we got!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: A dog! All right, Dad!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Good bless him.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: So love at first sight is possible.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: And if he runs away, he'll be easy to catch.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: This is the best gift of all, Homer.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It is?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, something to share our love --

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: -- And frighten prowlers.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: What's his name?

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Number eight. I mean, Santa's Little Helper.

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: RUDOLPH THE RED NOSED REINDEER / HAD A VERY SHINY NOSE / AND IF YOU EVER SAW IT / YOU WOULD EVEN SAY IT GLOWED

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Like a light bulb!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: ALL OF THE OTHER REINDEER / USED TO LAUGH AND CALL HIM NAMES...

name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Like Shine-ola!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: THEY NEVER LET POOR RUDOLPH / JOIN IN ANY REINDEER GAMES...

spoken_words: Like strip poker!

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm warning you two!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: THEN ONE FOGGY CHRISTMAS EVE / SANTA CAME TO SAY...

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Take it, Homer!

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: RUDOLPH WITH YOUR NOSE... OVER HERE... / SO YOU CAN GUIDE MY SLEIGH TODAY....

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, Homer.

title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: THEN ALL THE REINDEER LOVED HIM / AS THEY SHOUTED OUT WITH GLEE / RUDOLPH THE RED NOSED REINDEER / YOU'LL GO DOWN IN HISTORY...

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Like Attila the Hun!

spoken_words: Come on, Mom.

title: Bart the Genius
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, Mom, hurry up.

name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All right... hmmm... How about "he"?

title: Bart the Genius

spoken_words: Nurturing.

spoken_words: Hmmmm. How could anyone make a word out of these lousy letters?

spoken_words: Oh, wait! Here's a good one -- "do".

spoken_words: "Id." Triple word score.

title: Bart the Genius

spoken_words: Hey! No abbreviations!

title: Bart the Genius

spoken_words: Not I.D., Dad. Id. It's a word.

title: Bart the Genius

spoken_words: As in, "this game is stup-id."

title: Bart the Genius
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, shut up, boy.

title: Bart the Genius

spoken_words: Yeah, Bart. You're supposed to be developing verbal abilities for your big aptitude test tomorrow.

title: Bart the Genius
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: We could look this "id" thing up in the dictionary.

spoken_words: We got one?

spoken_words: I think it's under the short leg of the couch.

spoken_words: "Id. Along with the ego and the superego, one of three components of the psyche."

spoken_words: Get outta here.

name: Bart Simpson

name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute, you little cheater. You're not going anywhere until you tell me what a kwyjibo is.

name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Kwyjibo: Uh, a big, dumb, balding...

title: Bart the Genius

spoken_words: You're right, Martin. Bart?

spoken_words: Remember to visualize the complex problems. And relax. The test will start... NOW!

title: Bart the Genius
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: At seven-thirty a.m. an express train traveling sixty miles an hour leaves Santa Fe bound for Phoenix, five hundred and twenty miles away.

title: Bart the Genius
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Shhhhh! Visualize it, Bart!

title: Bart the Genius
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: At the same time a local train traveling thirty miles an hour and carrying forty passengers leaves Phoenix bound for Santa Fe.

title: Bart the Genius
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: It's eight cars long and always carries the same number of passengers in each car.

title: Bart the Genius
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: An hour later, a number of passengers equal to half the number of minutes past the hour get off, but three times as many plus six get on.

title: Bart the Genius
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oof!

spoken_words: At the second stop, half the passengers plus two get off, but twice as many get on as got on at the first stop.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

spoken_words: Like getting Washington's birthday and Lincoln's birthday back as separate paid holidays. President's Day! Pfft. What a rip-off! I bust my butt day in and day out --

name: Homer Simpson

raw_location_text: SECURITY CLEARANCE BOOTH AT POWER PLANT
spoken_words: Hold me, Smithers.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
raw_location_text: SECURITY CLEARANCE BOOTH AT POWER PLANT
spoken_words: I suppose that's normal background radiation? The kind you would find in any well-maintained nuclear facility? Or, for that matter, playgrounds and hospitals.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, look! Some careless person has left thousands and thousands of dollars just lying here on my coffee table. Uh, Smithers, why don't we leave the room and hopefully, when we return the pile of money will be gone.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Look Smithers, the money and a very stupid man are still here.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Is there some confusion about this?

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

spoken_words: Ooooh, cushy.

name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Homer, they're trying to shut us down.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, nobody's perfect.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish

spoken_words: Uh oh.

spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Goodness! I didn't realize this casual dinner was going to turn into a charged political debate.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I was only reading what the card...

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Homer, I agree with you and, if I'm elected governor , I will lower taxes whether those bureaucrats in the State capital like it or not.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Lisa, do you have a question you would like to ask your Uncle Montgomery?

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yes, sir. A very inane one. Mr. Burns, your campaign seems to have the momentum of a runaway freight train. Why are you so popular?

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oooh, a tough question, but a fair one. Lisa, there's no single answer. Some voters respond to my integrity. Others are more impressed with my incorruptibility... still others by my determination to lower taxes, and the bureaucrats in the state capital can put that in their pipes and smoke it.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oh Mom, that felt awful.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I'm sorry, dear. It will all be over soon.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But Mom, we've become the tools of evil.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, you're learning many lessons tonight and one of them is to always give your mother the benefit of the doubt.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: ...some can't even get a fair shake, or even a square deal... Ummmm, smells delightful.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All right! Three eyed fish!

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Can I have your plate, Mr. Burns?

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: You must have a few tricks left up your sleeves. Smithers, boil some coffee. We're not licked yet.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Wait! Come back! You can't do this to me! I'm Charles Montgomery Burns!

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Smithers, tip over this table for me!

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Yes sir.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer... Homer... make them stop.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh, Mr. Burns... Uh, Mr. Burns...

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Shut up and wreck something.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns, I hardly see what destroying our meager possessions is going to accomplish.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: She's right. Take me home, Smithers. We'll destroy something tasteful.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ironic, isn't it Smithers? This anonymous clan of slack-jawed troglodytes has cost me the election, and yet if I were to have them killed, I would be the one to go to jail. That's democracy for you.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: You are noble and poetic in defeat, sir.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Simpson, I shall make it the focus of my remaining years that your dreams will go unfulfilled.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh oh. You're busted, Dad.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh. My dreams will go unfulfilled! Oh no. I don't like the sound of that one bit. That means I have nothing to hope for. Marge, make it better. Please. Can't you make it better, huh?

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, when a man's biggest dreams include seconds on dessert, occasional snuggling, and sleeping till noon on weekends, no one man can destroy them.

title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you did it!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Aw, Barney.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Come on, Homer. We're dyin' of curiosity.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, there's only one thing worse than being a loser. It's being one of those guys who sits in a bar telling the story of how he became a loser. And I never want that to happen to me.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: C'mom, Homer.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, okay. It all started on "Nuclear Plant Employees, Spouses, and No More Than Three Children Night," down at Springfield stadium.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You know, boy, some of the players you see tonight may make it to the big leagues, one day.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What? Aren't we gonna see any washed-up major leaguers?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sure, we get a nice mix here.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't think of a better place to spend a balmy summer's night than the old ball yard. There's just the green grass of the outfield, the crushed brick of the infield, and the white chalk lines that divide the man from the little boy.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, honey, you're forgetting the beer. It comes in seventy-two ounce tubs here.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I hope you'll space out the tubs this year, Homer.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What are you getting at?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, last year you got a little rambunctious and mooned the poor umpire.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, this ticket doesn't just give me a seat, it also gives me the right - no, the duty, to make a complete ass of myself.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, the Gammills. Good to see you.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, take your mind off contaminates for one night and have a hot dog.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Put a little smile on his card, Smithers.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Already there, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: The Simpsons, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, well, if it isn't the Simps.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Uh... Simp-sons, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Huh? Hmmm, oh, oh yes... Homer and Marge Simpson. Oh, and these must be Bart, Lisa and uh, "Expecting".

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: The card needs to be updated, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, that's okay. The baby's name isn't important. Let's go, Marge.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, wow -- there's Flash Bailor! I gotta get his autograph! He used to be a star!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Flash! Will ya sign my ball?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lousy, washed-up, broken-down... old tub of guts... who does he think he is anyway...

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's the matter, boy?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: He wouldn't sign my ball.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he's a fine role model. Bart, give me that ball!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here you go, Bart.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: "Hmmm, Springfield Kozy Kort Motel, Room 26... How 'bout it? -- Flash."

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! Flash Bailor came on to my wife! You've still got the magic, Marge.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Dad, look, you're on JumboVision!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Whoa!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey everybody! How you doin'? Look at me! I'm Homer Simpson! Heh...heh.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer... Homer... X.Y.Z.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Examine my zipper? Why? Whoops!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, everybody.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Ah, they love you, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Heh, heh. As well they might. You know, Smithers, when I was a young buck, my patented fadeaway pitch was compared by many to the "trouble ball" of the late great Satchel Paige. Spit on this for me, Smithers.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: One hocker coming up, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What a lame-o!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: I could actually hear the air being torn, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, shut up.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Burns! Hey, "Rag Arm"!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You throw like my sister, man!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, you throw like me.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Ah, sitting with the employees. I guess this proves I'm their friend. You did get me something on an aisle, Smithers? I don't want to be surrounded by them.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Let's go now... Sa-winggg, batter!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We want a pitcher / Not a belly itcher!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We want a catcher / Not a belly scratcher!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Here we are, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no. Marge, sitting next to the boss -- the best night of the year, and it's ruined! Of all the lousy, rotten... this stinks...

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: All this means is you can't wave your fanny in public.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Rub it in.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Delicious frosty beer. Fat lot of good that does me, sitting next to old man Burns.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now, Homer.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: I suppose you want a beer?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Me, sir? Oh, no. Not a chance. Only idiots drink beer.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Actually, I was wondering if you'd join me. My treat.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh. Well, if someone of your stature can enjoy a beer, maybe I'm all turned around on the subject. Wait a minute, we're not having a drug test tomorrow, are we?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: No. Vendor, two, please.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: THE HITTER'S OFF HIS ROCKER / KISSING BETTY CROCKER!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good one, sir.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh well, I used to rile the late, great Connie Mack with that one at old Shibe Park.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: LITTLE BABY BATTER / CAN'T CONTROL HIS BLADDER!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Will you shut up, I'm trying to think of a name.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Hmmm. Crude, but I like it. What do you say we freshen up our little drinkie poos?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't mind if I do.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Well, Simpsie, you up for another wave?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, Burnsie.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Damnation! These banjos couldn't carry Pie Traynor's glove.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon! All we need is a grand slam.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: My one game of the year... ruined by pathetic incompetence.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What's wrong with you people? Let's show some spirit! Come on, get up!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your team needs you! C'mon!!!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: As I got up in front of them, I felt an intoxication that had nothing to do with alcohol. It was the intoxication of being a public spectacle.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Waylon Smithers
spoken_words: Well, that was certainly exciting.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Yes. Unfortunately, Homer Simpson's shameless display of exhibitionism tainted the entire evening. I want him banned for life from all company outings.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I thank you. You're too kind. Glad you enjoyed it, but I can't take all the credit. The batter did his part, too.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: M-- me? A mascot for a bush league team?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I should have slept on it. Or at least stared blankly for a while. Perhaps if I'd been unable to think of a nickname, all our lives might have been spared.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm ready to punch in.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, oh. Hey, cool, man.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Our lives have taken an odd turn.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Did the team ask you to dress like that, Homer?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Nope, this was my own bright idea. C'mon, we gotta hurry. Don't fill up on those vegetables, kids. Save room for your nachos.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: For the first time in my life, people weren't laughing at me, they were laughing towards me.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: A Simpson on a T-shirt. I never thought I'd see the day.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, boogie, boogie, boogie, boogie, boogie. Woo, boogie, boogie, boogie, boogie, boogie, boogie.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah? And where might that be? Oh.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Helen, I'm in a Caribbean mood tonight. How 'bout giving me "Baby Elephant Walk" with a little reggae kinda beat?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You wanted to see me, "Tex"?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, oh, oh, I get it. You can't fire the players, so you fire the mascot. You make me sick.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Me? In the majors?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait a minute, Capital City has a mascot. The greatest mascot there is: The Capital City "Goofball".

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll say!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Because they might say no.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This was the biggest decision the Simpsons ever faced. I should've listened to the kids instead of my big dumb wife.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I shouldn't have called her that. Bite my tongue. Bite my tongue. Oooh.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't leave Springfield. I was born here and I thought I would die here.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It won't be so bad. You'll die someplace else.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, what am I supposed to do about friends?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Phfft. You'll make new and better friends.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But, Dad. We're simple people with simple values. Capital City is too big and too complex. Everyone in Springfield knows us and has forgiven us.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I'd be lying if I didn't say that this scares me a little. But we all have a calling, a reason The Almighty put us on this Earth. And yours might be to dance on dugouts.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You mean -- ?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Let's do it, Homer!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, let's blow this pop stand and never look back.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Whatever doesn't kill me can only make me stronger.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's not that simple. I've got to convince my supervisor to give me a leave of absence.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right, Ned.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, knock it off, Flanders! Don't start blubbering on me. I'm gonna miss you too... not.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I don't know, Bart. I mean, I'm gonna miss you and all, but...

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Milhouse. This way we'll be friends forever.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Well, okay.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Ewww!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'm gonna miss you, spit brother.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: I'm gonna miss you, spit brother.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I can't help but feel that if we had gotten to know each other better, my leaving would actually have meant something.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we have one quick stop and then it's on to Capital City.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: ... Some may say that I have been given a bad break in life -- little education, bald as a cue ball, ten years on the same job for the same salary -- but today, as I leave for Capital City, I consider myself the luckiest mascot on the face of the Earth!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: With the fickle fans already forgetting me, I was ready to take the biggest step of my life.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well kids, there it is, Capital City.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look! The Crosstown Bridge!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The Pennyloafer!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Kids, look! Street crime!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! That's service!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Look, it's Tony Bennett!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Fourth Street and D!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The Duff Brewery!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Capital City -- yeah!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Awww. Come to bed, Homie.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, honey. I'm just a little nervous.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: We would talk about it always. For the first time in our lives, Marge fell asleep before I did.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, here are your tickets. They're supposed to be good. You're sitting with the player's wives. And don't forget to cheer for me.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: See you after the game, when you're a big star.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart was strangely quiet. Later he explained he was confused by feelings of respect for me. That wouldn't last.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Omigod! I don't believe it. It's really you, the Capital City "Goofball."

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wow, the fifth.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Right, Mr. Goofball.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I get up, I dance, I spell out the name of the city... all to the tune of Baby Elephant Walk.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see. Upper, upper, upper mezzanine. Hmmm. Yes, these must be ours.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: These seats stink!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You'd think the player's wives would be a little closer to the action.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who'd've thought it? A free ticket to a big league park but I was too tense to enjoy the game. Every ounce of concentration I possessed was focused on the task at hand.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, red hots.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Announcer
spoken_words: Ladies and gentlemen. Capital City's newest sensation, Dancin' Homer!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mmm, these do taste better at the ballpark. Uh oh.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: There he is!

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I was graceful. I was witty. Brother, I was somethin'.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But they didn't care.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's with these people? Why are they sitting on their hands?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, what's he doing wrong?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I don't know.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It was so quiet you could hear each individual smart-ass remark.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The only applause I got was for dragging my carcass out of there.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I guess it's back to good old Springfield.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Would you like some fruit juice?

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But I can't go back! Not after I've seen the bright lights of Capital City. I'll wither and die like a hothouse flower.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now stop it you two. And don't look too down. I'm sure this is hard enough for your father.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What a family.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: My wife and kids stood by me. On the way home I realized how little that helped.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: So that's it. The costume's buried now. As my son would say, I'm one sad ape-like dude.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: What a saga.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, you guys are hanging on my every word. I've become the center of attention.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Tell it again, Homer.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay. I wonder why stories of degradation and humiliation make you more popular.

title: Dancin' Homer
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: I don't know. They just do.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bust my hump all week... stupid grass... supposed to be the boy's job.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now, now, Homer. Bart's busy working on his science project.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You heard the lady, Homer. So please mow quietly. Genius at work.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words:

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: H'lo, Flanders.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Doing a little yard work, huh?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Who told? Marge! Beer me!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Say Simpson, I-I've got some time-release granules that'll get rid of that crabgrass in just a half-a-jif.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Crabgrass? What are you talking about? Where?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, ooh, there... there... and uh there's a big patch over there.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: There's nothing wrong with crabgrass! It just has a bad name, that's all. Everyone would love it if it had a cute name like... uh... elfgrass.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, you may be right!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge! Where's the Duff?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Don't toy with me, woman.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Couldn't help overhearing, Simpson. I've got some ice-cold suds in the rumpus room, if you'd like to join me.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, uh, okay. What the heck, I've earned a little break.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Holy moly! It's... it's... beautiful!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Say, that's right. This is your first visit to the Flanders homestead.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, we've only been neighbors, what? uh, one, two, three, four... eight years.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: There's my little Popcorn Ball. Kissy, kissy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ain't she wonderful, Simpson?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, yeah, yeah, but aren't we forgetting something, Flanders?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, your beer. Uh, is draft okay? Just put in the tap last week.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Heh, heh. This is a tasty little lager that came all the way from Holland.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well, beggars can't be choosy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: My pleasure, Study Buddy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, you know how that embarrasses me.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ah, kids can be a trial sometimes.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, knock it off!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Uh, knock what off, Simpson?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You've been rubbing my nose in it since I got here. Your family is better than my family. Your beer comes from farther away than my beer. You and your son like each other. Your wife's butt is higher than my wife's butt. You make me sick!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Simpson, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you to leave. I hope you understand.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I wouldn't stay on a bet!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: One for the road.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homie, quit tossing.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Play it where it lays, Homer.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry, Marge. But it's just that I'm still steamed up about that jerk Flanders. Lousy... bragging... know-it-all... show-off...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: What exactly did he say?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Get this. He said... he said... well, it wasn't so much what he said, it was how he said it!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, how did he say it?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Well... he...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Was he angry?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Was he rude?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay. It wasn't how he said it either, but the message was loud and clear... our family stinks!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I'm your best friend, but I've gotta say, I've never seen him be anything but a perfect neighbor.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, he's perfect now, is he?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, he's not perfect, but he is very...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, no, Marge. Don't backpedal. You were right the first time. He's perfect. Perfect in every way.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm just gonna go take a walk around the block to calm down. I got a little excited. I'm not perfect... like Ned Flanders.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I feel terrible.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Sometimes I forget that we have things a little better than the Simpsons. I drag him over here. He has a few beers. You can't blame him for erupting.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: And then I turn into a snarling beast. Talk about flunking the old turn-the-other-cheek test!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hello, Reverend Lovejoy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Ugh, probably stepped on a worm. Hello, Ned.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hey, there's Homer Simpson! Oh, what a perfect opportunity to follow up on my letter.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Reverend, I'm sorry to bother you at this hour but I threw a man out of my house today. I feel like I've violated Matthew 19:19.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Love thy neighbor.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Oh. Oh. Matthew, 19:19, yeah, right, right. Well, you know, Ned. The Good Book says a gentle answer turneth away wrath.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: A gentle answer. Well, that is a jim-dandy idea. Bless you, Reverend.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Dear Neighbor...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: I don't blame you for being upset with me, Homer. I just wanted to give you this letter. I'll leave now.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Dear neighbor...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: You are my brother. I love you and yet I feel a great sadness in my bosom.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wait! Wait! There's more...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I think it's terrible. A man opens his heart and you make fun of him.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: "Neighbors forever. Oh, no! Ned Flanders."

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What a sap!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Read the bosom part again, Dad.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now, just a minute.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Bosom!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Bart!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Huh?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I wish this family was as close as the Flanders.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, okay, all right, all right. She's right! Let's do something together. What does everyone say to some miniature golf, followed by a round of frosty chocolate milkshakes?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: All right!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Hmmm. I was going to wash my hair.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And I'm studying for the Math Fair. If I win, I'll bring home a brand new protractor.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Too bad we don't live on a farm. Let's go, boy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Fore!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Heh, heh, heh heh...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But I got it in the middle!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That was just a practice shot, boy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Give up, Homeboy. There's a six-stroke limit.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I know, I know. I can still make this for five. Come on, baby, pleeze pleeze go in. Pleeze.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hi, Simpson! Having fun?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders! What are you doing here?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Ah, just playing a little mini-golf with the Todd-meister.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Get bent.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Say, now that we're all friends again, why don't we make a foursome?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: All right! This will be fun! Oh, say, you looked like you were having a little trouble there.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That shot is impossible! Jack Nicholson himself couldn't make it.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Good shot, Toddsky!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Luck.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Final score: Bart, forty-one. Homer... let's see, six plus six plus six plus six plus six plus six...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Never mind!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Wow! Free balloons for everyone who enters!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: So, my little Bartley, thinking of entering the tournament?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, he's entering and what's more, he's going to win, aren't you, boy?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I guess it's possible.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hey, I like that confidence!... but I hope you're not putting too much pressure on the boy. My Todd's awfully good.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah! Well I think the fruit of my loins can beat the fruit of your loins any day of the week.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, boy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: But Dad, I've never won anything in my life.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Son, this is the only time I'm ever gonna say this. It is not okay to lose.

title: Bart vs. Thanksgiving
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: You brought food...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Stay, stay. Good dog. Now, keep your head down.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No, not you. I'm talking to the boy. Keep your head down. Follow through...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, that didn't work. This time move your head and don't follow through.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, man.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What're you doing? That putter is to you what a bat is to a baseball player, what a violin is to the guy tha...the violin guy. Now, c'mon, give your putter a name.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, give it a name.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Putter.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Do you wanna try a little harder, son? Come on, give it a girl's name.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Your putter's name is Charlene!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Why?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It just is. That's why.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, this is a picture of your enemy, Todd Flanders. Every day I want you to spend fifteen minutes staring at it and concentrating on how much you hate him and how glorious it will be when you and Charlene annihilate him.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who's Charlene?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll show you who Charlene is! Now start hating!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, I couldn't help overhearing you warp Bart's mind.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: And?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm worried that you're making too big a deal of this silly little kiddie golf tournament.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But, Marge, this is our big chance to show up the Flanderses.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, I'm sure it is, but why do we want to do that?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Because sometimes the only way you can feel good about yourself is by making someone else look bad. And I'm tired of making other people feel good about themselves.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Bart. What're you doing?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lis, what do you call those guys in chess that don't matter?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Absolutely. Eeeeeeeer!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, a blockaded bishop is of little value, but I think you're referring to a pawn.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Right. I am a pawn.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I know. It's times like this that I'm thankful Dad has little to no interest in almost everything I do. Bart, I think I can help you.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Our journey begins here at the library.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Mrs. Norton.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hi, Ralph.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, gang. Okay, Bart, this is the card catalog.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Let's see, "golf"... Anecdotes, Eisenhower and, Fashion, Humor, Japanese Obsession With... ah, here it is. Putting.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: And, finally, the most important book of all, The Tao Te Ching by Lao Tzu.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, we can't afford all these books.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, we're just gonna borrow them.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, heh, heh. Gotcha.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I want you to shut off the logical part of your mind.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Embrace nothingness.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: You got it.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Become like an uncarved stone.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Done.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! You're just pretending to know what I'm talking about.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: True.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Well, it's very frustrating.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I'll bet.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, I have a riddle for you: What's the sound of one hand clapping?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Piece of cake.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No, Bart. It's a three-thousand-year-old riddle with no answer. It's supposed to clear your mind of conscious thought.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: No answer? Lisa, listen up.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Let's try another one: If a tree falls in the woods and no one's around, does it make a sound?

title: Bart vs. Thanksgiving
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I said NOW!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: But Bart, how can a sound exist if there's no one there to hear it?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Woooooooo!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: It is time.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: The basis of this game seems to be simple geometry. All you have to do is hit the ball here.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: I can't believe it... You've actually found a practical use for geometry.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Bart! What're you doing? Get down from there before the neighbors see --

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Hey, Simpson.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Flanders, I don't care what this looks like, Bart's gonna mop the floor with your son's ugly butt.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, sir, may the best man win.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, "may the best man win". The mating call of the loser.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Now, just a minute, Simpson. I think my son has a very good chance.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, yeah? Wanna bet?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Yeah, well, I'm not a betting man.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Oh, I'm a chicken, am I?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: That's right!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: All right, how's this for a wager? A batch of your wife's delicious blueberry muffins against one of my wife's homemade wind chimes!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What, are you afraid to make a real bet?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: No, I just --

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You know, Simpson, you're starting to annoy me.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: How about this Henny Penny? If Bart wins tomorrow, you have to mow my lawn.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: All right, and if Todd wins, you have to mow my lawn! And do a decent job of it, for a change!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Better yet, you have to mow my lawn in your wife's Sunday dress.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: You have yourself a bet, you jackaninny!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Read that back to me, Marge.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The father of the loser mows the lawn --

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Eh, eh, just a minute. "Loser" is such a harsh word. Couldn't we just say "the boy who doesn't win"?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh man. Fine.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: The father of the boy who doesn't win has to mow the lawn in his wife's Sunday dress.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: There you go.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Now I suppose you both have to sign this. I hope blood won't be necessary.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'm game if you are, Flanders.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Good gravy, what have I done?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Keep your left arm straight, Bart... rotate your shoulders...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Look, son, all I'm asking is that you try.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay, I'll try.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Anybody can try! I want you to win!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer?!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, give me your honest opinion. This? Or this?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Good morning, son! Oh, by the way, today's the day of the big tournament, and you'd better win!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: See you downstairs, boy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heh heh... that crazy Marmaduke...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Eighth hole.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Aim for the Octopus' third tentacle.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Twelfth hole.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Bank it off the pink tombstone.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Nirvana.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: A state of bliss attained through the extinction of the self.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here you go, Bart. A lumberjack's breakfast for my little golfer.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, Bart is on a strict diet of complex carbohydrates. Steak will make him logy.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh, well, what won't make him logy?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oatmeal.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oatmeal?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Oats are what a champion thoroughbred eats before he or she wins the Kentucky Derby.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: News flash, Lisa! Bart is not a horse. Eat your steak, boy.

title: Bart vs. Thanksgiving
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Mom, do I have to?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Bart, having never received any words of encouragement myself, I'm not sure how they're supposed to sound. But here goes. I believe in you.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, man!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Flanders, it's no use praying. I already did the same thing, and we can't both win.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Actually, Simpson, we were praying that no one gets hurt.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh... Well, Flan-ders, it doesn't matter. This time tomorrow, you'll be wearing high heels.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: No, you will.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Fraid not.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: 'Fraid so.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Fraid not.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: 'Fraid so.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: 'Fraid not infinity.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: 'Fraid so infinity plus one.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, man...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Tree falling in the woods. Tree falling in the woods. Tree falling in...

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Woo-hoo-hoo!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Mercy is for the weak, Todd.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: It's okay, son. You can recover.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, Bart. Remember what Vince Lombardi said: "If you lose, you're out of the family."

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ow.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: This is pretty tense, isn't it, Todd?

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Who wants to build character. Let's quit.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: We want to call it a draw, man.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Put her there, man!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: Well, Homer, our kids showed us something today, huh? By working together, we can both be winners. Thank heaven neither of us has to go through with that silly wager. Put 'er there, pal.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ohhh, so you're gonna welch on our bet?!

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: What are you talking about? Neither boy lost.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I got it right here in writing.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The father of the boy who doesn't win has to mow the lawn in his wife's Sunday dress.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Ned Flanders
spoken_words: But... neither, I mean we're both... I mean, you have to do it too.

title: Dead Putting Society
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: It's a small price to pay to see you humiliate yourself.
