spoken_words: Oh Hello, Mrs. Homer. I have brought an assortment of jerkies.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, didja swipe those from work?

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Certainly not. What has been implied here?

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: I just want to call attention to the fact that I'm not watching this fight. It's my form of non-violent protest.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, Homer, I brought ya...

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Quick, it's Moe. I gotta hide the mugs...

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, will you... Hey, go protest outside will ya, now!.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Hey, Homer. I brought you a mug.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oooh, thank you, Moe! I always wanted one of these.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Mr. Burns! Bart... quick. Hide the stuff I "borrowed" from work.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right, the stuff I stole from work!

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, okay.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Now, c'mon. Take all this, and this, put it in the closet.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Will you quit staring at me like that!

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, hello, Simpson.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: We were just in the neighborhood and thought we'd drop by.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ugh, ah, hello, Mr. Burns. Would you like to watch the fight?

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: The fight? Don't mind if I do. Oh, Simpson. Good news -- I brought some munchies. Smithers -- the Cheetos.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: No... No I... It wasn't me... It was it was my wife's, my wife's idea... yeah, yeah... I would never...

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, sure, sure. Be my guest.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Lisa, I brought you some lemonade for your protest.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Thanks, Mom. It doesn't seem to be going very well.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, don't give up. When you love somebody you have to have faith that in the end they will do the right thing.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, Lisa, Maggie...

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Come on, boy.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Excuse me. I hate to interrupt your judging me, but I wanted you to know I've made a couple of really important decisions. Number one: I'm cutting the cable as soon as the fight's over. And Number Two: I'm not very fond of any of you.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, we may have saved your soul.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Yeah, at the worst possible time.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Everyone to my place for blueberry Squishees and microwave burritos!

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The greatest fight ever and I missed it.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: We're really proud of you, Dad.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: What a donnybrook game, Mr. Burns.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: C. Montgomery Burns
spoken_words: Oh, hogwash! Why, I once watched Gentleman Jim Corbett fight an Eskimo fellow bare-knuckled for a hundred and thirteen rounds. Back then, of course, if a fight lasted less than fifty rounds, we demanded our nickel back.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Cable clippers, please.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Here you go, Homie.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Go for it Dad!

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Dad, I beg you to reconsider. Tractor pulls, Atlanta Braves baseball, Joe Franklin...

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oops.

title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Third time's the charm.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ooh! Barbecue!

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: This is like some beautiful dream.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: One. And two. And three. And reach. And five. And six. And seven..

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, honey, I've got five words to say to you. Greasy Joe's Bottomless Bar-B-Q Pit.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, remember you promised you'd try to limit pork to six servings a week?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: See me again tomorrow?

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Marge, I'm only human. Now look, here's what we're gonna do. We'll unload the kids on Patty and Selma Saturday night. And then we'll eat until they kick us out of the place. Just like old times.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Saturday night? I'm not even sure my sisters will be available.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll take that bet.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well if you have other plans...

title: Principal Charming
name: Rev. Timothy Lovejoy
spoken_words: Friends, relatives, work-related acquaintances, we are gathered here today to join Stanley and Martha in holy matrimony.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Then the day after that.

title: Principal Charming
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: Poor Brandy. Aunt Selma, do you think you'll ever get married?

title: Principal Charming
name: Lisa Simpson
spoken_words: No. And, since I'm sure that you'd only resent the pity of an eight-year-old niece, I'll simply hope that you're one of the statistically insignificant forty-year-old single women who ever find their fair Prince.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Patty! Selma! We're home.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: I'll tell you one thing, Greasy Joe is sorry he ever saw the likes of me.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh and that sauce, Barney. I could have drunk a bowl of it by itself! No Barney, that's just my sister-in-law.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well... I'll try.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer? Do you remember our last family vacation when you made us go to the Bowler's Hall of Fame in St. Louis, Missouri so you could see that car shaped like a giant bowling pin?

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Remember? Who could forget?

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Then you'll also remember that you owe me a favor...

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: ...to be called up whenever and for whatever reason I desire.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But that was just an idle promise.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Not to me.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: I want you to find a husband for my sister Selma.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Find a husband? Which one's Selma again?

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: She's the one who likes Police Academy movies and Hummel figurines and walking through the park on clear autumn days.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. But I thought she didn't like to be... you know, touched.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's Patty who chose the life of celibacy. Selma simply had celibacy thrust upon her.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But Marge...

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, you will find her a man.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: All right.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: And not just any man.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He should be honest... and caring... and well off... and handsome...

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey! Why should she have a better husband than you do?

title: Principal Charming
name: Edna Krabappel-Flanders
spoken_words: Sodium tetrasulfate is highly caustic and can remove your skin. Say when!

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's this stuff for?

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: What's a herbicide?

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Must find man. Must find man. Must find man.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Boy, a good man really is hard to find.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Gentlemen, according to my sources you are planning to simultaneously drop your pencils at 2:15 this afternoon. Do so and you will be suspended.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Vandalism fans, hold on to your hats!

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: One seafood burrito, Apu.

title: Principal Charming
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: I am loathe to interrupt your meditation. But the time has come for money to change hands.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Sorry.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Say what they will about our cafeteria, I-I still think they're the best Tater Tots money can buy.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Wait a minute... that smells like sodium tetrasulfate bonding with chlorophyll!

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Sweet Lord it is!

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: SIMPSON!!!

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart, I'm flabbergasted. Surely you knew, as you were writing your own name in forty-foot-high letters in the field, that you would be caught.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Maybe it was one of the other Barts, Sir.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: There are no other Barts!

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh-oh.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The sheer contempt demonstrated by this incident makes me wish I could pull the trusty board of education out of retirement.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Call your father immediately.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Hello, is Homer there?

title: Principal Charming
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Homer who?

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Homer Sexual.

title: Principal Charming
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Just a minute, let me check. Homer Sexual. Come on, come on. One of you guys must be Homer Sexual!

title: Principal Charming
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Why you rotten little punk! If I ever get a hold of you, I'll sink my teeth into your cheek and rip your face off!

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You'll do what, young man?

title: Principal Charming
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Wait a minute. Who is this?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I think the real question is who is this and where is Homer Simpson?

title: Principal Charming
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Oh, sorry Principal Skinner. It must be a bad connection. It's for you. I think Bart's in trouble again.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: What is it this time?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'm afraid this time the victims are the innocent blades of grass on Groundskeeper Willie's award-winning play field. If it's all right with you, Bart will repay his debt to society through back-breaking physical labor, re-sodding the field manually, seed by seed.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But enough about Bart. Tell me, Principal Skinner, are you married?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Only to my job.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But if you weren't married to your job, you'd tend to go for a girl, right?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, of course. These pants come off at night just like everyone else's. But tell me, why all the questions?

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, no reason, really. I was just wondering if you know, you'd like to come over to my house for dinner. A payback for all the crummy things Bart has done to your school.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, a home-cooked meal would be a nice change of pace. I'd be delighted!

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Excellent.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Good evening, Principal Skinner and welcome to our home.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well thank you, Bart. I only hope that for the next few hours you and I can leave our differences in the schoolyard.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Fine. Now just get inside already.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: He's here.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Now, Simpson. I-I had a discomforting thought on the way over here. This dinner wouldn't be a master plan of yours to set me up with some unmarried relation? Because I can assure you that...

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I... ah... muh... Be still my foolish heart.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Heh heh heh. Here we go. Boy meets beast. Principal Skinner, allow me to introduce you to my wife's lovely and available sister, Selma.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Sel-ma.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Wha...?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Pat-ty.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: So Patty, tell me more about your trip to Egypt.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Marvelous. Just marvelous.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Selma hated Egypt, too. A camel spit on her.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, yes. I've heard they can be difficult. Patty, the Parents Advisory Board has asked that I attend the premiere of Space Mutants Part 5 tomorrow night. Would you be interested in joining me?

title: Principal Charming
name: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon
spoken_words: Here you go. Smoke them in good health. And will you be needing any lottery tickets with that?

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Stupid - Principal - Skinner. No - sense - of - humor.

title: Principal Charming
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: Save your strength, lad. There's a whole field for to resod yet.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Bart, you wouldn't happen to know what sort of candy your Aunt Patty likes, would you?

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Cherry cordials, sir.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Very good. Now then, regarding your punishment... do you feel that you've learned your lesson?

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Have I ever. Just the thought of doing anything bad again makes my stomach turn.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, then, you are free to go.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Well, Willie, you can take it from here. Adios, dude.

title: Principal Charming
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: You'll be back!

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: C'mon, Patty. You don't want to show up looking like Yosemite Sam.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
raw_location_text: Hallway Outside Selma And Patty's Apt.
spoken_words: "Two and Two are Four, Four and Four are Eight, Eight and Eight are Sixteen..."

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
raw_location_text: Hallway Outside Selma And Patty's Apt.
spoken_words: Cherry cordials. I hope you like 'em.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
raw_location_text: Hallway Outside Selma And Patty's Apt.
spoken_words: Ah, excellent suggestion. I suggest we start with The Springfield Revolving Restaurant. You know, food tastes better when you're revolving.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
raw_location_text: Hallway Outside Selma And Patty's Apt.
spoken_words: Indeed. Truly terrible.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Indeed, truly terrible.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Well, well, well. If it isn't little Jimmy Pearson. Class of '71 I believe.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Pearson, get this woman a glass of water, immediately! And tuck in your shirt.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Nearly thirty and still working as a busboy. Standardized testing never lies.

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Well, don't worry. There are still plenty of fish in the sea. Right, Homer?

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh yes, plenty of fish. We just don't have any bait.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hmm.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh.. uh... sorry.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Hello, Dolly.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, that was the worst film I've ever seen.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Isn't it nice we hate the same things?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: The day after that, then.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Kiss me, Patty. I don't have cooties.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Until then!

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I wish I could make a P.A. announcement to the whole world. Attention, everyone: Seymour Skinner is in love!

title: Principal Charming
name: Milhouse Van Houten
spoken_words: Bart, Skinner's gonna kill you.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Skinner? He works for me now.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Simpson!

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Uh oh.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: What is that there?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Ah... Bart, I hate to pull you away from your daily exercise, but ... well...

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I wanted you to be the first to know. I'm going to ask for your Aunt Patty's hand in marriage.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Your funeral, Seymour.

title: Principal Charming
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Lighten up, Homer. You're making Happy Hour bitterly ironic.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Ah, Moe. I've gotta find a date for my big, fat, snotty sister-in-law, Selma.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Like my wife's ugly sister.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I can't afford that! I'm an educator.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Seymour?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: I'll take it!

title: Principal Charming
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Homer, my sister is not going out with Barney Gumbel.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Hey, Selma's no prize pig herself you know.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Okay.

title: Principal Charming
name: Bart Simpson
spoken_words: Principal Skinner is going to ask Aunt Patty to marry him.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: But' nothing, Marge. She's a heifer, plain and simple.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Oh, there's the little prom queen now.

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Is that Selma? Ring-a-ding-ding!

title: Principal Charming
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Take it to the hoop, Selma.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You seem preoccupied tonight, my little... pudding cup.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, well there's something up here that will pick up your spirit.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: It's the second most precious jewel in this bell tower. Patty, the question before you is will you marry me?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Just say whatever's in your heart.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You love me! Caloo Calay!

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: But?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: You have a special tie to your sister...

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: ... that you couldn't leave your sister for any man. Oh.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: See you again?

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Farewell, my Pattycake.

title: Principal Charming
name: Seymour Skinner
spoken_words: Oh, Springfield Elementary! I will have you back again! After all, tomorrow is another school day!

title: Principal Charming
name: Moe Szyslak
spoken_words: Don't worry, Barney. Time heals all wounds.

title: Principal Charming
name: Groundskeeper Willie
spoken_words: I told you you'd be back!

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?

spoken_words: ... And thank you most of all for nuclear power, which is yet to cause a single proven fatality, at least in this country. Amen.

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: Quiet, you kids! If I hear one more word, Bart doesn't get to watch cartoons and Lisa doesn't get to go to college.

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?

spoken_words: Da-ad!...

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?

spoken_words: We didn't say anything.

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: Telephone, Homer.

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
name: Marge Simpson
spoken_words: It's the hospital.

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
name: Homer Simpson
spoken_words: The hospital? Y'ello... Oh my God!

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
name: Dr. Julius Hibbert
spoken_words: Homer, I'm happy to say that your father only had a mild arrhythmia.

title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
